atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

summary.zh: 日本关东军炸毁南满铁路柳条湖段并进攻沈阳北大营，中国抗日战争由此开始。
summary.en: The Japanese Kwantung Army blew up the South Manchuria Railway near Liutiaohu and attacked Beidaying in Shenyang, beginning China’s war of resistance.

fields.name: 九一八事变 Mukden Incident 沈阳事变 Shenyang Incident
fields.summary: 日本关东军炸毁南满铁路柳条湖段并进攻沈阳北大营，中国抗日战争由此开始。 The Japanese Kwantung Army blew up the South Manchuria Railway near Liutiaohu and attacked Beidaying in Shenyang, beginning China’s war of resistance.
fields.description: 1931 年 9 月 18 日夜，日本关东军自行炸毁沈阳北郊柳条湖附近的南满铁路路轨，反诬中国军队所为，随即进攻东北军北大营和沈阳城。此后数月，日军侵占东北大部。 本事件日期与地点为通行说法，具体战斗经过待史料校订。 On the night of 18 September 1931, the Japanese Kwantung Army destroyed a section of the South Manchuria Railway near Liutiaohu, blamed Chinese troops, and attacked Beidaying and Shenyang. Within months Japanese forces occupied most of the Northeast. Dates and locations follow conventional accounts; details await historical review.

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

summary.zh: 九一八事变次日，日军关东军进攻长春，中国守军抵抗后撤退，长春陷落。
summary.en: The day after the Mukden Incident, Japanese Kwantung Army forces attacked Changchun; the Chinese defenders withdrew and the city fell.

fields.name: 长春沦陷 Fall of Changchun
fields.summary: 九一八事变次日，日军关东军进攻长春，中国守军抵抗后撤退，长春陷落。 The day after the Mukden Incident, Japanese Kwantung Army forces attacked Changchun; the Chinese defenders withdrew and the city fell.
fields.description: 1931 年 9 月 19 日，关东军第 2 师团等部向长春发动进攻，驻长春中国军队与日军激战后退往吉林方向，长春当日陷落。长春是南满铁路与中东铁路交会点，沦陷后成为日军控制吉林、黑龙江的重要基地。日期与作战经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 19 September 1931 the Japanese 2nd Division and other Kwantung Army units attacked Changchun. The Chinese garrison fought briefly and withdrew toward Jilin, and the city fell the same day. As the junction of the South Manchuria and Chinese Eastern railways, Changchun became an important base for Japanese control of Jilin and Heilongjiang. Dates and operational details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1931年9月19日，日军独立守备队第三大队侵占营口。
summary.en: On 19 September 1931 the Japanese 3rd Independent Guard Battalion occupied Yingkou.

fields.name: 营口沦陷 Fall of Yingkou
fields.summary: 1931年9月19日，日军独立守备队第三大队侵占营口。 On 19 September 1931 the Japanese 3rd Independent Guard Battalion occupied Yingkou.
fields.description: 1931年9月19日晨8时，日军独立守备队第三大队侵入营口，包围县政府、公安局及其他机关，缴去练军营官兵及警察枪械，炸毁电报、电话及河北车站无线电台。日期据《1931年9月18日“九一八”事变爆发》与《中共中央最早关注营口的1931年九一八事变宣言》。 At 8 a.m. on 19 September 1931 the Japanese 3rd Independent Guard Battalion entered Yingkou, surrounded the county government, police bureau and other offices, disarmed the militia and police, and blew up the telegraph, telephone and wireless station at Hebei station.

summary.zh: 1931年9月19日，日军独立守备队侵占安东（今丹东）。
summary.en: On 19 September 1931 the Japanese Independent Guard Battalion occupied Andong (modern Dandong).

fields.name: 安东沦陷 Fall of Andong
fields.summary: 1931年9月19日，日军独立守备队侵占安东（今丹东）。 On 19 September 1931 the Japanese Independent Guard Battalion occupied Andong (modern Dandong).
fields.description: 1931年9月19日晨5时，日军铁道独立守备队200余人分两路侵入安东市街，包围县政府、公安局，公安队和警察未抵抗即被缴械。安东为安奉铁路终点、中朝边境重镇，失守后日军控制鸭绿江下游。日期据《1931年9月18日“九一八”事变爆发》与《东北沦陷时期丹东大事记》。 At 5 a.m. on 19 September 1931 more than 200 men of the Japanese railway independent guard entered Andong in two columns, surrounded the county government and police bureau and disarmed the police without resistance. Andong was the terminus of the Anfeng railway and the key border town on the Yalu; its fall gave Japan control of the lower Yalu.

summary.zh: 1931年9月19日，日军侵占抚顺。
summary.en: On 19 September 1931 the Japanese occupied Fushun.

fields.name: 抚顺沦陷 Fall of Fushun
fields.summary: 1931年9月19日，日军侵占抚顺。 On 19 September 1931 the Japanese occupied Fushun.
fields.description: 1931年9月19日，日军在侵占沈阳的同时，沿南满铁路占据抚顺。抚顺为东北最大煤矿区，日军占领后由满铁控制煤矿开采；次年9月16日又在平顶山制造惨案。日期据《1931年9月18日“九一八”事变爆发》与《九一八事变，侵占东北（1）》。 On 19 September 1931, while taking Shenyang, the Japanese occupied Fushun along the South Manchuria Railway. Fushun was the largest coal-mining area in the Northeast; after occupation the South Manchuria Railway Company controlled its mines, and on 16 September 1932 the Japanese carried out the Pingdingshan massacre.

summary.zh: 1931年9月19日，日军第2师团侵占辽阳。
summary.en: On 19 September 1931 the Japanese 2nd Division occupied Liaoyang.

fields.name: 辽阳沦陷 Fall of Liaoyang
fields.summary: 1931年9月19日，日军第2师团侵占辽阳。 On 19 September 1931 the Japanese 2nd Division occupied Liaoyang.
fields.description: 1931年9月19日，驻辽阳的日军第2师团主力于凌晨5时抵沈阳，参加进攻沈阳；同日辽阳亦被日军控制。辽阳为南满铁路要地，第2师团司令部原驻于此。日期据《1931年9月18日“九一八”事变爆发》与《九一八事变，侵占东北（1）》。 On 19 September 1931 the main force of the Japanese 2nd Division, stationed at Liaoyang, reached Shenyang at 5 a.m. and joined the attack on the city; Liaoyang itself was also brought under Japanese control the same day. Liaoyang was a key point on the South Manchuria Railway and the original seat of the 2nd Division headquarters.

summary.zh: 1931年9月19日，日军侵占鞍山。
summary.en: On 19 September 1931 the Japanese occupied Anshan.

fields.name: 鞍山沦陷 Fall of Anshan
fields.summary: 1931年9月19日，日军侵占鞍山。 On 19 September 1931 the Japanese occupied Anshan.
fields.description: 1931年9月19日，日军在侵占沈阳的同时占领鞍山。鞍山为南满铁路沿线铁矿重镇，日本独立守备队第六大队此前已驻鞍山“满铁附属地”；失守后鞍山铁矿被日本控制。日期据《1931年9月18日“九一八”事变爆发》与《鞍山地区抗日斗争的特点》。 On 19 September 1931 the Japanese occupied Anshan together with Shenyang. Anshan was an iron-mining town on the South Manchuria Railway, and the Japanese 6th Independent Guard Battalion had already been stationed in its railway concession; after the fall the Anshan mines came under Japanese control.

summary.zh: 1931年9月19日，日军侵占铁岭。
summary.en: On 19 September 1931 the Japanese occupied Tieling.

fields.name: 铁岭沦陷 Fall of Tieling
fields.summary: 1931年9月19日，日军侵占铁岭。 On 19 September 1931 the Japanese occupied Tieling.
fields.description: 1931年9月19日凌晨4时，驻铁岭日军独立守备队赶赴沈阳，参加进攻北大营；同日铁岭亦被日军控制。铁岭为南满铁路要地，失守后日军控制沈阳以北铁路。日期据《1931年9月18日“九一八”事变爆发》与《九一八事变，侵占东北（1）》。 At 4 a.m. on 19 September 1931 the Japanese independent guard at Tieling rushed to Shenyang and joined the attack on Beidaying; Tieling itself was also brought under control that day. Tieling was a key point on the South Manchuria Railway, and its fall gave Japan control of the railway north of Shenyang.

summary.en: On 19 September 1931 the Japanese occupied Benxi.

fields.name: 本溪沦陷 Fall of Benxi
fields.summary: 1931年9月19日，日军侵占本溪。 On 19 September 1931 the Japanese occupied Benxi.
fields.description: 1931年9月19日，日军在侵占沈阳、安东的同时占领本溪。本溪为安奉铁路沿线煤铁重镇，失守后日军控制本溪湖煤矿。日期据《1931年9月18日“九一八”事变爆发》与《九一八事变，侵占东北（1）》。 On 19 September 1931 the Japanese occupied Benxi together with Shenyang and Andong. Benxi was a coal-and-iron town on the Anfeng railway, and its fall gave Japan control of the Benxihu mines.

summary.zh: 1931年9月19日，日军侵占海城。
summary.en: On 19 September 1931 the Japanese occupied Haicheng.

fields.name: 海城沦陷 Fall of Haicheng
fields.summary: 1931年9月19日，日军侵占海城。 On 19 September 1931 the Japanese occupied Haicheng.
fields.description: 1931年9月19日晨8时，海城县城被日军全部占领；驻海城车站的日军独立守备队一个中队包围县政府，将县长、公安局长押往日本兵营。海城为南满铁路要地，失守后日军控制辽南交通。日期据《1931年9月18日“九一八”事变爆发》与《东北抗日义勇军大事记》。 At 8 a.m. on 19 September 1931 the Japanese fully occupied Haicheng; a company of the independent guard from the station surrounded the county government and took the county magistrate and police chief to the Japanese barracks. Haicheng was a key point on the South Manchuria Railway, and its fall gave Japan control of communications in southern Liaoning.

summary.zh: 1931年9月19日，日军侵占盖平（今盖州）。
summary.en: On 19 September 1931 the Japanese occupied Gaiping (modern Gaizhou).

fields.name: 盖平沦陷 Fall of Gaiping
fields.summary: 1931年9月19日，日军侵占盖平（今盖州）。 On 19 September 1931 the Japanese occupied Gaiping (modern Gaizhou).
fields.description: 1931年9月19日，日军独立守备队第三大队自大石桥南犯，占领盖平（今盖州）。盖平为南满铁路辽南段要地，失守后日军继续南犯复县、瓦房店。日期据《1931年9月18日“九一八”事变爆发》与《中共中央最早关注营口的1931年九一八事变宣言》。 On 19 September 1931 the Japanese 3rd Independent Guard Battalion advanced south from Dashiqiao and occupied Gaiping (modern Gaizhou). Gaiping was a key point on the southern section of the South Manchuria Railway; the Japanese then moved on Fuxian and Wafangdian.

fields.summary: 1931年9月19日，日军独立守备队侵占凤城。 On 19 September 1931 the Japanese independent guard occupied Fengcheng.
fields.description: 1931年9月19日凌晨2时，日军从凤城以北四台子下火车，分两路包围县城，缴去姜全我部第一团官兵455名及公安警察200余名枪械，兵不血刃占领凤城。凤城为安奉铁路要地，失守后日军控制辽东。日期据《1931年9月18日“九一八”事变爆发》与《东北抗日义勇军大事记》。 At 2 a.m. on 19 September 1931 the Japanese left their train north of Fengcheng at Sitai and surrounded the county town in two columns, disarming 455 officers and men of Jiang Quanwo’s 1st Regiment and more than 200 police, taking Fengcheng without a fight. Fengcheng was a key point on the Anfeng railway, and its fall gave Japan control of eastern Liaoning.

name.en: China’s Appeal to the League of Nations

summary.zh: 中国代表施肇基援引《国联盟约》第十一条向国联申诉，要求制止日军进攻、恢复事变前状态。
summary.en: Chinese representative Sao-Ke Alfred Sze appealed to the League of Nations under Article 11 of the Covenant, asking it to stop the Japanese advance and restore the status quo ante.

fields.name: 中国向国联申诉九一八事变 China’s Appeal to the League of Nations
fields.summary: 中国代表施肇基援引《国联盟约》第十一条向国联申诉，要求制止日军进攻、恢复事变前状态。 Chinese representative Sao-Ke Alfred Sze appealed to the League of Nations under Article 11 of the Covenant, asking it to stop the Japanese advance and restore the status quo ante.
fields.description: 1931 年 9 月 21 日，中国驻国联代表施肇基向国联秘书长递交声明书，援引《国联盟约》第十一条，控告日本侵略中国领土，要求国联行政院立即采取行动，阻止事态扩大、恢复九一八事变前的状态，并确定中国应得的赔偿。 国民政府把制止日本侵略的希望主要寄托于国联调处，但国联行政院仅向中日双方发出内容相同的“紧急警告”，未将日本定为侵略者，也未采取制裁。此后国联决定派遣调查团，即李顿调查团。 外交事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。 On 21 September 1931 Chinese representative Sao-Ke Alfred Sze submitted a note to the League of Nations Secretary-General invoking Article 11 of the Covenant, accusing Japan of invading Chinese territory and asking the Council to stop the widening of the incident, restore the status quo ante, and determine reparations. The Nationalist government placed its main hope in League mediation, but the Council only issued identical urgent warnings to both sides, neither naming Japan the aggressor nor imposing sanctions. The League subsequently decided to send a commission of inquiry — the Lytton Commission. A diplomatic event with no route drawn; dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

fields.description: 1931 年 9 月 21 日，日军第 2 师团一部沿吉长铁路进攻吉林省城吉林，代理吉林省主席熙洽下令不抵抗，日军占领吉林。吉林沦陷使日军迅速控制吉林省大部。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 21 September 1931 a detachment of the Japanese 2nd Division advanced along the Jilin–Changchun railway toward Jilin City. Acting Jilin governor Xi Qia ordered no resistance, and the Japanese occupied the city, rapidly extending their control over most of Jilin province. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

fields.description: 1931 年 11 月，日军第 2 师团等部沿洮昂铁路北犯，在嫩江江桥遭马占山部抗击。11 月 19 日，日军占领齐齐哈尔，黑龙江省城沦陷。江桥抗战是九一八后中国军队有组织的抵抗之一。日期与兵力为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In November 1931 the Japanese 2nd Division and other units advanced north along the Tao’ang railway and met resistance from Ma Zhanshan’s forces at the Nen River bridge. On 19 November the Japanese occupied Qiqihar, the provincial capital. The Jiangqiao resistance was one of the first organized Chinese military stands after the Mukden Incident. fields.name: 锦州沦陷 Fall of Jinzhou
fields.summary: 日军西进占领锦州，东北军退入关内，辽西沦陷。 Japanese forces advanced west and took Jinzhou; the Northeast Army withdrew inside the Great Wall, leaving western Liaoning occupied.
fields.description: 九一八事变后，日军沿南满铁路向北推进，同时西进辽西。1932 年 1 月 3 日占领锦州，东北军在张学良命令下未作有力抵抗即退入关内，辽西与热河门户洞开。 日期与地点取通行说法，待史料校订。 After the Mukden Incident, Japanese forces pushed north along the South Manchuria Railway and west into western Liaoning. They occupied Jinzhou on 3 January 1932; the Northeast Army, under Zhang Xueliang’s orders, withdrew inside the Great Wall without effective resistance, leaving western Liaoning and the approaches to Rehe open. Dates and locations follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

fields.description: 1932年1月4日，日军侵犯绥中县、葫芦岛。绥中为辽西走廊西端、山海关以东要地，失守后日军直逼山海关。日期据《中华民族抗日编年（1932年1月）》与《东北抗日义勇军大事记》。 On 4 January 1932 the Japanese invaded Suizhong and Huludao. Suizhong was the western end of the western Liaoning corridor, east of Shanhaiguan; its fall brought the Japanese to the gates of Shanhaiguan.

fields.name: 义县沦陷 Fall of Yi County
fields.place: 辽宁义县 Yi County, Liaoning
fields.summary: 1932年1月7日，日军嘉村旅团自锦州向义县推进并占领义县。 On 7 January 1932 the Japanese Kamura brigade advanced from Jinzhou and occupied Yi County.
fields.description: 1932年1月7日，日军嘉村旅团自锦州向义县、北票推进，占领义县。义县为锦州通往热河的门户，失守后日军窥伺热河。日期据《中华民族抗日编年（1932年1月）》与维基百科《1932年中国》。 On 7 January 1932 the Japanese Kamura brigade advanced from Jinzhou toward Yi County and Beipiao and occupied Yi County. Yi County was the gateway from Jinzhou to Rehe, and its fall opened the Japanese approach to Rehe.

fields.description: 1932年1月11日，日军依田旅团攻占锦西县城（江家屯）。1月9日锦西义勇军在江家屯伏击日军骑兵第27联队，击毙联队长古贺传太郎以下百余人；1月18日日军被迫放弃锦西县城。日期据《中华民族抗日编年（1932年1月）》与《义勇军“江家屯大捷”》。 On 11 January 1932 the Japanese Ida brigade captured Jinxi (Jiangjiatun). On 9 January the Jinxi guerrillas ambushed the Japanese 27th Cavalry Regiment at Jiangjiatun, killing Colonel Koga Densaburo and over a hundred men; on 18 January the Japanese abandoned the county town.

fields.summary: 1932年1月13日，日军高地大队侵占北镇。 On 13 January 1932 the Japanese Takachi detachment occupied Beizhen.
fields.description: 1932年1月13日，日军占领锦州后派高地少佐一个大队向北镇进犯，驱散民团，占据北镇。北镇为辽西义勇军活动中心，失守后日军对北镇、黑山、台安等县大规模搜村。日期据《东北抗日义勇军大事记》与《中华民族抗日编年（1932年1月）》。 On 13 January 1932, after taking Jinzhou, the Japanese sent a battalion under Major Takachi against Beizhen, dispersed the militia and occupied the town. Beizhen was a centre of the western Liaoning guerrillas; after its fall the Japanese conducted large-scale sweeps through Beizhen, Heishan and Tai’an counties.

fields.name: 一·二八事变 January 28 Incident 淞沪抗战 January 28 Resistance
fields.summary: 日军进攻上海闸北，第十九路军等部奋起抵抗，淞沪地区爆发激烈战斗。 Japanese forces attacked Zhabei in Shanghai; the 19th Route Army and other Chinese units resisted in fierce fighting.
fields.description: 1932 年 1 月 28 日，日军以保护侨民为借口进攻上海闸北。第十九路军在蒋光鼐、蔡廷锴指挥下抵抗，双方在淞沪地区激战至 3 月。5 月，中日签订《淞沪停战协定》。 本事件日期与地点为通行说法，待史料校订。 On 28 January 1932, Japanese forces attacked Zhabei in Shanghai under the pretext of protecting residents. The 19th Route Army, commanded by Jiang Guangnai and Cai Tingkai, resisted until March. In May, China and Japan signed the Shanghai Ceasefire Agreement. Dates and locations follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

fields.name: 哈尔滨沦陷 Fall of Harbin
fields.place: 黑龙江哈尔滨 Harbin, Heilongjiang
fields.summary: 日军占领哈尔滨，东北主要城市至此基本沦陷。 Japanese forces captured Harbin, completing the occupation of the Northeast’s major cities.
fields.description: 1932 年 2 月 5 日，日军进入哈尔滨。此前齐齐哈尔、锦州等地已相继失守，东北三省主要城市至此基本被日军控制。 本事件为路线分段端点，日期取通行说法，待史料校订。 Japanese troops entered Harbin on 5 February 1932. Qiqihar, Jinzhou, and other cities had already fallen, leaving the major cities of the three northeastern provinces largely under Japanese control. This event marks a route segment endpoint; the date follows conventional accounts and awaits historical review.

fields.description: 1932 年 3 月 1 日，日本扶植清朝末代皇帝溥仪在长春成立伪满洲国，随后以“日满议定书”等形式加以控制。中国政府与国际联盟均未承认该政权。 本事件为政治事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述待史料校订。 On 1 March 1932, Japan installed Puyi, the last Qing emperor, as head of the puppet state of Manchukuo in Changchun, later controlling it through agreements such as the Japan-Manchukuo Protocol. Neither the Chinese government nor the League of Nations recognized the regime. This is a political event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

name.zh: 国联李顿调查团赴东北

summary.zh: 国际联盟调查团抵达沈阳调查九一八事变；报告否认伪满洲国合法性，但未认定日本为侵略者。
summary.en: The League of Nations commission reached Shenyang to investigate the Mukden Incident; its report denied Manchukuo’s legitimacy but did not name Japan an aggressor.

fields.name: 国联李顿调查团赴东北 Lytton Commission in the Northeast
fields.summary: 国际联盟调查团抵达沈阳调查九一八事变；报告否认伪满洲国合法性，但未认定日本为侵略者。 The League of Nations commission reached Shenyang to investigate the Mukden Incident; its report denied Manchukuo’s legitimacy but did not name Japan an aggressor.
fields.description: 1932 年 4 月 21 日，国际联盟李顿调查团抵达沈阳，开始调查九一八事变后的东北局势。调查团由英、美、法、德、意五国代表组成，英国代表李顿任团长；中国代表顾维钧以顾问（襄助委员）身份参加。 调查团不是中国政府派出的：1931 年 9 月 21 日中国政府向国联申诉，同年 12 月 10 日国联行政院决议派遣调查团。中国政府是申诉方和当事国，负责接待与配合，但调查的发起、组成和结论都出自国联。 调查团 10 月 2 日公布报告书，承认东北是中国领土、否认伪满洲国的合法性，但未将日本定为侵略者，主张国际共管。1933 年 2 月国联大会通过报告书，日本随后退出国联。 国际事件，不绘制路线；日期、职务与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。 On 21 April 1932 the League of Nations Lytton Commission reached Shenyang and began investigating the situation in the Northeast after the Mukden Incident. The commission consisted of representatives of Britain, the United States, France, Germany, and Italy, with the British representative Lord Lytton as chairman; the Chinese representative Wellington Koo took part as assessor. The commission was not sent by the Chinese government: China appealed to the League on 21 September 1931, and the League Council resolved on 10 December 1931 to send a commission of inquiry. China was the complainant and the party concerned and handled reception and cooperation, but the initiative, composition, and conclusions belonged to the League. The report, published on 2 October 1932, recognized the Northeast as Chinese territory and denied the legality of Manchukuo, but did not name Japan as an aggressor and proposed international administration. The League Assembly adopted the report in February 1933, and Japan withdrew from the League soon afterwards. An international event with no route drawn; dates, titles, and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

fields.name: 《淞沪停战协定》签署 Signing of the Shanghai Ceasefire Agreement
fields.summary: 中日签订《淞沪停战协定》，一·二八事变结束，中国军队退出上海市区。 China and Japan signed the Shanghai Ceasefire Agreement, ending the January 28 Incident and requiring Chinese troops to withdraw from urban Shanghai.
fields.description: 1932 年 5 月 5 日，中日双方签订《淞沪停战协定》，规定上海为非武装区，中国军队不得驻守市区，日军则可留驻部分区域。一·二八事变至此结束，但协定被舆论视为屈辱让步。 外交事件，不绘制路线；日期与地点取通行说法，待史料校订。 On 5 May 1932 China and Japan signed the Shanghai Ceasefire Agreement, making Shanghai a demilitarized zone: Chinese troops were barred from the urban area while Japanese forces could remain in parts of it. The January 28 Incident thus ended, though the agreement was widely seen as a humiliating concession. A diplomatic event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

fields.description: 1932 年 5 月《淞沪停战协定》签订后，第十九路军由上海调驻福建。1933 年 11 月，该部在福州发动福建事变，另立政府，次年失败。 路线为示意简化，日期取通行说法，待史料校订。 After the Shanghai Ceasefire Agreement of May 1932, the 19th Route Army moved from Shanghai to Fujian. In November 1933 it launched the Fujian Incident at Fuzhou and formed a separate government, which collapsed the following year. Illustrative simplified route; dates follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

summary.zh: 日本与伪满洲国签订《日满议定书》，正式承认伪满并取得驻军、经营铁路等权益。
summary.en: Japan and the puppet state of Manchukuo signed the Japan–Manchukuo Protocol, formalizing Japanese recognition and securing garrison and railway rights.

fields.name: 《日满议定书》签订 Signing of the Japan–Manchukuo Protocol
fields.place: 吉林长春（伪满称“新京”） Changchun, Jilin (Japanese puppet capital “Xinjing”)
fields.summary: 日本与伪满洲国签订《日满议定书》，正式承认伪满并取得驻军、经营铁路等权益。 Japan and the puppet state of Manchukuo signed the Japan–Manchukuo Protocol, formalizing Japanese recognition and securing garrison and railway rights.
fields.description: 1932 年 9 月 15 日，日本驻伪满特命全权大使武藤信义与伪满洲国总理郑孝胥在长春签订《日满议定书》。日本据此承认伪满洲国，并取得在伪满驻军、管理铁路和开发资源等特权，东北进一步被纳入日本殖民统治体系。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 15 September 1932 Japanese ambassador Mutō Nobuyoshi and Manchukuo premier Zheng Xiaoxu signed the Japan–Manchukuo Protocol in Changchun. Japan recognized the puppet state and secured privileges including troop stationing, railway management and resource development, drawing Northeast China further into its colonial system. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 平顶山惨案 Pingdingshan Massacre
fields.place: 辽宁抚顺平顶山 Pingdingshan, Fushun, Liaoning
fields.summary: 日军抚顺守备队在平顶山实施大屠杀，杀害大批矿工和平民。 Japanese garrison troops carried out a massacre at Pingdingshan near Fushun, killing a large number of miners and civilians.
fields.description: 1932 年 9 月 16 日，日军抚顺守备队以报复抗日义勇军袭击为由，包围抚顺平顶山村落，屠杀村民并焚毁房屋。具体死难人数各说不一，通行说法为三千人左右，待页码级核对。本事件为惨案，不绘路线。 On 16 September 1932 Japanese garrison troops at Fushun, claiming retaliation for an attack by anti-Japanese volunteers, surrounded the village of Pingdingshan, massacred residents and burned the houses. Accounts of the death toll differ; the conventional figure is about 3,000 and awaits page-level verification. As a massacre, this event is not drawn as a route.

fields.name: 岫岩沦陷 Fall of Xiuyan
fields.summary: 1932年12月16日，日军侵占岫岩县城。 On 16 December 1932 the Japanese occupied Xiuyan.
fields.description: 1932年12月中旬，日军以第2师团主力和守备队及伪军组成岫岩、庄河两个讨伐队，进攻辽南三角抗区。12月15日刘景文部义勇军在岫岩大偏岭阻击，16日上午11时日军进入岫岩县城。日期据《东北抗日义勇军大事记》与《东北沦陷时期丹东大事记》。 In mid-December 1932 the Japanese formed two punitive columns from the 2nd Division, guard units and puppet troops against the southern Liaoning triangle. On 15 December Liu Jingwen’s guerrillas fought a delaying action at Dapianling; at 11 a.m. on the 16th the Japanese entered Xiuyan.

summary.en: Japanese forces attacked Shanhaiguan; He Zhuguo’s Northeast Army troops resisted for three days before the pass fell, opening the Great Wall campaign.

fields.name: 榆关抗战 Defense of Shanhaiguan 山海关抗战 Battle of Shanhaiguan
fields.place: 河北山海关（今属秦皇岛） Shanhaiguan, Hebei (now Qinhuangdao)
fields.summary: 日军进攻山海关，东北军何柱国部抵抗，榆关三日失守，长城抗战序幕拉开。 Japanese forces attacked Shanhaiguan; He Zhuguo’s Northeast Army troops resisted for three days before the pass fell, opening the Great Wall campaign.
fields.description: 1933 年 1 月 1 日，日军以炮火进攻山海关，东北军第九旅何柱国部奋起抵抗。守军兵力单薄、后援不继，1 月 3 日榆关失守。此役是九一八事变后中国军队在华北的首次有组织抵抗，也被视为长城抗战的序幕。 日期与地点取通行说法，待史料校订。 On 1 January 1933 Japanese artillery opened the attack on Shanhaiguan, and He Zhuguo’s 9th Brigade of the Northeast Army resisted. With insufficient troops and no reinforcements, the pass fell on 3 January. It was the first organized Chinese resistance in North China after the Mukden Incident and is regarded as the opening of the Great Wall campaign. Dates and locations follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

fields.name: 日军进攻热河 Japanese Invasion of Rehe
fields.place: 热河朝阳（今属辽宁） Chaoyang, Rehe (now Liaoning)
fields.summary: 日军分路进攻热河，中国守军节节败退，承德于三月失守。 Japanese forces attacked Rehe along several axes; Chinese defenders fell back and Chengde was lost in March.
fields.description: 1933 年 2 月 21 日，关东军与伪军分路向热河进攻，中国守军指挥不一、士气低落，防线迅速崩溃。3 月 4 日日军占领承德，热河全省沦陷，东北全部落入日本控制，日军兵锋直指长城各口。 日期与地点取通行说法，待史料校订。 On 21 February 1933 the Kwantung Army and puppet troops attacked Rehe along several axes. Chinese defenders, poorly coordinated and demoralized, collapsed quickly. Chengde fell on 4 March, the whole province was occupied, and the Japanese advance reached the Great Wall passes. Dates and locations follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

name.zh: 国联大会通过李顿报告书
name.en: The League Assembly Adopts the Lytton Report

summary.zh: 国联大会通过李顿报告书，承认中国对东北的主权、不承认伪满洲国；日本随后退出国联。
summary.en: The League Assembly adopted the Lytton Report, recognizing Chinese sovereignty over the Northeast and denying Manchukuo; Japan then withdrew from the League.

fields.name: 国联大会通过李顿报告书 The League Assembly Adopts the Lytton Report
fields.summary: 国联大会通过李顿报告书，承认中国对东北的主权、不承认伪满洲国；日本随后退出国联。 The League Assembly adopted the Lytton Report, recognizing Chinese sovereignty over the Northeast and denying Manchukuo; Japan then withdrew from the League.
fields.description: 1933 年 2 月 24 日，国际联盟大会以压倒多数通过李顿报告书，承认东北是中国领土、不承认伪满洲国的合法性，要求日军撤出。日本投下唯一反对票，代表当场退场，并于 3 月 27 日正式退出国联；随后日军进攻热河，扩大侵华战争。 决议出自国联大会，中国政府是申诉方和受益方，但不是决议的制定者；国联也没有能力强制日本执行。 国际事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。 On 24 February 1933 the League of Nations Assembly adopted the Lytton Report by an overwhelming majority, recognizing Chinese sovereignty over the Northeast, denying the legality of Manchukuo, and calling for the withdrawal of Japanese troops. Japan cast the sole opposing vote; its delegate left the hall, and Japan formally withdrew from the League on 27 March. Japanese forces then attacked Rehe (Jehol), widening the war. The resolution came from the League Assembly; the Chinese government was the complainant and beneficiary, not the author, and the League had no means to enforce it. An international event with no route drawn; dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

summary.zh: 日军占领承德，热河全省沦陷，东北四省全部被日本控制。
summary.en: Japanese forces occupied Chengde and the whole of Rehe, completing the occupation of the four northeastern provinces.

fields.name: 承德失守 Fall of Chengde
fields.summary: 日军占领承德，热河全省沦陷，东北四省全部被日本控制。 Japanese forces occupied Chengde and the whole of Rehe, completing the occupation of the four northeastern provinces.
fields.description: 1933 年 3 月 4 日，日军先头部队进入承德，热河省主席汤玉麟此前已弃城逃走。热河沦陷后，东北四省全部被日本控制，日军与中国军队在长城一线形成对峙。 日期与地点取通行说法，待史料校订。 On 4 March 1933 Japanese advance units entered Chengde after provincial chairman Tang Yulin had fled. With Rehe lost, all four northeastern provinces were under Japanese control, and Japanese and Chinese forces faced each other along the Great Wall. Dates and locations follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

summary.zh: 第29军、第17军、第32军及东北军等部在喜峰口、罗文峪、古北口、冷口等关口抗击日军，最终以《塘沽协定》收场。
summary.en: The 29th, 17th, and 32nd Armies and Northeast Army units fought the Japanese at Xifengkou, Luowenyu, Gubeikou, and Lengkou until the Tanggu Truce ended the campaign.

fields.name: 长城抗战 Defense of the Great Wall
fields.summary: 第29军、第17军、第32军及东北军等部在喜峰口、罗文峪、古北口、冷口等关口抗击日军，最终以《塘沽协定》收场。 The 29th, 17th, and 32nd Armies and Northeast Army units fought the Japanese at Xifengkou, Luowenyu, Gubeikou, and Lengkou until the Tanggu Truce ended the campaign.
fields.description: 1933 年 3 月至 5 月，中国军队依托长城各口抗击日军。主要参战部队： - 喜峰口、罗文峪：第29军（宋哲元），辖第37师（冯治安）、第38师（张自忠）、暂编第2师（刘汝明）； - 古北口、南天门：东北军第67军（王以哲）先守，中央军第17军（徐庭瑶）第2师（黄杰）、第25师（关麟征）、第83师（刘戡）增援； - 冷口：第32军（商震）第139师等部； - 界岭口：东北军第53军（万福麟）等部。 由于装备与指挥劣势，中国军队最终后撤，5 月 31 日签订《塘沽协定》。 日期与部队番号取通行说法，待史料校订。 From March to May 1933 Chinese forces defended the Great Wall passes. Main units: - Xifengkou and Luowenyu: 29th Army (Song Zheyuan), with the 37th Division (Feng Zhi’an), 38th Division (Zhang Zizhong), and Provisional 2nd Division (Liu Ruming); - Gubeikou and Nantianmen: Northeast Army’s 67th Corps (Wang Yizhe) held first, reinforced by the Central Army’s 17th Army (Xu Tingyao) with the 2nd Division (Huang Jie), 25th Division (Guan Linzheng), and 83rd Division (Liu Kan); - Lengkou: 32nd Army (Shang Zhen), including the 139th Division; - Jielingkou: Northeast Army’s 53rd Corps (Wan Fulin) and others. Hampered by inferior equipment and coordination, the Chinese forces eventually withdrew, and the Tanggu Truce was signed on 31 May. Dates and unit designations follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

summary.zh: 第29军宋哲元部在喜峰口以大刀夜袭日军，取得长城抗战中著名胜利。
summary.en: Song Zheyuan’s 29th Army raided Japanese camps at Xifengkou with broadswords, winning one of the best-known victories of the Great Wall campaign.

fields.name: 第29军与喜峰口战斗 29th Army at Xifengkou
fields.summary: 第29军宋哲元部在喜峰口以大刀夜袭日军，取得长城抗战中著名胜利。 Song Zheyuan’s 29th Army raided Japanese camps at Xifengkou with broadswords, winning one of the best-known victories of the Great Wall campaign.
fields.description: 1933 年 3 月 9 日，日军进攻喜峰口，第29军（军长宋哲元）第37师（冯治安）、第38师（张自忠）驰援。11 日夜，第37师第109旅旅长赵登禹、佟泽光等率部攀山绕袭日军营地，以大刀近战重创敌军。喜峰口战斗打破了日军不可战胜的形象，也让第29军声名大振。 日期与部队番号取通行说法，待史料校订。 On 9 March 1933 Japanese forces attacked Xifengkou, and the 29th Army under Song Zheyuan rushed its 37th Division (Feng Zhi’an) and 38th Division (Zhang Zizhong) to defend it. On the night of 11 March, Zhao Dengyu, commander of the 37th Division’s 109th Brigade, and Tong Zeguang led troops over the mountains to raid Japanese camps, inflicting heavy losses in close combat with broadswords. The battle shattered the image of Japanese invincibility and made the 29th Army famous. Dates and unit designations follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

fields.description: 1933 年 3 月，日军进攻冷口，第32军（军长商震）第139师等部依托关隘抗击，双方反复争夺。4 月中旬冷口失守，中国军队退守滦河以西。冷口与喜峰口、古北口同为长城抗战的主要方向。 日期与部队番号取通行说法，待史料校订。 In March 1933 Japanese forces attacked Lengkou, where the 32nd Army under Shang Zhen, including the 139th Division, held the pass in repeated see-saw fighting. Lengkou fell in mid-April and the Chinese forces withdrew west of the Luan River. Lengkou was one of the main sectors of the Great Wall campaign alongside Xifengkou and Gubeikou. Dates and unit designations follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

fields.name: 第17军与古北口战斗 17th Army at Gubeikou
fields.summary: 东北军第67军与中央军第17军在古北口、南天门一线抗击日军，伤亡惨重。 The Northeast Army’s 67th Corps and the Central Army’s 17th Army fought the Japanese at Gubeikou and Nantianmen at heavy cost.
fields.description: 1933 年 3 月 10 日，日军进攻古北口，东北军第67军（王以哲）先守，中央军第17军（徐庭瑶）第25师（关麟征）、第2师（黄杰）、第83师（刘戡）等部陆续增援。双方在南天门一线反复争夺至 4 月下旬，中国军队伤亡惨重但仍迟滞了日军推进。古北口是长城抗战中战斗最激烈的方向之一。 日期与部队番号取通行说法，待史料校订。 On 10 March 1933 Japanese forces attacked Gubeikou. The Northeast Army’s 67th Corps under Wang Yizhe held first, then the Central Army’s 17th Army under Xu Tingyao reinforced with the 25th Division (Guan Linzheng), 2nd Division (Huang Jie), and 83rd Division (Liu Kan). Fighting around Nantianmen continued into late April; Chinese casualties were heavy, but the defense delayed the Japanese advance. Gubeikou was one of the most bitterly contested sectors of the Great Wall campaign. Dates and unit designations follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

Luowenyu was another important position for the 29th Army in the Great Wall campaign. Dates and unit designations follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

name.zh: 察哈尔民众抗日同盟军成立
name.en: Establishment of the Chahar People’s Anti-Japanese Allied Army

summary.zh: 冯玉祥（下野的西北军领袖）、吉鸿昌（原第22路军总指挥，中共秘密党员）、方振武等在张家口成立抗日同盟军，冯玉祥任总司令。
summary.en: Feng Yuxiang (retired Northwest Army leader), Ji Hongchang (former 22nd Route Army commander and secret CCP member), and Fang Zhenwu formed the Anti-Japanese Allied Army at Zhangjiakou, with Feng as commander-in-chief.

fields.name: 察哈尔民众抗日同盟军成立 Establishment of the Chahar People’s Anti-Japanese Allied Army
fields.place: 察哈尔张家口 Zhangjiakou, Chahar
fields.summary: 冯玉祥（下野的西北军领袖）、吉鸿昌（原第22路军总指挥，中共秘密党员）、方振武等在张家口成立抗日同盟军，冯玉祥任总司令。 Feng Yuxiang (retired Northwest Army leader), Ji Hongchang (former 22nd Route Army commander and secret CCP member), and Fang Zhenwu formed the Anti-Japanese Allied Army at Zhangjiakou, with Feng as commander-in-chief.
fields.description: 1933 年 5 月 26 日，冯玉祥、吉鸿昌、方振武等在张家口成立察哈尔民众抗日同盟军，号召武装抗日、收复失地。 三人当时的身份并不相同： - 冯玉祥 ：中原大战后下野的西北军领袖。1928 年曾任国民政府行政院副院长兼军政部长，1930 年反蒋失败后失去实权；1933 年无军政实职，被推举为同盟军总司令。 - 吉鸿昌 ：冯玉祥旧部、原西北军将领，曾任第22路军总指挥兼第30军军长。1931 年因不愿「剿共」被解除兵权、被迫出洋考察，1932 年回国并加入中国共产党；在同盟军任前敌总指挥兼第2军军长。 - 方振武 ：原国民军将领，曾任安徽省政府主席，反蒋被囚后于 1931 年获释；1933 年变卖财产组织抗日救国军北上，任同盟军北路前敌总司令。 同盟军在中共北方党组织推动与协助下组建，队伍一度发展到十万余人，北上收复康保、宝昌、沽源和多伦，但在日军与国民党当局的双重压力下于同年秋解散。 建制事件，不单独绘制路线；日期、职务与人数取通行说法，待史料校订。 On 26 May 1933 Feng Yuxiang, Ji Hongchang, Fang Zhenwu, and others formed the Chahar People’s Anti-Japanese Allied Army at Zhangjiakou, calling for armed resistance and the recovery of lost territory. Their standing at the time differed: - Feng Yuxiang was the retired leader of the Northwest Army. He had served as vice president of the Executive Yuan and minister of military administration in 1928, but lost real power after his anti-Chiang coalition was defeated in 1930. Holding no military or government office in 1933, he was elected commander-in-chief of the Allied Army. - Ji Hongchang , a former Northwest Army general under Feng, had commanded the 22nd Route Army and the 30th Army. Relieved of command in 1931 for refusing to fight the Communists and sent abroad, he returned to China in 1932 and joined the Chinese Communist Party. In the Allied Army he served as front-line commander-in-chief and commander of the 2nd Army. - Fang Zhenwu , a former National Army general and governor of Anhui, had been imprisoned for opposing Chiang and released in 1931. In 1933 he sold his property to raise the Anti-Japanese National Salvation Army and became the Allied Army’s northern front commander. Organized with the encouragement and help of the CCP’s northern organization, the army grew to more than 100,000 men and recovered Kangbao, Baochang, Guyuan, and Duolun before being disbanded that autumn under pressure from both Japan and the Nationalist government. An organizational event with no separate route; dates, titles, and troop numbers follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

summary.zh: 中日签订《塘沽协定》，中国默认日军对东北、热河的控制，冀东被划为非武装区。
summary.en: China and Japan signed the Tanggu Truce, tacitly accepting Japanese control of the Northeast and Rehe and creating a demilitarized zone in eastern Hebei.

fields.name: 《塘沽协定》 Tanggu Truce
fields.summary: 中日签订《塘沽协定》，中国默认日军对东北、热河的控制，冀东被划为非武装区。 China and Japan signed the Tanggu Truce, tacitly accepting Japanese control of the Northeast and Rehe and creating a demilitarized zone in eastern Hebei.
fields.description: 1933 年 5 月 31 日，中国代表熊斌与日本代表冈村宁次在塘沽签订停战协定。协定规定中国军队撤至延庆、昌平、高丽营、顺义、通州、香河、宝坻、林亭口、宁河、芦台一线以西以南，冀东划为非武装区。中国实际上默认了日本对东北和热河的控制。 外交事件，不绘制路线；日期与地点取通行说法，待史料校订。 On 31 May 1933 Chinese representative Xiong Bin and Japanese representative Okamura Yasuji signed a truce at Tanggu. Chinese troops were to withdraw west and south of a line through Yanqing, Changping, Gaoliying, Shunyi, Tongzhou, Xianghe, Baodi, Lintingkou, Ninghe, and Lutai, and eastern Hebei became a demilitarized zone. China thus tacitly accepted Japanese control of the Northeast and Rehe. A diplomatic event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

place.zh: 察哈尔多伦（今属内蒙古）

summary.zh: 察哈尔抗日同盟军北路前敌总司令方振武、总指挥吉鸿昌率部收复多伦，为九一八事变后中国军队首次收复失地。
summary.en: The northern front of the Chahar Anti-Japanese Allied Army, under Fang Zhenwu and Ji Hongchang, retook Duolun — the first recovery of lost territory by Chinese forces after the Mukden Incident.

fields.name: 收复多伦 Recapture of Duolun
fields.place: 察哈尔多伦（今属内蒙古） Duolun, Chahar (now Inner Mongolia)
fields.summary: 察哈尔抗日同盟军北路前敌总司令方振武、总指挥吉鸿昌率部收复多伦，为九一八事变后中国军队首次收复失地。 The northern front of the Chahar Anti-Japanese Allied Army, under Fang Zhenwu and Ji Hongchang, retook Duolun — the first recovery of lost territory by Chinese forces after the Mukden Incident.
fields.description: 1933 年 7 月，察哈尔民众抗日同盟军北路前敌总司令方振武、总指挥吉鸿昌率部围攻多伦，经数日激战于 7 月 12 日收复该城。这是九一八事变后中国军队首次从日军及其伪军手中收复失地，在舆论上引起很大反响。 吉鸿昌当时是原西北军将领、第22路军前总指挥，1932 年加入中国共产党，在同盟军任前敌总指挥兼第2军军长。 日期与地点取通行说法，待史料校订。 In July 1933 the northern front of the Chahar People’s Anti-Japanese Allied Army, commanded by Fang Zhenwu and Ji Hongchang, besieged Duolun and retook the town on 12 July after several days of fighting. It was the first recovery of lost territory from Japanese and puppet forces after the Mukden Incident and caused a sensation in public opinion. Ji Hongchang was a former Northwest Army general and former commander of the 22nd Route Army; he joined the Chinese Communist Party in 1932 and served as the Allied Army’s front-line commander-in-chief and commander of the 2nd Army. Dates and locations follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

fields.summary: 第十九路军在福州另立政府，次年失败。 The 19th Route Army set up a separate government at Fuzhou, which collapsed the following year.
fields.description: 1933 年 11 月 20 日，第十九路军将领蒋光鼐、蔡廷锴等在福州发动福建事变，成立“中华共和国人民革命政府”，不久在南京政府军事压力下失败。 政治事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述待史料校订。 On 20 November 1933 Jiang Guangnai, Cai Tingkai, and other 19th Route Army commanders launched the Fujian Incident at Fuzhou and established the “People’s Revolutionary Government of the Chinese Republic,” which soon collapsed under military pressure from Nanjing. A political event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

fields.summary: 蒋介石在南昌发起新生活运动，以“礼义廉耻”整饬社会风气。 Chiang Kai-shek launched the New Life Movement in Nanchang, promoting “propriety, righteousness, honesty, and shame” to reform social habits.
fields.description: 1934 年 2 月，蒋介石在南昌发起新生活运动，提倡“礼义廉耻”，要求生活军事化、生产化、艺术化，试图以道德教化整饬社会。运动持续到抗战时期，实际效果有限。 日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。 In February 1934 Chiang Kai-shek launched the New Life Movement in Nanchang, promoting “propriety, righteousness, honesty, and shame” and calling for a militarized, productive, and artistic daily life. The movement continued into the war years with limited practical effect. Dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

fields.description: 1934 年 3 月 1 日，溥仪在长春称“满洲帝国皇帝”，改元“康德”。伪满政权在日本关东军控制下进一步完善殖民统治机构，但始终未获中国政府与国际社会普遍承认。 政治事件，不绘制路线；日期与地点取通行说法，待史料校订。 On 1 March 1934 Puyi was enthroned as “Emperor of Manchukuo” in Changchun and adopted the era name Kangde. Under Kwantung Army control the puppet state further developed its colonial institutions, but it was never widely recognized by the Chinese government or the international community. A political event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

fields.name: 天羽声明 Amau Statement
fields.summary: 日本外务省发表天羽声明，反对列强援助中国，暴露独占中国的意图。 Japan’s Foreign Ministry issued the Amau Statement, opposing foreign aid to China and revealing its aim of monopolizing China.
fields.description: 1934 年 4 月 17 日，日本外务省情报部长天羽英二发表非正式声明，称日本对东亚有特殊责任，反对列强向中国提供武器、借款或技术援助。声明被中国与英美等国视为“亚洲门罗主义”，加剧了华北危机前的紧张局势。 外交事件，不绘制路线；日期与地点取通行说法，待史料校订。 On 17 April 1934 Amau Eiji, spokesman of Japan’s Foreign Ministry, issued an informal statement claiming a special Japanese responsibility in East Asia and opposing foreign arms, loans, or technical aid to China. China, Britain, and the United States saw it as an “Asian Monroe Doctrine,” heightening tensions before the North China crisis. A diplomatic event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

fields.name: 藏本英明事件 Kuramoto Incident
fields.summary: 日本驻南京副领事藏本英明失踪，日方借机陈兵施压，数日后其被发现在紫金山隐居。 A Japanese vice-consul in Nanjing disappeared; Japan massed warships as a pretext, but he was found days later hiding in the Zijin Mountains.
fields.description: 1934 年 6 月 9 日，日本驻南京总领事馆副领事藏本英明失踪。日本方面宣称其被中国方面绑架，调集军舰施压。6 月 13 日，藏本在南京紫金山被发现，自称因精神苦闷出走，日方的借口随之破产。 外交事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。 On 9 June 1934 Kuramoto, a vice-consul at the Japanese consulate in Nanjing, disappeared. Japan claimed he had been kidnapped by the Chinese side and massed warships as pressure. On 13 June he was found in the Zijin Mountains outside Nanjing, saying he had left because of mental distress, and the Japanese pretext collapsed. A diplomatic event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

fields.description: 1935 年 1 月，日军在察哈尔东部沽源一带挑起冲突，进攻长梁、乌泥河等地，中国守军与地方武装抵抗。事件后中日双方在大滩交涉，2 月达成口约。 军事事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。 In January 1935 Japanese forces provoked clashes around Guyuan in eastern Chahar, attacking Changliang, Wunihe, and other places, where Chinese garrisons and local forces resisted. Negotiations followed at Datan and produced an oral accord in February. A military event with no route drawn; dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

summary.zh: 中方与日方在大滩达成口约，中国军队撤出察东，日军获得自由行动空间。
summary.en: China and Japan reached an oral accord at Datan: Chinese troops withdrew from eastern Chahar and Japanese forces gained freedom of movement.

fields.name: 大滩口约 Datan Oral Accord
fields.place: 察哈尔沽源大滩 Datan, Guyuan, Chahar
fields.summary: 中方与日方在大滩达成口约，中国军队撤出察东，日军获得自由行动空间。 China and Japan reached an oral accord at Datan: Chinese troops withdrew from eastern Chahar and Japanese forces gained freedom of movement.
fields.description: 1935 年 2 月 2 日，中方与日方在察哈尔沽源大滩达成口约，中国军队撤出察东，日军获得自由行动空间。这是中日双方共同的行为，但中国处于被迫接受的一方，为同年张北事件与秦土协定埋下伏笔。 外交事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。 On 2 February 1935 China and Japan reached an oral accord at Datan in Guyuan, Chahar: Chinese troops withdrew from eastern Chahar and Japanese forces gained freedom of movement. It was a bilateral act, but China was forced to accept, and it set the stage for the Zhangbei Incident and the Qin-Doihara Agreement later that year. A diplomatic event with no route drawn; dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

fields.name: 国民经济建设运动 National Economic Construction Movement
fields.summary: 蒋介石在贵阳发起国民经济建设运动，推动交通、工矿与农村建设。 Chiang Kai-shek launched the National Economic Construction Movement in Guiyang to promote transport, industry, mining, and rural construction.
fields.description: 1935 年 4 月，蒋介石在贵阳发起国民经济建设运动，号召“尽人力、辟地利、均供求、畅流通”，推动交通、工矿、农村合作与国防经济建设。该运动与法币改革同为战前经济准备的一部分。 日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。 In April 1935 Chiang Kai-shek launched the National Economic Construction Movement in Guiyang, calling for mobilizing labor, developing resources, balancing supply and demand, and improving distribution. It promoted transport, industry, mining, rural cooperatives, and defense-related construction, alongside the currency reform as part of prewar economic preparation. Dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

fields.name: 张北事件 Zhangbei Incident
fields.summary: 日本特务在张北被中国守军盘查，日方借机提出交涉。 Japanese agents were stopped and questioned by Chinese guards at Zhangbei, and Japan used the incident to demand concessions.
fields.description: 1935 年 6 月 5 日，日本特务在张北被中国守军盘查，日方借机提出交涉，要求撤换有关人员、撤退察哈尔省境内国民党军与党部，并取缔抗日活动。6 月 27 日秦德纯与土肥原贤二签订“秦土协定”。 外交事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。 On 5 June 1935 Japanese agents were stopped and questioned by Chinese guards at Zhangbei. Japan used the incident to demand the replacement of the officers involved, the withdrawal of Nationalist troops and party offices from Chahar, and the suppression of anti-Japanese activities. On 27 June Qin Dechun and Doihara Kenji signed the Qin-Doihara Agreement. A diplomatic event with no route drawn; dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

summary.zh: 日军以孙永勤部进入滦东“非武装区”和胡白被杀为借口，向北平军分会提出交涉并调兵施压。
summary.en: Japan used Sun Yongqin’s entry into the demilitarized zone east of the Luan River and the killing of Hu Bai as pretexts to press the Beiping Military Council and move troops.

fields.name: 河北事件 Hebei Incident
fields.summary: 日军以孙永勤部进入滦东“非武装区”和胡白被杀为借口，向北平军分会提出交涉并调兵施压。 Japan used Sun Yongqin’s entry into the demilitarized zone east of the Luan River and the killing of Hu Bai as pretexts to press the Beiping Military Council and move troops.
fields.description: 1935 年 5 至 6 月，日军以孙永勤部进入滦东“非武装区”和胡白被杀事件为借口，向北平军分会代委员长何应钦提出交涉，并从东北调兵入关施压。日方要求撤换河北省军政人员、撤出中央军与国民党党部。7 月 6 日何应钦复函接受，形成“何梅协定”。 外交/军事事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。 In May and June 1935 Japan used Sun Yongqin’s entry into the demilitarized zone east of the Luan River and the killing of Hu Bai as pretexts to press He Yingqin, acting chairman of the Beiping Military Council, and moved troops from the Northeast through the Great Wall. Japan demanded the replacement of Hebei officials and the withdrawal of Central Army units and Nationalist Party offices. He Yingqin’s reply of 6 July accepted these demands, producing the He-Umezu Agreement. A diplomatic and military event with no route drawn; dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

fields.description: 1935 年 6 月 27 日，秦德纯与土肥原贤二在北平签订协定，中国方面同意撤换有关人员、撤退察哈尔省境内国民党军与党部，并取缔抗日活动。察哈尔主权进一步受损。 外交事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。 On 27 June 1935 Qin Dechun and Doihara Kenji signed an agreement in Beiping: China replaced the officials involved, withdrew Nationalist troops and party offices from Chahar, and suppressed anti-Japanese activities. Chahar’s sovereignty was further eroded. A diplomatic event with no route drawn; dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

fields.name: 何梅协定 He-Umezu Agreement
fields.summary: 何应钦复函梅津美治郎，接受日方要求，中央军与国民党党部退出河北。 He Yingqin replied to Umezu Yoshijiro, accepting Japanese demands and withdrawing Central Army units and party offices from Hebei.
fields.description: 1935 年 7 月 6 日，北平军分会代委员长何应钦复函日本华北驻屯军司令梅津美治郎，实质上接受日方要求：中央军与国民党党部退出河北，撤换有关军政人员。此即“何梅协定”，中国在华北的主权进一步受损。 外交事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。 On 6 July 1935 He Yingqin, acting chairman of the Beiping Military Council, replied to Umezu Yoshijiro, commander of the Japanese garrison in North China, effectively accepting Japanese demands: Central Army units and Nationalist Party offices withdrew from Hebei and officials were replaced. This is known as the He-Umezu Agreement, which further eroded Chinese sovereignty in North China. A diplomatic event with no route drawn; dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

summary.zh: 日本内阁决定“广田三原则”，要求中国取缔排日、承认伪满、共同防共。
summary.en: The Japanese cabinet adopted “Hirota’s Three Principles,” demanding an end to anti-Japanese activity, recognition of Manchukuo and joint anti-communism.

fields.name: 广田三原则提出 Hirota’s Three Principles
fields.summary: 日本内阁决定“广田三原则”，要求中国取缔排日、承认伪满、共同防共。 The Japanese cabinet adopted “Hirota’s Three Principles,” demanding an end to anti-Japanese activity, recognition of Manchukuo and joint anti-communism.
fields.description: 1935 年 10 月 4 日，日本冈田启介内阁决定《外、陆、海三相关于对华政策的谅解》，即“广田三原则”：中国取缔排日言行并摆脱对欧美依赖、事实上默认伪满洲国、在邻近外蒙地区与日本合作防共。10 月 7 日，广田弘毅向中国驻日大使蒋作宾提出。中方未接受，交涉无果。日期为阁议决定日，待页码级核对。 On 4 October 1935 the Japanese cabinet of Okada Keisuke adopted the “Understanding of the Foreign, Army and Navy Ministers on Policy toward China,” known as Hirota’s Three Principles: China should suppress anti-Japanese words and deeds and abandon reliance on the Western powers; tacitly accept Manchukuo; and cooperate with Japan against communism in areas bordering Outer Mongolia. Foreign Minister Hirota Kōki presented them to Chinese ambassador Jiang Zuobin on 7 October. China did not accept them and the talks failed. The date is that of the cabinet decision and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 国民政府实行法币政策，统一货币、稳定金融，为抗战经济动员奠定基础。

fields.name: 法币改革 Currency Reform
fields.summary: 国民政府实行法币政策，统一货币、稳定金融，为抗战经济动员奠定基础。 The Nationalist government introduced the fabi currency, unifying the monetary system and stabilizing finance for wartime mobilization.
fields.description: 1935 年 11 月 3 日，国民政府财政部宣布法币政策，白银收归国有，以中央、中国、交通等银行发行的钞票为法币，统一货币、稳定金融。法币改革为抗战时期的财政与军费动员提供了基础。 日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。 On 3 November 1935 the Ministry of Finance announced the fabi reform: silver was nationalized and notes issued by the Central Bank of China, Bank of China, Bank of Communications, and others became legal tender. The reform unified the currency and stabilized finance, providing a basis for wartime fiscal and military mobilization. Dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

fields.description: 1935 年 11 月 25 日，殷汝耕在通州成立“冀东防共自治委员会”，宣布冀东二十二县“自治”，实际处于日本控制之下。此举是华北自治运动的高潮，直接引发一二·九运动。 政治事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。 On 25 November 1935 Yin Rugeng established the “East Hebei Anti-Communist Autonomous Council” at Tongzhou, declaring 22 counties of eastern Hebei “autonomous” under de facto Japanese control. The movement spread nationwide and became an important backdrop to the formation of the anti-Japanese united front. This is a political event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

fields.description: 1935 年 12 月 16 日，北平学生万余人举行游行，抗议冀察政务委员会成立，遭到军警镇压。运动迅速扩展到天津、上海、南京、广州等地，成为全国抗日救亡运动的新高潮，也为抗日民族统一战线的形成准备了群众基础。 政治事件，不绘制路线；日期与地点取通行说法，待史料校订。 On 16 December 1935 more than ten thousand students marched in Beiping against the Hebei-Chahar Political Council and were suppressed by police. The movement quickly spread to Tianjin, Shanghai, Nanjing, Guangzhou, and elsewhere, becoming a new high point of national salvation activity and preparing popular ground for the anti-Japanese united front. A political event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

fields.name: 华北自治运动与冀察政务委员会成立 North China Autonomy Movement and the Hebei-Chahar Political Council
fields.summary: 日本策动华北五省“自治”，南京国民政府被迫设立半独立性质的冀察政务委员会。 Japan promoted “autonomy” in five North China provinces, forcing Nanjing to create the semi-autonomous Hebei-Chahar Political Council.
fields.description: 1935 年秋，日本策动华北五省“自治运动”，扶植殷汝耕在通州成立“冀东防共自治委员会”。南京国民政府在日本压力下于 12 月 18 日设立冀察政务委员会，由宋哲元任委员长，华北出现半独立局面。此举直接引发了一二·九与一二·一六运动。 政治事件，不绘制路线；日期与地点取通行说法，待史料校订。 In autumn 1935 Japan promoted an “autonomy movement” across five North China provinces and sponsored Yin Rugeng’s “East Hebei Anti-Communist Autonomous Council” at Tongzhou. Under Japanese pressure Nanjing established the Hebei-Chahar Political Council on 18 December, chaired by Song Zheyuan, leaving North China semi-autonomous. The move directly triggered the December Ninth and December Sixteenth movements. A political event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

fields.name: 两广事变 Liangguang Incident
fields.summary: 陈济棠、李宗仁等以“北上抗日”为号召反蒋，事变后和平解决。 Chen Jitang and Li Zongren moved against Chiang Kai-shek under the banner of “marching north to resist Japan”; the incident was resolved peacefully.
fields.description: 1936 年 6 月，广东陈济棠与广西李宗仁、白崇禧联合反蒋，组织“抗日救国军”北上，史称两广事变。蒋介石分化瓦解，陈济棠部将余汉谋倒戈，7 月陈济棠下野，事变和平解决，两广重归南京国民政府统辖。 政治事件，不绘制路线；日期与地点取通行说法，待史料校订。 In June 1936 Chen Jitang of Guangdong joined Li Zongren and Bai Chongxi of Guangxi against Chiang Kai-shek, forming a “Anti-Japanese National Salvation Army” and marching north; the episode is known as the Liangguang Incident. Chiang undermined the coalition, Chen’s subordinate Yu Hanmou defected, and Chen stepped down in July. The incident ended peacefully and the two provinces returned to Nanjing’s authority. A political event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

fields.name: 日军策动伪蒙军进攻绥远 Japanese-Backed Mengjiang Invasion of Suiyuan
fields.summary: 日本关东军策动伪蒙军自商都进攻绥远，傅作义部奋起抵抗。 The Kwantung Army directed Mengjiang forces from Shangdu against Suiyuan, where Fu Zuoyi’s troops resisted.
fields.description: 1936 年 11 月，日本关东军策动德王所属伪蒙军自商都一带西进，进攻绥远东部。绥远省主席傅作义率晋绥军迎战，先后取得红格尔图与百灵庙战斗的胜利。绥远抗战得到全国各界慰问与支援，成为西安事变前抗日情绪高涨的重要背景。 日期与地点取通行说法，待史料校订。 In November 1936 the Kwantung Army directed Prince De’s Mengjiang forces westward from the Shangdu area against eastern Suiyuan. Suiyuan chairman Fu Zuoyi led Shanxi-Suiyuan troops to meet them and won the battles of Honggeertu and Bailingmiao. The Suiyuan campaign drew nationwide support and helped raise anti-Japanese sentiment before the Xi’an Incident. Dates and locations follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

fields.name: 红格尔图战斗 Battle of Honggeertu
fields.place: 绥远红格尔图 Honggeertu, Suiyuan
fields.summary: 傅作义部在红格尔图击退伪蒙军进攻，绥远抗战由此展开。 Fu Zuoyi’s forces repelled the Mengjiang attack at Honggeertu, opening the Suiyuan campaign.
fields.description: 1936 年 11 月 15 日，伪蒙军在日本顾问指挥下进攻红格尔图。傅作义部骑兵与守军协同反击，经数日激战将其击退，毙伤俘敌数百人。红格尔图战斗是绥远抗战的首场胜利，为随后收复百灵庙创造了条件。 日期与地点取通行说法，待史料校订。 On 15 November 1936 Mengjiang troops under Japanese advisers attacked Honggeertu. Fu Zuoyi’s cavalry and garrison counterattacked and, after several days of fighting, drove them back with hundreds of casualties and prisoners. The victory at Honggeertu opened the Suiyuan campaign and paved the way for the recovery of Bailingmiao. Dates and locations follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

fields.name: 百灵庙大捷 Victory at Bailingmiao
fields.summary: 傅作义部奇袭百灵庙，取得绥远抗战决定性胜利，全国慰问运动高涨。 Fu Zuoyi’s surprise attack on Bailingmiao won a decisive victory in the Suiyuan campaign and triggered nationwide support.
fields.description: 1936 年 11 月 23 日夜，傅作义部在严寒中长途奔袭百灵庙，经一夜激战于 24 日攻克该地，歼灭伪蒙军一部并缴获大量物资。百灵庙大捷震动全国，各界纷纷组织慰问与捐款，成为绥远抗战的标志性胜利。 日期与地点取通行说法，待史料校订。 On the night of 23 November 1936 Fu Zuoyi’s troops marched through severe cold to surprise Bailingmiao and, after a night of fighting, took it on 24 November, destroying part of the Mengjiang force and capturing large quantities of supplies. The victory caused a national sensation, with organizations across the country sending condolences and donations, and became the emblematic success of the Suiyuan campaign. fields.name: 七君子事件 Seven Gentlemen Incident
fields.summary: 沈钧儒等七位救国会领袖在上海被捕，引发全国抗议。 Seven leaders of the National Salvation Association, including Shen Junru, were arrested in Shanghai, prompting nationwide protests.
fields.description: 1936 年 11 月 23 日，南京国民政府以“危害民国”罪名在上海逮捕沈钧儒、章乃器、邹韬奋、李公朴、沙千里、史良、王造时七位救国会领袖，史称“七君子事件”。事件激起全国各界抗议，进一步推动了抗日救亡运动。 政治事件，不绘制路线；日期与地点取通行说法，待史料校订。 On 23 November 1936 the Nanjing government arrested seven leaders of the National Salvation Association in Shanghai—Shen Junru, Zhang Naiqi, Zou Taofen, Li Gongpu, Sha Qianli, Shi Liang, and Wang Zaoshi—on charges of “endangering the Republic.” Known as the Seven Gentlemen Incident, the arrests provoked nationwide protests and further strengthened the national salvation movement. A political event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

summary.en: Zhang Xueliang and Yang Hucheng detained Chiang Kai-shek in Xi’an, leading to a turn toward ending the civil war and resisting Japan.

fields.name: 西安事变 Xi’an Incident
fields.summary: 张学良、杨虎城在西安扣留蒋介石，促成停止内战、联共抗日的转折。 Zhang Xueliang and Yang Hucheng detained Chiang Kai-shek in Xi’an, leading to a turn toward ending the civil war and resisting Japan.
fields.description: 1936 年 12 月 12 日，东北军将领张学良与第十七路军将领杨虎城在西安扣留蒋介石，要求停止内战、一致抗日。经多方斡旋，事变和平解决，为抗日民族统一战线的形成创造了条件。 本事件为政治事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述待史料校订。 On 12 December 1936, Zhang Xueliang of the Northeast Army and Yang Hucheng of the 17th Route Army detained Chiang Kai-shek in Xi’an, demanding an end to the civil war and united resistance against Japan. The incident was resolved peacefully, helping pave the way for the anti-Japanese united front. This is a political event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

summary.en: Japanese forces provoked a clash near the Marco Polo Bridge and attacked Wanping, marking the start of full-scale Chinese resistance.

fields.name: 卢沟桥事变 Marco Polo Bridge Incident 七七事变 July 7 Incident
fields.place: 北平卢沟桥 Marco Polo Bridge, Beiping
fields.summary: 日军在卢沟桥附近挑起冲突并进攻宛平城，中国全面抗战由此爆发。 Japanese forces provoked a clash near the Marco Polo Bridge and attacked Wanping, marking the start of full-scale Chinese resistance.
fields.description: 1937 年 7 月 7 日夜，日军在北平西南卢沟桥附近演习，借口士兵失踪要求进入宛平城搜查，遭拒后发动进攻。中国守军第二十九军奋起抵抗，战事迅速扩大。 本事件为路线分段端点，日期与地点为通行说法，待史料校订。 On the night of 7 July 1937, Japanese troops on exercise near the Marco Polo Bridge demanded entry into Wanping to search for a missing soldier. After being refused, they attacked. The Chinese 29th Army resisted, and the fighting quickly escalated. This event marks a route segment endpoint; date and location follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

fields.name: 庐山谈话 Lushan Statement
fields.summary: 蒋介石发表庐山谈话，表示“地无分南北，年无分老幼，皆有守土抗战之责任”。 Chiang Kai-shek’s Lushan statement declared that “regardless of north or south, young or old, everyone has the duty to defend the land and resist.”
fields.description: 1937 年 7 月 17 日，蒋介石在庐山发表谈话，提出解决卢沟桥事变的四项立场，并表示“如果战端一开，那就是地无分南北，年无分老幼，无论何人，皆有守土抗战之责任”。这被视为国民政府走向全面抗战的重要表态。 日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。 On 17 July 1937 Chiang Kai-shek issued the Lushan Statement, setting out four conditions for settling the Marco Polo Bridge Incident and declaring that “if war begins, then regardless of north or south, young or old, everyone has the duty to defend the land and resist.” It is regarded as a key statement of the Nationalist government’s turn toward full-scale resistance. Dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

fields.description: 1937 年 7 月 28 日，日军向北平南苑、北苑等地发动总攻，第 29 军副军长佟麟阁、第 132 师师长赵登禹殉国。7 月 29 日，第 29 军奉命撤离北平，日军占领北平。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 28 July 1937 Japanese forces launched a general assault on Nanyuan, Beiyuan and other positions around Beiping. 29th Army deputy commander Tong Linge and 132nd Division commander Zhao Dengyu were killed. fields.summary: 日军进攻天津，中国守军撤退，天津沦陷。 Japanese forces attacked Tianjin; the Chinese defenders withdrew and the city fell.
fields.description: 1937 年 7 月 29 日至 30 日，日军第 20 师团等部进攻天津，中国第 38 师等部抵抗后撤离。7 月 30 日天津沦陷，日军控制海河与天津港。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 From 29 to 30 July 1937 the Japanese 20th Division and other units attacked Tianjin. The Chinese 38th Division and other forces resisted and then withdrew. Tianjin fell on 30 July, giving Japan control of the Hai River and Tianjin port. name.en: Relocation of Industry to the Interior

summary.zh: 抗战爆发后，沿海工厂大规模内迁四川、云南、贵州、陕西等地。
summary.en: After the war began, coastal factories were moved on a large scale to Sichuan, Yunnan, Guizhou, Shaanxi, and other interior provinces.

fields.name: 工厂西迁 Relocation of Industry to the Interior
fields.summary: 抗战爆发后，沿海工厂大规模内迁四川、云南、贵州、陕西等地。 After the war began, coastal factories were moved on a large scale to Sichuan, Yunnan, Guizhou, Shaanxi, and other interior provinces.
fields.description: 1937 年 8 月起，国民政府组织沿海工厂内迁，600 余家工厂、大批设备与技术工人迁往四川、云南、贵州、陕西等地，成为大后方工业基础。内迁过程艰苦，但保存了抗战所需的军工与民用生产能力。 日期与数字取通行说法，待史料校订。 From August 1937 the Nationalist government organized the relocation of coastal industry. More than 600 factories, large quantities of equipment, and skilled workers moved to Sichuan, Yunnan, Guizhou, Shaanxi, and other interior provinces, forming the industrial base of the rear area. The process was arduous but preserved military and civilian production capacity for the war. Dates and figures follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

fields.summary: 中日双方在上海投入重兵鏖战三个月，中国军队粉碎了日军速战速决的企图。 China and Japan poured troops into three months of fighting in Shanghai, thwarting Japan’s hope for a quick victory.
fields.description: 1937 年 8 月 13 日，淞沪会战爆发。中国军队先后投入数十万兵力，与日军在上海市区及周边反复争夺。11 月，中国军队西撤，上海沦陷，但会战打破了日军“三个月灭亡中国”的计划。 本事件为路线分段端点，日期与战果表述待史料校订。 The Battle of Shanghai began on 13 August 1937. Hundreds of thousands of Chinese troops fought Japanese forces in and around the city. In November the Chinese army withdrew west and Shanghai fell, but the battle shattered Japan’s plan to conquer China in three months. This event marks a route segment endpoint; dates and assessments await historical review.

name.en: First Japanese Air Raid on Suzhou

summary.zh: 1937年8月16日，日军航空队两批24架次首次轰炸苏州城，死伤500余人。
summary.en: On 16 August 1937 two waves of 24 Japanese aircraft bombed Suzhou for the first time, killing and wounding more than 500 people.

fields.name: 日机首炸苏州 First Japanese Air Raid on Suzhou
fields.summary: 1937年8月16日，日军航空队两批24架次首次轰炸苏州城，死伤500余人。 On 16 August 1937 two waves of 24 Japanese aircraft bombed Suzhou for the first time, killing and wounding more than 500 people.
fields.description: 淞沪会战爆发后，日军航空队对苏州实施持续轰炸。8月16日，日机两批24架次首炸阊门外兵营和城内道前街、西善长巷、学士街一带，死伤500余人；至11月15日，苏州城区共受弹4200余颗，街市、房舍、学校、医院、工厂破坏严重。此为日军航空队对平民城市的无差别轰炸，不绘制地面路线。日期据《苏州抗战大事记》，待页码级核对。 After the Battle of Shanghai began, Japanese aircraft bombed Suzhou repeatedly. On 16 August 1937 two waves of 24 aircraft hit the barracks outside Changmen and the Daqian Street, Xishanchang Lane and Xueshi Street areas, killing and wounding more than 500 people; by 15 November the city had received more than 4,200 bombs. This was an indiscriminate air raid on a civilian city, so no ground route is drawn. The date follows the Suzhou chronicle and awaits page-level verification.

summary.en: On 17 August 1937 the Japanese Kwantung Army’s Chahar Detachment established its battle headquarters at Dolon under Lt. Gen. Tojo Hideki.

fields.name: 察哈尔派遣兵团设司令部于多伦 Chahar Detachment Headquarters at Dolon
fields.summary: 1937年8月17日，日军关东军察哈尔派遣兵团在多伦设立战斗司令部，东条英机任司令官。 On 17 August 1937 the Japanese Kwantung Army’s Chahar Detachment established its battle headquarters at Dolon under Lt. Gen. Tojo Hideki.
fields.description: 1937年8月9日日本参谋本部决定察哈尔作战，8月14日关东军编成察哈尔派遣兵团，以东条英机中将为司令官；17日在多伦设立战斗司令部，19日移至张北。兵团下辖独立混成第1、第2旅团、混成第15旅团及堤支队、大泉支队等部，自多伦、沽源、张北一线向张家口进攻。该事件为指挥机构设立，不绘制进攻路线。日期据《战史丛书·支那事变·陆军作战(1)》译稿与维基百科《察哈尔派遣兵团》。 On 9 August 1937 the Japanese General Staff decided on the Chahar operation. The Kwantung Army formed the Chahar Detachment on 14 August under Lt. Gen. Tojo Hideki, and on the 17th established its battle headquarters at Dolon, moving to Zhangbei on the 19th. The force comprised the 1st and 2nd Independent Mixed Brigades, the 15th Mixed Brigade, and the Tsutsumi and Oizumi detachments, advancing on Zhangjiakou from Dolon, Guyuan and Zhangbei. fields.name: 张北战斗 Battle of Zhangbei
fields.summary: 1937年8月20日，日军混成第2旅团自张北出击，突破长城线。 On 20 August 1937 the Japanese 2nd Mixed Brigade sortied from Zhangbei and broke the Great Wall line.
fields.description: 1937年8月，中国第29军第143师曾于8月20日攻占张北城外围玻璃彩村等要点，但日军关东军察哈尔派遣兵团主力已集结张北。20日夜，日军混成第2旅团自张北二台出发，突破长城防御，占领神威台；中国军队于21日夜退守神威台，23日午夜神威台失陷。张北自1935年《秦土协定》后已为日军控制，本事件记日军自张北出击，不记“张北沦陷”。日期据《南口战役》与《战史丛书·支那事变·陆军作战(1)》译稿。 In August 1937 the Chinese 143rd Division briefly took the glass-factory village outside Zhangbei on the 20th, but the Japanese Chahar Detachment had already concentrated at Zhangbei. On the night of the 20th the Japanese 2nd Mixed Brigade advanced from Er’tai, broke the Great Wall line and took Shenweitei; the Chinese fell back on the night of the 21st, and Shenweitei fell at midnight on the 23rd. Zhangbei had been under Japanese control since the 1935 Qin-Doihara agreement, so this entry records the Japanese sortie from Zhangbei, not a “fall of Zhangbei.”

summary.zh: 中共中央在洛川冯家村召开政治局扩大会议，确定八路军「独立自主的山地游击战」方针。
summary.en: The CCP Central Committee met at Fengjiacun, Luochuan, and set the Eighth Route Army’s strategy of “independent mountain guerrilla warfare.”

fields.name: 洛川会议 Luochuan Conference 中共中央政治局扩大会议 Enlarged Politburo Meeting
fields.place: 陕西洛川冯家村 Fengjiacun, Luochuan, Shaanxi
fields.summary: 中共中央在洛川冯家村召开政治局扩大会议，确定八路军「独立自主的山地游击战」方针。 The CCP Central Committee met at Fengjiacun, Luochuan, and set the Eighth Route Army’s strategy of “independent mountain guerrilla warfare.”
fields.description: 1937 年 8 月 22 日至 25 日，中共中央在陕北洛川冯家村召开政治局扩大会议。会议通过《抗日救国十大纲领》和《关于目前形势与党的任务的决定》，确定红军改编后的战略方针为「独立自主的山地游击战」，包括在有利条件下集中兵力消灭敌人兵团和在平原发展游击战争，但着重于山地；作战原则是「分散以发动群众，集中以消灭敌人，打得赢就打，打不赢就走」。会议同时强调抗日民族统一战线中的独立自主原则，决定红军主力出动，并留一部分保卫陕甘宁边区。 会上对游击战与运动战的主次仍有不同意见，因部队急于出动未及充分讨论；方针表述以《毛泽东选集》第二卷所收《为动员一切力量争取抗战胜利而斗争》及中央档案馆藏件为准。会议地点在冯家村，不在洛川县城。 From 22 to 25 August 1937 the CCP Central Committee held an enlarged Politburo meeting at Fengjiacun, Luochuan, northern Shaanxi. It adopted the Ten-Point Program for Resisting Japan and the Resolution on the Present Situation and the Party’s Tasks, and fixed the Red Army’s post-reorganization strategy as “independent mountain guerrilla warfare,” including concentrating forces to destroy enemy formations under favourable conditions and developing guerrilla warfare on the plains, but with emphasis on the mountains. The operational principle was “disperse to mobilize the people, concentrate to destroy the enemy; fight if you can win, move away if you cannot.” The meeting also stressed independence within the united front, decided that the main Red Army forces would go to the front, and left part of the force to defend the Shaanxi-Gansu-Ningxia border region. Views on the balance between guerrilla and mobile warfare still differed and were not fully debated because the troops had to move; the wording follows “Struggle to Mobilize All Forces for Victory in the War of Resistance” in Selected Works of Mao Zedong, vol. 2, and documents held by the Central Archives. The venue was Fengjiacun, not Luochuan county town.

fields.description: 1937年8月22日，日军混成第2旅团进攻旧万全，中国第143师抵抗后于23日退守张家口西南、平绥线上的孔家庄一线。24日晨，日军攻占万全县城，随即以步兵一联队、炮兵一营沿公路直趋张家口。日期据《张家口政协·烽火年代》与《南口战役》，两源一致。 On 22 August 1937 the Japanese 2nd Mixed Brigade attacked old Wanquan; the Chinese 143rd Division resisted and on the 23rd fell back on the Kongjiazhuang high ground southwest of Zhangjiakou. At dawn on the 24th the Japanese took Wanquan and pushed an infantry regiment and artillery battalion down the road toward Zhangjiakou. Both cited accounts give 24 August.

fields.name: 八路军成立 Establishment of the Eighth Route Army
fields.summary: 红军主力改编为国民革命军第八路军，下辖第115、第120、第129师。 The main Red Army forces were reorganized as the Eighth Route Army, with the 115th, 120th, and 129th divisions.
fields.description: 1937 年 8 月 22 日，国民政府军事委员会宣布红军主力改编为国民革命军第八路军；8 月 25 日，中共中央军委发布改编命令，朱德任总指挥，彭德怀任副总指挥，叶剑英任参谋长，左权任副参谋长，任弼时任政治部主任，邓小平任副主任，下辖第115、第120、第129 师。红军总部在陕西泾阳云阳镇完成改编，各师自 8 月下旬起陆续誓师东渡黄河，开赴山西抗日前线。 改编日期与主官为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 22 August 1937 the National Government’s Military Commission announced the reorganization of the main Red Army forces into the Eighth Route Army; on 25 August the Central Military Commission issued the reorganization order, with Zhu De as commander, Peng Dehuai as deputy commander, Ye Jianying as chief of staff, Zuo Quan as deputy chief of staff, Ren Bishi as director of the Political Department and Deng Xiaoping as deputy director, under the 115th, 120th, and 129th divisions. The Red Army headquarters completed the reorganization at Yunyang, Jingyang, Shaanxi, and from late August the divisions crossed the Yellow River toward Shanxi. Dates and appointments follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.summary: 日本海军宣布封锁中国中部沿海，切断中国海上补给。 The Japanese navy declared a blockade of China’s central coast, cutting maritime supply lines.
fields.description: 1937 年 8 月 25 日，日本海军第三舰队宣布封锁上海至汕头之间的中国海岸，禁止中国船只航行，随后将封锁范围扩大至中国全部沿海。封锁与日军占领沿海港口相配合，切断了中国经海路输入军需物资的主要通道。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 25 August 1937 the Japanese 3rd Fleet declared a blockade of the Chinese coast between Shanghai and Shantou, barring Chinese shipping; the blockade was later extended to the entire Chinese coast. Together with the seizure of coastal ports, it cut China’s main maritime route for importing military supplies. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 日军进抵独石口以西 Japanese Advance West of Dushikou
fields.place: 察哈尔独石口 Dushikou, Chahar
fields.summary: 1937年8月26日，日军大泉支队自沽源南进，占领独石口以西三间房。 On 26 August 1937 the Japanese Oizumi detachment advanced south from Guyuan and took Sanjianfang west of Dushikou.
fields.description: 1937年8月13日，日军大泉支队抵达沽源，随后沿独石口、赤城、龙关一线南进，企图抢占宣化、截断平绥铁路。中国第17军高桂滋部在宁强堡—赤城—龙关一线防御，未能阻止日军。8月26日，大泉支队占领独石口以西之三间房。日期据《中国抗日战争全史》与澎湃《卢沟桥事变后，河北经历了什么？》。 The Japanese Oizumi detachment reached Guyuan on 13 August 1937 and advanced south through Dushikou, Chicheng and Longguan to seize Xuanhua and cut the Beiping–Suiyuan railway. Gao Guizi’s 17th Corps defended the Ningqiangpu–Chicheng–Longguan line but could not stop it. On 26 August the detachment took Sanjianfang west of Dushikou.

fields.name: 张家口沦陷 Fall of Zhangjiakou
fields.place: 察哈尔张家口 Zhangjiakou, Chahar
fields.summary: 日军察哈尔派遣兵团占领张家口，控制平绥线东段。 The Japanese Chahar Expeditionary Force captured Zhangjiakou, controlling the eastern section of the Peiping–Suiyuan railway.
fields.description: 1937 年 8 月，日军关东军察哈尔派遣兵团沿平绥线西进，配合南口作战。8 月 27 日，日军占领张家口，中国守军撤退。张家口沦陷使日军控制察哈尔东部，并为进攻大同打开通路。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In August 1937 the Japanese Kwantung Army’s Chahar Expeditionary Force advanced west along the Peiping–Suiyuan railway in support of the Nankou operation. On 27 August it captured Zhangjiakou and the Chinese defenders withdrew. The fall of Zhangjiakou gave Japan control of eastern Chahar and opened the route toward Datong. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 怀来沦陷 Fall of Huailai
fields.summary: 1937年8月27日，日军第5师团占领怀来。 On 27 August 1937 the Japanese 5th Division occupied Huailai.
fields.description: 1937年8月25日南口失守后，中国守军于26日退守怀来；日军第5师团与独立混成第11旅团分两路追击，26日占领怀来、27日占领延庆（一说27日占怀来）。怀来失守后，平绥铁路东段被日军打通。日期据《中国抗日战争全史》与澎湃《卢沟桥事变后，河北经历了什么？》；后者记27日怀来失陷。 After Nankou fell on 25 August 1937 the Chinese withdrew to Huailai on the 26th. The Japanese 5th Division and 11th Independent Mixed Brigade pursued in two columns, taking Huailai and Yanqing on 26–27 August (one account gives 27 August for Huailai). The fall of Huailai opened the eastern Beiping–Suiyuan railway.

fields.description: 1937年8月，日军大泉支队自沽源经独石口南下，连陷龙关、赤城，企图抢占宣化。8月27日攻占赤城，28日攻占宣化。赤城失守后，中国第17军高桂滋部向桑干河右岸撤退。日期据澎湃《卢沟桥事变后，河北经历了什么？》与《张家口政协·烽火年代》。 In August 1937 the Japanese Oizumi detachment advanced south from Guyuan through Dushikou, took Longguan and Chicheng, and drove on Xuanhua. Chicheng fell on 27 August and Xuanhua on the 28th. Gao Guizi’s 17th Corps then withdrew to the south bank of the Sanggan River.

fields.name: 宣化沦陷 Fall of Xuanhua
fields.summary: 1937年8月28日，日军攻占宣化。 On 28 August 1937 the Japanese captured Xuanhua.
fields.description: 1937年8月27日张家口失陷后，日军大泉支队自赤城、龙关方向南下，28日攻占宣化，与由张家口东进的混成第2旅会合；29日日军第5师亦进至宣化。宣化失守后，日军控制张家口以南整个平绥路东段。日期据澎湃《卢沟桥事变后，河北经历了什么？》与《南口战役》；《中国抗日战争全史》记27日占宣化，正文并列。 After Zhangjiakou fell on 27 August 1937, the Japanese Oizumi detachment came south from Chicheng and Longguan and took Xuanhua on the 28th, joining the 2nd Mixed Brigade advancing east from Zhangjiakou; the 5th Division reached Xuanhua on the 29th. The Japanese thus controlled the entire eastern Beiping–Suiyuan railway south of Zhangjiakou. The campaign history gives 27 August; that variant is noted.

The China Daily account gives 28 August for Chaigoubu; that variant is noted.

fields.name: 第74军组建 Formation of the 74th Army
fields.place: 上海（淞沪战场） Shanghai (Songhu front)
fields.summary: 第74军在淞沪战场以第51、第58师为基干组建，后成为正面战场主力。 The 74th Army was formed on the Songhu battlefield around the 51st and 58th Divisions and became a mainstay of the frontal war.
fields.description: 1937 年 9 月，第74军在淞沪战场以第51师、第58师为基干组建，俞济时任军长。此后参加南京保卫战、兰封会战、万家岭战斗、上高会战、常德会战与湘西会战，被称为“抗日铁军”。 建制事件，不单独绘制路线；日期与番号沿革待史料校订。 In September 1937 the 74th Army was formed on the Songhu battlefield around the 51st and 58th Divisions, with Yu Jishi as commander. It later fought at Nanjing, Lanfeng, Wanjialing, Shanggao, Changde, and Xiangxi, and became known as the “iron army” of the resistance. An organizational event with no separate route; dates and order of battle await historical review.

summary.en: Sichuan units left the province in successive waves for the Shanxi and Shanghai fronts.

fields.name: 川军出川抗战 Sichuan Troops March Out to Resist Japan
fields.summary: 川军各部自四川分批出川，开赴山西、淞沪等抗日前线。 Sichuan units left the province in successive waves for the Shanxi and Shanghai fronts.
fields.description: 1937 年 9 月起，川军各部陆续出川抗战。第22集团军（邓锡侯、孙震部）经川陕公路北上，开赴山西第二战区；第20军（杨森部）经长江东下，开赴淞沪战场。川军装备简陋，但作战顽强，伤亡惨重。 路线为示意简化，日期取通行说法，待史料校订。 From September 1937 Sichuan units left the province in successive waves. The 22nd Group Army under Deng Xihou and Sun Zhen moved north via the Sichuan–Shaanxi road to the 2nd War Zone in Shanxi, while the 20th Army under Yang Sen moved east along the Yangtze to the Shanghai front. Poorly equipped but tenacious, the Sichuan troops suffered heavy casualties. Illustrative simplified route; dates follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

fields.summary: 桂军第21集团军自广西出发，经武汉、徐州开赴淞沪战场。 The Guangxi 21st Group Army left Guangxi via Wuhan and Xuzhou for the Shanghai front.
fields.description: 1937 年 9 月，桂军第21集团军（廖磊部）自桂林、柳州出发，经武汉、徐州开赴淞沪，10 月参加蕴藻浜反击战。桂军作战勇猛，但在日军优势火力下伤亡惨重。 路线为示意简化，日期取通行说法，待史料校订。 In September 1937 the Guangxi 21st Group Army under Liao Lei left Guilin and Liuzhou via Wuhan and Xuzhou for Shanghai, and in October fought in the Yunzaobang counterattack. The Guangxi troops fought bravely but suffered heavy losses under Japanese firepower. Illustrative simplified route; dates follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

summary.zh: 1937年9月3日，日舰炮击厦门，屿仔尾炮台击沉日舰若竹号。
summary.en: On 3 September 1937 Japanese warships shelled Xiamen; the Yuzaiwei battery sank the Japanese destroyer Waketake.

fields.name: 厦门炮战 Naval Engagement off Xiamen
fields.summary: 1937年9月3日，日舰炮击厦门，屿仔尾炮台击沉日舰若竹号。 On 3 September 1937 Japanese warships shelled Xiamen; the Yuzaiwei battery sank the Japanese destroyer Waketake.
fields.description: 9月3日凌晨4时3分，日本海军驱逐舰「羽风」「若竹」号等3艘入侵厦门与海澄交界海域，向白石头炮台及曾厝垵海军飞机场发炮轰击，猛攻胡里山总台。驻守屿仔尾南炮台部队立即开炮迎击，开炮3发，两中若竹号艏艉；羽风等二舰遁逃，若竹舰沉没海中。此为海战，不绘地面路线。 At 4:03 a.m. on 3 September three Japanese destroyers, including Hagikaze and Waketake, entered the waters between Xiamen and Haicheng and shelled the Baishitou battery, the Zengcuoan naval airfield and the Huli Shan main fort. The Yuzaiwei battery opened fire with three rounds, hitting Waketake fore and aft; the other two ships fled and Waketake sank. As a naval engagement, it is not drawn as a ground route.

summary.zh: 1937年9月9日，日军攻占阳高县城。
summary.en: On 9 September 1937 Japanese forces captured Yanggao.

fields.name: 阳高沦陷 Fall of Yanggao
fields.summary: 1937年9月9日，日军攻占阳高县城。 On 9 September 1937 Japanese forces captured Yanggao.
fields.description: 9月初，日军关东军察哈尔派遣兵团突破天镇盘山防线，9月8日围攻阳高。守军第61军第414团据城抵抗，9日拂晓日军由东南城墙登城，阳高失守，守军由南门撤退。城破后日军在瓮城屠杀欢迎民众及青壮年五百余人。日期据《山西县城沦陷及光复概况》（阳高县政协稿）与《太原会战》逐日记载。 In early September the Kwantung Army’s Chahar force broke the Panshan line at Tianzhen and besieged Yanggao on 8 September. The 414th Regiment of the 61st Corps held the town until Japanese troops mounted the southeast wall at dawn on the 9th; Yanggao fell and the defenders withdrew through the south gate. After the capture the Japanese massacred more than 500 people in the barbican. Dates follow the Shanxi county gazetteer compilation and the day-by-day Taoyuan campaign account.

fields.name: 第18集团军成立 Establishment of the 18th Group Army
fields.summary: 国民政府军事委员会将八路军改称第18集团军，朱德任总司令。 The Military Commission renamed the Eighth Route Army the 18th Group Army, with Zhu De as commander-in-chief.
fields.description: 1937 年 9 月 11 日，国民政府军事委员会将国民革命军第八路军改称第18集团军，朱德任总司令，彭德怀任副总司令。因八路军番号已深入民心，中共方面和民间仍多沿用“八路军”名称，作战序列与指挥关系不变。 日期与主官为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 11 September 1937 the National Government’s Military Commission renamed the Eighth Route Army the 18th Group Army, with Zhu De as commander-in-chief and Peng Dehuai as deputy commander-in-chief. Because the name “Eighth Route Army” had already taken root, the Chinese Communist side and the public continued to use it; the order of battle and command relationships were unchanged. Dates and appointments follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.name: 蔚县沦陷 Fall of Yu County
fields.place: 察哈尔蔚县 Yu County, Chahar
fields.summary: 1937年9月11日，日军第5师团骑兵第5联队占领蔚县。 On 11 September 1937 the 5th Cavalry Regiment of the Japanese 5th Division occupied Yu County.
fields.description: 1937年9月6日，日军第5师团自宣化、新保安、怀来分三路南下，进攻蔚县；中国第68军刘汝明部未与日军接触即行后撤。9月11日，日军骑兵第5联队占领蔚县；随后第5师团经蔚县、广灵向灵丘方向进攻。日期据《战史丛书·支那事变·陆军作战(1)》译稿与《每日新闻社：日军侵华记录（八）》，两者均记9月11日。 On 6 September 1937 the Japanese 5th Division advanced south from Xuanhua, Xinbao’an and Huailai against Yu County; Liu Ruming’s 68th Corps withdrew without contact. On 11 September the 5th Cavalry Regiment occupied Yu County, and the 5th Division then moved through Yu County and Guangling toward Lingqiu. Both cited accounts give 11 September.

summary.zh: 1937年9月12日，日军攻占天镇县城。
summary.en: On 12 September 1937 Japanese forces captured Tianzhen.

fields.name: 天镇沦陷 Fall of Tianzhen
fields.summary: 1937年9月12日，日军攻占天镇县城。 On 12 September 1937 Japanese forces captured Tianzhen.
fields.description: 日军自9月3日起进攻天镇盘山防线，守军第61军苦战。9月7日守军主力后撤，仅留第399团守城；9月11日夜守军突围，12日天镇县城失守。天镇是晋北门户，失守后日军直趋大同。天镇日期另有9月11日说（《太原会战》逐日条记“九月十一日占领天镇县城”），此处取各县政协稿与同文正文的9月12日。 Japanese forces attacked the Panshan line at Tianzhen from 3 September. The 61st Corps’ main force withdrew on the 7th, leaving the 399th Regiment in the town; the garrison broke out on the night of the 11th and Tianzhen fell on the 12th, opening the road to Datong. One day-by-day account gives 11 September for the town’s capture; this entry follows the county gazetteer compilation and the same account’s narrative of the 12th.

fields.summary: 日军关东军察哈尔派遣兵团占领大同，随后沿同蒲路南下。 The Japanese Kwantung Army’s Chahar expeditionary force took Datong and moved south along the Tongpu railway.
fields.description: 1937 年 9 月 13 日日军关东军察哈尔派遣兵团占领大同，晋北门户洞开；日军随后沿同蒲路南下，10 月 13 日猛攻忻口。 On 13 September 1937 the Kwantung Army’s Chahar force took Datong, opening northern Shanxi; the Japanese then moved south along the Tongpu railway and attacked Xinkou on 13 October.

name.en: Appeal to the League of Nations

summary.zh: 中国向国际联盟申诉日本侵略，援引盟约第十七条。
summary.en: China appealed to the League of Nations against Japanese aggression under Article 17 of the Covenant.

fields.name: 国联申诉 Appeal to the League of Nations
fields.summary: 中国向国际联盟申诉日本侵略，援引盟约第十七条。 China appealed to the League of Nations against Japanese aggression under Article 17 of the Covenant.
fields.description: 1937 年 9 月 13 日，中国向国际联盟申诉日本侵略，援引盟约第十七条，要求制裁。国联随后通过谴责日本、支持中国的决议，但缺乏强制力，未采取实际行动。 日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。 On 13 September 1937 China appealed to the League of Nations against Japanese aggression under Article 17 of the Covenant and sought sanctions. The League adopted resolutions condemning Japan and supporting China, but they lacked enforcement and produced no practical action. Dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

summary.zh: 1937年9月14日，日军未经战斗占领怀仁县城。
summary.en: On 14 September 1937 Japanese forces occupied Huairen without a fight.

fields.name: 怀仁沦陷 Fall of Huairen
fields.summary: 1937年9月14日，日军未经战斗占领怀仁县城。 On 14 September 1937 Japanese forces occupied Huairen without a fight.
fields.description: 9月13日大同失守后，怀仁守军与县政府弃城南撤。9月14日，当地士绅出城迎接，日军独立混成第15旅团未发一枪占领怀仁县城。日期据《山西县城沦陷及光复概况》（怀仁县政协稿）与《太原会战》逐日记载。 After Datong fell on 13 September, the garrison and county government at Huairen withdrew south. On the 14th local gentry went out to welcome the Japanese, and the Independent Mixed 15th Brigade occupied the town without firing a shot. Dates follow the county gazetteer compilation and the day-by-day Taoyuan campaign account.

summary.zh: 1937年9月14日，日军第5师团攻占广灵县城。
summary.en: On 14 September 1937 the Japanese 5th Division captured Guangling.

fields.name: 广灵沦陷 Fall of Guangling
fields.summary: 1937年9月14日，日军第5师团攻占广灵县城。 On 14 September 1937 the Japanese 5th Division captured Guangling.
fields.description: 9月13日，日军第5师团第21旅团进攻广灵洗马庄一带，中国军队第73师防线被突破，师长刘奉滨负伤。9月14日广灵县城失守，第73师向平型关转进。此后八路军杨成武支队曾在月内四次收复县城，11月初日军再次侵占并长期盘踞。日期据《太原会战》逐日记载与《山西县城沦陷及光复概况》（广灵县政协稿）。 On 13 September the Japanese 5th Division’s 21st Brigade attacked the Chinese 73rd Division’s line at Ximazhuang and broke it, wounding divisional commander Liu Fengbin. Guangling fell on the 14th and the 73rd Division retired toward Pingxingguan. Yang Chengwu’s detachment retook the town four times within a month before the Japanese reoccupied it in early November. Dates follow the day-by-day campaign account and the county gazetteer compilation.

summary.zh: 1937年9月17日，日军独立步兵第11联队占领丰镇。
summary.en: On 17 September 1937 the Japanese 11th Independent Infantry Regiment occupied Fengzhen.

fields.name: 丰镇沦陷 Fall of Fengzhen
fields.summary: 1937年9月17日，日军独立步兵第11联队占领丰镇。 On 17 September 1937 the Japanese 11th Independent Infantry Regiment occupied Fengzhen.
fields.description: 1937年9月13日日军占领大同后，独立步兵第11联队沿平绥路向北推进，17日占领丰镇。丰镇为大同以北的平绥线要地，失守后日军打开进攻集宁、归绥的通道。日期据《战史丛书·支那事变·陆军作战(1)》译稿与《中国抗日战争全史》；《内蒙古区情网》记9月23日占丰镇县城，正文并列。 After taking Datong on 13 September 1937, the Japanese 11th Independent Infantry Regiment advanced north along the Beiping–Suiyuan railway and took Fengzhen on the 17th. Fengzhen was the key railway town north of Datong; its fall opened the way to Jining and Guisui. The Inner Mongolia gazetteer gives 23 September for the county town; that variant is noted.
