summary.zh: 1937年9月19日，日军混成第1旅团占领左云县城。
summary.en: On 19 September 1937 the Japanese 1st Mixed Brigade occupied Zuoyun.

fields.name: 左云沦陷 Fall of Zuoyun
fields.summary: 1937年9月19日，日军混成第1旅团占领左云县城。 On 19 September 1937 the Japanese 1st Mixed Brigade occupied Zuoyun.
fields.description: 9月17日，骑兵军孙长胜部数百人入左云守城，当晚日军攻城因雨停止。18日黄昏守军撤走，19日上午日军入城，随即屠杀居民287人。日期取《太原会战》逐日条“九月十九日……侵占左云”；《山西县城沦陷及光复概况》记18日黄昏守军撤走、次日入城，与此一致。 On 17 September several hundred men of Sun Changsheng’s cavalry entered Zuoyun; the Japanese attack that night was halted by rain. The defenders withdrew at dusk on the 18th and the Japanese entered on the morning of the 19th, then massacred 287 residents. The date follows the day-by-day campaign account, consistent with the county gazetteer compilation’s account of the defenders’ withdrawal on the 18th.

summary.en: On 19 September 1937 the Japanese Kawamura detachment occupied Xinghe.

fields.name: 兴和沦陷 Fall of Xinghe
fields.summary: 1937年9月19日，日军河村支队占领兴和。 On 19 September 1937 the Japanese Kawamura detachment occupied Xinghe.
fields.description: 1937年9月6日，日军独立混成第1旅团河村支队占领南壕堑，掩护兵团右侧；19日占领兴和，随后向凉城（宁远）方向推进，24日与自右玉方向进攻的松井支队会合，攻克隆城。日期据《战史丛书·支那事变·陆军作战(1)》译稿与《中国抗日战争全史》；《内蒙古区情网》记9月17日日军入侵兴和，正文并列。 On 6 September 1937 the Kawamura detachment of the Japanese 1st Independent Mixed Brigade took Nanhaojian to cover the army’s right flank; on the 19th it took Xinghe and advanced toward Liangcheng (Ningyuan), joining the Matsui detachment from Youyu on the 24th to capture the town. The Inner Mongolia gazetteer gives 17 September for the Japanese entry into Xinghe; that variant is noted.

fields.summary: 1937年9月24日，日军攻占沧州。 On 24 September 1937 Japanese forces captured Cangzhou.
fields.description: 9月，日军沿津浦铁路南犯。9月24日，日军攻占沧州。沧州是津浦线北段重镇，失守后日军继续南犯德州、济南。日期据《河北抗日战争史》与《河北省志·军事志》，待页码级核对。 In September Japanese forces advanced south along the Tianjin–Pukou railway and captured Cangzhou on 24 September. A key town on the northern section of the line, its fall opened the way south toward Dezhou and Jinan. The date follows the Hebei war history and the provincial military gazetteer and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 集宁沦陷 Fall of Jining
fields.summary: 1937年9月24日，日军占领集宁（平地泉）。 On 24 September 1937 the Japanese occupied Jining (Pingdiquan).
fields.description: 1937年9月24日，日军独立步兵第11联队占领绥东重镇平地泉（今集宁）。集宁守备司令曾延毅临阵脱逃，守军崩溃。集宁失守后，日军打开西进归绥的门户。日期据《战史丛书·支那事变·陆军作战(1)》译稿与《中国抗日战争全史》；《内蒙古区情网》记9月27日占集宁，正文并列。 On 24 September 1937 the Japanese 11th Independent Infantry Regiment took Pingdiquan (modern Jining), the key town of eastern Suiyuan. The garrison commander Zeng Yanyi fled and the defence collapsed. The fall of Jining opened the way west to Guisui. The Inner Mongolia gazetteer gives 27 September; that variant is noted.

fields.description: 1937年9月19日日军占领兴和后，河村支队向凉城（宁远）方向推进；24日与自右玉方向进攻的松井支队会合，攻克隆城。凉城失守后，日军从东南方向逼近归绥。日期据《战史丛书·支那事变·陆军作战(1)》译稿与《中国抗日战争全史》，两源一致。 After taking Xinghe on 19 September 1937, the Kawamura detachment advanced toward Liangcheng (Ningyuan); on the 24th it joined the Matsui detachment from Youyu and captured the town. summary.zh: 八路军第115师在平型关东北伏击日军，取得全面抗战初期的重要胜利。
summary.en: The 115th Division ambushed Japanese forces northeast of Pingxingguan, an important early victory of the full-scale war.

fields.name: 平型关大捷 Battle of Pingxingguan 平型关战斗 Pingxingguan Ambush 平型关伏击战 Pingxingguan Ambush
fields.place: 山西灵丘平型关 Pingxingguan, Lingqiu, Shanxi
fields.summary: 八路军第115师在平型关东北伏击日军，取得全面抗战初期的重要胜利。 The 115th Division ambushed Japanese forces northeast of Pingxingguan, an important early victory of the full-scale war.
fields.description: 1937 年 9 月 25 日，八路军第115师（师长林彪、副师长聂荣臻）在山西灵丘平型关东北的乔沟一带伏击日军第5师团第21旅团一部及辎重部队，毙伤日军一部，击毁汽车、马车多辆，取得全面抗战初期中国军队主动出击的重要胜利。此战打破了“日军不可战胜”的神话，也提高了八路军在华北的声威。 参战兵力与战果各书记载不一，待页码级核对。 On 25 September 1937 the 115th Division (commander Lin Biao, deputy commander Nie Rongzhen) ambushed a detachment of the Japanese 5th Division’s 21st Brigade and its supply train in the Qiaogou area northeast of Pingxingguan, Lingqiu, Shanxi, inflicting casualties and destroying trucks and carts. It was an important early victory won by Chinese forces taking the initiative, and it raised the Eighth Route Army’s prestige in North China. Force sizes and results vary between accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: Fall of Shuoxian and the Shuoxian Massacre

summary.zh: 1937年9月28日，日军攻破朔县县城，随后屠杀居民约三千人。
summary.en: On 28 September 1937 Japanese forces broke into Shuoxian and massacred some 3,000 residents.

fields.name: 朔县沦陷与朔县屠城 Fall of Shuoxian and the Shuoxian Massacre
fields.summary: 1937年9月28日，日军攻破朔县县城，随后屠杀居民约三千人。 On 28 September 1937 Japanese forces broke into Shuoxian and massacred some 3,000 residents.
fields.description: 9月27日傍晚，日军独立混成第1旅团进入朔县川。守军东北军何柱国部一个连与县长郭同仁、公安局长白生成率军民堵门守城。28日晨日军分两路包围县城，9时许以坦克破门，随即展开屠杀，持续三日，约三千人遇害，县长郭同仁殉难，是为“九二八惨案”。日期据《太原会战》逐日条“九月二十八日……占领朔县”与《山西县城沦陷及光复概况》（朔县政协稿）。 On the evening of 27 September the Japanese Independent Mixed 1st Brigade entered the Shuoxian basin. A company of He Zhuguo’s Northeast Army, county magistrate Guo Tongren and police chief Bai Shengcheng led civilians in barricading the gates. At dawn on the 28th the Japanese encircled the town and broke in with tanks around 9 a.m., beginning a three-day massacre in which about 3,000 people died and magistrate Guo was killed. Dates follow the day-by-day campaign account and the county gazetteer compilation.

fields.name: 繁峙沦陷 Fall of Fanshi
fields.summary: 1937年9月29日，日军混成第15旅团占领繁峙县城。 On 29 September 1937 the Japanese 15th Mixed Brigade occupied Fanshi.
fields.description: 9月28日，日军混成第15旅团攻占茹越口，中国守军第203旅旅长梁鉴堂力战殉国，日军越铁角岭南下。9月29日繁峙县城失守，平型关守军侧后受到威胁，第二战区随即下令全线后撤。日期据《太原会战》逐日记载与《山西县城沦陷及光复概况》（繁峙县政协、县志办稿）。 On 28 September the Japanese 15th Mixed Brigade took Ruyuekou after killing Brig. Liang Jiantang of the 203rd Brigade, then crossed Tiejiaoling. Fanshi fell on the 29th, threatening the rear of the Pingxingguan defenders and prompting the Second War Zone to order a general withdrawal. Dates follow the day-by-day campaign account and the county gazetteer compilation.

fields.summary: 1937年9月30日，日军混成第15旅团占领代县县城。 On 30 September 1937 the Japanese 15th Mixed Brigade occupied Daixian.
fields.description: 9月30日，日军由繁峙向代县进犯，晋绥军抵抗约半小时即退，日军当晚占领代县城。次日地方商会出面成立“代县治安维持会”。日期据《太原会战》逐日条“九月三十日……占领代县”与《山西县城沦陷及光复概况》（代县政协稿）。 On 30 September Japanese troops advanced from Fanshi toward Daixian; the Shanxi garrison resisted for about half an hour before withdrawing and the town fell that evening. The local chamber of commerce set up a “maintenance committee” the next day. Dates follow the day-by-day campaign account and the county gazetteer compilation.

summary.en: On 2 October 1937 the Japanese 1st Mixed Brigade occupied Ningwu and massacred more than 2,000 residents.

fields.name: 宁武沦陷 Fall of Ningwu
fields.summary: 1937年10月2日，日军混成第1旅团占领宁武县城，随后屠杀居民两千余人。 On 2 October 1937 the Japanese 1st Mixed Brigade occupied Ningwu and massacred more than 2,000 residents.
fields.description: 10月2日，日军由朔县进攻宁武，晚九时占领县城。日军诱骗外逃群众回城，随后集中屠杀，遇害者两千二百余人。10月13日八路军第120师袭击县城，日军连夜撤离；1938年日军再次入侵。日期据《太原会战》逐日条与《山西县城沦陷及光复概况》（宁武县政协稿）。 On 2 October Japanese troops advanced from Shuoxian and took Ningwu at 9 p.m. They lured fleeing residents back and then massacred more than 2,200 people. On 13 October the 120th Division attacked the town and the Japanese withdrew overnight; they invaded again in 1938. Dates follow the day-by-day campaign account and the county gazetteer compilation.

summary.en: On 5 October 1937 the Japanese 10th Division captured Dezhou.

fields.name: 德州沦陷 Fall of Dezhou
fields.summary: 1937年10月5日，日军第10师团攻占德州。 On 5 October 1937 the Japanese 10th Division captured Dezhou.
fields.description: 9月30日，日军第10师团沿津浦路侵入山东。10月3日进攻德州，中国守军第3集团军抵抗；10月5日德州沦陷。日军占领后掠夺资源、强征劳工，德州成为津浦路北段重要据点。日期据《山东抗日战争大事记》与《日军进攻山东》，待页码级核对。 On 30 September the Japanese 10th Division entered Shandong along the Tianjin–Pukou railway. It attacked Dezhou on 3 October against resistance by the Chinese 3rd Group Army, and the city fell on 5 October. Japanese forces then plundered resources and conscripted labour, making Dezhou a key point on the northern section of the railway. The date follows the Shandong war chronology and the provincial party history and awaits page-level verification.

fields.description: 10月，日军沿平汉铁路南犯。10月8日，日军攻占定县。定县是平汉线中段重镇，失守后日军继续南犯石家庄。日期据《中国抗日战争史》与《河北省志·军事志》，待页码级核对。 In October Japanese forces advanced south along the Beiping–Hankou railway and captured Dingxian on 8 October. A key town on the central section of the line, its fall opened the way south toward Shijiazhuang. The date follows the Chinese war history and the provincial military gazetteer and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 崞县沦陷 Fall of Guoxian
fields.place: 山西崞县 Guoxian (now Guoyang, Yuanping), Shanxi
fields.summary: 1937年10月8日，日军混成第2旅团攻占崞县县城。 On 8 October 1937 the Japanese 2nd Mixed Brigade captured Guoxian.
fields.description: 10月1日起，日军混成第2旅团由代县南下进攻崞县，第19军王靖国部苦战一周。10月8日晨守军撤出，崞县失守，团长刘良相、石成文阵亡，日军入城后屠杀居民与伤兵两千五百余人。崞县即今原平市崞阳镇，与南面的原平镇为忻口以北两处要点。日期据《太原会战》逐日条与《山西县城沦陷及光复概况》（原平县政协稿）。 From 1 October the Japanese 2nd Mixed Brigade advanced south from Daixian against Guoxian, where Wang Jingguo’s 19th Corps fought for a week. The defenders withdrew on the morning of the 8th; colonels Liu Liangxiang and Shi Chengwen were killed and the Japanese massacred more than 2,500 residents and wounded. Guoxian is today’s Guoyang town in Yuanping. Dates follow the day-by-day campaign account and the county gazetteer compilation.

fields.description: 1937 年 10 月，日军第 1 军沿平汉线继续南下。10 月 10 日，日军占领石家庄，控制平汉、正太两铁路交会点，为沿正太线西攻娘子关、太原创造条件。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In October 1937 the Japanese 1st Army continued south along the Peiping–Hankou railway. On 10 October it captured Shijiazhuang, the junction of the Peiping–Hankou and Zhengding–Taiyuan railways, creating conditions for the westward drive along the Zhengding–Taiyuan line toward Niangziguan and Taiyuan. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 原平沦陷 Fall of Yuanping
fields.place: 山西崞县原平镇 Yuanping, Shanxi
fields.summary: 1937年10月10日，日军混成第15旅团攻占原平镇，守军第196旅几乎全部殉国。 On 10 October 1937 the Japanese 15th Mixed Brigade captured Yuanping; the Chinese 196th Brigade was almost annihilated.
fields.description: 10月4日，日军混成第15旅团绕过崞县进攻原平，第34军第196旅旅长姜玉贞率部死守。原平掩护忻口布防，守军完成任务后于10日夜至11日晨突围，姜玉贞中弹殉国，全旅四千余人大部阵亡。日期取《太原会战》逐日条“十月十日……攻占原平”；姜玉贞突围殉国在11日，两说并不矛盾。 On 4 October the Japanese 15th Mixed Brigade bypassed Guoxian and attacked Yuanping, defended by Brig. Jiang Yuzhen’s 196th Brigade of the 34th Corps. Covering the deployment at Xinkou, the brigade broke out on the night of the 10th; Jiang was mortally wounded and most of his 4,000 men died. The capture date follows the day-by-day campaign account; Jiang’s death during the breakout on the 11th is consistent with it.

summary.zh: 川军第22集团军自四川北上，在娘子关一线参加保卫战。

fields.name: 川军第22集团军参加娘子关战斗 22nd Group Army at Niangziguan
fields.summary: 川军第22集团军自四川北上，在娘子关一线参加保卫战。 The Sichuan 22nd Group Army marched north and fought in the defense of Niangziguan.
fields.description: 1937 年 10 月，川军第22集团军经宝鸡、西安北上，在娘子关一线参加对日作战。川军装备低劣、补给困难，仍以重大伤亡迟滞日军。此后该部转赴山东，参加滕县保卫战。 路线为示意简化，日期取通行说法，待史料校订。 In October 1937 the Sichuan 22nd Group Army moved north via Baoji and Xi’an and fought the Japanese at Niangziguan. Poorly equipped and badly supplied, it still delayed the Japanese at great cost. The army then moved to Shandong and fought in the defense of Tengxian. Illustrative simplified route; dates follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

summary.en: Chinese forces blocked the Japanese at Xinkou for nearly a month before the position fell and Taiyuan was lost.

fields.name: 忻口会战 Battle of Xinkou 忻口战役 Xinkou Campaign
fields.summary: 中国军队在忻口阻击日军，激战近一个月，忻口最终失守，太原随后沦陷。 Chinese forces blocked the Japanese at Xinkou for nearly a month before the position fell and Taiyuan was lost.
fields.description: 1937 年 10 月，日军第五师团等部沿同蒲铁路南下，进攻忻口。中国第二战区部队在卫立煌指挥下依托阵地顽强抵抗，双方在忻口一线激战。日军久攻不下，后因娘子关失守、中国军队侧后受威胁，中国军队于 11 月 2 日撤退，太原于 11 月 8 日失守。此役是太原会战的重要组成部分。 本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。 In October 1937, Japanese forces including the 5th Division advanced south along the Datong–Pukou railway and attacked Xinkou. Chinese troops of the Second War Zone, commanded by Wei Lihuang, resisted stubbornly from prepared positions in fierce fighting around Xinkou. Unable to break through quickly, the Japanese exploited the fall of Niangziguan and threatened the Chinese flank and rear; Chinese forces withdrew on 2 November, and Taiyuan fell on 8 November. The battle was an important part of the Taiyuan campaign. Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

fields.description: 1937 年 10 月，日军关东军察哈尔派遣兵团沿平绥线西进，进攻绥远。10 月 14 日，日军占领归绥（今呼和浩特），中国守军撤退。归绥沦陷使日军控制绥远东部，随后进攻包头。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In October 1937 the Japanese Kwantung Army’s Chahar Expeditionary Force advanced west along the Peiping–Suiyuan railway into Suiyuan. On 14 October it captured Guisui (present-day Hohhot) and the Chinese defenders withdrew. The fall of Guisui gave Japan control of eastern Suiyuan and opened the way to Baotou. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1937年10月15日，日军攻占邢台。
summary.en: On 15 October 1937 Japanese forces captured Xingtai.

fields.name: 邢台沦陷 Fall of Xingtai
fields.summary: 1937年10月15日，日军攻占邢台。 On 15 October 1937 Japanese forces captured Xingtai.
fields.description: 10月15日，日军沿平汉线南犯，攻占邢台。邢台是冀南重镇，失守后日军继续南犯邯郸。日期据《中国抗日战争史》与《河北省志·军事志》，待页码级核对。 On 15 October Japanese forces advanced south along the Beiping–Hankou railway and captured Xingtai. A key town in southern Hebei, its fall opened the way to Handan. The date follows the Chinese war history and the provincial military gazetteer and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1937年10月16日，日军占领萨拉齐县城，制造萨拉齐惨案。
summary.en: On 16 October 1937 the Japanese occupied Salaqi and carried out the Salaqi massacre.

fields.name: 萨拉齐沦陷 Fall of Salaqi
fields.summary: 1937年10月16日，日军占领萨拉齐县城，制造萨拉齐惨案。 On 16 October 1937 the Japanese occupied Salaqi and carried out the Salaqi massacre.
fields.description: 1937年10月14日归绥失陷后，日军沿平包铁路西进，16日上午进犯萨拉齐县城，不到两小时内屠杀居民70人；同日又在公积板村杀害村民41人。17日日军占领包头。日期据《内蒙古区情网》、浙江在线《10月16日》与《日军进犯包头途中的两起大屠杀》，三源一致。 After Guisui fell on 14 October 1937 the Japanese advanced west along the Beiping–Baotou railway. On the morning of the 16th they entered Salaqi and killed 70 residents in less than two hours, then killed 41 villagers at Gongjiban; Baotou fell on the 17th. Three cited accounts agree on 16 October.

summary.en: Japanese forces captured Baotou, completing the occupation of the western Peiping–Suiyuan railway.

fields.name: 包头沦陷 Fall of Baotou
fields.summary: 日军占领包头，平绥线西段沦陷。 Japanese forces captured Baotou, completing the occupation of the western Peiping–Suiyuan railway.
fields.description: 1937 年 10 月 17 日，日军占领包头，平绥线西段至此基本沦陷。日军随后在绥远扶植伪政权，控制煤炭、铁路等资源。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 17 October 1937 Japanese forces captured Baotou, completing the occupation of the western Peiping–Suiyuan railway. Japan then installed puppet authorities in Suiyuan and controlled coal, railway and other resources. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

summary.en: On 17 October 1937 Japanese forces captured Handan.

fields.name: 邯郸沦陷 Fall of Handan
fields.summary: 1937年10月17日，日军攻占邯郸。 On 17 October 1937 Japanese forces captured Handan.
fields.description: 10月17日，日军攻占邯郸。邯郸是平汉线南段与冀南门户，失守后日军继续南犯磁县、安阳。日期据《中国抗日战争史》与《河北省志·军事志》，待页码级核对。 On 17 October Japanese forces captured Handan. At the southern section of the Beiping–Hankou railway and the gateway to southern Hebei, its fall opened the way to Cixian and Anyang. The date follows the Chinese war history and the provincial military gazetteer and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 八路军第120师第358旅在雁门关以南伏击日军运输队，切断忻口前线补给。
summary.en: The 358th Brigade of the 120th Division ambushed Japanese supply columns south of Yanmenguan, cutting the supply line to the Xinkou front.

fields.name: 雁门关伏击战 Ambush at Yanmenguan 雁门关战斗 Battle of Yanmenguan
fields.place: 山西代县雁门关 Yanmenguan, Daixian, Shanxi
fields.summary: 八路军第120师第358旅在雁门关以南伏击日军运输队，切断忻口前线补给。 The 358th Brigade of the 120th Division ambushed Japanese supply columns south of Yanmenguan, cutting the supply line to the Xinkou front.
fields.description: 1937 年 10 月，八路军第120师第358旅第716团在山西代县雁门关以南的黑石头沟地区连续两次设伏，袭击日军往返于大同、忻口之间的汽车运输队，一度切断日军补给线，配合了正面战场的忻口防御作战。 参战部队、日期与战果为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In October 1937 the 716th Regiment of the 358th Brigade, 120th Division, set ambushes twice in the Heishitougou area south of Yanmenguan, Daixian, Shanxi, attacking Japanese truck convoys between Datong and Xinkou. The attacks temporarily cut the Japanese supply line and supported the Xinkou defense on the regular front. Units, dates, and results follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.summary: 1937年10月18日，日军攻占磁县。 On 18 October 1937 Japanese forces captured Cixian.
fields.description: 10月18日，日军攻占磁县。磁县是河北南端、平汉线入豫前的最后一站，失守后日军进入河南安阳。日期据《中国抗日战争史》与《河北省志·军事志》，待页码级核对。 On 18 October Japanese forces captured Cixian. At the southern tip of Hebei and the last station on the Beiping–Hankou railway before Henan, its fall opened the way into Anyang. The date follows the Chinese war history and the provincial military gazetteer and awaits page-level verification.

summary.en: The Guangxi 21st Group Army and other units counterattacked along Yunzaobang at heavy cost.

fields.name: 蕴藻浜反击战 Yunzaobang Counterattack
fields.summary: 桂军第21集团军等在蕴藻浜一线反击日军，伤亡惨重。 The Guangxi 21st Group Army and other units counterattacked along Yunzaobang at heavy cost.
fields.description: 1937 年 10 月中下旬，中国军队在蕴藻浜一线反击日军，桂军第21集团军等部投入战斗。由于日军火力占优，反击未能奏效，桂军伤亡惨重。 路线为示意简化，日期取通行说法，待史料校订。 In mid-to-late October 1937 Chinese forces counterattacked along Yunzaobang, with the Guangxi 21st Group Army and others committed. Japanese firepower prevailed, the counterattack failed, and the Guangxi troops suffered heavy casualties. Illustrative simplified route; dates follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

summary.en: The 769th Regiment of the 129th Division raided Yangmingbao airfield at night, destroying or damaging 24 Japanese aircraft.

fields.place: 山西代县阳明堡 Yangmingbao, Daixian, Shanxi
fields.summary: 八路军第129师第769团夜袭阳明堡机场，毁伤日军飞机 24 架。 The 769th Regiment of the 129th Division raided Yangmingbao airfield at night, destroying or damaging 24 Japanese aircraft.
fields.description: 1937 年 10 月 19 日夜，八路军第129师第769团（团长陈锡联）突袭山西代县阳明堡日军机场，毁伤飞机 24 架，歼灭机场警卫分队百余人，打击了日军在忻口方向的空中支援。 日期、战果为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On the night of 19 October 1937 the 769th Regiment of the 129th Division (commander Chen Xilian) raided the Japanese airfield at Yangmingbao, Daixian, Shanxi, destroying or damaging 24 aircraft and killing more than a hundred airfield guards, thereby reducing Japanese air support for the Xinkou front. Dates and results follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: The 386th Brigade of the 129th Division ambushed Japanese supply troops twice at the same spot near Qigencun.

fields.name: 七亘村伏击战 Ambush at Qigencun 七亘大捷 Qigen Victory
fields.place: 山西平定七亘村 Qigencun, Pingding, Shanxi
fields.summary: 八路军第129师第386旅在七亘村连续两次重叠设伏，打击日军辎重部队。 The 386th Brigade of the 129th Division ambushed Japanese supply troops twice at the same spot near Qigencun.
fields.description: 1937 年 10 月 26 日和 28 日，八路军第129师第386旅第772团在山西平定县七亘村连续两次设伏，袭击向平定方向运送物资的日军第20师团辎重部队，毙伤日军数百人。刘伯承将这种在同一地点重复设伏的战法称为“重叠设伏”。 日期、番号与战果为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 26 and 28 October 1937 the 772nd Regiment of the 386th Brigade, 129th Division, ambushed Japanese 20th Division supply troops carrying matériel toward Pingding at Qigencun, Shanxi, inflicting several hundred casualties. Liu Bocheng called this repeated ambush at the same site “overlapping ambush.” Dates, unit designations, and results follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军第 20 师团等部攻占娘子关，打开晋东门户。
summary.en: The Japanese 20th Division and other units captured Niangziguan, opening the eastern gateway to Shanxi.

fields.name: 娘子关失守 Fall of Niangziguan
fields.place: 山西平定娘子关 Niangziguan, Pingding, Shanxi
fields.summary: 日军第 20 师团等部攻占娘子关，打开晋东门户。 The Japanese 20th Division and other units captured Niangziguan, opening the eastern gateway to Shanxi.
fields.description: 1937 年 10 月，日军第 20 师团等部沿正太线西进，进攻娘子关。中国军队第 26 路军、第 27 路军等部在娘子关、旧关一带顽强抵抗。10 月 26 日，娘子关失守，日军随后西进太原。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In October 1937 the Japanese 20th Division and other units advanced west along the Zhengding–Taiyuan railway against Niangziguan. Chinese 26th and 27th Route Army troops resisted stubbornly at Niangziguan and Jiuguan. Niangziguan fell on 26 October and the Japanese advanced west toward Taiyuan. fields.place: 福建金门料罗湾 Liaoluo Bay, Kinmen, Fujian
fields.summary: 1937年10月26日，日军在料罗湾登陆，进攻金门县城。 On 26 October 1937 Japanese forces landed at Liaoluo Bay and attacked the Kinmen county town.
fields.description: 10月26日12时，日军攻占金门县城。日军在料罗湾登陆后向金门城推进，金门县长邝汉未待日军登陆即擅离职守，率家属和公务人员先逃往大嶝岛，然后转逃漳州。日期据《泉州抗日战争大事记》与《漳州抗日战争大事记》，待页码级核对。 At noon on 26 October Japanese forces captured the Kinmen county town. After landing at Liaoluo Bay they advanced on the town; county magistrate Kuang Han abandoned his post before the landing, fleeing with his family and staff first to Dadeng island and then to Zhangzhou. The date follows the Quanzhou and Zhangzhou chronicles and awaits page-level verification.

fields.place: 福建金门城 Kinmen town, Fujian
fields.summary: 1937年10月26日，金门县城沦陷。 On 26 October 1937 the Kinmen county town fell.
fields.description: 10月26日，日军攻占金门县城，金门沦陷。金门县政府退至大嶝岛，改设办事处。金门是福建最早沦陷的县份之一。日期据《泉州抗日战争大事记》与《漳州抗日战争大事记》，待页码级核对。 On 26 October Japanese forces captured the Kinmen county town and Kinmen fell. The county government withdrew to Dadeng island and set up an office there. Kinmen was one of the earliest counties in Fujian to fall. The date follows the Quanzhou and Zhangzhou chronicles and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1937年10月29日，日军第20师团侵占平定县城。
summary.en: On 29 October 1937 the Japanese 20th Division occupied Pingding.

fields.name: 平定沦陷 Fall of Pingding
fields.summary: 1937年10月29日，日军第20师团侵占平定县城。 On 29 October 1937 the Japanese 20th Division occupied Pingding.
fields.description: 10月26日娘子关失守后，日军第20师团沿正太线西追。平定县长及公务人员先期弃城，守军炸毁阳泉五渡铁路桥后西撤。10月29日夜十时许日军先头部队进入平定城，翌日大队开进，30日占领阳泉。日期据《太原会战》逐日条“十月二十九日……侵占平定县城”与《山西县城沦陷及光复概况》（平定县政协稿）。 After Niangziguan fell on 26 October, the Japanese 20th Division pursued west along the Zhengding–Taiyuan railway. The Pingding magistrate and officials had fled and the garrison withdrew after blowing up the Wudu railway bridge at Yangquan. Japanese advance troops entered Pingding around 10 p.m. on the 29th, the main body followed next morning, and Yangquan was occupied on the 30th. Dates follow the day-by-day campaign account and the county gazetteer compilation.

summary.zh: 1937年10月30日，日军第20师团占领阳泉镇。
summary.en: On 30 October 1937 the Japanese 20th Division occupied Yangquan.

fields.name: 阳泉沦陷 Fall of Yangquan
fields.place: 山西平定阳泉镇 Yangquan, Shanxi
fields.summary: 1937年10月30日，日军第20师团占领阳泉镇。 On 30 October 1937 the Japanese 20th Division occupied Yangquan.
fields.description: 阳泉时为平定县属镇，是正太铁路与煤矿枢纽。娘子关失守后，日军第20师团以两纵队向阳泉平原追击，10月30日占领阳泉，随后西犯寿阳、榆次。日期据《山西县城沦陷及光复概况》（平定县政协稿）与《抗日战争中的阳泉》。 Yangquan was then a town in Pingding county and a hub of the Zhengding–Taiyuan railway and coal mines. After Niangziguan fell, the Japanese 20th Division pursued in two columns onto the Yangquan plain and occupied the town on 30 October before advancing on Shouyang and Yuci. Dates follow the county gazetteer compilation and the Shanxi war-resistance account of Yangquan.

fields.name: 寿阳沦陷 Fall of Shouyang
fields.summary: 1937年11月2日，日军第20师团占领寿阳县城。 On 2 November 1937 the Japanese 20th Division occupied Shouyang.
fields.description: 日军第20师团自平定、阳泉西进，击退川军第41军阻击后于11月2日占领寿阳，随即逼近榆次、太原。八路军第115师、第129师先后在广阳伏击日军。寿阳日期取《太原会战》逐日条“十一月二日占寿阳”与《娘子关战役》所记同一日期；《山西县城沦陷及光复概况》寿阳县稿则记10月30日占领县城，异说并存，本条目从多数记载。 The Japanese 20th Division advanced west from Pingding and Yangquan, brushed aside the Sichuan 41st Corps and took Shouyang on 2 November, closing on Yuci and Taiyuan. The 115th and 129th Divisions ambushed Japanese columns at Guangyang. The date follows the day-by-day campaign account and the Niangziguan campaign account; the county gazetteer compilation gives 30 October as a variant, noted here.

summary.zh: 九国公约会议在布鲁塞尔召开，中国呼吁制裁日本，未获实质结果。
summary.en: The Nine-Power Treaty Conference met in Brussels; China called for sanctions on Japan but achieved no substantive result.

fields.name: 九国公约会议 Nine-Power Treaty Conference
fields.place: 比利时布鲁塞尔 Brussels, Belgium
fields.summary: 九国公约会议在布鲁塞尔召开，中国呼吁制裁日本，未获实质结果。 The Nine-Power Treaty Conference met in Brussels; China called for sanctions on Japan but achieved no substantive result.
fields.description: 1937 年 11 月，九国公约会议在布鲁塞尔召开，中国代表顾维钧呼吁制裁日本，但会议仅通过泛泛决议，未采取实际行动。中国转而更多寻求苏联、美国等双边援助。 会议是九国公约签字国召开的多边会议，中国是参加国和申诉方，但会议本身不是中国政府的决策。 国际事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。 In November 1937 the Nine-Power Treaty Conference met in Brussels. Chinese representative Wellington Koo called for sanctions on Japan, but the conference adopted only general resolutions and took no practical action. China increasingly turned to bilateral aid from the Soviet Union and the United States. The conference was a multilateral meeting of the Nine-Power Treaty signatories; China was a participant and complainant, but the conference itself was not a decision of the Chinese government. An international event with no route drawn; dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

fields.name: 日军登陆金山卫 Japanese Landing at Jinshanwei
fields.place: 江苏金山卫（今属上海） Jinshanwei (present-day Shanghai)
fields.summary: 日军第 10 军在金山卫登陆，迂回淞沪中国守军侧后。 The Japanese 10th Army landed at Jinshanwei, turning the flank of the Chinese forces at Shanghai.
fields.description: 1937 年 11 月 5 日，日军第 10 军在杭州湾北岸金山卫登陆，突破中国守军防线，向松江、嘉兴方向推进，威胁淞沪中国军队侧后。中国军队随后全线西撤，上海于 11 月 12 日沦陷。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 5 November 1937 the Japanese 10th Army landed at Jinshanwei on the north bank of Hangzhou Bay, broke through the Chinese defenses and advanced toward Songjiang and Jiaxing, threatening the rear of the Chinese forces at Shanghai. The Chinese army then withdrew along the whole line and Shanghai fell on 12 November. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

fields.description: 1937 年 11 月 5 日，德国驻华大使陶德曼受日本委托，向蒋介石转达日方停战条件，包括承认伪满、华北特殊化、赔款等。随着南京沦陷和日本提出更苛刻条件，调停失败。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 5 November 1937 German ambassador Oskar Trautmann, acting at Japan’s request, conveyed Japanese armistice terms to Chiang Kai-shek, including recognition of Manchukuo, special status for North China and indemnities. After the fall of Nanjing and Japan’s harsher terms, the mediation failed. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 安阳沦陷 Fall of Anyang
fields.summary: 1937年11月5日，日军第14师团攻占豫北重镇安阳（彰德）。 On 5 November 1937 the Japanese 14th Division captured Anyang (Zhangde), the key city of northern Henan.
fields.description: 1937年11月3日，日军第14师团强渡漳河；4日凌晨攻占安阳火车站；5日下午2时由小西门突入城内，安阳（彰德）沦陷。日军入城后屠杀居民千余人、烧房两千余间。安阳是河南第一个沦陷的重要城市，此后成为日军进攻晋东南和豫北的出发点。日期据《抗战时期安阳地区大事记》与《河南的抗战历程》，两者均记11月5日城陷。 On 3 November 1937 the Japanese 14th Division forced the Zhang River; before dawn on the 4th it took Anyang railway station, and at 2 p.m. on the 5th it entered the city through the Small West Gate. Anyang (Zhangde) thus became the first major Henan city to fall, and later served as the Japanese base for operations into southeastern Shanxi and northern Henan. Both cited accounts give 5 November.

name.en: Establishment of the Jin-Cha-Ji Military Region

summary.zh: 晋察冀军区在阜平成立，开辟华北第一个敌后抗日根据地。
summary.en: The Jin-Cha-Ji Military Region was established at Fuping, opening North China’s first base area behind enemy lines.

fields.name: 晋察冀军区成立 Establishment of the Jin-Cha-Ji Military Region
fields.summary: 晋察冀军区在阜平成立，开辟华北第一个敌后抗日根据地。 The Jin-Cha-Ji Military Region was established at Fuping, opening North China’s first base area behind enemy lines.
fields.description: 1937 年 11 月 7 日，根据中共中央和中央军委命令，晋察冀军区在河北阜平成立，聂荣臻任司令员兼政治委员，统一领导以五台山、阜平为中心的敌后武装。11 月下旬，日军调集 2 万余人分八路围攻，军区部队以游击战和集中主力歼敌相结合，粉碎围攻，根据地扩展到 30 余县，成为华北第一个敌后抗日根据地。 日期、兵力与主官为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 7 November 1937, by order of the CCP Central Committee and Central Military Commission, the Jin-Cha-Ji Military Region was established at Fuping, Hebei, with Nie Rongzhen as commander and political commissar. In late November Japanese forces totaling more than 20,000 attacked in eight routes; the region’s troops combined guerrilla warfare with concentrated attacks, broke the encirclement, and expanded the base to more than 30 counties, making it North China’s first base area behind enemy lines. Dates, force sizes, and appointments follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.name: 平遥沦陷 Fall of Pingyao
fields.summary: 1937年11月9日，日军第20师团侵占平遥县城。 On 9 November 1937 the Japanese 20th Division occupied Pingyao.
fields.description: 太原失守后，日军第20师团沿同蒲线南下，11月9日侵占平遥城，半月后撤回祁县。1938年2月13日日军再犯平遥，第17军高桂滋部骑兵营与自卫队抵抗，营长史殿杰力战自尽，日军入城后杀害伤兵与居民千余人。日期取《山西县城沦陷及光复概况》（平遥县稿）；《太原会战》逐日条记11月10日进占平遥，异说并存。 After Taiyuan fell the Japanese 20th Division moved south along the Tongpu railway and occupied Pingyao on 9 November, withdrawing to Qixian about a fortnight later. On 13 February 1938 the Japanese attacked again; a cavalry battalion of Gao Guizi’s 17th Corps and local militia resisted, battalion commander Shi Dianjie took his own life, and more than 1,000 wounded soldiers and residents were killed. The date follows the county gazetteer compilation; the campaign chronology gives 10 November as a variant.

summary.zh: 太原失守后，八路军总部在石拐镇部署三师分兵，由正规战转向敌后游击战。
summary.en: After the fall of Taiyuan, the Eighth Route Army headquarters at Shiguan deployed its three divisions to disperse behind enemy lines and shift from regular to guerrilla warfare.

fields.name: 石拐会议 Shiguan Conference 石拐镇会议 Shiguan Town Conference
fields.place: 山西和顺石拐镇 Shiguan, Heshun, Shanxi
fields.summary: 太原失守后，八路军总部在石拐镇部署三师分兵，由正规战转向敌后游击战。 After the fall of Taiyuan, the Eighth Route Army headquarters at Shiguan deployed its three divisions to disperse behind enemy lines and shift from regular to guerrilla warfare.
fields.description: 1937 年 11 月 8 日太原失守，华北以国民党为主体的正规战争基本结束。11 日，朱德在山西和顺石拐镇主持召开八路军总部领导干部会议，彭德怀、任弼时、左权、刘伯承、张浩、宋任穷等出席，决定第120师以管涔山为支点创建晋西北根据地，第115师主力转至吕梁山创建晋西南根据地，第129师与第115师一部依托太行、太岳山创建晋冀豫根据地。13 日，刘伯承主持召开第129师干部会议，部署「化整为零」、分兵发动群众。会后八路军三大主力由正规战转入游击战，分区挺进敌后。 会议日期、与会人员与各师分区分工为通行说法，石拐镇坐标按和顺县位置示意，均待页码级核对。 Taiyuan fell on 8 November 1937, ending the phase in which Nationalist regular forces bore the main burden in North China. On 11 November Zhu De chaired a headquarters conference of senior commanders at Shiguan, Heshun, Shanxi—attended by Peng Dehuai, Ren Bishi, Zuo Quan, Liu Bocheng, Zhang Hao, and Song Renqiong—which assigned the 120th Division to build the northwestern Shanxi base around the Guancen Mountains, the main force of the 115th Division to build the southwestern Shanxi base in the Lüliang Mountains, and the 129th Division with part of the 115th to build the Jin-Ji-Yu base in the Taihang and Taiyue mountains. On 13 November Liu Bocheng chaired a 129th Division cadres’ meeting and ordered units to “break into pieces,” disperse, and mobilize the population. The three main divisions then shifted from regular to guerrilla warfare and moved into the Japanese rear in separate areas. Dates, attendees, and area assignments follow conventional accounts; the Shiguan coordinates are schematic, based on Heshun county, and await page-level verification.

fields.name: 上海沦陷 Fall of Shanghai
fields.summary: 淞沪会战后期中国军队西撤，日军占领上海。 At the end of the Battle of Shanghai the Chinese army withdrew west and Japanese forces occupied the city.
fields.description: 1937 年 11 月，日军第 10 军在金山卫登陆，迂回中国守军侧后。11 月 12 日，中国军队撤离上海，日军占领上海除租界外地区。上海沦陷使日军获得进攻南京的基地。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In November 1937 the Japanese 10th Army landed at Jinshanwei and turned the Chinese flank. On 12 November the Chinese forces withdrew from Shanghai and the Japanese occupied the city outside the foreign concessions. The fall of Shanghai gave Japan a base for the advance on Nanjing. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

fields.description: 日军登陆后沿途烧杀，吴市一带被杀害群众571人，全县3000余名群众被杀、3万余间房屋被烧。11月19日攻入常熟县城，杀害无辜群众1500人，烧毁全城三分之一房屋。此段为日军登陆后向常熟县城进攻的起点，路线为示意简化。 After landing, Japanese forces burned and killed along the way: 571 people were killed in the Wushi area, more than 3,000 across the county, and over 30,000 houses were burned. They entered Changshu on 19 November, killing some 1,500 civilians and burning a third of the city. This is the starting point of the advance on Changshu; the route is schematic.

fields.name: 日军进攻昆山 Japanese Attack on Kunshan
fields.summary: 1937年11月15日，日军进攻昆山，吴县县政府官员撤逃。 On 15 November 1937 Japanese forces attacked Kunshan; officials of Wu county government fled.
fields.description: 淞沪会战后期，日军沿京沪铁路西进。11月15日进攻昆山，昆山城陷的具体日期史料记载不一，本事件只记「进攻」，不写「沦陷」；路线自昆山向苏州，表示日军沿铁路西进方向。日期据《1937年江苏历史大事记》，待页码级核对。 In the late stage of the Battle of Shanghai, Japanese forces advanced west along the Nanjing–Shanghai railway. They attacked Kunshan on 15 November; sources differ on the exact date the town fell, so this event records the attack rather than the fall. The route from Kunshan to Suzhou shows the westward advance and is schematic. The date follows the 1937 Jiangsu chronicle and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1937年11月19日，日军攻入常熟县城，常熟沦陷。
summary.en: On 19 November 1937 Japanese forces entered Changshu and the county town fell.

fields.name: 常熟沦陷 Fall of Changshu
fields.summary: 1937年11月19日，日军攻入常熟县城，常熟沦陷。 On 19 November 1937 Japanese forces entered Changshu and the county town fell.
fields.description: 日军从白茆口登陆后于11月19日攻入常熟县城。城内商店停业，南门莲墩浜盐公堂发生机枪扫射，300余人被杀；全城三分之一房屋被烧。三源日期一致。 After landing at Baimaokou, Japanese forces entered Changshu on 19 November. Shops closed, more than 300 people were machine-gunned at the Liandunbang salt depot by the south gate, and a third of the city's houses were burned. Three sources agree on the date.

summary.en: On 19 November 1937 Japanese forces entered Suzhou and the city fell.

fields.name: 苏州沦陷 Fall of Suzhou
fields.summary: 1937年11月19日，日军攻入苏州城，苏州沦陷。 On 19 November 1937 Japanese forces entered Suzhou and the city fell.
fields.description: 11月17日日军分两路进犯苏州，19日第10军海劳原部攻入苏州城。城郊遭血腥屠杀，6774人被杀，大火燃烧三天三夜；城内尸骸枕藉，银行、店铺、住宅被劫掠。三源日期一致。 Japanese forces attacked Suzhou from two directions on 17 November and the 10th Army entered the city on 19 November. Some 6,774 people were killed in the suburbs and fires burned for three days; banks, shops and homes were looted. Three sources agree on the date.

summary.zh: 1937年11月19日，日军侵入临清。
summary.en: On 19 November 1937 Japanese forces entered Linqing.

fields.name: 临清沦陷 Fall of Linqing
fields.summary: 1937年11月19日，日军侵入临清。 On 19 November 1937 Japanese forces entered Linqing.
fields.description: 11月16日，韩复榘下令第三集团军各部撤过黄河并炸毁黄河大桥，鲁北地区沦入敌手。11月19日，日军侵入临清、高唐等县。鲁西北专员范筑先坚持抗战，发布「皓电」，震动全国。日期据《山东抗日战争大事记》，待页码级核对。 On 16 November Han Fuju ordered the 3rd Group Army to withdraw across the Yellow River and blew up the railway bridge, leaving northern Shandong to the Japanese. On 19 November Japanese forces entered Linqing and Gaotang. Fan Zhuxian, commissioner of northwestern Shandong, refused to flee and issued his famous telegram, which inspired the country. The date follows the Shandong war chronology and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 高唐沦陷 Fall of Gaotang
fields.summary: 1937年11月19日，日军侵入高唐。 On 19 November 1937 Japanese forces entered Gaotang.
fields.description: 11月19日，日军侵入临清、高唐等县。高唐位于鲁西北平原，是日军控制鲁西北、进逼聊城的要点。日期据《山东抗日战争大事记》，待页码级核对。 On 19 November Japanese forces entered Linqing and Gaotang. Gaotang, on the northwestern Shandong plain, was a key point for controlling the region and advancing on Liaocheng. The date follows the Shandong war chronology and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1937年11月19日，嘉兴城沦陷。
summary.en: On 19 November 1937 the city of Jiaxing fell.

fields.name: 嘉兴沦陷 Fall of Jiaxing
fields.summary: 1937年11月19日，嘉兴城沦陷。 On 19 November 1937 the city of Jiaxing fell.
fields.description: 淞沪会战结束后，日军沿沪杭铁路西进。11月19日，嘉兴城沦陷，日军所到之处烧杀淫掠。嘉兴是沪杭铁路与杭嘉湖水网的枢纽，沦陷后成为日军控制浙北的据点。日期据南湖区政府与《浙江抗战大事记》，待页码级核对。 After the Battle of Shanghai, Japanese forces advanced west along the Shanghai–Hangzhou railway. Jiaxing fell on 19 November; Japanese troops burned, killed and looted. At the junction of the railway and the Hangzhou–Jiaxing–Huzhou water network, Jiaxing became a Japanese base for controlling northern Zhejiang. The date follows the Nanhu district government and the Zhejiang war chronology and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 国民政府宣言迁都重庆，以西南为大后方坚持抗战。
summary.en: The Nationalist government declared Chongqing the wartime capital and made the southwest its rear base.

fields.name: 迁都重庆 Capital Moved to Chongqing
fields.summary: 国民政府宣言迁都重庆，以西南为大后方坚持抗战。 The Nationalist government declared Chongqing the wartime capital and made the southwest its rear base.
fields.description: 1937 年 11 月 20 日，国民政府发表迁都重庆宣言，随后军政机关、工厂、学校陆续西迁。1940 年 9 月 6 日，重庆被明定为陪都，成为战时政治、军事与经济中心。 日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。 On 20 November 1937 the Nationalist government declared the capital moved to Chongqing, and government offices, factories, and schools moved west in succession. On 6 September 1940 Chongqing was formally designated the wartime capital, becoming the political, military, and economic center of the rear area. Dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

fields.name: 南京安全区与国际救援 Nanjing Safety Zone and International Relief
fields.place: 江苏南京安全区 Nanjing Safety Zone, Jiangsu
fields.summary: 南京安全区国际委员会设立难民区，收容难民、提供救济并记录日军暴行。 The International Committee for the Nanjing Safety Zone set up a refugee zone, provided relief, and documented Japanese atrocities.
fields.description: 1937 年 11 月，南京安全区国际委员会成立，划设安全区，由约翰·拉贝、明妮·魏特琳等外籍人士主持，收容大批难民，提供粮食、医疗与庇护，并记录日军暴行。安全区在南京沦陷后继续运作到 1938 年初。 政治/人道事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。 In November 1937 the International Committee for the Nanjing Safety Zone was formed to establish a refugee zone. Led by foreigners including John Rabe and Minnie Vautrin, it sheltered large numbers of refugees, provided food, medical care, and protection, and documented Japanese atrocities. The zone continued to operate into early 1938 after the city fell. A political and humanitarian event with no route drawn; dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

fields.name: 许巷惨案 Xuxiang Massacre
fields.place: 江苏无锡许巷 Xuxiang, Wuxi, Jiangsu
fields.summary: 1937年11月24日，日军在无锡东亭许巷放火焚烧全村，用机枪杀害群众223人。 On 24 November 1937 Japanese troops burned Xuxiang village in Dongting, Wuxi, and machine-gunned 223 people.
fields.description: 11月23日日军分两路进犯无锡，一路从常熟白茆口登陆，另一路从苏州沿京杭运河西进。24日，日军在东亭许巷放火焚烧全村，用机枪杀害群众223人。此为日军进攻无锡途中的暴行，不单独绘线。数字据《1937年江苏历史大事记》，待页码级核对。 Japanese forces attacked Wuxi from two directions on 23 November: one column landed at Baimaokou in Changshu, the other advanced west from Suzhou along the Grand Canal. On 24 November they burned Xuxiang village in Dongting and machine-gunned 223 people. This atrocity during the advance on Wuxi is not drawn as a separate route. The figure follows the 1937 Jiangsu chronicle and awaits page-level verification.

summary.en: On 24 November 1937 Japanese forces captured Wuxing (Huzhou).

fields.name: 湖州沦陷 Fall of Huzhou
fields.summary: 1937年11月24日，日军攻陷吴兴（湖州）。 On 24 November 1937 Japanese forces captured Wuxing (Huzhou).
fields.description: 11月24日，日军攻陷吴兴（今湖州市），大片民房被烧毁，沿公路尸积盈野，县城内被杀平民尸体达300余具，南浔镇有400余名平民被杀、4993间民房被毁。日期据南京大屠杀纪念馆与《浙江抗战大事记》，待页码级核对。 On 24 November Japanese forces captured Wuxing (present-day Huzhou). Large areas of housing were burned, bodies lay along the roads, more than 300 civilian bodies were counted in the county town, and in Nanxun 400 civilians were killed and 4,993 houses destroyed. The date follows the Nanjing memorial and the Zhejiang war chronology and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1937年11月25日，日军侵占无锡，随后大肆烧杀。
summary.en: On 25 November 1937 Japanese forces occupied Wuxi and carried out large-scale burning and killing.

fields.name: 无锡沦陷 Fall of Wuxi
fields.summary: 1937年11月25日，日军侵占无锡，随后大肆烧杀。 On 25 November 1937 Japanese forces occupied Wuxi and carried out large-scale burning and killing.
fields.description: 11月25日，日军第16师团第20联队侵占无锡。占领后最初三天，从闾口桥至吴桥被残杀的无辜平民尸体有2000余具；日军纵火焚烧城区，大火七日不熄，全城房屋被焚半数以上。无锡沦陷日期有11月25日与11月27日两说，本事件取25日通行说法，正文并列27日说。 On 25 November the Japanese 16th Division's 20th Regiment occupied Wuxi. In the first three days more than 2,000 civilian bodies were counted between Lukou Bridge and Wu Bridge; fires burned for seven days and more than half the city's houses were destroyed. Sources give both 25 and 27 November; this event follows the common 25 November account and notes the alternative.

summary.zh: 1937年11月25日，日军攻陷长兴。
summary.en: On 25 November 1937 Japanese forces captured Changxing.

fields.name: 长兴沦陷 Fall of Changxing
fields.summary: 1937年11月25日，日军攻陷长兴。 On 25 November 1937 Japanese forces captured Changxing.
fields.description: 11月25日，日军攻陷长兴，杀害平民200余人。长兴是太湖南岸通往安徽广德、江苏宜兴的节点，日军由此继续西进。日期据南京大屠杀纪念馆与《浙江抗战大事记》，待页码级核对。 On 25 November Japanese forces captured Changxing and killed more than 200 civilians. Changxing was a node on the southern shore of Taihu connecting Guangde in Anhui and Yixing in Jiangsu, from which Japanese forces continued west. The date follows the Nanjing memorial and the Zhejiang war chronology and awaits page-level verification.

summary.en: On 28 November 1937 Japanese forces took Yixing; more than 700 bodies were collected from the streets.

fields.name: 宜兴沦陷 Fall of Yixing
fields.summary: 1937年11月28日，日军占领宜兴，街头收尸700余具。 On 28 November 1937 Japanese forces took Yixing; more than 700 bodies were collected from the streets.
fields.description: 11月28日，由浙江长兴转向北进的日军第10军所部占领宜兴，街头尸体遍地，经雇工以芦席裹尸，收尸700余具。宜兴是太湖南岸一路日军向南京迂回的重要节点。日期据南京大屠杀纪念馆与《中华民族抗日编年》，待页码级核对。 On 28 November troops of the Japanese 10th Army, turning north from Changxing in Zhejiang, occupied Yixing. Bodies lay in the streets and more than 700 were collected by hired workers. Yixing was an important node on the southern Taihu route to Nanjing. The date follows the Nanjing memorial and the Chinese war chronology and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1937年11月29日，日军攻占常州，烧杀淫掠。
summary.en: On 29 November 1937 Japanese forces took Changzhou and burned, killed and looted.

fields.name: 常州沦陷 Fall of Changzhou
fields.summary: 1937年11月29日，日军攻占常州，烧杀淫掠。 On 29 November 1937 Japanese forces took Changzhou and burned, killed and looted.
fields.description: 11月29日，日军第16师团攻占常州。日军沿路烧杀，仅常州、戚墅堰等地即毁房9000余间、被杀4000余人；城东北三河口等乡镇一半街道化为灰烬。三源日期一致。 On 29 November the Japanese 16th Division took Changzhou. Along the way it burned and killed: more than 9,000 houses were destroyed and over 4,000 people killed in Changzhou and Qishuyan alone, and half the streets of Sanhekou and other northeastern townships were reduced to ashes. Three sources agree on the date.

summary.zh: 1937年11月30日，日军第18师团攻占广德，第145师师长饶国华殉国。
summary.en: On 30 November 1937 the Japanese 18th Division captured Guangde; Major General Rao Guohua of the 145th Division died in the defence.

fields.name: 广德沦陷 Fall of Guangde
fields.summary: 1937年11月30日，日军第18师团攻占广德，第145师师长饶国华殉国。 On 30 November 1937 the Japanese 18th Division captured Guangde; Major General Rao Guohua of the 145th Division died in the defence.
fields.description: 11月23日日军第18师团及伪满军一部由浙江泗安进攻广德东部界牌，一度占领窑机场，被第145师击退。11月26日起日军飞机数百架次轰炸广德、芜湖、安庆、阜阳等地；11月30日广德县城失守，第145师师长饶国华自杀殉国。日军焚毁县城周围10公里内集镇，杀害居民近2万人。日期据《安徽沦陷大事记》与人民网，待页码级核对。 On 23 November the Japanese 18th Division and a Manchukuo unit attacked Jiepai east of Guangde and briefly seized the airfield before being driven back by the 145th Division. From 26 November Japanese aircraft bombed Guangde, Wuhu, Anqing and Fuyang; on 30 November Guangde fell and Major General Rao Guohua took his own life. Japanese troops burned market towns within 10 km of the county seat and killed nearly 20,000 residents. The date follows the Anhui occupation chronology and People's Daily and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1937年12月2日，日军攻占江阴要塞。
summary.en: On 2 December 1937 Japanese forces captured the Jiangyin fortress.

fields.name: 江阴要塞沦陷 Fall of the Jiangyin Fortress
fields.summary: 1937年12月2日，日军攻占江阴要塞。 On 2 December 1937 Japanese forces captured the Jiangyin fortress.
fields.description: 江阴为长江下游要塞。11月27日起日军以海空军进攻江阴要塞，中国海军与要塞守军奋战六昼夜；日军又调陆军从无锡三面围攻，12月2日攻占江阴要塞。江阴城在11月底已失守，本事件专记要塞，避免把城陷与要塞陷混为一谈。 Jiangyin was a key fortress on the lower Yangtze. From 27 November Japanese sea and air forces attacked the fortress; Chinese naval and garrison troops fought for six days and nights, while Japanese ground troops attacked from three directions from Wuxi. The fortress fell on 2 December. The town had already fallen in late November; this event records the fortress specifically to avoid conflating the two.

summary.en: On 2 December 1937 Japanese forces captured Danyang.

fields.name: 丹阳沦陷 Fall of Danyang
fields.summary: 1937年12月2日，日军攻占丹阳。 On 2 December 1937 Japanese forces captured Danyang.
fields.description: 12月2日，日军攻占丹阳，在城郊皇塘、折柳、井巷、横塘等地杀害无辜农民120余人。丹阳是京沪铁路与京杭运河交会处，为日军西进南京的通道。 On 2 December Japanese forces took Danyang and killed more than 120 peasants in Huangtang, Zheliu, Jingxiang and Hengtang. Danyang, at the junction of the Nanjing–Shanghai railway and the Grand Canal, was a corridor for the Japanese advance on Nanjing.

fields.summary: 1937年12月2日，日军攻占金坛。 On 2 December 1937 Japanese forces captured Jintan.
fields.description: 12月2日，日军第9师团由常州出发攻占金坛，烧毁房屋千余间，枪杀农民200余人。金坛是日军第9师团经溧水、句容进攻南京的必经之地。 On 2 December the Japanese 9th Division advanced from Changzhou and took Jintan, burning more than 1,000 houses and shooting over 200 peasants. Jintan lay on the 9th Division's route to Nanjing via Lishui and Jurong.

fields.name: 溧阳沦陷 Fall of Liyang
fields.summary: 1937年12月2日，日军攻占溧阳。 On 2 December 1937 Japanese forces captured Liyang.
fields.description: 12月2日，日军攻占溧阳。溧阳位于太湖南岸通往南京的公路线上，与金坛、丹阳同日失守。具体日期据《1937年江苏历史大事记》，省级党史只记 12 月日军攻陷江苏全省，待页码级核对。 On 2 December Japanese forces took Liyang. Liyang lay on the road from the southern shore of Taihu to Nanjing and fell the same day as Jintan and Danyang. The specific date follows the 1937 Jiangsu chronicle; the provincial party history only records the general December collapse and awaits page-level verification.

fields.summary: 日军首次占领三灶岛，盘踞 24 天后撤离。 Japanese forces first occupied Sanzao Island and withdrew after 24 days.
fields.description: 1937 年 12 月 4 日，日军 400 余人从高栏岛出发，在汉奸带领下进犯三灶岛，占领莲塘附近各乡，24 天后撤离。三灶岛位于珠江口，是日军觊觎的华南航空基地选址。日期据珠海地方志与日军“妙高号”档案，待页码级核对。 On 4 December 1937 more than 400 Japanese troops moved from Gaolan Island with Chinese collaborators and attacked Sanzao Island, occupying villages around Liantang before withdrawing 24 days later. Sanzao, at the mouth of the Pearl River, was a prospective Japanese air base in South China. The date follows Zhuhai local gazetteers and the Japanese “Myōkō” archives and awaits page-level verification.

fields.summary: 1937年12月4日，日军攻占溧水。 On 4 December 1937 Japanese forces captured Lishui.
fields.description: 12月4日，日军攻占溧水。溧水是南京东南门户，日军自溧阳、金坛方向西进，12月4日陷溧水，5日陷句容，随后逼近南京。日期据《1937年江苏历史大事记》与国家档案局《第51师卫戍南京战斗经过》。 On 4 December Japanese forces took Lishui. fields.summary: 1937年12月5日，日军攻占句容。 On 5 December 1937 Japanese forces captured Jurong.
fields.description: 12月5日，日军攻占句容。句容是南京东南重要屏障，日军占领后沿句容—南京公路推进，参加南京外围作战。日期据《1937年江苏历史大事记》与国家档案局《第51师卫戍南京战斗经过》。 On 5 December Japanese forces took Jurong, an important southeastern shield for Nanjing. summary.en: On 5 December 1937 Langxi fell.

fields.name: 郎溪沦陷 Fall of Langxi
fields.summary: 1937年12月5日，郎溪失陷。 On 5 December 1937 Langxi fell.
fields.description: 广德失守后，日军第18师团兵分两路，一路经宣城、湾沚进攻芜湖，一路经郎溪、溧阳迂回南京。12月5日郎溪失陷。日期据《安徽沦陷大事记》，待页码级核对。 After Guangde fell, the Japanese 18th Division split: one column moved via Xuancheng and Wanzhi toward Wuhu, the other via Langxi and Liyang to outflank Nanjing. Langxi fell on 5 December. The date follows the Anhui occupation chronology and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1937年12月6日，宣城失陷。
summary.en: On 6 December 1937 Xuancheng fell.

fields.name: 宣城沦陷 Fall of Xuancheng
fields.summary: 1937年12月6日，宣城失陷。 On 6 December 1937 Xuancheng fell.
fields.description: 12月5日郎溪失陷后，日军第18师团继续北犯，12月6日宣城失陷。宣城是皖南通往芜湖、南京的交通节点。日期据《安徽沦陷大事记》，待页码级核对。 After Langxi fell on 5 December, the Japanese 18th Division advanced north and took Xuancheng on 6 December. Xuancheng was a transport node between southern Anhui, Wuhu and Nanjing. The date follows the Anhui occupation chronology and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1937年12月8日，日军攻占镇江，大肆烧杀。
summary.en: On 8 December 1937 Japanese forces captured Zhenjiang and carried out large-scale burning and killing.

fields.name: 镇江沦陷 Fall of Zhenjiang
fields.summary: 1937年12月8日，日军攻占镇江，大肆烧杀。 On 8 December 1937 Japanese forces captured Zhenjiang and carried out large-scale burning and killing.
fields.description: 12月8日，日军第11师团天谷支队攻占镇江。日军在镇江大肆烧杀淫掠，后经慈善团体收埋尸体3000余具；据伪丹徒县署统计，被枪杀民众达4525人，烧毁房屋30151间。三源日期一致。 On 8 December the Japanese 11th Division's Amaya detachment took Zhenjiang. Japanese troops burned, killed and looted; charities buried more than 3,000 bodies, and the puppet Dantu county office recorded 4,525 people shot and 30,151 houses burned. Three sources agree on the date.

summary.zh: 1937年12月10日，芜湖沦陷。
summary.en: On 10 December 1937 Wuhu fell.

fields.name: 芜湖沦陷 Fall of Wuhu
fields.summary: 1937年12月10日，芜湖沦陷。 On 10 December 1937 Wuhu fell.
fields.description: 12月10日，日军第18师团攻占芜湖。日军在芜湖大肆屠杀平民，据红十字会统计，1938年一年内被杀平民即达997人；12月12日，芜湖日军炮击英舰「蜜蜂号」「瓢虫号」，并在和县江面炸沉美舰「巴纳号」。日期据《安徽沦陷大事记》与人民网，待页码级核对。 On 10 December the Japanese 18th Division took Wuhu. Japanese troops massacred civilians; the Red Cross recorded 997 civilians killed in 1938 alone. On 12 December Japanese forces at Wuhu shelled the British gunboats Bee and Ladybird, and Japanese aircraft sank the US gunboat Panay on the Yangtze near He county. The date follows the Anhui occupation chronology and People's Daily and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1937年12月11日，当涂沦陷。
summary.en: On 11 December 1937 Dangtu fell.

fields.name: 当涂沦陷 Fall of Dangtu
fields.summary: 1937年12月11日，当涂沦陷。 On 11 December 1937 Dangtu fell.
fields.description: 芜湖失陷次日，日军沿长江东岸北进，12月11日当涂沦陷。当涂是芜湖通往马鞍山、南京的沿江节点。日期据《安徽沦陷大事记》，待页码级核对。 The day after Wuhu fell, Japanese forces advanced north along the east bank of the Yangtze and took Dangtu on 11 December. Dangtu was a riverine node between Wuhu, Ma'anshan and Nanjing. The date follows the Anhui occupation chronology and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1937年12月12日，日机在和县江面炸沉美舰「巴纳号」。
summary.en: On 12 December 1937 Japanese aircraft sank the US gunboat Panay on the Yangtze near He county.

fields.name: 巴纳号事件 USS Panay Incident
fields.place: 安徽和县江面 Yangtze near He county, Anhui
fields.summary: 1937年12月12日，日机在和县江面炸沉美舰「巴纳号」。 On 12 December 1937 Japanese aircraft sank the US gunboat Panay on the Yangtze near He county.
fields.description: 12月12日，日军飞机在和县江面炸沉美国海军炮舰「巴纳号」，美军公司两艘油轮被炸起火；同日芜湖日军炮击英舰「蜜蜂号」「瓢虫号」和英国货轮「清泰号」，造成英国水兵伤亡。事后英美政府仅向日本政府提出抗议。该事件是日军在长江流域对第三国军舰的直接攻击，不绘地面路线。 On 12 December Japanese aircraft sank the US Navy gunboat Panay on the Yangtze near He county and set two Standard Oil tankers on fire; the same day Japanese forces at Wuhu shelled the British gunboats Bee and Ladybird and the British freighter Ching Tai, causing British casualties. Britain and the United States only protested. This direct attack on third-country warships is not drawn as a ground route.

summary.zh: 日军攻占南京，南京保卫战失败，守军突围。
summary.en: Japanese forces captured Nanjing after the defense failed, and the Chinese garrison broke out.

fields.name: 南京沦陷 Fall of Nanjing 南京保卫战 Defense of Nanjing
fields.summary: 日军攻占南京，南京保卫战失败，守军突围。 Japanese forces captured Nanjing after the defense failed, and the Chinese garrison broke out.
fields.description: 1937 年 12 月，中国军队进行南京保卫战。12 月 13 日日军攻占南京，守军突围，部分官兵滞留城内。此后日军对平民和战俘实施大规模屠杀、强奸与劫掠，即南京大屠杀。 本事件为路线分段端点；日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。 In December 1937 Chinese forces fought the defense of Nanjing. On 13 December Japanese forces captured the city, the garrison broke out, and some soldiers remained trapped. Japanese forces then carried out mass killings, rape, and looting against civilians and prisoners of war—the Nanjing Massacre. This event marks a route segment endpoint; dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

summary.zh: 日军攻占南京后对平民和战俘实施大规模屠杀、强奸与劫掠，造成惨重伤亡。
summary.en: After capturing Nanjing, Japanese forces carried out mass killings, rape, and looting against civilians and prisoners of war.

fields.name: 南京大屠杀 Nanjing Massacre
fields.summary: 日军攻占南京后对平民和战俘实施大规模屠杀、强奸与劫掠，造成惨重伤亡。 After capturing Nanjing, Japanese forces carried out mass killings, rape, and looting against civilians and prisoners of war.
fields.description: 1937 年 12 月 13 日日军攻占南京后，在数周内对放下武器的中国军人和无辜平民实施大规模屠杀、强奸、纵火与抢劫。远东国际军事法庭认定伤亡规模巨大。具体伤亡数字存在不同统计口径，待史料校订。 惨案事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述取通行说法。 After capturing Nanjing on 13 December 1937, Japanese forces carried out mass killings, rape, arson, and looting against disarmed Chinese soldiers and civilians over several weeks. The International Military Tribunal for the Far East found the scale of the atrocities to be enormous. Casualty figures vary among accounts and await historical review. An atrocity event with no route drawn; dates and wording follow conventional accounts.

name.en: Establishment of the Provisional Government of the Republic of China

summary.zh: 日本在北平扶植成立伪中华民国临时政府。
summary.en: Japan established the puppet Provisional Government of the Republic of China in Beiping.

fields.name: 伪中华民国临时政府成立 Establishment of the Provisional Government of the Republic of China
fields.summary: 日本在北平扶植成立伪中华民国临时政府。 Japan established the puppet Provisional Government of the Republic of China in Beiping.
fields.description: 1937 年 12 月 14 日，日本在北平扶植成立伪中华民国临时政府，以王克敏为首，管辖华北日占区。伪政权名义上“自治”，实际受日本华北方面军控制。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 14 December 1937 Japan installed the puppet Provisional Government of the Republic of China in Beiping under Wang Kemin to administer the Japanese-occupied areas of North China. Nominally autonomous, it was controlled by the Japanese North China Area Army. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1937年12月14日，日军渡江攻占扬州。
summary.en: On 14 December 1937 Japanese forces crossed the Yangtze and captured Yangzhou.

fields.name: 扬州沦陷 Fall of Yangzhou
fields.summary: 1937年12月14日，日军渡江攻占扬州。 On 14 December 1937 Japanese forces crossed the Yangtze and captured Yangzhou.
fields.description: 12月14日，日军第13师团天谷支队渡江攻占扬州。日军逐街逐院搜杀，进城头三天杀害市民500余人；占领第一周有600多名妇女被污辱。扬州沦陷后，江苏省政府已于12月14日前匆忙迁往淮阴。 On 14 December the Japanese 13th Division's Amaya detachment crossed the Yangtze and took Yangzhou. Troops searched street by street and courtyard by courtyard, killing more than 500 residents in the first three days; over 600 women were raped in the first week. The Jiangsu provincial government had already fled to Huaiyin before the fall.

summary.en: On 17 December 1937 Japanese troops in Yangzhou massacred more than 400 labourers at Wanfu Bridge.

fields.name: 万福桥惨案 Wanfu Bridge Massacre
fields.place: 江苏扬州万福桥 Wanfu Bridge, Yangzhou, Jiangsu
fields.summary: 1937年12月17日，驻扬州日军在万福桥屠杀民夫400余人。 On 17 December 1937 Japanese troops in Yangzhou massacred more than 400 labourers at Wanfu Bridge.
fields.description: 12月17日，驻扬州日军在城东万福桥屠杀民夫400余人，仅一人跳水逃生；万福村100多间房屋被烧、100多名百姓被杀。惨案数字有400余人与460余人两说，正文并列。此为暴行事件，不绘路线。 On 17 December Japanese troops in Yangzhou massacred more than 400 labourers at Wanfu Bridge east of the city; only one man escaped by jumping into the river. More than 100 houses were burned in Wanfu village and over 100 villagers killed. Sources give both 400-plus and 460-plus; both are noted. This atrocity is not drawn as a route.

fields.summary: 1937年12月22日，全椒沦陷。 On 22 December 1937 Quanjiao fell.
fields.description: 12月22日，全椒沦陷；次日日军占领马鞍山矿区，24日滁县沦陷。日军沿津浦铁路南段与滁河推进，切断南京江北退路。日期据《安徽沦陷大事记》，待页码级核对。 Quanjiao fell on 22 December; the next day Japanese forces occupied the Ma'anshan iron mines, and Chuxian fell on 24 December. Japanese forces advanced along the southern Tianjin–Pukou railway and the Chu River, cutting the Nationalist retreat north of Nanjing. The date follows the Anhui occupation chronology and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1937年12月23日，日军占领马鞍山矿区。
summary.en: On 23 December 1937 Japanese forces occupied the Ma'anshan iron-mining area.

fields.name: 马鞍山矿区沦陷 Occupation of the Ma'anshan Mines
fields.place: 安徽当涂马鞍山 Ma'anshan, Dangtu, Anhui
fields.summary: 1937年12月23日，日军占领马鞍山矿区。 On 23 December 1937 Japanese forces occupied the Ma'anshan iron-mining area.
fields.description: 12月23日，日军占领马鞍山矿区，随后由日伪华中矿业公司开采铁矿，向日本本土和伪满输送。马鞍山矿区是日军在安徽掠夺战略资源的重要据点。日期据《安徽沦陷大事记》，待页码级核对。 On 23 December Japanese forces occupied the Ma'anshan iron-mining area. The Japanese-controlled Central China Mining Company then extracted iron ore for Japan and Manchukuo. The mines were an important base for Japan's seizure of strategic resources in Anhui. The date follows the Anhui occupation chronology and awaits page-level verification.

summary.en: After landing at Jinshanwei, the Japanese 10th Army advanced south and captured Hangzhou.

fields.name: 杭州沦陷 Fall of Hangzhou
fields.summary: 日军第 10 军自金山卫登陆后南下，杭州沦陷。 After landing at Jinshanwei, the Japanese 10th Army advanced south and captured Hangzhou.
fields.description: 1937 年 11 月，日军第 10 军在金山卫登陆，沿沪杭线西进。12 月 24 日，日军占领杭州，中国守军撤往钱塘江以南。杭州沦陷后，中日两军隔钱塘江对峙。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In November 1937 the Japanese 10th Army landed at Jinshanwei and advanced west along the Shanghai–Hangzhou line. On 24 December Japanese forces occupied Hangzhou and the Chinese defenders withdrew south of the Qiantang River, where the two sides faced each other across the river. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1937年12月24日，滁县沦陷。
summary.en: On 24 December 1937 Chuxian fell.

fields.name: 滁县沦陷 Fall of Chuxian
fields.summary: 1937年12月24日，滁县沦陷。 On 24 December 1937 Chuxian fell.
fields.description: 12月24日，滁县沦陷。滁县位于津浦铁路南段，是南京江北门户；日军占领后沿铁路继续北犯明光、蚌埠。日期据《安徽沦陷大事记》，待页码级核对。 Chuxian fell on 24 December. Located on the southern section of the Tianjin–Pukou railway, it was the northern gateway to Nanjing; after occupying it Japanese forces continued north toward Mingguang and Bengbu. The date follows the Anhui occupation chronology and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1937年12月26日，日军攻占周村。
summary.en: On 26 December 1937 Japanese forces captured Zhoucun.

fields.name: 周村沦陷 Fall of Zhoucun
fields.summary: 1937年12月26日，日军攻占周村。 On 26 December 1937 Japanese forces captured Zhoucun.
fields.description: 12月中旬日军迫近周村。12月24日，驻守周村的国民党第22师师长谷良民率部南逃；25日日军侵占周村西北一带，26日攻占周村。周村是胶济铁路西段商埠，沦陷后成为日军控制鲁中的据点。日期据《山东抗日战争大事记》与周村地方史，待页码级核对。 In mid-December Japanese forces closed on Zhoucun. On 24 December the Nationalist 22nd Division commander Gu Liangmin fled south; on 25 December Japanese troops occupied the northwestern outskirts and on 26 December took the town. Zhoucun, a commercial centre on the western section of the Jiaoji railway, became a Japanese base for controlling central Shandong. The date follows the Shandong war chronology and local history and awaits page-level verification.

summary.en: The Japanese 2nd Army crossed the Yellow River and occupied Jinan, the Shandong provincial capital.

fields.name: 济南沦陷 Fall of Jinan
fields.summary: 日军第 2 军渡过黄河，占领山东省会济南。 The Japanese 2nd Army crossed the Yellow River and occupied Jinan, the Shandong provincial capital.
fields.description: 1937 年 12 月，日军第 2 军自河北南下，在济阳、泺口一带渡过黄河。12 月 27 日，日军占领济南，山东省主席韩复榘此前擅自撤退。济南沦陷使日军控制胶济铁路西端。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In December 1937 the Japanese 2nd Army advanced south from Hebei and crossed the Yellow River near Jiyang and Luokou. On 27 December it occupied Jinan after Shandong chairman Han Fuju had withdrawn without orders. The fall of Jinan gave Japan the western end of the Jiaoji railway. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

summary.en: On 27 December 1937 Japanese forces occupied Zichuan.

fields.name: 淄川沦陷 Fall of Zichuan
fields.summary: 1937年12月27日，日军占领淄川。 On 27 December 1937 Japanese forces occupied Zichuan.
fields.description: 12月27日，日军占领淄川，随后制造多起血腥惨案，掠夺淄川煤矿。淄川是胶济铁路与淄博煤矿区的重要节点。日期据《淄川地方大事记》与《山东抗日战争大事记》，待页码级核对。 On 27 December Japanese forces occupied Zichuan, then carried out several massacres and seized the Zichuan coal mines. Zichuan was an important node on the Jiaoji railway and in the Zibo coal area. The date follows the Zichuan local chronology and the Shandong war chronology and awaits page-level verification.

summary.en: On 31 December 1937 Japanese forces occupied Tai'an.

fields.name: 泰安沦陷 Fall of Tai'an
fields.summary: 1937年12月31日，日军占领泰安。 On 31 December 1937 Japanese forces occupied Tai'an.
fields.description: 12月27日济南失守后，日军沿津浦路南下，12月31日占领泰安。泰安是津浦路中段与泰山门户，日军占领后继续南犯兖州、济宁。日期据《山东抗日战争大事记》与《日军侵占济宁及其暴行》，待页码级核对。 After Jinan fell on 27 December, Japanese forces advanced south along the Tianjin–Pukou railway and occupied Tai'an on 31 December. Tai'an was a key point on the central section of the railway and the gateway to Mount Tai; from there Japanese forces moved on Yanzhou and Jining. The date follows the Shandong war chronology and the Jining account and awaits page-level verification.

fields.summary: 1938年1月4日，日军占领兖州。 On 4 January 1938 Japanese forces occupied Yanzhou.
fields.description: 1938年1月初，日军飞机轰炸兖州；1月4日，日军前锋占领兖州、曲阜。兖州是津浦铁路与兖石铁路交会处，日军由此南下济宁、滕县。日期据《日军侵占济宁及其暴行》，待页码级核对。 In early January 1938 Japanese aircraft bombed Yanzhou; on 4 January the Japanese advance guard occupied Yanzhou and Qufu. Yanzhou was the junction of the Tianjin–Pukou railway and the Yanzhou–Shijiu line, from which Japanese forces moved south toward Jining and Tengxian. The date follows the Jining account and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 日军登陆青岛 Japanese landing at Qingdao
fields.summary: 日军在青岛登陆，随后沿胶济路西进。 The Japanese landed at Qingdao and moved west along the Jiaoji railway.

name.zh: 晋察冀边区行政委员会成立
name.en: Establishment of the Jin-Cha-Ji Border Region Government

summary.zh: 晋察冀边区军政民代表大会在阜平召开，成立敌后第一个抗日民主政权。
summary.en: The Jin-Cha-Ji border region congress met at Fuping and established the first anti-Japanese democratic government behind enemy lines.

fields.name: 晋察冀边区行政委员会成立 Establishment of the Jin-Cha-Ji Border Region Government 晋察冀边区政府成立 Founding of the Jin-Cha-Ji Border Government
fields.summary: 晋察冀边区军政民代表大会在阜平召开，成立敌后第一个抗日民主政权。 The Jin-Cha-Ji border region congress met at Fuping and established the first anti-Japanese democratic government behind enemy lines.
fields.description: 1938 年 1 月 10 日至 15 日，晋察冀边区军政民代表大会在河北阜平召开，选举产生晋察冀边区临时行政委员会，宋劭文任主任委员。这是中国共产党在华北敌后建立的第一个统一战线性质的抗日民主政权，同年 1 月 31 日经国民政府批准改称晋察冀边区行政委员会。 代表人数与日期细节各书略有出入，待页码级核对。 From 10 to 15 January 1938 the Jin-Cha-Ji border region military-civilian congress met at Fuping, Hebei, and elected the Jin-Cha-Ji Border Region Provisional Administrative Committee with Song Shaowen as chairman. It was the first united-front anti-Japanese democratic government established by the CCP behind enemy lines in North China; on 31 January it was approved by the National Government and renamed the Jin-Cha-Ji Border Region Administrative Committee. Delegate counts and date details vary slightly between accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1938年1月10日，日本海军陆战队在沙子口登陆，占领青岛。
summary.en: On 10 January 1938 Japanese marines landed at Shazikou and occupied Qingdao.

fields.name: 青岛沦陷 Fall of Qingdao
fields.summary: 1938年1月10日，日本海军陆战队在沙子口登陆，占领青岛。 On 10 January 1938 Japanese marines landed at Shazikou and occupied Qingdao.
fields.description: 12月27日，青岛市长沈鸿烈下令炸毁日本纱厂机器设备，并凿沉中国海军第三舰队全部舰只；28日，全体机关人员、军警撤出青岛。1938年1月10日，日本海军陆战队在沙子口登陆，进入青岛市区，青岛失陷。日期据《山东抗日战争大事记》与《日军进攻山东》，待页码级核对。 On 27 December Qingdao mayor Shen Honglie ordered the machinery of Japanese cotton mills destroyed and the ships of the Chinese 3rd Fleet scuttled; on 28 December the government offices, troops and police withdrew. On 10 January 1938 Japanese marines landed at Shazikou and entered Qingdao, which fell. The date follows the Shandong war chronology and the provincial party history and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 潍县沦陷 Fall of Weixian
fields.summary: 1938年1月10日，日军占领胶济线重镇潍县。 On 10 January 1938 Japanese forces occupied Weixian, a key town on the Jiaoji railway.
fields.description: 1938年1月10日，日军占领胶济线中部重地潍县；1月19日，日军与海军陆战队会师青岛，胶济铁路沿线城市全部沦陷。潍县是胶济铁路中段枢纽。日期据人民网党史与《山东抗日战争大事记》，待页码级核对。 On 10 January 1938 Japanese forces took Weixian, a key town on the central Jiaoji railway. On 19 January they linked up with the naval landing force at Qingdao, completing the occupation of the railway's urban centres. Weixian was the central junction of the Jiaoji line. The date follows the People's Daily party-history account and the Shandong war chronology and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 济宁沦陷 Fall of Jining
fields.summary: 1938年1月11日，日军第10师团占领济宁。 On 11 January 1938 the Japanese 10th Division occupied Jining.
fields.description: 1月11日凌晨，日军兵临济宁城下，中国抗日军民激烈抵抗，终因兵力悬殊失守；日军第10师团占领济宁。济宁是鲁西南运河重镇。日期据《日军侵占济宁及其暴行》，待页码级核对。 In the early hours of 11 January Japanese forces reached Jining. Chinese troops and civilians resisted fiercely but were overwhelmed, and the Japanese 10th Division occupied the city. Jining was a key Grand Canal town in southwestern Shandong. The date follows the Jining account and awaits page-level verification.

summary.en: The 120th Division opened the Jin-Sui base area in northwestern Shanxi, shielding the Shaanxi-Gansu-Ningxia border region and the North China corridor.

fields.name: 晋绥根据地 Jin-Sui base area
fields.summary: 第120师在晋西北开辟晋绥根据地，屏障陕甘宁与华北通道。 The 120th Division opened the Jin-Sui base area in northwestern Shanxi, shielding the Shaanxi-Gansu-Ningxia border region and the North China corridor.
fields.description: 1938 年初，八路军第120师在师长贺龙、政治委员关向应率领下，依托晋西北地区开辟晋绥抗日根据地，控制同蒲铁路北段与黄河东岸，成为陕甘宁边区的重要屏障和华北各根据地之间的联系通道。 具体成立日期与辖区范围各书记载不一，待页码级核对。 In early 1938 the 120th Division, under commander He Long and political commissar Guan Xiangying, opened the Jin-Sui anti-Japanese base area in northwestern Shanxi, controlling the northern section of the Tongpu railway and the east bank of the Yellow River. It became an important shield for the Shaanxi-Gansu-Ningxia border region and a link between North China base areas. Exact founding dates and territorial extent vary between accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.description: 1938 年 1 月，中国第一个机械化师第 200 师在湖南湘潭成立，杜聿明任师长。成立时间与主官为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In January 1938, China’s first mechanized division, the 200th Division, was formed at Xiangtan, Hunan, with Du Yuming as commander. The date and appointment follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.zh: 日本发表“不以国民政府为对手”声明
name.en: Japan’s “Not to Deal with the Nationalist Government” Statement

summary.zh: 日本政府发表声明，宣称“不以国民政府为对手”。
summary.en: The Japanese government declared that it would “not deal with the Nationalist Government.”

fields.name: 日本发表“不以国民政府为对手”声明 Japan’s “Not to Deal with the Nationalist Government” Statement
fields.summary: 日本政府发表声明，宣称“不以国民政府为对手”。 The Japanese government declared that it would “not deal with the Nationalist Government.”
fields.description: 1938 年 1 月 16 日，日本近卫文麿内阁发表声明，称在国民政府不改变抗日政策的情况下，日本“不以国民政府为对手”，将扶植新政权。声明标志着日本试图以军事压力和政治诱降迫使中国屈服。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 16 January 1938 the Japanese cabinet of Konoe Fumimaro declared that, so long as the Nationalist Government did not change its policy of resistance, Japan would “not deal with it” and would foster new regimes instead. The statement marked Japan’s attempt to force China to submit through military pressure and political inducement. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

fields.description: 1月10日青岛沦陷后，日军沿青烟公路和胶济铁路向东、西两个方向进犯即墨、胶县、平度、莱阳。1月17日，日军侵占即墨城。日期据《山东抗日战争大事记》与青岛地方史，待页码级核对。 After Qingdao fell on 10 January, Japanese forces advanced east and west along the Qingdao–Yantai road and the Jiaoji railway into Jimo, Jiaoxian, Pingdu and Laiyang. On 17 January they occupied Jimo. The date follows the Shandong war chronology and Qingdao local history and awaits page-level verification.

fields.description: 1月18日，津浦路南段和淮河防御战开始，国民党第31军沿津浦路抵抗进攻徐州的日军，明光当日失陷。明光是津浦铁路南段重镇。日期据《安徽沦陷大事记》，待页码级核对。 On 18 January the defence of the southern Tianjin–Pukou railway and the Huai River began. The Chinese 31st Army resisted the Japanese drive toward Xuzhou along the railway, but Mingguang fell that day. Mingguang was a key town on the southern section of the railway. The date follows the Anhui occupation chronology and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1938年1月30日，定远池河失陷。
summary.en: On 30 January 1938 Chihe in Dingyuan fell.

fields.name: 池河沦陷 Fall of Chihe
fields.place: 安徽定远池河 Chihe, Dingyuan, Anhui
fields.summary: 1938年1月30日，定远池河失陷。 On 30 January 1938 Chihe in Dingyuan fell.
fields.description: 1月30日，国民党第31军在定远池河镇阻击日军，激战数天后撤守，池河失陷。池河是津浦路西侧通往定远、蚌埠的要点。日期据《安徽沦陷大事记》，待页码级核对。 On 30 January the Chinese 31st Army fought a delaying action at Chihe in Dingyuan and then withdrew; Chihe fell. The town was a key point west of the Tianjin–Pukou railway on the road to Dingyuan and Bengbu. The date follows the Anhui occupation chronology and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1938年2月1日，临淮关失陷。
summary.en: On 1 February 1938 Linhuaiguan fell.

fields.name: 临淮关沦陷 Fall of Linhuaiguan
fields.place: 安徽凤阳临淮关 Linhuaiguan, Fengyang, Anhui
fields.summary: 1938年2月1日，临淮关失陷。 On 1 February 1938 Linhuaiguan fell.
fields.description: 2月1日，国民党第3集团军第50军工事尽毁，入夜临淮关失陷。临淮关是淮河与津浦铁路交会处，日军由此渡淮南犯蚌埠。日期据《安徽沦陷大事记》，待页码级核对。 On 1 February the positions of the Chinese 50th Army, 3rd Group Army, were destroyed and Linhuaiguan fell that night. At the junction of the Huai River and the Tianjin–Pukou railway, it was the crossing point from which Japanese forces moved south toward Bengbu. The date follows the Anhui occupation chronology and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1938年2月2日，定远失陷。
summary.en: On 2 February 1938 Dingyuan fell.

fields.name: 定远沦陷 Fall of Dingyuan
fields.summary: 1938年2月2日，定远失陷。 On 2 February 1938 Dingyuan fell.
fields.description: 2月2日，定远、凤阳、蚌埠相继失陷。定远位于津浦路西侧，是日军控制淮河中游、掩护蚌埠侧翼的要点。日期据《安徽沦陷大事记》，待页码级核对。 On 2 February Dingyuan, Fengyang and Bengbu fell in succession. West of the Tianjin–Pukou railway, Dingyuan was a key point for controlling the middle Huai River and covering Bengbu's flank. The date follows the Anhui occupation chronology and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1938年2月2日，凤阳失陷。
summary.en: On 2 February 1938 Fengyang fell.

fields.name: 凤阳沦陷 Fall of Fengyang
fields.summary: 1938年2月2日，凤阳失陷。 On 2 February 1938 Fengyang fell.
fields.description: 2月2日，凤阳与定远、蚌埠同日失陷。凤阳是淮河中游重镇，明中都皇城所在地；日军占领后纵火焚烧，县城遭到严重破坏。日期据《安徽沦陷大事记》，待页码级核对。 Fengyang fell on 2 February together with Dingyuan and Bengbu. A key town on the middle Huai River and site of the Ming central capital, it was heavily damaged by Japanese burning after occupation. The date follows the Anhui occupation chronology and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1938年2月2日，蚌埠失陷。
summary.en: On 2 February 1938 Bengbu fell.

fields.name: 蚌埠沦陷 Fall of Bengbu
fields.summary: 1938年2月2日，蚌埠失陷。 On 2 February 1938 Bengbu fell.
fields.description: 1月31日，驻守蚌埠的国民党军第167师撤往淮河北岸，夜间炸毁淮河铁桥；2月2日蚌埠失陷。蚌埠是津浦铁路与淮河交会处，此后成为日军在安徽的统治中心，伪安徽省政府于1938年10月28日设于此。日期据《安徽沦陷大事记》，待页码级核对。 On 31 January the Chinese 167th Division withdrew north of the Huai River and blew up the railway bridge that night; Bengbu fell on 2 February. At the junction of the Tianjin–Pukou railway and the Huai River, Bengbu became the centre of Japanese rule in Anhui, and the puppet Anhui provincial government was established there on 28 October 1938. The date follows the Anhui occupation chronology and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1938年2月3日，日军占领烟台。
summary.en: On 3 February 1938 Japanese forces occupied Yantai.

fields.name: 烟台沦陷 Fall of Yantai
fields.summary: 1938年2月3日，日军占领烟台。 On 3 February 1938 Japanese forces occupied Yantai.
fields.description: 2月3日，侵华日军第二军第五师团3000余人，自青岛沿烟青公路北犯，在海上6艘舰艇配合下占领烟台。烟台是胶东半岛重要港口。日期据《烟台抗战大事记》，待页码级核对。 On 3 February more than 3,000 troops of the Japanese 2nd Army's 5th Division advanced north from Qingdao along the Qingdao–Yantai road, supported by six naval vessels, and occupied Yantai. Yantai was the main port of the Jiaodong peninsula. The date follows the Yantai war chronology and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1938年2月4日，日军在凤阳山马村烧毁全村，杀死350余人。
summary.en: On 4 February 1938 Japanese troops burned Shanmacun in Fengyang and killed more than 350 people.

fields.name: 凤阳山马村惨案 Shanmacun Massacre in Fengyang
fields.place: 安徽凤阳山马村 Shanmacun, Fengyang, Anhui
fields.summary: 1938年2月4日，日军在凤阳山马村烧毁全村，杀死350余人。 On 4 February 1938 Japanese troops burned Shanmacun in Fengyang and killed more than 350 people.
fields.description: 2月4日（农历正月初五），300余名日军包围凤阳县山马村，先以机枪扫射，再入村逐户搜杀，焚烧全村；被杀群众350余人。此为本批日军在淮河中游制造的典型惨案，不绘路线。日期与数字据《安徽沦陷大事记》与人民网，待页码级核对。 On 4 February (the fifth day of the first lunar month) more than 300 Japanese troops surrounded Shanmacun in Fengyang, machine-gunned the villagers, searched house by house and burned the village, killing over 350 people. This is a representative atrocity in the middle Huai River area and is not drawn as a route. The date and figures follow the Anhui occupation chronology and People's Daily and await page-level verification.

summary.en: On 5 February 1938 Japanese forces crossed the Huai River and occupied Huaiyuan.

fields.name: 怀远沦陷 Fall of Huaiyuan
fields.summary: 1938年2月5日，日军强渡淮河进占怀远。 On 5 February 1938 Japanese forces crossed the Huai River and occupied Huaiyuan.
fields.description: 2月5日，日军以飞机大炮掩护强渡淮河，进占怀远。此后日军在淮河北岸与小蚌埠、临淮关北岸与中国军队反复争夺。日期据《安徽沦陷大事记》，待页码级核对。 On 5 February Japanese forces crossed the Huai River under air and artillery cover and occupied Huaiyuan. Japanese and Chinese forces then contested the north bank of the Huai around Xiaobengbu and the north bank at Linhuaiguan. The date follows the Anhui occupation chronology and awaits page-level verification.

summary.en: On 5 February 1938 Japanese forces occupied Huangxian.

fields.name: 黄县沦陷 Fall of Huangxian
fields.summary: 1938年2月5日，日军占领黄县。 On 5 February 1938 Japanese forces occupied Huangxian.
fields.description: 2月3日烟台沦陷后，日军分兵东攻蓬莱、黄县、掖县，西占牟平、威海。2月5日，日军占领黄县。日期据胶东地方史与《山东抗日战争大事记》，待页码级核对。 After Yantai fell on 3 February, Japanese forces moved east against Penglai, Huangxian and Yexian and west against Muping and Weihai. On 5 February they occupied Huangxian. The date follows Jiaodong local history and the Shandong war chronology and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1938年2月7日，日军第14师团馆支队自大名南犯，占领南乐。
summary.en: On 7 February 1938 the Kaneda detachment of the Japanese 14th Division advanced south from Daming and took Nanle.

fields.name: 南乐沦陷 Fall of Nanle
fields.summary: 1938年2月7日，日军第14师团馆支队自大名南犯，占领南乐。 On 7 February 1938 the Kaneda detachment of the Japanese 14th Division advanced south from Daming and took Nanle.
fields.description: 1938年2月6日，日军第14师团分两路进犯豫北。馆支队（第27旅团）5个步兵大队、3个炮兵大队自大名南下，7日陷南乐，9日占清丰、内黄，10日攻陷濮阳。南乐仅驻地方保安团，未经激战即溃。日期据《1938年河南历史大事记》与《新乡抗战·惨案》所引地方党史。 On 6 February 1938 the Japanese 14th Division attacked northern Henan in two columns. The Kaneda (27th Brigade) detachment marched south from Daming, took Nanle on the 7th, Qingfeng and Neihuang on the 9th, and Puyang on the 10th. Nanle was held only by local security regiments, which collapsed without a serious fight.

summary.en: On 9 February 1938 the Kaneda detachment of the Japanese 14th Division occupied Qingfeng.

fields.name: 清丰沦陷 Fall of Qingfeng
fields.summary: 1938年2月9日，日军第14师团馆支队占领清丰。 On 9 February 1938 the Kaneda detachment of the Japanese 14th Division occupied Qingfeng.
fields.description: 1938年2月7日日军陷南乐后继续南犯，9日占清丰、内黄，并围攻濮阳。清丰、南乐一带仅有地方保安团约四千人，接火即溃，日军得以长驱直入。日期据《1938年河南历史大事记》与《新乡抗战·惨案》。 After taking Nanle on 7 February 1938 the Japanese pushed south, occupying Qingfeng and Neihuang on the 9th and investing Puyang. The area was defended only by about 4,000 local security troops, who broke on contact, allowing the Japanese to advance rapidly. Dates follow the 1938 Henan chronology and the Xinxiang wartime survey.

summary.zh: 1938年2月10日，日军第14师团馆支队攻陷濮阳。
summary.en: On 10 February 1938 the Kaneda detachment of the Japanese 14th Division captured Puyang.

fields.name: 濮阳沦陷 Fall of Puyang
fields.summary: 1938年2月10日，日军第14师团馆支队攻陷濮阳。 On 10 February 1938 the Kaneda detachment of the Japanese 14th Division captured Puyang.
fields.description: 濮阳扼道口、封丘、延津要冲，日军陷南乐、清丰后即围攻濮阳。第一战区急令第77军副军长张凌云率3个旅及骑兵第9师自东明、道口反击，但各部行动迟缓，日军增兵至五千余人，附炮20余门、坦克10余辆，在飞机、重炮掩护下于10日攻陷濮阳。日期据《1938年河南历史大事记》与《新乡抗战·惨案》。 Puyang commanded the approaches to Daokou, Fengqiu and Yanjin. After taking Nanle and Qingfeng the Japanese invested the city. The First War Zone ordered Zhang Lingyun’s three brigades and the 9th Cavalry Division to counterattack from Dongming and Daokou, but they moved too slowly; reinforced to over 5,000 men with more than 20 guns and 10 tanks, the Japanese took Puyang on the 10th under air and artillery cover.

summary.zh: 1938年2月13日，日军第14师团进占汤阴。
summary.en: On 13 February 1938 the Japanese 14th Division occupied Tangyin.

fields.name: 汤阴沦陷 Fall of Tangyin
fields.summary: 1938年2月13日，日军第14师团进占汤阴。 On 13 February 1938 the Japanese 14th Division occupied Tangyin.
fields.description: 1938年2月6日起，日军第14师团主力自安阳沿平汉路南犯，在宝莲寺、汤阴附近与万福麟、高树勋部血战四昼夜。11日上午宝莲寺失守，12日晚万福麟以阵地被毁、两翼受围，擅自放弃汤阴退至淇河南岸，13日日军进占汤阴。日期据《1938年河南历史大事记》；《新乡抗战·惨案》亦记2月中旬日军侵占汤阴。 From 6 February 1938 the main force of the Japanese 14th Division advanced south from Anyang along the Beiping–Hankou railway, fighting Wan Fulin and Gao Shuxun’s troops for four days around Baoliansi and Tangyin. Baoliansi fell on the morning of the 11th; on the night of the 12th Wan abandoned Tangyin and withdrew south of the Qi River, and the Japanese entered the city on the 13th.

summary.zh: 1938年2月13日，日军第14师团进占淇县。
summary.en: On 13 February 1938 the Japanese 14th Division occupied Qi County.

fields.name: 淇县沦陷 Fall of Qi County
fields.place: 河南淇县 Qi County, Henan
fields.summary: 1938年2月13日，日军第14师团进占淇县。 On 13 February 1938 the Japanese 14th Division occupied Qi County.
fields.description: 1938年2月12日日军越过淇河逼近淇县，13日万福麟部退至平汉路西侧，日军轻易占据淇县，直接威胁道清铁路。淇县失守后，日军一部继续南犯汲县，一部转向浚县，制造浚县惨案。日期据《1938年河南历史大事记》与《新乡抗战·惨案》。 On 12 February 1938 the Japanese crossed the Qi River toward Qi County; on the 13th Wan Fulin’s troops withdrew west of the Beiping–Hankou railway and the Japanese occupied the county town, threatening the Daoqing railway. Part of the force then moved south toward Jixian and part turned on Xunxian, where it carried out the Xunxian massacre.

summary.zh: 1938年2月14日，日军第14师团馆支队攻陷长垣。
summary.en: On 14 February 1938 the Kaneda detachment of the Japanese 14th Division captured Changyuan.

fields.name: 长垣沦陷 Fall of Changyuan
fields.summary: 1938年2月14日，日军第14师团馆支队攻陷长垣。 On 14 February 1938 the Kaneda detachment of the Japanese 14th Division captured Changyuan.
fields.description: 濮阳失守后，日军第14师团馆支队一部迅速南下，14日陷长垣，15日陷封丘，直逼新乡。长垣首次沦陷日期另有2月13日、2月23日/24日等说。3月25日日军攻入县城，制造黉学惨案，屠杀民众1700余人。日期取《1938年河南历史大事记》，异说据《新乡抗战·惨案》与长垣地方史料。 After Puyang fell, part of the Kaneda detachment drove south, taking Changyuan on 14 February and Fengqiu on the 15th, closing on Xinxiang. Local accounts give 13 February or 23/24 February for the first occupation. On 25 March the Japanese entered the city and carried out the Hongxue massacre, killing more than 1,700 civilians. The date follows the 1938 Henan chronology, with variants noted.
