fields.name: 顺德沦陷 Fall of Shunde
fields.summary: 日军占领顺德，控制珠江三角洲南部。 Japanese forces occupied Shunde and controlled the southern Pearl River Delta.
fields.description: 1938 年 10 月广州失守后，日军向珠江三角洲推进，10 月 23 日进攻陈村，26 日前后占领顺德各属。顺德县治大良此后多次易手，1940 年 2 月 29 日再度沦陷。日期据顺德地方史，待页码级核对。 After Guangzhou fell in October 1938, Japanese forces advanced into the Pearl River Delta, attacking Chencun on 23 October and occupying Shunde’s towns around 26 October. The county seat Daliang changed hands repeatedly and fell again on 29 February 1940. The date follows Shunde local history and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 番禺沦陷 Fall of Panyu
fields.summary: 日军占领番禺，控制广州南部与珠江航道。 Japanese forces occupied Panyu and controlled southern Guangzhou and the Pearl River channels.
fields.description: 1938 年 10 月广州失守后，日军第 21 军一部占领番禺，控制广州南部与珠江航道。11 月日军在番禺沙湾、石楼等地“扫荡”。日期据广州战役与番禺地方史，待页码级核对。 After Guangzhou fell in October 1938, elements of the Japanese 21st Army occupied Panyu and controlled southern Guangzhou and the Pearl River channels. In November Japanese forces conducted sweeps at Shawan and Shilou in Panyu. The date follows Guangzhou campaign and Panyu local histories and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1938年10月27日，德安沦陷。
summary.en: On 27 October 1938 De'an fell.

fields.name: 德安沦陷 Fall of De'an
fields.summary: 1938年10月27日，德安沦陷。 On 27 October 1938 De'an fell.
fields.description: 10月27日，日军攻占德安。德安位于南浔铁路中段，是万家岭战役的核心地区；日军第106师团在万家岭遭中国军队重创后，主力仍于10月底攻占德安。日期据《江西抗日战争史》与央广网江西抗战专题，待页码级核对。 On 27 October Japanese forces captured De'an. On the central section of the Nanchang–Jiujiang railway, De'an was at the heart of the Wanjialing battle; the Japanese 106th Division was mauled at Wanjialing, but the main force still took De'an in late October. The date follows the Jiangxi war history and the CNR Jiangxi campaign feature and awaits page-level verification.

summary.en: On 27 October 1938 the Japanese 16th Division captured Huang’an (modern Hong’an).

fields.name: 黄安沦陷 Fall of Huang’an
fields.summary: 1938年10月27日，日军第16师团攻占黄安（今红安）。 On 27 October 1938 the Japanese 16th Division captured Huang’an (modern Hong’an).
fields.description: 1938年10月27日日军第16师团笠井骑兵部队攻占黄安（今红安）。黄安为鄂东北门户，失守后日军进逼河口镇、黄陂。日期据《中国抗日战争全史》与《抗战史记·武汉会战（下）》。 On 27 October 1938 the Japanese 16th Division’s Kasai cavalry unit took Huang’an (modern Hong’an), the gateway to northeastern Hubei, and closed on Hekou and Huangpi. Both cited accounts give 27 October.

summary.en: On 28 October 1938 Dongliu fell.

fields.name: 东流沦陷 Fall of Dongliu
fields.summary: 1938年10月28日，东流沦陷。 On 28 October 1938 Dongliu fell.
fields.description: 10月28日，东流（今属东至县）与贵池同日沦陷。日军沿长江南岸西进，配合进攻武汉。日期据《安徽沦陷大事记（二）》，待页码级核对。 Dongliu (now part of Dongzhi county) fell on 28 October together with Guichi. Japanese forces advanced west along the south bank of the Yangtze in support of the Wuhan campaign. The date follows the second part of the Anhui occupation chronology and awaits page-level verification.

fields.summary: 1938年10月28日，贵池沦陷。 On 28 October 1938 Guichi fell.
fields.description: 10月28日，贵池沦陷。贵池位于长江南岸，是日军由安庆西进、控制皖江航道的重要据点。日期据《安徽沦陷大事记（二）》，待页码级核对。 Guichi fell on 28 October. On the south bank of the Yangtze, it was an important base for the Japanese advance west from Anqing and for controlling the Anhui section of the river. The date follows the second part of the Anhui occupation chronology and awaits page-level verification.

name.zh: 伪安徽省政府在蚌埠成立
name.en: Establishment of the Puppet Anhui Provincial Government

summary.zh: 1938年10月28日，伪安徽省政府在蚌埠成立。
summary.en: On 28 October 1938 the puppet Anhui provincial government was established in Bengbu.

fields.name: 伪安徽省政府在蚌埠成立 Establishment of the Puppet Anhui Provincial Government
fields.summary: 1938年10月28日，伪安徽省政府在蚌埠成立。 On 28 October 1938 the puppet Anhui provincial government was established in Bengbu.
fields.description: 1938年6月12日，伪南京维新政府任命倪道烺为安徽省长；10月28日，伪安徽省政府在蚌埠正式成立。此后伪省府、伪省党部及日军特务机关均设蚌埠，蚌埠成为日军在安徽的统治中心。政治事件，不绘路线。 On 12 June 1938 the puppet Nanjing Reformed Government appointed Ni Daolang governor of Anhui; on 28 October the puppet provincial government was formally established in Bengbu. The puppet provincial government, party headquarters and Japanese special agency were all based there, making Bengbu the centre of Japanese rule in Anhui. This political event is not drawn as a route.

fields.name: 咸宁沦陷 Fall of Xianning
fields.summary: 1938年10月29日，日军第27师团攻占咸宁县城。 On 29 October 1938 the Japanese 27th Division captured Xianning.
fields.description: 1938年10月29日日军第27师团攻占咸宁县城。咸宁为粤汉铁路要地，失守后日军沿铁路南下崇阳、通城，切断粤汉线。日期据咸宁日报《不容抹杀的滔天罪行》与维基百科《咸宁市》。 On 29 October 1938 the Japanese 27th Division took Xianning, a key point on the Canton–Hankou railway. The Japanese then moved south through Chongyang and Tongcheng, cutting the railway. Both cited accounts give 29 October.

summary.en: On 30 October 1938 the Japanese 3rd and 10th Divisions captured Yingcheng.

fields.name: 应城沦陷 Fall of Yingcheng
fields.summary: 1938年10月30日，日军第3、第10师团攻占应城。 On 30 October 1938 the Japanese 3rd and 10th Divisions captured Yingcheng.
fields.description: 1938年10月30日日军第3、第10师团攻占应城。日军自应山、安陆、云梦、应城向汉阳、汉口迂回，应城失守后切断了中国第5战区向西撤退的通道。日期据《抗战史记·武汉会战（下）》与《中国抗日战争全史》。 On 30 October 1938 the Japanese 3rd and 10th Divisions took Yingcheng. Advancing via Yingshan, Anlu, Yunmeng and Yingcheng toward Hanyang and Hankou, the Japanese cut the Fifth War Zone’s westward withdrawal route.

summary.en: The New 3rd Army was defeated at Chongyang in Hubei and then moved to northern Jiangxi.

fields.name: 新3军参加崇阳战斗 New 3rd Army at Chongyang
fields.summary: 新3军在湖北崇阳作战失利，随后转往赣北。 The New 3rd Army was defeated at Chongyang in Hubei and then moved to northern Jiangxi.
fields.description: 1938 年 11 月，新3军在湖北崇阳地区与日军作战失利，随后转往赣北、湘北，隶属第9战区，参加后续长沙会战。 路线为示意简化，日期取通行说法，待史料校订。 In November 1938 the New 3rd Army was defeated by Japanese forces around Chongyang in Hubei. It then moved to northern Jiangxi and northern Hunan under the 9th War Zone and fought in later Changsha campaigns. Illustrative simplified route; dates follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

summary.zh: 日本提出建立“东亚新秩序”，公开否定九国公约体系。
summary.en: Japan proclaimed a “New Order in East Asia,” openly rejecting the Washington treaty system.

fields.name: 日本提出“东亚新秩序” Japan’s “New Order in East Asia”
fields.summary: 日本提出建立“东亚新秩序”，公开否定九国公约体系。 Japan proclaimed a “New Order in East Asia,” openly rejecting the Washington treaty system.
fields.description: 1938 年 11 月 3 日，日本近卫内阁发表第二次声明，提出建立“东亚新秩序”，声称日本、伪满、中国应相互结合，公开否定华盛顿体系下的门户开放原则。该声明为汪精卫投日后的对华政策定调。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 3 November 1938 the second Konoe cabinet issued a statement proclaiming a “New Order in East Asia,” asserting that Japan, Manchukuo and China should be closely linked and openly rejecting the Open Door principle of the Washington system. The statement set the framework for Japan’s China policy after Wang Jingwei’s defection. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

fields.summary: 1938年11月6日，日军第27师团攻占崇阳县城。 On 6 November 1938 the Japanese 27th Division captured Chongyang.
fields.description: 1938年11月6日13时，日军第27师团宫崎部队攻占崇阳县城。崇阳为武汉通长沙的公路要地，失守后日军继续南犯通城、岳阳。日期据咸宁日报《不容抹杀的滔天罪行》与崇阳县史志研究中心。 At 1 p.m. on 6 November 1938 the Japanese 27th Division’s Miyazaki unit took Chongyang, a key point on the Wuhan–Changsha road. name.en: Establishment of the North China and Central China Development Companies

summary.en: Japan established the North China and Central China development companies to control the occupied economies.

fields.name: 日本设立华北开发、华中振兴两会社 Establishment of the North China and Central China Development Companies
fields.summary: 日本设立华北开发、华中振兴两大会社，统制沦陷区经济。 Japan established the North China and Central China development companies to control the occupied economies.
fields.description: 1938 年 11 月 7 日，日本政府主导的华北开发株式会社与华中振兴株式会社先后成立（华北开发于同年 6 月设立、11 月召开总会；华中振兴 11 月 7 日在上海成立，日期有异说）。两社以“中日合办”名义统制华北、华中的交通、矿业、电力、通信等业，是日本掠夺沦陷区资源的核心机构。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 7 November 1938 the Japanese government’s North China Development Company and Central China Development Company were established (the North China company was incorporated in June and held its general meeting in November; the Central China company was founded in Shanghai on 7 November; dates vary). Under a “Sino-Japanese joint venture” formula they controlled transport, mining, electric power and communications in North and Central China and were central to Japan’s extraction of occupied resources. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 聊城沦陷 Fall of Liaocheng
fields.summary: 1938年11月15日，日军攻破聊城，范筑先殉国。 On 15 November 1938 Japanese forces broke into Liaocheng; Fan Zhuxian died in the defence.
fields.description: 11月14日至15日，日军分3路进犯鲁西北地区，聊城被围。范筑先率部与日军英勇战斗，终因敌众我寡，被日军攻破城门，范筑先等近700名将士壮烈殉国。日期据《山东抗日战争大事记》与《日军进攻山东》，待页码级核对。 On 14–15 November Japanese forces advanced into northwestern Shandong in three columns and surrounded Liaocheng. Fan Zhuxian and his troops fought bravely but were overwhelmed; the gates were breached and Fan and nearly 700 officers and men died. The date follows the Shandong war chronology and the provincial party history and awaits page-level verification.

fields.summary: 1938年11月22日，日军攻陷宿迁城（通行说法）。 On 22 November 1938 Japanese forces captured Suqian (common account).
fields.description: 11月20日，日军约3000人在飞机、坦克配合下沿宿睢公路东犯，进攻宿迁；11月22日宿城陷落（通行说法），日军进城后屠杀居民，宿城惨案清理尸体4000余具。宿迁沦陷日期另有「11月下旬」说，正文并列。 On 20 November about 3,000 Japanese troops with aircraft and tanks advanced east along the Suqian–Suining road and attacked Suqian. The city fell on 22 November in the common account; Japanese troops then massacred residents, and more than 4,000 bodies were recovered after the Suqian massacre. Some sources say only "late November"; both are noted.

fields.description: 1938 年 11 月 22 日，日军在大鹏湾登陆，随后东路由盐田、龙岗、沙头角直扑深圳镇，西路自虎门在沙井、西乡登岸进攻南头。11 月 26 日，日军占领深圳镇与南头城。11 月 30 日中国军队收复深圳镇，12 月 2 日收复宝安。日期据《深圳通史》，待页码级核对。 On 22 November 1938 Japanese forces landed at Dapeng Bay; the eastern column advanced via Yantian, Longgang and Shatoujiao toward Shenzhen town, while the western column landed at Shajing and Xixiang from Humen and attacked Nantou. On 26 November Japanese troops occupied Shenzhen town and Nantou. Chinese forces recovered Shenzhen on 30 November and Bao’an on 2 December. The date follows the Shenzhen History and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 琼崖抗日独立队成立 Establishment of the Qiongya Independent Detachment

fields.description: 1938 年 12 月 5 日，琼崖工农红军游击队在海南琼山云龙改编为广东民众抗日自卫团第十四区独立队，冯白驹任队长。日期与主官为通行说法，待页码级核对。 本事件为建军建制，不绘制行军路线。 On December 5, 1938, the Qiongya Workers’ and Peasants’ Red Army guerrillas were reorganized at Yunlong, Qiongshan, Hainan, as the Independent Detachment of the 14th District of the Guangdong People’s Anti-Japanese Self-Defense Corps, with Feng Baiju as commander. summary.zh: 日本设立兴亚院，统一管理在华占领区的政治、经济事务。

fields.name: 兴亚院成立 Establishment of the Kōain (Asia Development Board)
fields.summary: 日本设立兴亚院，统一管理在华占领区的政治、经济事务。 Japan established the Kōain to centralize political and economic administration of its occupied areas in China.
fields.description: 1938 年 12 月 16 日，日本设立兴亚院，作为内阁直属机构，统一指导在华占领区的政治、经济和文化事务，并在北平、上海、汉口等地设联络部。兴亚院成立标志着日本对华殖民统治机构化。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 16 December 1938 Japan established the Kōain as a cabinet-level body to coordinate political, economic and cultural affairs in its occupied areas in China, with liaison offices in Beiping, Shanghai and Hankou. Its creation marked the institutionalization of Japan’s colonial rule in China. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 山东本地起义武装在沂水王庄整编为八路军山东纵队，统一指挥全省抗日武装。
summary.en: Shandong’s local uprising forces were reorganized at Wangzhuang, Yishui, as the Shandong Column, unifying the province’s anti-Japanese forces.

fields.name: 山东纵队成立 Establishment of the Shandong Column
fields.summary: 山东本地起义武装在沂水王庄整编为八路军山东纵队，统一指挥全省抗日武装。 Shandong’s local uprising forces were reorganized at Wangzhuang, Yishui, as the Shandong Column, unifying the province’s anti-Japanese forces.
fields.description: 1938 年 12 月 27 日，中共中央决定在山东沂水王庄成立八路军山东纵队，统一指挥山东各地共产党领导的抗日武装（鲁西、冀鲁边另成系统）。张经武任指挥，黎玉任政治委员，王建安任副指挥，王彬任参谋长，江华任政治部主任，下辖第二、第三、第四、第五、第六、第八、第九、第十二支队等 10 个支队又 3 个团，共 2.45 万余人。这支部队以山东各地抗日武装起义（徂徕山、天福山、黑铁山、牛头镇等）的基干队伍为基础编成，不是由八路军主力入鲁后组建；1938 年 6 月各地起义武装已统一使用「八路军山东人民抗日游击队」番号，12 月改称山东纵队。1942 年 8 月，山东纵队改为山东军区；1943 年 3 月，山东军区与第115师合并为新的山东军区。本事件为建军建制，不绘制行军路线。 成立日期、主官与兵力为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 27 December 1938 the CCP Central Committee decided to establish the Eighth Route Army’s Shandong Column at Wangzhuang, Yishui, to command the Communist-led anti-Japanese forces across Shandong (western Shandong and the Hebei-Shandong border area remained separate). Zhang Jingwu was commander, Li Yu political commissar, Wang Jian’an deputy commander, Wang Bin chief of staff, and Jiang Hua director of the political department, with ten detachments and three regiments—more than 24,500 men. The column was formed from the cadre units of Shandong’s local anti-Japanese uprisings (Culaishan, Tianfushan, Heitieshan, Niutouzhen, and others); it was not created by a main-force unit entering the province. In June 1938 the uprising forces had already adopted the designation “Eighth Route Army Shandong People’s Anti-Japanese Guerrillas,” renamed the Shandong Column in December. In August 1942 the column became the Shandong Military Region; in March 1943 that region merged with the 115th Division to form the new Shandong Military Region. This is a formation event and no march route is drawn. Dates, appointments, and force size follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: Fifth Plenary Session of the Kuomintang

summary.zh: 国民党五届五中全会确定防共、限共方针，同时坚持抗战。
summary.en: The Kuomintang’s fifth plenary session adopted a policy of guarding against and limiting the Communists while continuing the war.

fields.name: 五届五中全会 Fifth Plenary Session of the Kuomintang
fields.summary: 国民党五届五中全会确定防共、限共方针，同时坚持抗战。 The Kuomintang’s fifth plenary session adopted a policy of guarding against and limiting the Communists while continuing the war.
fields.description: 1939 年 1 月，国民党五届五中全会在重庆召开，确定“溶共、防共、限共、反共”方针，设立防共委员会；同时仍表示坚持抗战。此后国共摩擦加剧，直至 1941 年皖南事变。 日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。 In January 1939 the Kuomintang’s fifth plenary session met in Chongqing and adopted a policy of “absorbing, guarding against, limiting, and opposing the Communists,” setting up an anti-Communist committee while still professing to continue the war. Kuomintang–Communist friction intensified, culminating in the Wannan Incident of 1941. Dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

name.en: The 120th Division Moves into Central Hebei

summary.zh: 贺龙、关向应率第120师主力到达冀中，与冀中军区会合。
summary.en: He Long and Guan Xiangying led the main force of the 120th Division into central Hebei and joined the Jizhong Military Region.

fields.name: 第120师挺进冀中 The 120th Division Moves into Central Hebei 120师东进冀中 120th Division Eastward Advance
fields.place: 河北河间惠伯口 Huibokou, Hejian, Hebei
fields.summary: 贺龙、关向应率第120师主力到达冀中，与冀中军区会合。 He Long and Guan Xiangying led the main force of the 120th Division into central Hebei and joined the Jizhong Military Region.
fields.description: 1938 年 12 月，八路军第120师主力在师长贺龙、政治委员关向应率领下由晋西北岚县出发，越过同蒲、平汉铁路封锁线，于 1939 年 1 月 25 日到达河北河间惠伯口，与冀中军区领导机关会合。随后成立冀中区总指挥部，贺龙任总指挥，统一指挥第120师和冀中军区部队，巩固冀中平原根据地。 行军日期与路线为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In December 1938 the main force of the 120th Division, under commander He Long and political commissar Guan Xiangying, set out from Lanxian in northwestern Shanxi, crossed the Tongpu and Pinghan railway blockade lines, and on 25 January 1939 reached Huibokou, Hejian, Hebei, joining the Jizhong Military Region headquarters. A Jizhong unified command was then formed under He Long to direct the 120th Division and local forces in consolidating the central Hebei plain base area. March dates and routes follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.name: 万县“二四”大轰炸 Wanxian Bombing of 4 February 1939
fields.summary: 1939年2月4日，日机18架轰炸万县市区，投弹100余枚。 On 4 February 1939 eighteen Japanese aircraft bombed Wanxian, dropping over 100 bombs.
fields.description: 1939年2月4日，日机18架轰炸万县市区，投弹100余枚，死亡300余人（另说伤亡近千人）。万县为川东门户和长江航运要地，此后至1944年共遭日机58批次轰炸。日期据《抗战大后方侵华日军无差别轰炸重大惨案的时空分布考察》与《抗战时期万县人口伤亡和财产损失巨大》。 On 4 February 1939 eighteen Japanese aircraft bombed Wanxian, dropping more than 100 bombs and killing over 300 (some accounts give nearly 1,000 casualties). Wanxian was the gateway to eastern Sichuan and a key Yangtze shipping point; by 1944 it suffered fifty-eight raids.

summary.en: On 4 February 1939 eighteen Japanese aircraft bombed Guiyang, killing 597.

fields.name: 贵阳“二四”大轰炸 Guiyang Bombing of 4 February 1939
fields.summary: 1939年2月4日，日机18架轰炸贵阳，炸死597人。 On 4 February 1939 eighteen Japanese aircraft bombed Guiyang, killing 597.
fields.description: 1939年2月4日中午，日机18架从城东侵入贵阳，轮番轰炸以大十字为中心的繁华商业区，投弹129枚，炸死597人、炸伤1526人，毁房1326幢，2万余人无家可归。贵阳为不设防的后方城市，此次“二四”轰炸是其抗战期间最惨重的一次。日期据人民网与贵州省民政厅。 At noon on 4 February 1939 eighteen Japanese aircraft entered Guiyang from the east and bombed the commercial district around the Great Cross in successive waves. They dropped 129 bombs, killing 597, wounding 1,526, destroying 1,326 buildings and leaving over 20,000 homeless. Guiyang was an undefended rear city; the “2/4” raid was its worst of the war.

place.zh: 海南琼山天尾港（今海口西北）
place.en: Tianwei Port, Qiongshan, Hainan (northwest of present-day Haikou)

summary.zh: 日军台湾混成旅团在琼山天尾港登陆，当日攻占海口、府城。
summary.en: The Japanese Taiwan Mixed Brigade landed at Tianwei Port in Qiongshan and took Haikou and Fucheng the same day.

fields.name: 日军登陆海南岛 Japanese landing on Hainan Island
fields.place: 海南琼山天尾港（今海口西北） Tianwei Port, Qiongshan, Hainan (northwest of present-day Haikou)
fields.summary: 日军台湾混成旅团在琼山天尾港登陆，当日攻占海口、府城。 The Japanese Taiwan Mixed Brigade landed at Tianwei Port in Qiongshan and took Haikou and Fucheng the same day.
fields.description: 1939 年 2 月 10 日凌晨，日军第21军台湾混成旅团数千人，在海军第5舰队 30 余艘舰艇、50 余架飞机掩护下，从海口西北的琼山县天尾港强行登陆；当日攻占府城、海口。岛上中国守军仅有保安第5旅等约 3900 人，抵抗后撤往定安山区。日军随后向文昌、定安、嘉积、儋县等沿海城镇推进，至 4 月完成首轮占领。日期、兵力为通行说法，待页码级核对。 Before dawn on 10 February 1939, several thousand troops of the Japanese 21st Army’s Taiwan Mixed Brigade, covered by more than 30 warships and 50 aircraft of the 5th Fleet, landed at Tianwei Port in Qiongshan, northwest of Haikou, and took Fucheng and Haikou that day. The Chinese defenders on the island, mainly the 5th Security Brigade, numbered only about 3,900 and withdrew to the Ding’an mountains after resisting. Japanese forces then pushed toward Wenchang, Ding’an, Jiaji and Xinzhou in Danxian, completing the first phase of occupation by April. Dates and strength follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: Japanese forces captured Haikou and Fucheng; the Qiongya defenders withdrew to the Ding’an mountains.

fields.name: 海口、府城失守 Fall of Haikou and Fucheng
fields.place: 海南海口、府城 Haikou and Fucheng, Hainan
fields.summary: 日军攻占海口、府城，琼崖守军撤往定安山区。 Japanese forces captured Haikou and Fucheng; the Qiongya defenders withdrew to the Ding’an mountains.
fields.description: 1939 年 2 月 10 日，日军登陆后分左右两翼进攻：右翼台湾步兵第一联队攻占府城，左翼第二联队攻占海口，秀英炮台守军曾开炮还击。守军保安第15团、第11团等因众寡悬殊撤退。海口、府城失守后，琼崖当局撤往定安山区。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 10 February 1939 the landing force attacked in two wings: the right wing, the 1st Taiwan Infantry Regiment, took Fucheng, while the left wing, the 2nd Regiment, took Haikou; the Xiuying battery returned fire. The defenders, including the 15th and 11th Security Regiments, withdrew after being heavily outnumbered. The Qiongya authorities then retreated into the Ding’an mountains. Dates follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: The Qiongya Independent Corps blocked the Japanese advance at Tankou Ford, firing the first shots of the Qiongya resistance.

fields.name: 潭口阻击战 Battle of Tankou Ford
fields.place: 海南琼山潭口渡口 Tankou Ford, Qiongshan, Hainan
fields.summary: 琼崖抗日独立队在潭口渡口阻击东进日军，打响琼崖抗战第一枪。 The Qiongya Independent Corps blocked the Japanese advance at Tankou Ford, firing the first shots of the Qiongya resistance.
fields.description: 1939 年 2 月 10 日，日军一部自海口东渡南渡江向文昌推进，琼崖抗日独立队第一中队在潭口渡口阻击，激战至黄昏后撤出。这是中共领导的琼崖抗日武装对日军的首次正面阻击，被称为「琼崖抗战第一枪」。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 10 February 1939 a Japanese detachment crossed the Nandu River east of Haikou toward Wenchang. The 1st Company of the Qiongya Independent Corps blocked it at Tankou Ford and fought until dusk before withdrawing. It was the first direct engagement between the CCP-led Qiongya forces and the Japanese, known as the “first shot of the Qiongya resistance.” Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.description: 1939 年 2 月 10 日至 12 日，日军为策应海口、府城作战，另部在澄迈湾东北角、老城附近登陆，随后向金江、临高、福山方向推进。4 月 14 日占领澄迈县城金江。登陆点据人民网与海南史志网，具体滩头待页码级核对。 From 10 to 12 February 1939, to support the attack on Haikou and Fucheng, another Japanese force landed at the northeast corner of Chengmai Bay near Laocheng and advanced toward Jinjiang, Lingao and Fushan. It occupied Jinjiang, seat of Chengmai county, on 14 April. The landing site follows People’s Daily Online and Hainan local history and awaits page-level verification.

name.en: Japanese capture of Sanya and Yulin

summary.zh: 日本海军陆战队在三亚湾登陆，占领三亚、榆林、崖城。
summary.en: Japanese naval landing forces came ashore at Sanya Bay and took Sanya, Yulin and Yacheng.

fields.name: 日军占领三亚、榆林 Japanese capture of Sanya and Yulin
fields.summary: 日本海军陆战队在三亚湾登陆，占领三亚、榆林、崖城。 Japanese naval landing forces came ashore at Sanya Bay and took Sanya, Yulin and Yacheng.
fields.description: 1939 年 2 月 14 日拂晓，日本海军第5舰队载佐世保海军陆战队约 2500 人进入三亚湾，登陆后当日占领三亚、榆林，深夜占领崖城。日军随后在榆林、三亚设海军基地和航空场，控制海南南部。日期、兵力为通行说法，待页码级核对。 At dawn on 14 February 1939 the Japanese 5th Fleet carried about 2,500 Sasebo naval landing troops into Sanya Bay; they took Sanya and Yulin that day and Yacheng late that night. Japan subsequently established naval bases and airfields at Yulin and Sanya and controlled southern Hainan. Dates and strength follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

Yacheng fell on 15 February. Landing sites follow Hainan local history and await page-level verification.

fields.summary: 日军自海口进攻定安，占领定安县城。 Japanese forces advanced from Haikou and occupied Ding’an county town.
fields.description: 1939 年 2 月 20 日，日军 700 余人以飞机、战车掩护，自海口猛攻定安县城。定安为国民党琼崖警备司令部驻地附近要地，失守后国民党军政机关退入山区。日期有 2 月 20 日、22 日诸说，待页码级核对。 On 20 February 1939 more than 700 Japanese troops, covered by aircraft and armoured vehicles, attacked Ding’an county town from Haikou. Ding’an was a key point near the Nationalist Qiongya garrison headquarters, whose offices withdrew into the mountains after its fall. Accounts differ between 20 and 22 February and await page-level verification.

fields.description: 1939 年 2 月 22 日日军占领文昌县城文城后，同部于 2 月 23 日进入清澜港。现有资料多写作“进入”，可能是自文城陆路推进，也可能是海上登陆，具体方式待页码级核对。清澜港失守后，日军控制文昌沿海与清澜湾。 After occupying Wencheng, seat of Wenchang county, on 22 February 1939, the same Japanese force entered Qinglan port on 23 February. Sources mostly say “entered”; it may have advanced overland from Wencheng or landed by sea, and the exact manner awaits page-level verification. The fall of Qinglan gave Japan control of the Wenchang coast and Qinglan Bay.

fields.description: 1939年2月27日，中国守军放弃连云港，2月28日日军占领连云港及云台山大桅尖；3月4日占领墟沟，连云地区全境沦陷。连云港保卫战自1938年5月开始，历时约289天。日期据《连云港保卫战》，待页码级核对。 On 27 February 1939 Chinese defenders abandoned Lianyungang; on 28 February Japanese forces occupied the port and the Dazhujian peak, and on 4 March they took Xugou, completing the occupation of the Lianyungang area. The defence had lasted about 289 days since May 1938. The date follows the Lianyungang campaign account and awaits page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

name.en: The 115th Division’s Main Force Enters Shandong

summary.zh: 陈光、罗荣桓率第115师师部及第686团由晋西挺进山东，首战樊坝。
summary.en: Chen Guang and Luo Ronghuan led the 115th Division headquarters and 686th Regiment from western Shanxi into Shandong, winning their first battle at Fanba.

fields.name: 第115师主力入鲁 The 115th Division’s Main Force Enters Shandong 东进支队挺进山东 Eastern Advance Detachment
fields.place: 山东鄄城、郓城一带 Juancheng–Yuncheng area, Shandong
fields.summary: 陈光、罗荣桓率第115师师部及第686团由晋西挺进山东，首战樊坝。 Chen Guang and Luo Ronghuan led the 115th Division headquarters and 686th Regiment from western Shanxi into Shandong, winning their first battle at Fanba.
fields.description: 1938 年 12 月 2 日，八路军总部命令第115师主力挺进山东。12 月 20 日，代师长陈光、政治委员罗荣桓率师部、师直属队和第343旅第686团组成东进支队，由晋西灵石出发，1939 年元旦到达晋东南黎城、屯留一带整训。2 月中旬继续东进，经河北涉县、磁县和河南林县、鹤壁、濮阳，3 月 1 日越过黄河进入山东鄄城，随后在郓城西北樊坝首战告捷，歼灭伪军 500 余人。师部留第686团第三营等在鲁西开辟根据地，主力继续东进，9 月进入鲁南抱犊崮山区。第115师入鲁后与山东纵队并肩作战，1943 年 3 月两部合并为新的山东军区。 进入山东的日期各书记为 3 月 1 日或 2 日，樊坝战斗为 3 月 3 日晚至 4 日，此处取 3 月 1 日至 4 日；待页码级核对。 On 2 December 1938 the Eighth Route Army headquarters ordered the 115th Division’s main force into Shandong. On 20 December acting commander Chen Guang and political commissar Luo Ronghuan formed the Eastern Advance Detachment from the division headquarters, its direct units, and the 686th Regiment of the 343rd Brigade, setting out from Lingshi in western Shanxi and reaching Licheng and Tunliu in southeastern Shanxi for training on New Year’s Day 1939. In mid-February it moved east through Shexian and Cixian in Hebei and Linxian, Hebi, and Puyang in Henan, crossed the Yellow River into Juancheng, Shandong, on 1 March, and won its first battle at Fanba northwest of Yuncheng, annihilating more than 500 puppet troops. The headquarters left the 686th Regiment’s 3rd Battalion and other units to open the western Shandong base while the main force continued east and entered the Baodugu mountains of southern Shandong in September. The 115th Division fought alongside the Shandong Column, and in March 1943 the two merged into the new Shandong Military Region. Accounts give 1 or 2 March for the entry into Shandong and 3–4 March for the Fanba battle; this entry uses 1–4 March pending page-level verification.

fields.name: 淮阴沦陷 Fall of Huaiyin
fields.summary: 1939年3月1日，日军一夜之间侵入淮阴城。 On 1 March 1939 Japanese forces entered Huaiyin overnight.
fields.description: 1939年3月1日，由连云港沿盐河、由宿迁沿运河、由沭阳沿淮沭路三个方向的日军，一夜之间侵入淮阴城；淮安、涟水等地相继沦陷。国民党江苏省政府及第24集团军总部连夜撤离。日期据淮安地方史与中共江苏地方简史。 On 1 March 1939 Japanese columns from Lianyungang along the Yan River, from Suqian along the Grand Canal and from Shuyang along the Huaishu road entered Huaiyin overnight; Huaian and Lianshui fell soon after. The Nationalist Jiangsu provincial government and the 24th Group Army headquarters fled during the night. The date follows Huai'an local history and the provincial party history.

fields.description: 3月4日上午，日军第114师团步兵1个大队、第21师团步兵1个大队及第5师团第212联队向海州城发起进攻，联合各路部队占领海州、新浦、连云港。海州地区全境沦陷后，日军在新浦设立海州特务机关。 On the morning of 4 March, one battalion of the Japanese 114th Division, one of the 21st Division and the 212th Regiment of the 5th Division attacked Haizhou and, together with other columns, occupied Haizhou, Xinpu and Lianyungang. fields.name: 永修沦陷 Fall of Yongxiu
fields.summary: 1939年3月22日，永修沦陷。 On 22 March 1939 Yongxiu fell.
fields.description: 3月20日，日军第11军强渡修河，突破中国军队修河防线；3月22日攻占永修。永修是南昌西北门户，失守后日军沿南浔铁路南下，直逼南昌。日期为通行说法，据《江西抗日战争史》与《南昌会战》，待页码级核对。 On 20 March the Japanese 11th Army crossed the Xiu River and broke the Chinese defence line; Yongxiu fell on 22 March. Northwest of Nanchang, Yongxiu was the city's gateway; its fall opened the Japanese advance south along the Nanchang–Jiujiang railway. The date is the common account, follows the Jiangxi war history and the Nanchang campaign, and awaits page-level verification.

fields.description: 1939 年 3 月 17 日，日军第 11 军向南昌发动进攻，中国第 9 战区部队抵抗。3 月 27 日，日军占领南昌，南昌会战结束。日军随后遭到中国军队反攻，4 月一度撤出，5 月再次占领。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 17 March 1939 the Japanese 11th Army attacked Nanchang and Chinese 9th War Zone troops resisted. On 27 March the Japanese occupied Nanchang, ending the battle. Chinese counterattacks forced a temporary withdrawal in April before the Japanese retook the city in May. fields.summary: 1939年3月29日，高安沦陷。 On 29 March 1939 Gao'an fell.
fields.description: 南昌会战期间，日军第11军一部沿湘赣公路西进，3月29日攻占高安。高安是南昌以西、锦江中游的要点，失守后中国军队第74军等部多次反攻。日期为通行说法，据《南昌会战》与《江西抗日战争史》，待页码级核对。 During the Nanchang campaign a Japanese 11th Army column advanced west along the Hunan–Jiangxi road and captured Gao'an on 29 March. West of Nanchang on the middle Jin River, Gao'an was a key point; Chinese forces including the 74th Army counter-attacked repeatedly after its fall. The date is the common account, follows the Nanchang campaign and the Jiangxi war history, and awaits page-level verification.

fields.description: 1939 年 3 月 28 日，日军南支派遣军陆海空部队 2000 余人及伪军 800 余人进犯新会，29 日直逼江门外围。30 日下午江门守军退守城外，江门沦陷。日期据新会地方史，待页码级核对。 On 28 March 1939 more than 2,000 Japanese army, navy and air troops of the South China Expeditionary Army, with 800 puppet troops, attacked Xinhui and on 29 March closed on Jiangmen. On the afternoon of 30 March the defenders withdrew from the town and Jiangmen fell. The date follows Xinhui local history and awaits page-level verification.

fields.description: 1939年4月，淮南大通、九龙岗两矿合并，由日本「兴亚在华联络部」和日伪政府联合组成「日华合办淮南煤炭股份有限公司」，公司设在上海，在淮南设「淮南矿业所」。日军占领期间共采煤429万吨，大多用于侵华战争；掠夺性开采对矿井破坏很大。日期只有月份，标 datePrecision: month，不绘路线。 In April 1939 the Datong and Jiulonggang mines were merged into the Japanese–Chinese Huainan Coal Company, jointly run by Japan's Kōain liaison office and the puppet government, with headquarters in Shanghai and a mining office in Huainan. During the occupation 4.29 million tons of coal were extracted, mostly for the war effort; destructive mining damaged the pits. Only the month is known, so the event is marked datePrecision: month and no route is drawn.

fields.name: 新会（会城）沦陷 Fall of Xinhui (Huicheng)
fields.place: 广东新会会城 Huicheng, Xinhui, Guangdong
fields.summary: 日军攻占新会县城会城。 Japanese forces captured Huicheng, seat of Xinhui county.
fields.description: 1939 年 3 月 30 日江门失守后，日军向新会县城会城推进。中国守军省保七团增援，但兵力悬殊，4 月 2 日会城失守。日期据新会地方史，待页码级核对。 After Jiangmen fell on 30 March 1939, Japanese forces advanced on Huicheng, seat of Xinhui county. The Chinese 7th Security Regiment reinforced the town, but the defenders were outnumbered and Huicheng fell on 2 April. The date follows Xinhui local history and awaits page-level verification.

fields.description: 4月2日，日军攻占奉新。奉新位于南昌以西、潦河中游，是南昌会战中西路的要点。日期为通行说法，据《南昌会战》与《江西抗日战争史》，待页码级核对。 On 2 April Japanese forces captured Fengxin. West of Nanchang on the middle Liao River, Fengxin was a key point on the western axis of the Nanchang campaign. The date is the common account, follows the Nanchang campaign and the Jiangxi war history, and awaits page-level verification.

fields.description: 1939 年 2 月日军在澄迈湾登陆后，向澄迈内地推进。4 月 14 日，日军占领澄迈县城金江镇。金江地处南渡江中游，是海口通往琼西的重要节点。日期据海南史志网，待页码级核对。 After landing in Chengmai Bay in February 1939, Japanese forces pushed inland. On 14 April they occupied Jinjiang, seat of Chengmai county. Jinjiang lies on the middle Nandu River and was an important node between Haikou and western Hainan. The date follows Hainan local history and awaits page-level verification.

fields.description: 1939 年 4 月 15 日，日军占领琼东县嘉积镇。嘉积是海南东部水陆交通枢纽，失守后日军以此为据点控制万泉河流域和琼东、乐会一带。日期据海南史志网，待页码级核对。 On 15 April 1939 Japanese forces occupied Jiaji in Qiongdong county. Jiaji was a transport hub in eastern Hainan; after its fall Japan used it as a base to control the Wanquan River valley and the Qiongdong–Lehui area. The date follows Hainan local history and awaits page-level verification.

summary.en: The Japanese Kawasaki force and naval landing troops came ashore at Baimajing and then took Xinying and Xinzhou.

fields.place: 海南儋县白马井（洋浦港入口北岸） Baimajing, Dan county (north bank of Yangpu harbour entrance), Hainan
fields.summary: 日军川崎部队与海军陆战队在白马井登陆，随后占新英、新州。 The Japanese Kawasaki force and naval landing troops came ashore at Baimajing and then took Xinying and Xinzhou.
fields.description: 1939 年 4 月 16 日，台湾混成旅团川崎部队与坂垣大佐指挥的海军陆战队在海南岛西部、今洋浦港入口北岸白马井登陆；4 月 17 日占新英港，4 月 18 日占儋县县城新州。登陆点据人民网与儋州地方史，待页码级核对。 On 16 April 1939 the Kawasaki force of the Taiwan Mixed Brigade and naval landing troops under Colonel Sakagami came ashore at Baimajing on the north bank of the present Yangpu harbour entrance in western Hainan. They took Xinying port on 17 April and Xinzhou, seat of Dan county, on 18 April. The landing site follows People’s Daily Online and Danzhou local history and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 临高沦陷 Fall of Lingao
fields.summary: 日军攻占临高县城，同时控制博鳌、洋浦、白马井等港口。 Japanese forces captured Lingao county town and also controlled the ports of Bo’ao, Yangpu and Baimajing.
fields.description: 1939 年 4 月 18 日，日军攻占临高县城，同时占领博鳌、乐会和洋浦港、白马井。临高失守使日军控制琼州海峡南岸与琼西北沿海。另有 9 月 25 日日军在新盈港登陆后占临城说，日期待页码级核对。 On 18 April 1939 Japanese forces captured Lingao county town and also took Bo’ao, Lehui, Yangpu port and Baimajing, giving them control of the south shore of the Qiongzhou Strait and the northwest coast. Another account has Japanese forces landing at Xinying on 25 September and then taking the county town; the date awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 儋县（新州）沦陷 Fall of Dan County (Xinzhou)
fields.place: 海南儋县新州 Xinzhou, Dan county (present-day Danzhou), Hainan
fields.summary: 日军自白马井、新英登陆，占领儋县县城新州。 Japanese forces landed at Baimajing and Xinying and occupied Xinzhou, seat of Dan county.
fields.description: 1939 年 4 月 16 日，日军从白马井登陆；17 日在新英登陆，随后向东进攻。4 月 18 日占领儋县县城新州。5 月 4 日，日军与伪军侵占琼西重镇那大，以那大基督教堂为据点。日期据海南史志网与儋州地方史，待页码级核对。 On 16 April 1939 Japanese forces landed at Baimajing, and on 17 April at Xinying, then advanced east. On 18 April they occupied Xinzhou, seat of Dan county. On 4 May Japanese and puppet troops seized Nada, the key town of western Hainan, using its church as a strongpoint. Dates follow Hainan and Danzhou local histories and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 第120师在齐会歼灭日军吉田大队大部，取得平原歼灭战胜利。
summary.en: The 120th Division destroyed most of the Japanese Yoshida Battalion at Qihui, a model annihilation battle on the plains.

fields.name: 齐会战斗 Battle of Qihui 齐会歼灭战 Qihui Annihilation Battle
fields.place: 河北河间齐会 Qihui, Hejian, Hebei
fields.summary: 第120师在齐会歼灭日军吉田大队大部，取得平原歼灭战胜利。 The 120th Division destroyed most of the Japanese Yoshida Battalion at Qihui, a model annihilation battle on the plains.
fields.description: 1939 年 4 月 23 日至 25 日，八路军第120师在河北河间齐会地区围歼日军第27师团第3联队吉田大队 800 余人，毙伤日军 700 余人。日军施放毒气，贺龙等 20 余人中毒；白求恩率医疗队在前线连续工作 69 小时，实施手术 115 例。此战是八路军在平原地区首次大量歼敌的范例。 战果数字为通行说法，待页码级核对。 From 23 to 25 April 1939 the 120th Division encircled and destroyed most of the Yoshida Battalion of the Japanese 27th Division’s 3rd Regiment at Qihui, Hejian, Hebei, inflicting more than 700 casualties on a force of over 800. Japanese troops used poison gas, poisoning He Long and more than 20 headquarters staff; Norman Bethune’s medical team worked 69 consecutive hours at the front and performed 115 operations. It was a model of large-scale annihilation warfare on the plains. Casualty figures follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.name: 陵水沦陷 Fall of Lingshui
fields.summary: 日军自三亚、藤桥方向进攻，占领陵水县城。 Japanese forces advanced from Sanya and Tengqiao and occupied Lingshui county town.
fields.description: 1939 年 4 月，日军自三亚、藤桥方向进攻陵水。4 月 28 日，日军占领陵水县城。陵水失守后，日军控制海南东南沿海，并以此为基地向保亭山区渗透。日期有 4 月 21 日、28 日诸说，待页码级核对。 In April 1939 Japanese forces advanced on Lingshui from Sanya and Tengqiao. On 28 April they occupied the county town, gaining control of the southeast coast and a base for penetration into the Baoting mountains. Accounts differ between 21 and 28 April and await page-level verification.

fields.summary: 日军完成海南岛首轮占领，控制文昌、定安、嘉积、儋县等沿海城镇。 Japan completed its first occupation of Hainan, controlling Wenchang, Ding’an, Jiaji, Danxian and other coastal towns.
fields.description: 1939 年 2 月登陆海口、三亚后，日军继续向文昌、定安、嘉积、儋县新州等沿海城镇推进。至 4 月底，日军完成海南岛首轮占领，控制主要港口、县城与交通线。各城具体失守日期待页码级核对。本事件为占领阶段节点，不绘单线。 After landing at Haikou and Sanya in February 1939, Japanese forces pushed toward Wenchang, Ding’an, Jiaji and Xinzhou in Danxian. By the end of April they had completed the first occupation of Hainan, controlling the main ports, county towns and roads. The exact date each town fell awaits page-level verification. This is a phase marker and is not drawn as a single route.

summary.zh: 日军进攻随县、枣阳地区，中国军队逐次抵抗并反击，恢复原阵地。
summary.en: Japanese forces attacked the Suixian and Zaoyang areas; Chinese troops resisted in stages, counterattacked, and restored the original line.

fields.name: 随枣会战 Battle of Suizao 随枣战役 Suizao Campaign
fields.place: 湖北随县（今随州） Suixian (now Suizhou), Hubei
fields.summary: 日军进攻随县、枣阳地区，中国军队逐次抵抗并反击，恢复原阵地。 Japanese forces attacked the Suixian and Zaoyang areas; Chinese troops resisted in stages, counterattacked, and restored the original line.
fields.description: 1939 年 5 月，日军第 11 军向随县、枣阳地区进攻，企图打击中国第五战区主力。中国军队依托地形逐次抵抗，并在日军补给困难时反击，至 5 月下旬恢复原阵地。此役是抗战进入相持阶段后的重要作战。 本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。 In May 1939, the Japanese 11th Army attacked the Suixian and Zaoyang areas, seeking to strike the main forces of China’s Fifth War Zone. Chinese troops used the terrain to resist in stages and counterattacked as Japanese supply lines became strained, restoring the original line by late May. It was an important operation after the war entered the stalemate phase. Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

fields.name: 重庆“五三”大轰炸 Chongqing Bombing of 3 May 1939
fields.summary: 1939年5月3日，日机36架轰炸重庆市区，投弹166枚。 On 3 May 1939 thirty-six Japanese aircraft bombed central Chongqing, dropping 166 bombs.
fields.description: 1939年5月3日，日本海军航空队36架飞机分两批空袭重庆市区，在民权路、飞来寺、国府路、学田湾、两路口等地投下爆炸弹83枚、燃烧弹36枚，以中央公园为中心19条街道被焚。据《民国二十八年度四川各地空袭损害统计表》，当日炸死673人、伤350人，损毁房屋1086幢。日期据重庆市档案馆空袭统计表与《重庆大轰炸》。 On 3 May 1939 thirty-six Japanese naval aircraft attacked central Chongqing in two waves, dropping 83 high-explosive and 36 incendiary bombs around Minquan Road, Feilai Temple, Guofu Road, Xuetianwan and Lianglukou; nineteen streets around Central Park burned. The 1939 Sichuan air-raid statistics record 673 dead, 350 wounded and 1,086 buildings damaged.

fields.name: 重庆“五四”大轰炸 Chongqing Bombing of 4 May 1939
fields.summary: 1939年5月4日，日机27架再炸重庆，死伤5000余人。 On 4 May 1939 twenty-seven Japanese aircraft bombed Chongqing again, killing or wounding more than 5,000.
fields.description: 1939年5月4日，日机27架再次轰炸重庆，大量投掷燃烧弹，都邮街、小梁子、夫子池、七星岗一带陷入火海。两日合计，市区房屋被毁2000余幢，市民死亡2648人、伤3668人；5月4日死伤5000余人，是大轰炸中伤亡最多的一次。日期据重庆市档案馆空袭统计表与《重庆大轰炸》。 On 4 May 1939 twenty-seven Japanese aircraft bombed Chongqing again with heavy use of incendiaries, setting Duyou Street, Xiaoliangzi, Fuzichi and Qixinggang ablaze. Over the two days more than 2,000 buildings were destroyed, 2,648 civilians killed and 3,668 wounded; the 4 May raid alone caused over 5,000 casualties, the deadliest of the bombing campaign.

fields.summary: 1939年5月8日，日军第3师团攻占随县。 On 8 May 1939 the Japanese 3rd Division captured Suixian.
fields.description: 1939年5月1日日军第11军向随枣地区进攻，5月8日随县失守。随县为鄂北门户，失守后日军沿襄花公路北进枣阳。日期据随州市政府《不屈的土地 英雄的人民》与维基百科《随枣会战》。 On 1 May 1939 the Japanese 11th Army attacked the Suixian–Zaoyang area; Suixian fell on the 8th. The town was the gateway to northern Hubei, and its loss opened the advance north along the Xianghua road to Zaoyang.

fields.description: 1939 年 6 月 21 日凌晨，日军第 21 军第 104 师团一部及海军陆战队共约万人，在汕头港外妈屿岛、达濠岛登陆，分路进攻汕头市区。中国守军独立第 9 旅、保安第 5 团等部抵抗。日期与兵力为通行说法，待页码级核对。 Before dawn on 21 June 1939, elements of the Japanese 21st Army’s 104th Division and naval landing forces, about 10,000 men in conventional accounts, landed on Mayu and Dahao islands outside Shantou harbour and attacked the city by several routes. Chinese 9th Independent Brigade and 5th Security Regiment troops resisted. Dates and strength follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

summary.zh: 日军攻占汕头市区，汕头沦陷。
summary.en: Japanese forces captured central Shantou and the city fell.

fields.name: 汕头沦陷 Fall of Shantou
fields.summary: 日军攻占汕头市区，汕头沦陷。 Japanese forces captured central Shantou and the city fell.
fields.description: 1939 年 6 月 21 日日军登陆后，22 日凌晨三路攻入汕头市区，汕头沦陷。汕头是广州失守后华南最后一个对外通商口岸，沦陷使中国经潮韶公路输入物资的通道被切断。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 After landing on 21 June 1939, Japanese forces entered central Shantou by three routes in the early hours of 22 June, and the city fell. Shantou was the last major external trading port in South China after the fall of Guangzhou; its loss cut China’s supply route via the Chaozhou–Shaoguan road. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

fields.summary: 日军自汕头北上，攻占潮州城。 Japanese forces advanced north from Shantou and captured Chaozhou.
fields.description: 1939 年 6 月 25 日，日军自汕头分两路进攻潮州，在枫溪、浮洋一带遭中国守军独立第 9 旅等部阻击。6 月 27 日上午，日军攻入潮州城，潮州沦陷。日期据汕头市档案馆档案，待页码级核对。 On 25 June 1939 Japanese forces advanced from Shantou toward Chaozhou in two columns and met resistance from the Chinese 9th Independent Brigade near Fengxi and Fuyang. On the morning of 27 June they entered Chaozhou, which then fell. The date follows Shantou municipal archives and awaits page-level verification.

fields.summary: 日军占领感恩县城。 Japanese forces occupied Gan’en county town.
fields.description: 1939 年 6 月 27 日，日军占领感恩县城（今东方感城）。感恩位于海南西南沿海，失守后日军与昌江、崖县据点连成一线，控制琼西南沿海。日期据海南史志网，待页码级核对。 On 27 June 1939 Japanese forces occupied Gan’en county town (present-day Gancheng, Dongfang). Gan’en lies on the southwest coast; after its fall Japanese garrisons at Changjiang and Ya county were linked, giving Japan control of the southwest coast. The date follows Hainan local history and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 澄海沦陷 Fall of Chenghai
fields.summary: 日军自潮州沿韩江进占澄海。 Japanese forces advanced from Chaozhou along the Han River and occupied Chenghai.
fields.description: 1939 年 6 月 29 日，侵占汕头的日军由潮州沿韩江进占澄海，澄海沦陷。至此，韩江、榕江、练江出海口均被日军控制。日期据汕头市档案馆，待页码级核对。 On 29 June 1939 Japanese forces occupying Shantou advanced from Chaozhou along the Han River and occupied Chenghai. With this, the mouths of the Han, Rong and Lian rivers were all under Japanese control. The date follows Shantou municipal archives and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 第74军驻防高安 74th Army Stationed at Gao’an
fields.summary: 王耀武接任第74军军长，部队驻防赣北高安，参加第一次长沙会战与上高会战。 Wang Yaowu took command of the 74th Army, which was stationed at Gao’an and fought in the first Battle of Changsha and at Shanggao.
fields.description: 1939 年 7 月，王耀武接任第74军军长，部队驻防赣北高安。此后第74军参加第一次长沙会战、1939 年冬季攻势与上高会战，长期活跃于赣北、湘北之间。 路线为示意简化，日期取通行说法，待史料校订。 In July 1939 Wang Yaowu took command of the 74th Army, which was stationed at Gao’an in northern Jiangxi. It then fought in the first Battle of Changsha, the winter offensive of 1939, and the Shanggao campaign, remaining active between northern Jiangxi and northern Hunan. Illustrative simplified route; dates follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

name.en: Opening of the Tiandu Iron Mine

place.zh: 海南崖县田独（今三亚田独）

summary.zh: 日军发现并开采田独铁矿，修建田独—榆林铁路与榆林港矿石码头。
summary.en: Japanese forces discovered and began mining the Tiandu iron ore deposit, building the Tiandu–Yulin railway and an ore terminal at Yulin port.

fields.name: 田独铁矿开采 Opening of the Tiandu Iron Mine
fields.place: 海南崖县田独（今三亚田独） Tiandu, Ya county (present-day Sanya), Hainan
fields.summary: 日军发现并开采田独铁矿，修建田独—榆林铁路与榆林港矿石码头。 Japanese forces discovered and began mining the Tiandu iron ore deposit, building the Tiandu–Yulin railway and an ore terminal at Yulin port.
fields.description: 1939 年 7 月，日军随军地质勘探人员在崖县田独发现优质铁矿，随即由石原株式会社组织开采。1940 年 6 月 11 日首次出矿，并修建田独至河口约 10 公里的轻便铁路，在榆林港建万吨级矿石码头。1944 年下半年因盟军封锁海域停产。据日方资料，田独铁矿共开采约 269 万吨、掠运约 268 万吨；数字待页码级核对。 In July 1939 Japanese military geologists discovered high-grade iron ore at Tiandu in Ya county, and the Ishihara interests began mining it. First ore was shipped on 11 June 1940; a roughly 10-km light railway was built from Tiandu to the river mouth, and a 10,000-ton ore terminal was built at Yulin port. Mining stopped in the second half of 1944 under Allied naval blockade. According to Japanese sources, about 2.69 million tons were mined and about 2.68 million tons shipped away; these figures await page-level verification.

fields.description: 7月11日至16日，日伪军进犯东山，守军第75师史克勤旅和县长楼胜利率领地方武装进行反击，日军败退。日期据《漳州抗日战争大事记》，待页码级核对。 From 11 to 16 July Japanese and puppet forces attacked Dongshan. The defending 75th Division's Shi Keqin brigade and county magistrate Lou Shengli led local forces in a counter-attack and drove the Japanese back. The date follows the Zhangzhou war chronology and awaits page-level verification.

fields.description: 1939 年 7 月 18 日，日军侵犯昌江，占领新街、墩头、八所，并在北黎设立司令部。昌江、感恩沿海与八所港被日军控制，为后来开采石碌铁矿、修建石八铁路准备了条件。日期据海南史志网，待页码级核对。 On 18 July 1939 Japanese forces invaded Changjiang, occupied Xinjie, Duntou and Basuo, and established headquarters at Beili. Control of the Changjiang–Gan’en coast and Basuo port prepared the way for mining the Shilu iron ore and building the Shilu–Basuo railway. The date follows Hainan local history and awaits page-level verification.

fields.summary: 日军占领万宁县城。 Japanese forces occupied Wanning county town.
fields.description: 1939 年 8 月 13 日，日军占领万宁县城。万宁位于海南东南沿海，失守后日军控制万泉河下游与东部海岸，与嘉积、陵水据点相连。日期据海南史志网，待页码级核对。 On 13 August 1939 Japanese forces occupied Wanning county town. Wanning lies on the southeast coast; after its fall Japan controlled the lower Wanquan River and the east coast, linking the Jiaji and Lingshui garrisons. The date follows Hainan local history and awaits page-level verification.

fields.summary: 日军第 18 师团在宝安登陆，占领南头、深圳，切断粤港交通。 The Japanese 18th Division landed in Bao’an and occupied Nantou and Shenzhen, cutting the Guangzhou–Hong Kong land link.
fields.description: 1939 年 8 月 13 日，日军第 18 师团自虎门出发，在宝安蛇口、西乡等地登陆。8 月 15 日占领南头城，随后控制深圳镇，切断广州与香港之间的陆路交通。日期据《深圳通史》与日本防卫省战史档案，待页码级核对。 On 13 August 1939 the Japanese 18th Division moved from Humen and landed at Shekou and Xixiang in Bao’an. It occupied Nantou on 15 August and then controlled Shenzhen town, cutting the overland link between Guangzhou and Hong Kong. The date follows the Shenzhen History and Japanese defense archives and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 乐山“八一九”大轰炸 Leshan Bombing of 19 August 1939
fields.summary: 1939年8月19日，日机36架轰炸乐山，炸死838人。 On 19 August 1939 thirty-six Japanese aircraft bombed Leshan, killing 838.
fields.description: 1939年8月19日，日机36架轰炸乐山城区，投弹100余枚，炸毁半个城区，炸死838人、炸伤380余人。乐山为川南文化名城，当时被日军误判为国民政府准备西迁的都城。日期据《乐山日报》与《抗战大后方侵华日军无差别轰炸重大惨案的时空分布考察》。 On 19 August 1939 thirty-six Japanese aircraft bombed Leshan, dropping over 100 bombs, destroying half the old city and killing 838 people, with more than 380 wounded. The Japanese apparently believed Leshan was a candidate capital for a westward Chinese government move.

summary.en: On 23 August 1939 Japanese and puppet forces again attacked Dongshan, occupying 15 villages including Chencheng, and withdrew on 4 September.

fields.name: 日伪军再犯东山 Second Japanese–Puppet Attack on Dongshan
fields.summary: 1939年8月23日，日伪军再犯东山，占领陈城等15个村落，9月4日退出。 On 23 August 1939 Japanese and puppet forces again attacked Dongshan, occupying 15 villages including Chencheng, and withdrew on 4 September.
fields.description: 8月23日，日本指挥官涩谷部和伪军郑天福部，在8架飞机掩护下进犯东山，占领陈城、港口、亲营、古雷庄、岐下等15个村落。8月26日、27日，守军第75师449团和保安第9团奋起抵抗，449团张润生副团长夜战中阵亡。在军民顽强抗击下，日伪军于9月4日退出东山。此为反复争夺，不绘单一路线。 On 23 August the Japanese commander Shibuya and the puppet Zheng Tianfu force, covered by eight aircraft, attacked Dongshan and occupied 15 villages including Chencheng, Gangkou, Qinying, Guleizhuang and Qixia. On 26–27 August the 449th Regiment of the 75th Division and the 9th Security Regiment counter-attacked; Lieutenant Colonel Zhang Runsheng of the 449th was killed in night fighting. Under sustained resistance the Japanese and puppet forces withdrew on 4 September. As repeated fighting, it is not drawn as a single route.

fields.name: 伪蒙疆联合自治政府成立 Establishment of the Mengjiang United Autonomous Government
fields.place: 察哈尔张家口 Zhangjiakou, Chahar
fields.summary: 日本扶植的伪蒙疆联合自治政府在张家口成立。 Japan established the puppet Mengjiang United Autonomous Government in Zhangjiakou.
fields.description: 1939 年 9 月 1 日，日本将察南、晋北、蒙古联盟三个伪政权合并，在张家口成立伪蒙疆联合自治政府，以德穆楚克栋鲁普（德王）为主席。伪政权受日本驻蒙军控制，是日本统治察哈尔、绥远沦陷区的重要工具。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 1 September 1939 Japan merged the three puppet regimes of South Chahar, North Shanxi and the Mongol Federation into the Mengjiang United Autonomous Government in Zhangjiakou, with Demchugdongrub (Prince De) as chairman. Controlled by the Japanese garrison army in Mongolia, it was an instrument of Japanese rule over occupied Chahar and Suiyuan. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 泸县“九一一”大轰炸 Luxian Bombing of 11 September 1939
fields.summary: 1939年9月11日，日机36架轰炸泸县县城。 On 11 September 1939 thirty-six Japanese aircraft bombed Luxian county town.
fields.description: 1939年9月11日，日机36架轰炸泸县县城，投弹10枚，死亡1160余人、伤1145人（另载死亡385人、伤445人）。泸县为长江与沱江交汇处的航运要地，是日军轰炸川南的重点。日期据《抗战大后方侵华日军无差别轰炸重大惨案的时空分布考察》。 On 11 September 1939 thirty-six Japanese aircraft bombed Luxian, dropping ten bombs and killing over 1,160, with 1,145 wounded (another account gives 385 dead and 445 wounded). Luxian, at the junction of the Yangtze and Tuo rivers, was a key shipping point and a focus of Japanese raids on southern Sichuan.

summary.en: Japanese forces attacked Changsha; Chinese troops blocked and counterattacked along the Xinqiang and Miluo rivers, restoring their original positions.

fields.name: 第一次长沙会战 First Battle of Changsha 长沙会战 First Changsha Campaign 第一次长沙战役 First Changsha Campaign
fields.place: 湖南新墙河一线 Xinqiang River line, Hunan
fields.summary: 日军进攻长沙，中国军队在新墙河、汨罗江一线阻击并反击，恢复原阵地。 Japanese forces attacked Changsha; Chinese troops blocked and counterattacked along the Xinqiang and Miluo rivers, restoring their original positions.
fields.description: 1939 年 9 月 14 日，日军集中兵力向湖南新墙河一线发起进攻，企图攻取长沙。中国军队第九战区部队逐次阻击，诱敌深入后侧击、反击，迫使日军于 10 月上旬退回原阵地。此役是抗战进入相持阶段后中国正面战场的一次重要防御作战。 本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。 On 14 September 1939, Japanese forces launched an offensive across the Xinqiang River in Hunan in an attempt to take Changsha. Chinese troops of the Ninth War Zone resisted in stages, drew the Japanese forward, then struck their flanks and counterattacked, forcing a withdrawal to the original line in early October. It was an important defensive battle on China’s frontal battlefield during the stalemate phase. Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

name.en: Fall of the Xinqiang River Line

summary.zh: 1939年9月23日，日军第6、第13师团强渡新墙河，中国守军转移。
summary.en: On 23 September 1939 the Japanese 6th and 13th Divisions forced the Xinqiang River and the Chinese defenders withdrew.

fields.name: 新墙河防线失守 Fall of the Xinqiang River Line
fields.place: 湖南岳阳新墙河 Xinqiang River, Yueyang, Hunan
fields.summary: 1939年9月23日，日军第6、第13师团强渡新墙河，中国守军转移。 On 23 September 1939 the Japanese 6th and 13th Divisions forced the Xinqiang River and the Chinese defenders withdrew.
fields.description: 1939年9月18日日军第6、第13师团进攻新墙河北岸，中国第52军第2、第195师胡春华营、史思华营死守，至20日北岸阵地全部陷落。23日凌晨，日军在飞机、重炮和毒气掩护下强渡新墙河，中国守军抗击至中午后转移。日期据《湖南抗日战争日志（1939年9月）》与《记湘北会战》。 On 18 September 1939 the Japanese 6th and 13th Divisions attacked the north bank of the Xinqiang River; the Chinese 2nd and 195th Divisions’ Hu Chunhua and Shi Sihua battalions held to the last, and the north-bank positions fell by the 20th. In the early hours of the 23rd the Japanese crossed under air, artillery and gas cover, and the Chinese withdrew after fighting until noon.

summary.zh: 1939年9月23日，日军第3师团上村支队在营田登陆，抄袭新墙河守军侧背。
summary.en: On 23 September 1939 the Uemura detachment of the Japanese 3rd Division landed at Yingtian, turning the Xinqiang River line.

fields.name: 营田登陆 Landing at Yingtian
fields.place: 湖南湘阴营田 Yingtian, Xiangyin, Hunan
fields.summary: 1939年9月23日，日军第3师团上村支队在营田登陆，抄袭新墙河守军侧背。 On 23 September 1939 the Uemura detachment of the Japanese 3rd Division landed at Yingtian, turning the Xinqiang River line.
fields.description: 1939年9月23日拂晓，日军第3师团上村支队在海军支援下于洞庭湖东岸营田登陆，抄袭新墙河守军侧背，营田当日失守。日军占领营田后13天内残杀百姓800余人、强奸妇女百人以上。日期据《湖南抗日战争日志（1939年9月）》与《记湘北会战》。 At dawn on 23 September 1939 the Uemura detachment of the Japanese 3rd Division landed at Yingtian on the east shore of Dongting Lake with naval support, turning the Xinqiang River line; Yingtian fell the same day. In the following thirteen days the Japanese killed more than 800 civilians and raped over a hundred women.

name.en: Fall of the Miluo River Line

summary.zh: 1939年9月26日，日军第6师团渡过汨罗江，进抵新市。
summary.en: On 26 September 1939 the Japanese 6th Division crossed the Miluo River and reached Xinshi.

fields.name: 汨罗江防线失守 Fall of the Miluo River Line
fields.place: 湖南湘阴汨罗 Miluo, Xiangyin, Hunan
fields.summary: 1939年9月26日，日军第6师团渡过汨罗江，进抵新市。 On 26 September 1939 the Japanese 6th Division crossed the Miluo River and reached Xinshi.
fields.description: 1939年9月25日凌晨日军迫近汨罗江北岸，26日日军第6师团渡过汨罗江进抵新市，在营田登陆的第3师团上村支队突破中国第95师阵地向粤汉路前进。中国第9战区按“后退决战”方针向长沙以东转移。日期据《湖南抗日战争日志（1939年9月）》与《记湘北会战》。 The Japanese reached the north bank of the Miluo in the early hours of 25 September 1939; on the 26th the 6th Division crossed and reached Xinshi, while the Uemura detachment from Yingtian broke the Chinese 95th Division and drove on the Canton–Hankou railway. The Chinese Ninth War Zone fell back east of Changsha under its “retreat and decisive battle” plan.

summary.en: On 29 September 1939 the Japanese 33rd Division captured Pingjiang and reached Changshoujie and Longmenchang.

fields.name: 平江沦陷 Fall of Pingjiang
fields.summary: 1939年9月29日，日军第33师团攻占平江，进抵长寿街、龙门厂。 On 29 September 1939 the Japanese 33rd Division captured Pingjiang and reached Changshoujie and Longmenchang.
fields.description: 1939年9月22日日军第33师团自鄂南通城南犯，23日进占麦市、桃树港，29日攻占平江，进抵朱溪厂、龙门厂、长寿街。中国第20、第79军在献钟、南楼岭、桃树港一带夹击，日军未能与湘北主力会合。日期据《湖南抗日战争日志（1939年9月）》与《记湘北会战》。 On 22 September 1939 the Japanese 33rd Division advanced south from Tongcheng in southern Hubei, took Maishi and Taoshugang on the 23rd, and captured Pingjiang on the 29th, reaching Zhuxichang, Longmenchang and Changshoujie. The Chinese 20th and 79th Corps counterattacked around Xianzhong and Nanluling, preventing a junction with the main force.

summary.en: On 30 September 1939 a Japanese column reached Yong’an, 30 km north of Changsha, the deepest penetration of the first Changsha campaign.

fields.name: 日军进抵永安 Japanese Reach Yong’an
fields.place: 湖南长沙永安 Yong’an, Changsha, Hunan
fields.summary: 1939年9月30日，日军一部进抵长沙以北30公里的永安，为第一次长沙会战日军南侵最远点。 On 30 September 1939 a Japanese column reached Yong’an, 30 km north of Changsha, the deepest penetration of the first Changsha campaign.
fields.description: 1939年9月28日日军第6师团在福临铺、金井遭中国第195师等部伏击，损失颇重；29日其主力进至桥头驿，一部进抵永安（距长沙30公里）。这是第一次长沙会战日军南侵最远点。10月1日日军开始撤退，至10月8日退回新墙河北岸。日期据《湖南抗日战争日志（1939年9月）》与《记湘北会战》。 On 28 September 1939 the Japanese 6th Division was ambushed by the Chinese 195th Division at Fulingpu and Jinjing and suffered heavily; on the 29th its main force reached Qiaotouyi and a detachment reached Yong’an, 30 km from Changsha, the deepest point of the Japanese advance. The Japanese began withdrawing on 1 October and were back north of the Xinqiang by the 8th.

summary.en: On 2 October 1939 Japanese forces occupied Gaoyou.

fields.name: 高邮沦陷 Fall of Gaoyou
fields.summary: 1939年10月2日，日军侵占高邮城。 On 2 October 1939 Japanese forces occupied Gaoyou.
fields.description: 1939年10月2日黎明，8架日机轮番轰炸车逻镇、高邮城，掩护日军独立混成旅两个大队乘汽艇由高邮湖石工头登陆，上午7时许翻越城墙进入高邮城。日军占领后连续屠杀，杀害无辜百姓1200余人。日期据《高邮日报》与高邮市文史资料。 At dawn on 2 October 1939 eight Japanese aircraft bombed Cheluo and Gaoyou, covering two battalions of an independent mixed brigade that landed by motorboat at Shigongtou on Gaoyou Lake and entered the city over the wall around 7 a.m. After the occupation Japanese troops killed more than 1,200 civilians. The date follows the Gaoyou newspaper and local文史 materials.

summary.en: Jin-Cha-Ji troops killed Major General Abe Norihide, commander of the Japanese 2nd Independent Mixed Brigade, at Huangtuling.

fields.name: 黄土岭战斗 Battle of Huangtuling 黄土岭伏击战 Huangtuling Ambush
fields.place: 河北涞源黄土岭 Huangtuling, Laiyuan, Hebei
fields.summary: 晋察冀军区部队在黄土岭击毙日军独立混成第2旅团长阿部规秀中将。 Jin-Cha-Ji troops killed Major General Abe Norihide, commander of the Japanese 2nd Independent Mixed Brigade, at Huangtuling.
fields.description: 1939 年 11 月，日军独立混成第2旅团对晋察冀根据地进行“扫荡”。11 月 7 日，晋察冀军区第一军分区等部在河北涞源黄土岭设伏，击毙旅团长阿部规秀中将，歼敌数百人。阿部规秀是抗战期间被八路军击毙的日军最高级别将领之一。 日期、兵力与战果为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In November 1939 the Japanese 2nd Independent Mixed Brigade conducted a “mopping-up” operation against the Jin-Cha-Ji base area. On 7 November troops of the Jin-Cha-Ji Military Region’s 1st Sub-district ambushed the column at Huangtuling, Laiyuan, Hebei, killing brigade commander Major General Abe Norihide and several hundred soldiers. Abe was one of the most senior Japanese officers killed by the Eighth Route Army during the war. Dates, force sizes, and results follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.name: 钦州湾登陆 Landing at Qinzhou Bay
fields.place: 广西钦州湾 Qinzhou Bay, Guangxi
fields.summary: 1939年11月15日，日军第5师团、台湾混成旅团在钦州湾登陆，桂南会战开始。 On 15 November 1939 the Japanese 5th Division and Taiwan Mixed Brigade landed at Qinzhou Bay, opening the southern Guangxi campaign.
fields.description: 1939年11月15日，日军第21军司令官安藤利吉指挥第5师团、台湾混成旅团及海军陆战队3万余人，在钦州湾龙门港、企沙强行登陆。中国新编第19师抵抗一天后溃退，日军登陆后即分路北上，直指南宁。日期据《“桂南会战”的回顾与反思》与《桂南会战之昆仑关战役》。 On 15 November 1939 Lt. Gen. Ando Rikichi’s 21st Army, with the 5th Division, the Taiwan Mixed Brigade and naval landing troops—over 30,000 men—forced a landing at Longmen and Qisha in Qinzhou Bay. The Chinese New 19th Division held for a day and then collapsed; the Japanese advanced north toward Nanning.

fields.description: 1939年11月17日日军占领钦县（今钦州），随即分兵北上，18日进攻小董。钦县为钦州湾登陆后的交通枢纽，失守后日军沿邕钦公路直指南宁。日期据《“桂南会战”的回顾与反思》与《桂南会战之昆仑关战役》。 On 17 November 1939 the Japanese took Qin County (modern Qinzhou), then divided their force and advanced north, attacking Xiaodong on the 18th. Qin County was the transport hub after the landing, and its loss opened the road along the Yong–Qin highway to Nanning.

fields.name: 小董失守 Fall of Xiaodong
fields.place: 广西钦县小董 Xiaodong, Qin County, Guangxi
fields.summary: 1939年11月18日，日军进攻小董，中国新编第19师溃退。 On 18 November 1939 the Japanese attacked Xiaodong and the Chinese New 19th Division collapsed.
fields.description: 1939年11月18日日军进攻中国新编第19师师部所在地小董，师长黄固临阵退缩，只身逃跑，部队溃散。日军继续北上，22日傍晚抵达南宁邕江南岸。日期据《“桂南会战”的回顾与反思》与《桂南会战之昆仑关战役》。 On 18 November 1939 the Japanese attacked Xiaodong, headquarters of the Chinese New 19th Division. Its commander Huang Gu fled alone and the division collapsed. The Japanese continued north and reached the south bank of the Yong River at Nanning on the evening of the 22nd.

fields.summary: 日军在钦州湾登陆后攻占南宁，桂南会战展开。 After landing at Qinzhou Bay, Japanese forces captured Nanning, opening the Battle of South Guangxi.
fields.description: 1939 年 11 月 15 日，日军第 5 师团等在钦州湾登陆，沿邕钦公路北犯。11 月 24 日，日军占领南宁，随后进攻昆仑关。中国军队调集兵力反攻，桂南会战展开。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 15 November 1939 the Japanese 5th Division and other units landed at Qinzhou Bay and advanced north along the Nanning–Qinzhou road. On 24 November they occupied Nanning and then attacked Kunlun Pass. Chinese forces concentrated for a counteroffensive, opening the Battle of South Guangxi. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

fields.summary: 1939年12月1日，日军攻占高峰隘。 On 1 December 1939 the Japanese captured Gaofeng Pass.
fields.description: 1939年11月26日起日军在飞机掩护下猛攻高峰隘，中国守军顽强抵抗，12月1日高峰隘失守。高峰隘为南宁至武鸣要冲，失守后南宁北面门户洞开。日期据《“桂南会战”的回顾与反思》与《桂南会战之昆仑关战役》。 From 26 November 1939 the Japanese attacked Gaofeng Pass under air cover. The Chinese resisted stubbornly, but the pass fell on 1 December. Gaofeng was the key point on the Nanning–Wuming road; its loss opened Nanning’s northern approaches.

fields.description: 1939年12月4日日军占领昆仑关。昆仑关为南宁至宾阳要冲，日军据守后切断桂越交通线；12月18日中国第5军反攻，31日收复昆仑关，击毙日军第21旅团长中村正雄。日期据《“桂南会战”的回顾与反思》与《桂南会战之昆仑关战役》。 On 4 December 1939 the Japanese occupied Kunlun Pass, the key point on the Nanning–Binyang road, cutting the Guangxi–Vietnam supply line. On 18 December the Chinese 5th Corps counterattacked and retook the pass on the 31st, killing Maj. Gen. Nakamura Masao, commander of the Japanese 21st Brigade.

fields.description: 1939 年 12 月，日军自芜湖出动，沿长江南岸进攻铜陵、青阳一带，中国军队在铜陵附近阻击。芜湖自 1937 年 12 月即为日军占领，为其沿江据点。 In December 1939 the Japanese moved out of Wuhu along the south bank of the Yangtze against Tongling and Qingyang, where the Chinese army resisted. fields.description: 1939 年 12 月 15 日，日军第 18 师团万余人由增城沿增龙公路北上，17 日突破中国第 63 军第 151 师铁扇关门防线，进占小楼、正果。这是第一次粤北会战右路的起点。日期据《广东省志·军事志》，待页码级核对。 On 15 December 1939 more than 10,000 troops of the Japanese 18th Division advanced north from Zengcheng along the Zengcheng–Longmen road. On 17 December they broke the Tieshan Pass line of the Chinese 63rd Army’s 151st Division and occupied Xiaolou and Zhengguo, opening the right-wing advance of the first northern Guangdong campaign. The date follows the Guangdong Military Gazetteer and awaits page-level verification.

summary.en: Chinese forces counterattacked at Kunlun Pass and recaptured the strategic pass after fierce fighting.

fields.name: 昆仑关战役 Battle of Kunlun Pass 昆仑关大捷 Kunlun Pass Victory
fields.place: 广西南宁昆仑关 Kunlun Pass, Nanning, Guangxi
fields.summary: 中国军队反攻昆仑关，经过激战收复关隘，取得昆仑关大捷。 Chinese forces counterattacked at Kunlun Pass and recaptured the strategic pass after fierce fighting.
fields.description: 1939 年 12 月，中国军队为收复南宁、夺回昆仑关，对日军发起反攻。中国第 5 军等部在昆仑关与日军激战，反复争夺，最终于 1940 年 1 月收复昆仑关，击毙日军旅团长中村正雄。此役是抗战中期中国军队的一次重要攻坚胜利。 本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。 In December 1939, Chinese forces launched a counteroffensive to recover Nanning and retake Kunlun Pass. The Chinese 5th Army and other units fought fierce, seesaw battles against the Japanese at the pass, finally recapturing it in January 1940 and killing the Japanese brigade commander Nakamura Masao. It was an important Chinese offensive victory in the middle years of the war. Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

The date follows the Guangdong Military Gazetteer and awaits page-level verification.

fields.description: 1939 年 12 月 20 日，日军近卫混成旅团由从化方向北犯，占领从化县城；21 日进占鸡笼冈，随后分路进攻良口、牛背脊。日期据《广东省志·军事志》，待页码级核对。 On 20 December 1939 the Japanese Guard Mixed Brigade advanced north from the Conghua direction and occupied Conghua county town; on 21 December it took Jilonggang and then advanced on Liangkou and Niubeiji. The date follows the Guangdong Military Gazetteer and awaits page-level verification.

fields.description: 1939年12月21日日军一部西进攻陷龙州，截断桂越国际交通线。另有记11月24日与南宁同日占龙州，正文并列。日期据《“桂南会战”的回顾与反思》与《桂南会战》。 On 21 December 1939 a Japanese column drove west and took Longzhou, cutting the Guangxi–Vietnam international route. fields.name: 良口失守 Fall of Liangkou
fields.place: 广东从化良口 Liangkou, Conghua, Guangdong
fields.summary: 日军近卫混成旅团占领良口。 The Japanese Guard Mixed Brigade occupied Liangkou.
fields.description: 1939 年 12 月 22 日，日军近卫混成旅团约 3000 人突破中国第 186 师蜈蚣山、热水、鸭洞阵地，占领良口；25 日又占吕田。良口、牛背脊是翁从公路要冲，此后成为中国军队反击的重点。日期据《广东省志·军事志》，待页码级核对。 On 22 December 1939 about 3,000 troops of the Japanese Guard Mixed Brigade broke the Chinese 186th Division’s positions at Wugongshan, Reshui and Yadong and occupied Liangkou; on 25 December they took Lü tian. Liangkou and Niubeiji were key points on the Wengyuan–Conghua road and later became the focus of the Chinese counterattack. The date follows the Guangdong Military Gazetteer and awaits page-level verification.

fields.place: 广东新丰梅坑、从化吕田 Meikeng, Xinfeng and Lü tian, Conghua, Guangdong
fields.summary: 日军第 18 师团占梅坑，近卫混成旅团占吕田。 The Japanese 18th Division took Meikeng and the Guard Mixed Brigade took Lü tian.
fields.description: 1939 年 12 月 25 日，日军第 18 师团突破中国军队防线，进占画眉堂、梅坑；同日近卫混成旅团集中七八千人突破第 151 师阵地，进占吕田。日期据《广东省志·军事志》，待页码级核对。 On 25 December 1939 the Japanese 18th Division broke the Chinese line and occupied Huameitang and Meikeng; the same day the Guard Mixed Brigade concentrated 7,000–8,000 troops, broke the 151st Division’s positions and occupied Lü tian. fields.summary: 日军第 18 师团占领新丰。 The Japanese 18th Division occupied Xinfeng.
fields.description: 1939 年 12 月 28 日，日军第 18 师团占领新丰，粤北战局危急。中国第 12 集团军急调第 54 军由湘入粤增援。日期据《广东省志·军事志》，待页码级核对。 On 28 December 1939 the Japanese 18th Division occupied Xinfeng, placing northern Guangdong in crisis. fields.summary: 日军近卫混成旅团占领翁源。 The Japanese Guard Mixed Brigade occupied Wengyuan.
fields.description: 1939 年 12 月 29 日，日军近卫混成旅团占官渡；30 日占领翁源，31 日占新江。日军三路对粤北形成大包围，但中国军队随即反击。日期据《广东省志·军事志》，待页码级核对。 On 29 December 1939 the Japanese Guard Mixed Brigade took Guandu; on 30 December it occupied Wengyuan and on 31 December Xinjiang. The three Japanese columns had enveloped northern Guangdong, but the Chinese army counterattacked immediately. The date follows the Guangdong Military Gazetteer and awaits page-level verification.

fields.description: 1939 年 12 月 30 日，日军第 104 师团沿粤汉铁路北犯，攻占英德。左路日军逼近曲江，第一次粤北会战进入最紧张阶段。日期据《广东省志·军事志》，待页码级核对。 On 30 December 1939 the Japanese 104th Division advanced north along the Canton–Hankou railway and captured Yingde. The left column was closing on Qujiang, the tensest phase of the first northern Guangdong campaign. The date follows the Guangdong Military Gazetteer and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 新江失守 Fall of Xinjiang
fields.place: 广东翁源新江 Xinjiang, Wengyuan, Guangdong
fields.summary: 日军近卫混成旅团占领新江，逼进曲江。 The Japanese Guard Mixed Brigade occupied Xinjiang, closing on Qujiang.
fields.description: 1939 年 12 月 31 日，日军近卫混成旅团占领新江，兵锋直指曲江。1940 年 1 月 1 日，日军因桂南战场吃紧开始全线退却；中国军队追击，至 1 月 16 日收复清远、花县、从化、龙门等地。日期据《广东省志·军事志》，待页码级核对。 On 31 December 1939 the Japanese Guard Mixed Brigade occupied Xinjiang and pointed directly at Qujiang. On 1 January 1940, with the Guangxi front under pressure, the Japanese began a general withdrawal; Chinese forces pursued and by 16 January had recovered Qingyuan, Hua county, Conghua and Longmen. The date follows the Guangdong Military Gazetteer and awaits page-level verification.

summary.en: In the first northern Guangdong battle the Japanese reached the outskirts of Shaoguan and withdrew.

fields.name: 日军攻韶关未克撤回 Japanese drive on Shaoguan fails
fields.summary: 第一次粤北会战，日军攻至韶关外围后撤回广州。 In the first northern Guangdong battle the Japanese reached the outskirts of Shaoguan and withdrew.
fields.description: 1939 年 12 月日军第 18 师团等自广州北犯，第一次粤北会战爆发；中国军队逐次抵抗并反攻，日军攻至韶关外围后于 1940 年 1 月中旬撤回广州。韶关为战时广东省会，始终未陷。 In December 1939 the Japanese 18th Division and others moved north from Guangzhou, opening the first northern Guangdong battle; the Chinese army resisted and counter-attacked, and the Japanese, having reached the outskirts of Shaoguan, withdrew to Guangzhou in mid-January 1940. Shaoguan, the wartime provincial capital, never fell.

fields.name: 萧山沦陷 Fall of Xiaoshan
fields.summary: 1940年1月22日，日军趁大雪偷渡钱塘江，攻占萧山县城。 On 22 January 1940 Japanese forces crossed the Qiantang River in heavy snow and captured Xiaoshan.
fields.description: 1月22日，日军趁大雪天偷渡钱塘江，攻占萧山县城。萧山是钱塘江南岸门户，日军由此打破与浙江守军隔江对峙的局面。日期据《杭州大事记（1940－1945）》与《杭州抗战大事记》，待页码级核对。 On 22 January Japanese forces crossed the Qiantang River during heavy snow and captured Xiaoshan. As the gateway on the south bank, Xiaoshan ended the standoff in which Chinese and Japanese forces faced each other across the river. The date follows the Hangzhou chronicles and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 第5军移驻云南 5th Army Moves to Yunnan
fields.summary: 昆仑关战役后，第5军由广西移驻云南整训，后成为远征军主力。 After Kunlun Pass the 5th Army moved from Guangxi to Yunnan for training and later became the core of the Expeditionary Force.
fields.description: 1940 年初昆仑关战役结束后，第5军经南宁、百色移驻云南昆明、杨林一带整训。1942 年 2 月，第5军作为中国远征军先头部队自云南入缅。 路线为示意简化，日期取通行说法，待史料校订。 After the Battle of Kunlun Pass in early 1940, the 5th Army moved via Nanning and Bose to Kunming and Yanglin in Yunnan for training. In February 1942 it entered Burma as the spearhead of the Chinese Expeditionary Force. Illustrative simplified route; dates follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

summary.zh: 1940年2月3日，日军攻占宾阳。
summary.en: On 3 February 1940 the Japanese captured Binyang.

fields.name: 宾阳沦陷（1940） Fall of Binyang (1940)
fields.summary: 1940年2月3日，日军攻占宾阳。 On 3 February 1940 the Japanese captured Binyang.
fields.description: 1940年1月28日日军第18师团、近卫混成旅团反扑，2月3日攻占宾阳，随后再夺昆仑关。2月9日日军开始南撤，中国军队追击，先后收复宾阳、武鸣、昆仑关。日期据《桂南会战》与《“桂南会战”的回顾与反思》。 On 28 January 1940 the Japanese 18th Division and Konoe Mixed Brigade counterattacked, taking Binyang on 3 February and retaking Kunlun Pass soon after. The Japanese began withdrawing on 9 February, and the Chinese pursued, recovering Binyang, Wuming and Kunlun Pass.

fields.name: 上林沦陷（1940） Fall of Shanglin (1940)
fields.summary: 1940年2月8日，日军进占上林。 On 8 February 1940 the Japanese occupied Shanglin.
fields.description: 1940年2月8日日军进占上林。日军第18师团、近卫混成旅团由良庆、七塘经甘棠、那河迂回宾阳，并分兵进占上林、武鸣。日期据《桂南会战》与《“桂南会战”的回顾与反思》。 On 8 February 1940 the Japanese occupied Shanglin. The 18th Division and Konoe Mixed Brigade had swung via Liangqing, Qitang, Gantang and Nahe to outflank Binyang, detaching forces to take Shanglin and Wuming.

fields.name: 荣成沦陷 Fall of Rongcheng
fields.summary: 1940年2月22日，日军占领荣成，山东107县全部沦陷。 On 22 February 1940 Japanese forces occupied Rongcheng, completing the occupation of all 107 counties in Shandong.
fields.description: 1940年2月22日，日军占领荣成县。至此，山东全省107个县全部沦陷。荣成是山东最后一个沦陷的县城，此后山东抗战进入全境敌后阶段。日期据《抗战期间沦陷的县城》与《山东抗日战争大事记（1939-1945）》，待页码级核对。 On 22 February 1940 Japanese forces occupied Rongcheng, the last county town in Shandong to fall; all 107 counties were now occupied. The war in Shandong then entered an entirely behind-the-lines phase. The date follows the occupied-county list and the 1939–1945 Shandong war chronology and awaits page-level verification.

fields.description: 1940 年 3 月 6 日，日军一部从海路登陆中山唐家、香洲，随后攻陷前山、坦洲、翠亨，配合从顺德南下的主力包围石岐。日期据中山地方史，待页码级核对。 On 6 March 1940 a Japanese force landed by sea at Tangjia and Xiangzhou in Zhongshan and then took Qianshan, Tanzhou and Cuiheng, cooperating with the main force advancing south from Shunde to envelop Shiqi. summary.zh: 日军藤井兵团入侵中山，占领石岐。
summary.en: The Japanese Fujii Brigade invaded Zhongshan and occupied Shiqi.

fields.name: 中山（石岐）沦陷 Fall of Zhongshan (Shiqi)
fields.place: 广东中山石岐 Shiqi, Zhongshan, Guangdong
fields.summary: 日军藤井兵团入侵中山，占领石岐。 The Japanese Fujii Brigade invaded Zhongshan and occupied Shiqi.
fields.description: 1940 年 3 月 5 日，日军藤井兵团约 1 万人入侵中山，一路从顺德攻入大小黄圃，一路从海路登陆唐家、香洲；3 月 7 日占领石岐，3 月 15 日占小榄，中山县境大部分沦陷。日期据中山地方史，待页码级核对。 On 5 March 1940 the Japanese Fujii Brigade, about 10,000 strong, invaded Zhongshan: one column entered Dahuangpu and Xiaohuangpu from Shunde, another landed by sea at Tangjia and Xiangzhou. Shiqi fell on 7 March and Xiaolan on 15 March, and most of Zhongshan was occupied. The date follows Zhongshan local history and awaits page-level verification.

name.en: Japanese seizure of the Shilu iron mine

summary.zh: 日军占领石碌铁矿，随后修铁路、建八所港，掠夺海南铁矿资源。
summary.en: Japan seized the Shilu iron mine, then built a railway and the Basuo port to extract Hainan’s iron ore.

fields.name: 日军占领石碌铁矿 Japanese seizure of the Shilu iron mine
fields.place: 海南昌江石碌 Shilu, Changjiang, Hainan
fields.summary: 日军占领石碌铁矿，随后修铁路、建八所港，掠夺海南铁矿资源。 Japan seized the Shilu iron mine, then built a railway and the Basuo port to extract Hainan’s iron ore.
fields.description: 1940 年 3 月 15 日，日军占领昌江石碌（今属昌江黎族自治县），此后开发石碌铁矿、修建石碌—八所港铁路和八所港，强征大批劳工，将铁矿石运往日本。田独、石碌、羊角岭水晶和那大锡矿是日军在海南重点掠夺的资源。据综述，1939—1945 年海南开采铁矿砂 338 万吨，其中 282 万吨运往日本；数字为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 15 March 1940 Japanese forces occupied Shilu in Changjiang (now Changjiang Li Autonomous County). They subsequently developed the Shilu iron mine, built the Shilu–Basuo railway and Basuo port, conscripted large numbers of labourers and shipped iron ore to Japan. Tian du, Shilu, the Yangjiaoling crystal mine and the Nada tin mine were among the resources Japan exploited most intensively in Hainan. According to survey accounts, 3.38 million tons of iron ore were mined in Hainan in 1939–1945, of which 2.82 million tons were shipped to Japan; these figures follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.name: 保亭沦陷 Fall of Baoting
fields.summary: 日军自陵水方向进攻，占领保亭县城。 Japanese forces advanced from Lingshui and occupied Baoting county town.
fields.description: 1940 年 3 月 15 日，驻陵水日军出占保亭县城。保亭地处五指山南麓，是日军向中部山区渗透的节点。另有 1940 年 7 月 16 日占领说，日期待页码级核对。 On 15 March 1940 Japanese forces from Lingshui occupied Baoting county town. Baoting lies on the southern slope of the Wuzhishan range and was a Japanese node for penetration into the central mountains. Another account gives 16 July 1940; the date awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 乐东沦陷 Fall of Ledong
fields.place: 海南乐东抱由 Baoyou, Ledong, Hainan
fields.summary: 日军自崖县方向进攻，占领乐东县城。 Japanese forces advanced from Ya county and occupied Ledong county town.
fields.description: 1940 年 3 月 15 日，驻崖县日军出占乐东县城（抱由）。乐东地处五指山西南，失守后日军与崖县、感恩据点相连，但山区仍为琼崖抗日武装活动区。日期据海南史志网，待页码级核对。 On 15 March 1940 Japanese forces from Ya county occupied Ledong county town (Baoyou). Ledong lies southwest of the Wuzhishan range; after its fall Japanese garrisons linked up with Ya county and Gan’en, but the mountains remained an area of Qiongya anti-Japanese activity. The date follows Hainan local history and awaits page-level verification.

name.en: Japanese Occupation of Hainan’s Coastal County Towns and Garrisons

summary.zh: 至 1940 年 3 月，日军占领海南除白沙县城和五指山周围山区外的环岛县城、港口与交通线。
summary.en: By March 1940 Japan had occupied Hainan’s coastal county towns, ports and roads, except Baisha county town and the Wuzhishan mountains.

fields.name: 日军占领海南环岛县城与据点 Japanese Occupation of Hainan’s Coastal County Towns and Garrisons
fields.summary: 至 1940 年 3 月，日军占领海南除白沙县城和五指山周围山区外的环岛县城、港口与交通线。 By March 1940 Japan had occupied Hainan’s coastal county towns, ports and roads, except Baisha county town and the Wuzhishan mountains.
fields.description: 至 1940 年 3 月，日军已占领海南岛 14 个县的县城和大部分市镇：琼山、文昌、定安、澄迈、琼东、乐东、万宁、陵水、临高、儋县、崖县、昌江、感恩、保亭；在环岛沿海和内陆山区设 360 多个军事据点，在县城、乡镇设 195 个维持会/分会。白沙县城和五指山及其周围山区未被长期占领，是琼崖抗日根据地。日军仍不断对根据地“蚕食”“扫荡”。数字据海南史志网综述，待页码级核对。本事件为占领范围总览，不绘单线。 By March 1940 Japan had occupied the county towns and most market towns of Hainan’s 14 counties: Qiongshan, Wenchang, Ding’an, Chengmai, Qiongdong, Ledong, Wanning, Lingshui, Lingao, Dan county, Ya county, Changjiang, Gan’en and Baoting. It established more than 360 military posts along the coast and in the interior and 195 maintenance associations or branches in county and market towns. Baisha county town and the Wuzhishan mountains were not permanently occupied and remained the Qiongya anti-Japanese base area; Japan continued “nibbling” and “sweeping” operations against it. Figures follow Hainan local history and await page-level verification. This is an overview of the occupied area, not a single route.

fields.name: 枣宜会战 Battle of Zaoyang–Yichang 枣宜战役 Zaoyi Campaign
fields.summary: 日军进攻枣阳、宜昌地区，中国军队顽强抵抗，张自忠殉国，宜昌最终失守。 Japanese forces attacked the Zaoyang and Yichang areas; Chinese troops resisted stubbornly, Zhang Zizhong was killed, and Yichang eventually fell.
fields.description: 1940 年 5 月，日军第十一军向枣阳、襄阳、宜昌地区发动进攻，企图歼灭中国第五战区主力并控制长江上游门户。中国军队在枣阳、襄阳一线抵抗，第 33 集团军总司令张自忠在宜城南瓜店战斗中殉国。6 月，宜昌失守。此役中国军队伤亡重大，但保持了战区主力。 本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。 In May 1940, the Japanese 11th Army attacked the Zaoyang, Xiangyang, and Yichang areas, seeking to destroy the main forces of China’s Fifth War Zone and control the upper Yangtze gateway. Chinese troops resisted along the Zaoyang–Xiangyang line, and Zhang Zizhong, commander of the 33rd Army Group, was killed in action near Nanguadian in Yicheng. Yichang fell in June. Chinese forces suffered heavy casualties but preserved the bulk of the war zone’s strength. Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

fields.description: 1940 年 5 月，枣宜会战期间，第33集团军总司令张自忠率部渡襄河督战，5 月 16 日在宜城南瓜店被日军包围，力战殉国，是抗战中阵亡的最高级别中国将领之一。 人物事件，随第33集团军路线标注；日期与地点待史料校订。 In May 1940, during the Zaoyang–Yichang campaign, General Zhang Zizhong, commander of the 33rd Group Army, crossed the Xiang River to direct operations. fields.name: 街口失守（第二次粤北） Fall of Jiekou (Second Northern Guangdong Campaign)
fields.place: 广东从化街口 Jiekou, Conghua, Guangdong
fields.summary: 日军第 38 师团占领从化街口。 The Japanese 38th Division occupied Jiekou in Conghua.
fields.description: 1940 年 5 月 13 日，日军第 38 师团从神岗、太平场沿广从公路北犯。5 月 17 日，街口被占，中国第 187 师退守荷村、新庄、白石山一带。日期据《广东省志·军事志》，待页码级核对。 On 13 May 1940 the Japanese 38th Division advanced north from Shenggang and Taipingchang along the Guangzhou–Conghua road. Jiekou fell on 17 May and the Chinese 187th Division withdrew to Hecun, Xinzhuang and Baishishan. The date follows the Guangdong Military Gazetteer and awaits page-level verification.

fields.description: 1940 年 5 月 18 日，日军第 38 师团占领鸡笼冈、门楼关；18 至 20 日又由鸡笼冈分三路向良口进攻。日期据《广东省志·军事志》，待页码级核对。 On 18 May 1940 the Japanese 38th Division occupied Jilonggang and Menlouguan; from 18 to 20 May it advanced on Liangkou from Jilonggang by three routes. The date follows the Guangdong Military Gazetteer and awaits page-level verification.

name.en: Fall of Liangkou (Second Northern Guangdong Campaign)

summary.zh: 日军第 38 师团突破李寨顶，占领良口。
summary.en: The Japanese 38th Division broke the Lizhaiding position and occupied Liangkou.

fields.name: 良口失守（第二次粤北） Fall of Liangkou (Second Northern Guangdong Campaign)
fields.place: 广东从化良口 Liangkou, Conghua, Guangdong
fields.summary: 日军第 38 师团突破李寨顶，占领良口。 The Japanese 38th Division broke the Lizhaiding position and occupied Liangkou.
fields.description: 1940 年 5 月 20 日，日军第 38 师团突破中国第 152 师李寨顶阵地，占领良口；22 日又攻占横坑、石榴花顶。中国军队随后在良口东西北三面反击。日期据《广东省志·军事志》，待页码级核对。 On 20 May 1940 the Japanese 38th Division broke the Chinese 152nd Division’s Lizhaiding position and occupied Liangkou; on 22 May it took Hengkeng and Shiliuhuading. Chinese forces then counterattacked from the east, west and north of Liangkou. The date follows the Guangdong Military Gazetteer and awaits page-level verification.

place.zh: 广东从化良口石榴花顶

summary.zh: 日军进攻石榴花顶，中国第 152 师顽强阻击。
summary.en: Japanese forces attacked Shiliuhuading and the Chinese 152nd Division fought a stubborn defense.

fields.name: 石榴花顶战斗 Battle of Shiliuhuading
fields.place: 广东从化良口石榴花顶 Shiliuhuading, Liangkou, Conghua, Guangdong
fields.summary: 日军进攻石榴花顶，中国第 152 师顽强阻击。 Japanese forces attacked Shiliuhuading and the Chinese 152nd Division fought a stubborn defense.
fields.description: 1940 年 5 月 22 日凌晨，日军集中飞机、大炮向石榴花顶阵地猛攻，并施放毒气；中国第 152 师多次击退日军，终因兵力不足退至五指山阵地。24 日中国军队全线反攻，6 月 1 日日军退却，3 日收复良口。日期据从化文史网，待页码级核对。 Before dawn on 22 May 1940 Japanese forces concentrated aircraft and artillery against the Shiliuhuading position and used poison gas; the Chinese 152nd Division repelled several attacks but withdrew to Wuzhishan for lack of strength. On 24 May Chinese forces counterattacked all along the line; the Japanese withdrew on 1 June and Liangkou was recovered on 3 June. The date follows Conghua local history and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 襄阳沦陷 Fall of Xiangyang
fields.summary: 1940年6月1日，日军第3、第39师团攻占襄阳。 On 1 June 1940 the Japanese 3rd and 39th Divisions captured Xiangyang.
fields.description: 1940年5月31日夜日军第3、第39师团强渡汉水，6月1日攻占襄阳。中国军队3日收复襄阳，日军遂南下进攻宜城、宜昌。日期据《中国抗日战争全史》与央视《抗战老兵忆枣宜会战》。 On the night of 31 May 1940 the Japanese 3rd and 39th Divisions crossed the Han River and took Xiangyang on 1 June. The Chinese recovered the city on the 3rd, and the Japanese turned south toward Yicheng and Yichang.

fields.name: 南漳沦陷 Fall of Nanzhang
fields.summary: 1940年6月3日，日军第3师团攻占南漳。 On 3 June 1940 the Japanese 3rd Division captured Nanzhang.
fields.description: 1940年6月3日日军第3师团攻占南漳。南漳为襄阳西南山地要地，失守后日军沿宜沙公路逼近宜昌。日期据《中国抗日战争全史》与维基百科《枣宜会战》。 On 3 June 1940 the Japanese 3rd Division took Nanzhang, the mountain town southwest of Xiangyang, and then advanced along the Yichang–Shashi road toward Yichang.

fields.summary: 1940年6月3日，日军第39师团攻占宜城。 On 3 June 1940 the Japanese 39th Division captured Yicheng.
fields.description: 1940年6月3日日军第39师团攻占宜城。宜城为汉水西岸要地，失守后日军第3、第39师团并列南下荆门、当阳。日期据《中国抗日战争全史》与维基百科《枣宜会战》。 On 3 June 1940 the Japanese 39th Division took Yicheng on the west bank of the Han River; the 3rd and 39th Divisions then advanced south abreast toward Jingmen and Dangyang.
