fields.name: 荆门沦陷 Fall of Jingmen
fields.summary: 1940年6月6日，日军第13师团、池田支队攻占荆门。 On 6 June 1940 the Japanese 13th Division and Ikeda detachment captured Jingmen.
fields.description: 1940年6月6日日军第13师团、池田支队攻占荆门。此前日军从钟祥旧口、沙洋强渡汉水，荆门失守后与北线日军对当阳形成南北夹击。日期据《中国抗日战争全史》与央视《抗战老兵忆枣宜会战》。 On 6 June 1940 the Japanese 13th Division and Ikeda detachment took Jingmen after crossing the Han River at Jiukou and Shayang. Its fall completed the north–south pincer against Dangyang.

fields.name: 荆州沦陷 Fall of Jingzhou
fields.summary: 1940年6月8日，日军第13师团、池田支队攻占江陵（荆州），同日沙市沦陷。 On 8 June 1940 the Japanese 13th Division and Ikeda detachment captured Jiangling (Jingzhou); Shashi fell the same day.
fields.description: 1940年6月8日日军第13师团、池田支队攻占江陵（荆州），同日沙市沦陷。江陵为长江中游重镇，失守后日军沿江西进宜昌。央视记6月7日江陵失守，正文并列。日期据《中国抗日战争全史》与央视。 On 8 June 1940 the Japanese 13th Division and Ikeda detachment took Jiangling (Jingzhou), and Shashi fell the same day. Jiangling was the key city of the middle Yangtze; the Japanese then moved upriver toward Yichang. CCTV gives 7 June; that variant is noted.

summary.en: On 9 June 1940 the Japanese 3rd and 39th Divisions captured Dangyang.

fields.name: 当阳沦陷 Fall of Dangyang
fields.summary: 1940年6月9日，日军第3、第39师团攻占当阳。 On 9 June 1940 the Japanese 3rd and 39th Divisions captured Dangyang.
fields.description: 1940年6月9日日军第3、第39师团攻占当阳。中国第18军第11师在当阳长坂坡一带顽强抵抗，终因两侧友军后撤而撤退。当阳失守后，宜昌门户洞开。日期据《中国抗日战争全史》与央视。 On 9 June 1940 the Japanese 3rd and 39th Divisions took Dangyang. The Chinese 11th Division of the 18th Corps fought stubbornly around Changbanpo but withdrew when both flanks gave way. The fall of Dangyang opened the gate to Yichang.

summary.en: Late in the Zaoyang–Yichang campaign, Japanese forces captured Yichang, the gateway to the upper Yangtze.

fields.name: 宜昌沦陷 Fall of Yichang
fields.summary: 枣宜会战后期日军攻占宜昌，长江上游门户失守。 Late in the Zaoyang–Yichang campaign, Japanese forces captured Yichang, the gateway to the upper Yangtze.
fields.description: 1940 年 5 月，日军发动枣宜会战。6 月 12 日，日军第 13 军等部攻占宜昌，中国军队反攻未克。宜昌是长江上游重要门户，沦陷后重庆受到更大威胁。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In May 1940 Japan launched the Zaoyang–Yichang campaign. On 12 June the Japanese 13th Army and other units captured Yichang; Chinese counterattacks failed to retake it. Yichang was the gateway to the upper Yangtze, and its fall increased the threat to Chongqing. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军第 18 师团在赤湾登陆，再次占领南头、深圳镇。
summary.en: The Japanese 18th Division landed at Chiwan and again occupied Nantou and Shenzhen town.

fields.name: 宝安（深圳）第三次沦陷 Third Fall of Bao’an (Shenzhen)
fields.place: 广东宝安南头（今深圳） Nantou, Bao’an (present-day Shenzhen), Guangdong
fields.summary: 日军第 18 师团在赤湾登陆，再次占领南头、深圳镇。 The Japanese 18th Division landed at Chiwan and again occupied Nantou and Shenzhen town.
fields.description: 1940 年 6 月 22 日，日军第 18 师团在赤湾登陆，当天占领南头、深圳镇，宝安第三次沦陷。此后日军长期盘踞宝安，直至 1945 年投降。日期据《深圳通史》，待页码级核对。 On 22 June 1940 the Japanese 18th Division landed at Chiwan and occupied Nantou and Shenzhen town the same day, the third fall of Bao’an. Japanese forces then remained in Bao’an until their surrender in 1945. The date follows the Shenzhen History and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1940年7月16日，日军进犯永宁，焚毁船舶近300艘、房屋90多座，杀害村民80多人。
summary.en: On 16 July 1940 Japanese forces attacked Yongning, burning nearly 300 boats and more than 90 houses and killing over 80 villagers.

fields.name: 永宁惨案 Yongning Massacre
fields.summary: 1940年7月16日，日军进犯永宁，焚毁船舶近300艘、房屋90多座，杀害村民80多人。 On 16 July 1940 Japanese forces attacked Yongning, burning nearly 300 boats and more than 90 houses and killing over 80 villagers.
fields.description: 7月16日，日本侵略军300多人在飞机、军舰掩护下，分3路进犯永宁。驻外高村20多名海防战士浴血奋战。日军占领永宁，大肆烧杀掠夺，十几个村庄惨遭其害，焚毁船舶近300艘、房屋90多座、学校3所，杀害村民80多人，财物被抢劫一空。史称「永宁惨案」。 On 16 July more than 300 Japanese troops, covered by aircraft and warships, attacked Yongning in three columns. More than 20 coastal defence soldiers at Waigao village fought to the death. The Japanese occupied Yongning and burned, killed and looted across more than a dozen villages, destroying nearly 300 boats, over 90 houses and three schools, killing more than 80 villagers and seizing property. It is known as the Yongning massacre.

summary.en: On 16 July 1940 Japanese forces landed at Chongwu, killing 93 people and burning 521 fishing and merchant boats.

fields.name: 崇武惨案 Chongwu Massacre
fields.summary: 1940年7月16日，日军登陆崇武，杀害民众93人，焚毁渔船商船521艘。 On 16 July 1940 Japanese forces landed at Chongwu, killing 93 people and burning 521 fishing and merchant boats.
fields.description: 7月16日，日机6架分2批侵入惠安崇武、獭窟等地轰炸，日舰同时向陆上开炮。稍后，日军500多人从后海、三屿、港墘等处登陆，窜入崇武城；另一支日军200多人从獭窟登陆。仅崇武一地民众死93人、伤40人，被烧毁渔、商船521艘，烧毁房屋566间、庙宇1座，其他财产损失无数。史称「崇武惨案」。 On 16 July six Japanese aircraft in two waves bombed Chongwu and Taku in Hui'an while warships shelled the coast. More than 500 Japanese troops then landed at Houhai, Sanyu and Gangqian and entered Chongwu, while another 200 landed at Taku. In Chongwu alone 93 civilians were killed and 40 wounded, 521 fishing and merchant boats and 566 houses were burned, along with a temple, and other property was lost. It is known as the Chongwu massacre.

summary.zh: 1940年7月17日，日军侵占镇海，7月22日被中国军队收复。
summary.en: On 17 July 1940 Japanese forces occupied Zhenhai; Chinese troops recovered it on 22 July.

fields.name: 镇海沦陷与收复 Zhenhai: Occupation and Recovery
fields.summary: 1940年7月17日，日军侵占镇海，7月22日被中国军队收复。 On 17 July 1940 Japanese forces occupied Zhenhai; Chinese troops recovered it on 22 July.
fields.description: 7月17日，日军侵占镇海城关、小港、江南等地。18日，国民党守军第194师在第16师48团增援下反击，师长陈德法亲临前线指挥，经五昼夜血战，于22日晨击退日军，收复失地，共击毙日军近400名。此役是浙东抗战的重要胜利。日期据《宁波抗战大事记》，待页码级核对。 On 17 July Japanese forces occupied Zhenhai's city area, Xiaogang and Jiangnan. On 18 July the Chinese 194th Division, reinforced by the 48th Regiment of the 16th Division and commanded personally by divisional commander Chen Defa, counter-attacked. After five days and nights of fighting they drove the Japanese back on the morning of 22 July, recovering the lost ground and killing nearly 400 Japanese troops. The date follows the Ningbo war chronology and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 成都“七二四”大轰炸 Chengdu Bombing of 24 July 1940

fields.description: 1940年7月24日午后，日机36架空袭成都，投弹135枚，轰炸城东一带，炸死103人、炸伤114人，房屋被毁3425间。中国空军在空战中击落日机1架。日期据《成都空战》与《成都大轰炸》。 On the afternoon of 24 July 1940 thirty-six Japanese aircraft raided Chengdu, dropping 135 bombs on the eastern part of the city, killing 103, wounding 114 and destroying 3,425 rooms. Chinese fighters shot down one Japanese aircraft.

fields.name: 自贡“八一二”大轰炸 Zigong Bombing of 12 August 1940
fields.summary: 1940年8月12日，日机90架轰炸自贡盐场与市区。 On 12 August 1940 ninety Japanese aircraft bombed Zigong’s salt works and urban area.
fields.description: 1940年8月12日，日机90架轰炸自贡，投弹267枚，炸死139人、伤258人（另载死亡92人、伤157人）。自贡为川盐生产中心，日军“102号作战”专门轰炸自贡盐场，1939年10月至1941年8月共遭7次16批轰炸。日期据《抗战大后方侵华日军无差别轰炸重大惨案的时空分布考察》与《抗战时期自贡盐业的“增产加运”》。 On 12 August 1940 ninety Japanese aircraft bombed Zigong, dropping 267 bombs, killing 139 and wounding 258 (another account gives 92 dead and 157 wounded). Zigong was the centre of Sichuan salt production, and Japan’s “Operation 102” specifically targeted its salt works; between October 1939 and August 1941 the city suffered seven raids in sixteen waves.

fields.name: 重庆“八一九”大轰炸 Chongqing Bombing of 19 August 1940
fields.summary: 1940年8月19日，日机178架次轰炸重庆，投弹500余枚。 On 19 August 1940 178 Japanese aircraft attacked Chongqing, dropping more than 500 bombs.
fields.description: 1940年8月19日，日军陆海军出动178架次飞机分5次空袭重庆，投弹500余枚，大田湾、两路口、储奇门、较场口等30余处中弹起火，商业区被焚毁殆尽。据重庆防空司令部统计，当日炸死181人、伤132人，毁房786栋1438间。日期据新华网《不应忘却的“重庆大轰炸”》与人民网《影像见证日本对重庆最猛烈轰炸场景》。 On 19 August 1940 the Japanese army and navy flew 178 sorties in five waves against Chongqing, dropping over 500 bombs. More than thirty places including Datianwan, Lianglukou, Chuqimen and Jiaochangkou were hit and set ablaze, and the commercial district was largely destroyed. The air-defence headquarters recorded 181 dead, 132 wounded and 786 buildings (1,438 rooms) destroyed.

place.en: Along the Zhengding–Taiyuan railway in North China (Yangquan area)

summary.zh: 八路军在华北发动大规模破袭战，先后参战部队达一百余个团。
summary.en: The Eighth Route Army launched a large-scale sabotage campaign in North China involving more than a hundred regiments.

fields.name: 百团大战 Hundred Regiments Offensive 百团战役 Hundred Regiments Campaign 正太路破袭战 Zhengding–Taiyuan Railway Sabotage
fields.place: 华北正太铁路沿线（阳泉一带） Along the Zhengding–Taiyuan railway in North China (Yangquan area)
fields.summary: 八路军在华北发动大规模破袭战，先后参战部队达一百余个团。 The Eighth Route Army launched a large-scale sabotage campaign in North China involving more than a hundred regiments.
fields.description: 1940 年 8 月 20 日起，八路军在副总司令彭德怀、副参谋长左权指挥下，在华北发动以破袭正太铁路为重点的大规模进攻，先后参战部队达 105 个团，故称“百团大战”。战役分破袭交通线、攻取据点、反“扫荡”三个阶段，持续至 1941 年初，对日军交通线和据点造成较大打击，也促使日军加强对华北敌后根据地的“扫荡”。 参战团数、阶段划分与战果各书记载不一，待页码级核对。 From 20 August 1940, under deputy commander Peng Dehuai and deputy chief of staff Zuo Quan, the Eighth Route Army launched a large offensive in North China centered on sabotaging the Zhengding–Taiyuan railway. Eventually 105 regiments took part, hence the name “Hundred Regiments Offensive.” The campaign had three phases—cutting transport lines, attacking strongpoints, and countering Japanese “mopping-up” operations—and lasted into early 1941, damaging Japanese communications and prompting harsher operations against base areas. Regiment counts, phase divisions, and results vary between accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 百团大战第一阶段，第129师破袭正太铁路西段。

fields.name: 正太路破袭战（西段） Sabotage of the western Zhengding–Taiyuan railway
fields.summary: 百团大战第一阶段，第129师破袭正太铁路西段。 In the first phase of the Hundred Regiments Offensive, the 129th Division sabotaged the western section of the Zhengding–Taiyuan railway.
fields.description: 1940 年 8 月 20 日夜，百团大战第一阶段开始，八路军第129师以第385旅、第386旅、新编第10旅等部破袭正太铁路西段，重点破坏阳泉至榆次间的铁路、桥梁、隧道和车站，并攻取沿线部分据点。 参战番号与破袭范围各书记载略有出入，待页码级核对。 On the night of 20 August 1940 the first phase of the Hundred Regiments Offensive began. The 129th Division, with the 385th, 386th, and new 10th brigades, sabotaged the western section of the Zhengding–Taiyuan railway, concentrating on track, bridges, tunnels, and stations between Yangquan and Yuci and capturing some strongpoints along the line. Participating units and the extent of sabotage vary slightly between accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.name: 重庆“八二〇”大轰炸 Chongqing Bombing of 20 August 1940
fields.summary: 1940年8月20日，日机126架次再炸重庆，市区38处起火。 On 20 August 1940 126 Japanese aircraft bombed Chongqing again, starting fires in 38 places.
fields.description: 1940年8月20日下午，日机126架次分4批轰炸重庆市区及江北、巴县，望龙门、临江门、大梁子、都邮街、小梁子、千厮门等38处起火，繁华街道被烧成焦土。19、20两日日军共出动289架飞机，投弹943枚，炸死烧死342人、重伤332人。日期据新华网与人民网。 On the afternoon of 20 August 1940 126 Japanese aircraft in four waves bombed Chongqing, Jiangbei and Ba County; fires broke out in thirty-eight places including Wanglongmen, Linjiangmen, Daliangzi, Duyou Street, Xiaoliangzi and Qiansimen. Over the two days the Japanese flew 289 aircraft and dropped 943 bombs, killing 342 and seriously wounding 332.

fields.name: 第60军回滇 60th Army Returns to Yunnan
fields.summary: 日军入侵越南北部后，滇军第60军由赣北调回云南，防守滇越边境。 After Japan moved into northern Vietnam, the Yunnan 60th Army was transferred from northern Jiangxi back to Yunnan to guard the Sino-Vietnamese border.
fields.description: 1940 年 9 月，日军入侵越南北部，威胁滇南。第60军第182、184师由赣北靖安、安义一线调回云南，防守滇越边境。此后第60军长期驻守滇南，直至抗战胜利。 路线为示意简化，日期取通行说法，待史料校订。 In September 1940 Japan moved into northern Vietnam and threatened southern Yunnan. The 60th Army’s 182nd and 184th Divisions were transferred from Jing’an and Anyi in northern Jiangxi back to Yunnan to guard the Sino-Vietnamese border. The army then held southern Yunnan until the end of the war. Illustrative simplified route; dates follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

fields.description: 1940 年 9 月 6 日，国民政府明定重庆为陪都，确立其战时政治中心地位。重庆同时是大后方工业、教育与外交活动的中心。 日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。 On 6 September 1940 the Nationalist government formally designated Chongqing as the wartime capital, confirming its role as the political center. It was also the hub of rear-area industry, education, and diplomacy. Dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

name.zh: 日军进驻法属印度支那北部
name.en: Japanese Entry into Northern French Indochina

summary.zh: 日军进驻法属印度支那北部，切断滇越铁路。
summary.en: Japanese forces entered northern French Indochina and cut the Yunnan–Vietnam railway.

fields.name: 日军进驻法属印度支那北部 Japanese Entry into Northern French Indochina
fields.summary: 日军进驻法属印度支那北部，切断滇越铁路。 Japanese forces entered northern French Indochina and cut the Yunnan–Vietnam railway.
fields.description: 1940 年 9 月，日本趁法国战败，与维希法国达成协议，日军于 9 月 22 日自镇南关进入法属印度支那北部，随后在海防登陆，进驻河内。日军控制越南北部后，切断滇越铁路，并建立轰炸中国西南和南下南洋的基地。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In September 1940, exploiting the French defeat, Japan reached an agreement with Vichy France and on 22 September Japanese forces entered northern French Indochina through Zhennanguan, later landing at Haiphong and occupying Hanoi. Control of northern Vietnam cut the Yunnan–Vietnam railway and gave Japan bases for bombing southwest China and for the southward advance. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 第60军防守滇南 60th Army Defends Southern Yunnan
fields.summary: 第60军进驻蒙自、河口一线，防守滇越边境，直至抗战胜利。 The 60th Army held the Mengzi–Hekou line on the Sino-Vietnamese border until the end of the war.
fields.description: 1940 年 10 月起，第60军进驻蒙自、河口一线，依托滇越铁路与红河防线阻止日军由越南侵入云南。滇南防御持续五年，直至 1945 年抗战胜利。 路线为示意简化，日期取通行说法，待史料校订。 From October 1940 the 60th Army held the Mengzi–Hekou line, using the Yunnan–Vietnam railway and the Red River defenses to block a Japanese advance from Vietnam into Yunnan. The defense of southern Yunnan lasted five years until the Japanese surrender in 1945. Illustrative simplified route; dates follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

fields.place: 江苏泰兴黄桥 Huangqiao, Taixing, Jiangsu
fields.summary: 新四军在黄桥反击国民党军，打开苏北局面。 The New Fourth Army counterattacked KMT forces at Huangqiao, opening up northern Jiangsu.
fields.description: 1940 年 10 月，新四军苏北指挥部在江苏泰兴黄桥地区反击国民党军韩德勤部，取得黄桥战役胜利。日期与战果为通行说法，待页码级核对。 本事件为战役点，不绘行军路线：黄桥战役由新四军苏北指挥部率部自苏南渡江发起，与军部驻地云岭不是同一条路线。 In October 1940, the New Fourth Army’s Northern Jiangsu Command counterattacked KMT forces under Han Deqin at Huangqiao, Taixing, Jiangsu, winning the Battle of Huangqiao. Dates and results follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification. This is a battle point with no march route: the Battle of Huangqiao was fought by the N4A Northern Jiangsu Command moving north from southern Jiangsu, not by the headquarters at Yunling.

name.en: Second Japanese Sweep in Southern Anhui

summary.zh: 1940年10月4日，日军1万余人第二次扫荡皖南，攻占泾县、南陵。
summary.en: On 4 October 1940 more than 10,000 Japanese and puppet troops launched a second sweep in southern Anhui, taking Jingxian and Nanling.

fields.name: 日军第二次扫荡皖南 Second Japanese Sweep in Southern Anhui
fields.summary: 1940年10月4日，日军1万余人第二次扫荡皖南，攻占泾县、南陵。 On 4 October 1940 more than 10,000 Japanese and puppet troops launched a second sweep in southern Anhui, taking Jingxian and Nanling.
fields.description: 10月4日，日军第15、第17、第116师团及伪军共1万余人，对皖南发动第二次大规模「扫荡」。叶挺指挥皖南新四军在汀潭、枫坑口、泾县县城等地激战，10月9日收复泾县县城，南陵亦被收复，历时一周，毙伤日伪军近2000人，迫使其撤退。此为多路扫荡，不绘单一路线。 On 4 October more than 10,000 Japanese troops from the 15th, 17th and 116th Divisions and puppet forces launched a second large-scale sweep in southern Anhui. Ye Ting commanded the New Fourth Army in fighting at Tingtan, Fengkengkou and Jingxian; Jingxian was recovered on 9 October and Nanling soon after. The week-long operation killed or wounded nearly 2,000 Japanese and puppet troops and forced a withdrawal. As a multi-column sweep, it is not drawn as a single route.

fields.name: 宁波细菌战 Bacteriological Attack on Ningbo
fields.summary: 日军在宁波投撒鼠疫菌，造成平民感染死亡。 Japanese forces spread plague bacteria in Ningbo, causing civilian infections and deaths.
fields.description: 1940 年 10 月 27 日，日军第 731 部队在宁波开明街一带投撒带有鼠疫菌的跳蚤、谷物等，引发鼠疫流行，造成平民死亡。具体死亡人数各说不一，待页码级核对。本事件为细菌战惨案，不绘路线。注意：事件日期与“宁波沦陷”（1941-04-20）不同，勿混。 On 27 October 1940 the Japanese Unit 731 spread plague-infected fleas and grain around Kaiming Street in Ningbo, triggering a plague outbreak and civilian deaths. Accounts of the death toll differ and await page-level verification. This is a bacteriological-warfare atrocity and is not drawn as a route. It is distinct from the fall of Ningbo on 20 April 1941.

fields.summary: 百团大战第三阶段，八路军围攻日军冈崎支队，未能全歼。 In the third phase of the Hundred Regiments Offensive, the Eighth Route Army besieged the Japanese Okazaki Detachment but failed to destroy it.
fields.description: 1940 年 10 月 30 日至 11 月 1 日，八路军第129师第385旅、第386旅、新编第10旅及决死第1纵队等部在山西武乡关家垴围攻日军第36师团冈崎支队约 500 人。日军依托窑洞和山地工事顽抗，八路军多次攻击未果，自身伤亡较大，最终日军援兵赶到，残部撤走。此战是百团大战第三阶段反“扫荡”中的一场硬仗，也暴露了八路军攻坚能力的不足。 兵力与伤亡数字各书记载不一，待页码级核对。 From 30 October to 1 November 1940 the 129th Division—with the 385th, 386th, and new 10th brigades and the 1st Suicide Squad—besieged about 500 men of the Japanese 36th Division’s Okazaki Detachment at Guanjianao, Wuxiang, Shanxi. The Japanese held out in cave dwellings and hill fortifications; repeated assaults failed and the attackers suffered heavy casualties before Japanese reinforcements arrived and the remnants withdrew. The battle was a hard fight in the third phase of the Hundred Regiments Offensive and exposed the Eighth Route Army’s limited capability in attacking fortified positions. Force and casualty figures vary between accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.description: 1941 年 1 月 25 日，日军驻唐山部队包围冀东丰润县潘家峪村，将村民集中屠杀并焚毁房屋。具体死难人数各说不一，通行说法为一千余人，待页码级核对。本事件为惨案，不绘路线。 On 25 January 1941 Japanese troops based in Tangshan surrounded Panjiayu village in Fengrun, eastern Hebei, massacred the assembled villagers and burned the houses. Accounts of the death toll differ; the conventional figure is over 1,000 and awaits page-level verification. As a massacre, this event is not drawn as a route.

fields.name: 确山沦陷 Fall of Queshan
fields.summary: 1941年1月26日，日军第11军攻占确山。 On 26 January 1941 the Japanese 11th Army captured Queshan.
fields.description: 1941年1月，日军第11军为打通平汉铁路南段、解除中国军队对信阳日军的威胁，发动豫南会战。日军快速出击，26日攻占确山、邢店、高邑、泌阳一线，27日推进至驻马店、汝南、沙河店、龙王庙一线。日期据维基百科《豫南会战》与央视《抗战史上的今天》。 In January 1941 the Japanese 11th Army launched the Southern Henan campaign to open the southern Beiping–Hankou railway and remove the threat to its Xinyang garrison. Attacking rapidly, it took the Queshan–Xingdian–Gaoyi–Biyang line on the 26th and reached the Zhumadian–Runan–Shahedian–Longwangmiao line on the 27th.

fields.description: 1941年1月26日，豫南会战中路日军攻陷确山，右翼攻陷正阳，左翼攻陷泌阳。中国第31集团军以第85军由临泉驰援，在泌阳、舞阳间侧击日军。日期据维基百科《豫南会战》与央视《抗战史上的今天》。 On 26 January 1941 the Japanese centre took Queshan, the right wing Zhengyang and the left wing Biyang. The Chinese 31st Group Army rushed the 85th Corps from Linquan and struck the Japanese flank between Biyang and Wuyang.

Zhumadian was then a town under Queshan county and a key point on the southern Beiping–Hankou railway.

fields.name: 琼崖抗日根据地 Qiongya anti-Japanese base area
fields.place: 海南琼山、文昌一带 Qiongshan–Wenchang, Hainan
fields.summary: 1941 年 2 月，琼崖抗日根据地在琼山、文昌一带坚持斗争；五指山根据地于 1943—1944 年开辟。 In February 1941 the Qiongya base area held out around Qiongshan and Wenchang; the Wuzhishan base was opened in 1943–1944.
fields.description: 1941 年 2 月，美合事变后琼崖特委和独立总队返回琼山、文昌一带，继续坚持抗日斗争。五指山根据地则于 1943—1944 年逐步开辟。时间与范围为通行说法，待页码级核对。 本事件为根据地形成，不绘路线；五指山方向的进军见 1944 年「琼崖纵队挺进五指山」。 In February 1941, after the Meihe Incident, the Qiongya Special Committee and the Independent Corps returned to the Qiongshan–Wenchang area and continued resistance. The Wuzhishan base was opened only in 1943–1944. Dates and extent follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification. fields.description: 1941年2月13日，鲁苏皖边区游击总指挥部副总指挥李长江率部投敌，泰州城沦陷；2月16日，日军独立混成第12旅团进驻泰县县城。新四军随后发起讨逆战役，2月21日攻克泰州后主动撤出。本事件记日军进驻，日期取2月16日，正文并列2月13日、2月15日说。 On 13 February 1941 Li Changjiang, deputy commander of the Lu-Su-Wan guerrilla headquarters, defected with his troops and Taizhou fell; on 16 February the Japanese 12th Independent Mixed Brigade entered the county seat. The New Fourth Army then launched a punitive campaign, took Taizhou on 21 February and withdrew. This event records the Japanese entry on 16 February and notes the 13 and 15 February accounts.

summary.zh: 日军进攻上高，中国军队包围反击，取得上高大捷。
summary.en: Japanese forces attacked Shanggao; Chinese troops encircled and counterattacked, winning a major victory.

fields.name: 上高会战 Battle of Shanggao 上高大捷 Shanggao Victory
fields.summary: 日军进攻上高，中国军队包围反击，取得上高大捷。 Japanese forces attacked Shanggao; Chinese troops encircled and counterattacked, winning a major victory.
fields.description: 1941 年 3 月，日军第十一军向江西上高地区进攻，企图打击中国第九战区部队。中国军队依托地形逐次抵抗，诱敌深入后实施包围反击，至 4 月上旬收复失地，取得上高会战胜利。此役是抗战中期正面战场的一次重要胜利。 本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。 In March 1941, the Japanese 11th Army attacked the Shanggao area of Jiangxi, seeking to strike Chinese forces of the Ninth War Zone. Chinese troops resisted in stages using the terrain, drew the Japanese in, then counterattacked and encircled them, recovering the lost ground by early April and winning the Battle of Shanggao. It was an important victory on China’s frontal battlefield in the middle years of the war. Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

fields.name: 海南警备府成立 Establishment of the Hainan Guard District
fields.summary: 日本海军将海南岛根据地队升格为海南警备府，强化对海南的军事控制。 The Japanese navy upgraded the Hainan Island Base Force to the Hainan Guard District, tightening its military control of the island.
fields.description: 1941 年 4 月 10 日，日本海军将海南岛根据地队升格为海南警备府，隶属中国方面舰队，统辖海口、三亚、榆林等要港和驻岛海军陆战队，把海南建成封锁华南海上交通、进窥法属印度支那和南进的基地。日军在岛上修筑机场、据点，实施「扫荡」与殖民统治。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 本事件为建制事件，不绘制路线。 On 10 April 1941 the Japanese navy upgraded the Hainan Island Base Force to the Hainan Guard District under the China Area Fleet, commanding the key ports of Haikou, Sanya and Yulin and the naval landing forces on the island. Hainan became a base for blockading South China’s sea lanes and for Japan’s southward advance toward French Indochina. Japanese forces built airfields and strongpoints and conducted “mopping-up” operations and colonial rule. Dates follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification. summary.zh: 宁绍战役开始，日军占领绍兴。
summary.en: The Ningbo–Shaoxing campaign began and Japanese forces captured Shaoxing.

fields.name: 绍兴沦陷 Fall of Shaoxing
fields.summary: 宁绍战役开始，日军占领绍兴。 The Ningbo–Shaoxing campaign began and Japanese forces captured Shaoxing.
fields.description: 1941 年 4 月 16 日，日军第 13 军自杭州附近向钱塘江南岸发动进攻，宁绍战役开始。4 月 17 日凌晨，日军占领绍兴，这是战役中中国方面失守的第一座城市。日期据《近代史研究》相关研究，待页码级核对。 On 16 April 1941 the Japanese 13th Army attacked south across the Qiantang River from near Hangzhou, opening the Ningbo–Shaoxing campaign. In the early hours of 17 April Japanese forces occupied Shaoxing, the first city lost by the Chinese side in the campaign. The date follows research in Modern Chinese History Studies and awaits page-level verification.

fields.summary: 日军在飞云江口登陆，占领瑞安县城。 Japanese forces landed at the Feiyun River mouth and occupied Rui’an.
fields.description: 1941 年 4 月 18 日，日军一部在瑞安飞云江口登陆，突破中国守军滩头阵地，当日占领瑞安县城，随后北犯温州。日期据温州地方史志，待页码级核对。 On 18 April 1941 a Japanese force landed at the mouth of the Feiyun River, broke through the Chinese beach defenses and occupied Rui’an the same day before advancing north toward Wenzhou. fields.description: 1941 年 4 月 19 日拂晓，日军第 5 师团及海军陆战队在镇海口北岸、江南等地登陆，中国守军暂编第 34 师等部抵抗。当日上午镇海县城沦陷，日军沿甬江西犯宁波。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 At dawn on 19 April 1941 the Japanese 5th Division and naval landing forces came ashore on both banks of the Yong River mouth at Zhenhai; Chinese provisional 34th Division troops resisted. The county town fell that morning and the Japanese advanced west along the Yong River toward Ningbo. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

After looting supplies, they withdrew in early May. The date follows Wenzhou local histories and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 日军登陆闽江口 Japanese Landing at the Min River Estuary
fields.place: 福建闽江口 Min River estuary, Fujian
fields.summary: 日军在闽江口及连江、长乐沿海登陆，第一次福州战役开始。 Japanese forces landed at the Min River estuary and along the Lianjiang and Changle coasts, opening the first battle for Fuzhou.
fields.description: 1941 年 4 月 19 日拂晓，日军第 48 师团、第 18 师团一部及海军陆战队在闽江口两侧的连江、长乐沿海多处登陆，随后向福州推进。中国守军第 75 师、第 80 师等部抵抗。日期据《福州史志》，待页码级核对。 At dawn on 19 April 1941 the Japanese 48th Division, elements of the 18th Division and naval landing forces came ashore at several points around the Min River estuary and along the Lianjiang and Changle coasts, then advanced on Fuzhou. Chinese 75th and 80th Division troops resisted. The date follows Fuzhou local history and awaits page-level verification.

fields.summary: 日军攻占宁波城区，宁波沦陷。 Japanese forces captured central Ningbo and the city fell.
fields.description: 1941 年 4 月 19 日日军在镇海登陆后沿甬江西进，4 月 20 日下午攻占宁波江北岸、江东和城区，宁波沦陷。日军占领宁波后封锁港口、掠夺物资。日期据《宁波日报》与宁波市档案馆资料，待页码级核对。 After landing at Zhenhai on 19 April 1941, Japanese forces advanced west along the Yong River and on the afternoon of 20 April captured the north bank, Jiangdong and central Ningbo. The city then fell; Japan closed the port and seized supplies. The date follows Ningbo Daily and municipal archives and awaits page-level verification.

fields.summary: 日军攻占福州，福州第一次沦陷。 Japanese forces captured Fuzhou for the first time.
fields.description: 1941 年 4 月 20 日，日军自连江、长乐分路包围福州；4 月 21 日，马尾失守，当晚日军进入福州城区，福州第一次沦陷。福州沦陷后，日军控制闽江口，封锁福建沿海。日期据《福州史志》，待页码级核对。 On 20 April 1941 Japanese forces converged on Fuzhou from Lianjiang and Changle. Mawei fell on 21 April and that evening Japanese troops entered central Fuzhou, which fell for the first time. The occupation gave Japan control of the Min River estuary and the Fujian coast. fields.summary: 1941年4月21日，长乐沦陷。 On 21 April 1941 Changle fell.
fields.description: 4月18日，日军登陆运输舰艇在闽江口海域集结，出动30架飞机对福州及闽江口两岸轮番轰炸。4月19日日军登陆，4月21日长乐、连江、福州相继沦陷。日期据《福州沦陷日》与《福州抗战大事记》，待页码级核对。 On 18 April Japanese transports massed off the Min River estuary and 30 aircraft bombed Fuzhou and both banks of the river. Within four years they extracted 100,000 tons of fluorite from the Wushi mountain mine (50,000 tons were left behind), and more than 2,700 miners were killed or worked to death. summary.en: Japanese forces besieged Chinese troops in the Zhongtiao Mountains; the Chinese army suffered heavy losses and was forced to break out south across the Yellow River.

fields.name: 中条山战役 Battle of South Shanxi 晋南会战 Battle of South Shanxi
fields.place: 山西中条山 Zhongtiao Mountains, Shanxi
fields.summary: 日军围攻中条山中国守军，中国军队遭受重大损失，被迫南渡黄河突围。 Japanese forces besieged Chinese troops in the Zhongtiao Mountains; the Chinese army suffered heavy losses and was forced to break out south across the Yellow River.
fields.description: 1941 年 5 月，日军集中兵力围攻山西南部中条山地区的中国军队。中国守军补给困难、指挥协同不足，在日军多路进攻下遭受重大损失，部分部队南渡黄河突围。此役是抗战中期中国正面战场的一次严重失利。 本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。 In May 1941, Japanese forces concentrated their strength to besiege Chinese troops in the Zhongtiao Mountains of southern Shanxi. Hampered by supply difficulties and poor coordination, the Chinese defenders suffered heavy losses under multiple Japanese attacks, and part of the force broke out south across the Yellow River. It was a serious setback for China’s frontal battlefield in the middle years of the war. Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

summary.en: On 8 May 1941 Japanese forces captured Yuanqu during the Zhongtiao Mountains campaign.

fields.name: 垣曲沦陷 Fall of Yuanqu
fields.summary: 1941年5月8日，日军在中条山会战中攻陷垣曲。 On 8 May 1941 Japanese forces captured Yuanqu during the Zhongtiao Mountains campaign.
fields.description: 1941年5月7日傍晚，日军华北方面军第1军等部由东、西、北三面以中央突破方式进攻中条山。8日晨突破中国军队正面阵地，直指垣曲，垣曲当日失守。垣曲地处中条山腹地，第5集团军指挥部所在地，失守后中条山守军被分割。日期据《中条山会战》与台湾荣民文化网《晉南會戰過程》。 At dusk on 7 May 1941 the Japanese First Army attacked the Zhongtiao Mountains from east, west and north with a central breakthrough. On the morning of the 8th it broke the front and drove on Yuanqu, which fell that day. Yuanqu lay in the heart of the mountains and housed the 5th Group Army headquarters; its loss split the Chinese defenders. Dates follow the Zhongtiao campaign article and the Veterans Affairs Council account.

summary.en: On 5 June 1941 Japanese night raiders triggered mass suffocation and trampling in the Jiaochangkou tunnel, killing hundreds of civilians.

fields.name: 重庆“六五”大隧道惨案 Chongqing Tunnel Tragedy of 5 June 1941
fields.summary: 1941年6月5日，日机夜袭重庆，较场口大隧道内大批避难民众窒息、踩踏而死。 On 5 June 1941 Japanese night raiders triggered mass suffocation and trampling in the Jiaochangkou tunnel, killing hundreds of civilians.
fields.description: 1941年6月5日18时18分，日机24架分3批夜袭重庆，空袭警报持续5小时9分钟。大量市民涌入较场口大隧道，洞内缺氧，人群向洞口拥挤，发生窒息、踩踏。官方审查委员会1941年7月3日公布死亡992人、重伤151人；各方统计从数百到上万人不等。日期据新华网与维基百科《重庆隧道惨案》。 At 18:18 on 5 June 1941 twenty-four Japanese aircraft attacked Chongqing in three night waves, with the alarm lasting five hours and nine minutes. Crowds packed the Jiaochangkou tunnel; oxygen ran short and people were crushed and suffocated at the entrances. The official review committee announced 992 dead and 151 seriously wounded on 3 July 1941, though estimates range from several hundred to over ten thousand.

fields.description: 1941 年 5 月 7 日日军进攻中条山，中国军队损失惨重；6 月中旬部分部队突围，南渡黄河退抵洛阳、新安一带整补。 On 7 May 1941 the Japanese attacked the Zhongtiao mountains and inflicted heavy losses; in mid-June part of the Chinese army broke out, crossed the Yellow River and reached Luoyang and Xin’an to refit.

fields.name: 成都“七二七”大轰炸 Chengdu Bombing of 27 July 1941
fields.summary: 1941年7月27日，日机108架连续轰炸成都，为成都大轰炸最惨重的一次。 On 27 July 1941 108 Japanese aircraft bombed Chengdu in successive waves, the worst raid on the city.
fields.description: 1941年7月27日上午8时30分，日机108架分4批、每批27架，从运城、汉口机场起飞，连续轰炸成都少城公园、盐市口、春熙路、大慈寺一带，中弹街道82条，投弹358枚，炸死575人、伤632人，毁房3585间。日期据四川省地方志办与《成都空战》。 From 8:30 a.m. on 27 July 1941, 108 Japanese aircraft in four waves of twenty-seven took off from Yuncheng and Hankou and bombed Chengdu’s Shaocheng Park, Yanshikou, Chunxi Road and Dacisi area. Eighty-two streets were hit, 358 bombs dropped, 575 killed, 632 wounded and 3,585 rooms destroyed.

summary.en: Japanese forces again attacked Changsha; Chinese troops resisted in stages and counterattacked, forcing a Japanese withdrawal to the original line in early October.

fields.name: 第二次长沙会战 Second Battle of Changsha 第二次长沙战役 Second Changsha Campaign
fields.place: 湖南岳阳新墙河一线 Xinqiang River line, Yueyang, Hunan
fields.summary: 日军再次进攻长沙，中国军队逐次抵抗并反击，日军于 10 月上旬退回原阵地。 Japanese forces again attacked Changsha; Chinese troops resisted in stages and counterattacked, forcing a Japanese withdrawal to the original line in early October.
fields.description: 1941 年 9 月，日军第十一军向新墙河、汨罗江一线发起进攻，企图击破中国第九战区主力并攻取长沙。中国军队逐次抵抗，双方在长沙外围激战；日军因补给困难和中国军队侧击，于 10 月上旬退回原阵地。此役双方均有较大伤亡。 本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。 In September 1941, the Japanese 11th Army attacked across the Xinqiang and Miluo rivers, aiming to destroy the main forces of China’s Ninth War Zone and take Changsha. Chinese troops resisted in stages and fought fierce actions on the city’s outskirts. Hampered by supply difficulties and Chinese flank attacks, the Japanese withdrew to their original line in early October. Both sides suffered considerable casualties. Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

fields.name: 大云山战斗 Battle of Dayun Mountain
fields.place: 湖南岳阳大云山 Dayun Mountain, Yueyang, Hunan
fields.summary: 1941年9月7日，日军第6师团进攻岳阳大云山，第二次长沙会战拉开序幕。 On 7 September 1941 the Japanese 6th Division attacked Dayun Mountain in Yueyang, opening the second Changsha campaign.
fields.description: 1941年9月7日晨，日军第6师团2个联队从忠防、西塘进攻岳阳大云山，中国第58军新11师、第4军第59师等部反击，10日收复大云山。日军以一部牵制中国5个师，主力已在岳阳正面集结，18日强渡新墙河。日期据光明网《9月7日：第二次长沙会战拉开序幕》与《长沙会战》。 On the morning of 7 September 1941 two regiments of the Japanese 6th Division attacked Dayun Mountain from Zhongfang and Xitang. The Chinese New 11th Division and 59th Division counterattacked and recovered the mountain on the 10th. The Japanese used this to pin five Chinese divisions while massing their main force at Yueyang, crossing the Xinqiang on the 18th.

fields.place: 湖南岳阳新墙河 Xinqiang River, Yueyang, Hunan
fields.summary: 1941年9月18日，日军第3、第4、第6、第40师团强渡新墙河。 On 18 September 1941 the Japanese 3rd, 4th, 6th and 40th Divisions forced the Xinqiang River.
fields.description: 1941年9月18日拂晓，日军第3、第4、第6、第40师团及荒木、早渊支队在320门火炮、50架飞机支援下，向新墙河南岸20公里正面发起总攻，中国第4军第102师阵地两小时内被突破，日军当晚占领黄沙街、大荆街。日期据光明网与《长沙会战》。 At dawn on 18 September 1941 the Japanese 3rd, 4th, 6th and 40th Divisions with the Araki and Hayabuchi detachments attacked a 20-km front south of the Xinqiang River with 320 guns and 50 aircraft. The Chinese 102nd Division’s line broke within two hours, and the Japanese took Huangshajie and Dajingjie that evening.

fields.summary: 1941年9月21日，日军主力强渡汨罗江，中国第37军转移。 On 21 September 1941 the Japanese main force crossed the Miluo River and the Chinese 37th Corps withdrew.
fields.description: 1941年9月19日日军进抵汨罗江北岸，21日拂晓主力强渡汨罗江，中国第37军抗击后向捞刀河东南转移。日军因破译中国军队电报，改以主力包围汨罗江南岸守军。日期据光明网与《长沙会战》。 The Japanese reached the north bank of the Miluo on 19 September 1941 and crossed in force at dawn on the 21st. The Chinese 37th Corps resisted and then withdrew southeast of the Laodao River. Having broken Chinese codes, the Japanese switched their main effort to encircling the south-bank defenders.

fields.place: 河北易县狼牙山 Langya Mountain, Yi County, Hebei
fields.summary: 晋察冀军区一团七连六班掩护机关和群众转移，弹尽后跳崖。 The 6th Squad of the 7th Company, 1st Regiment, covered the evacuation of headquarters and civilians and jumped from the cliff after running out of ammunition.
fields.description: 1941 年 9 月 25 日，日军“扫荡”晋察冀边区，晋察冀军区第1军分区第1团第7连第6班班长马宝玉、副班长葛振林和战士宋学义、胡德林、胡福才，为掩护党政机关和群众转移，将日军引向易县狼牙山棋盘陀绝顶，弹尽粮绝后毁枪跳崖。马宝玉、胡德林、胡福才牺牲，葛振林、宋学义被树枝挂住负伤获救。 战斗细节与歼敌数字各书记载不一，待页码级核对。 On 25 September 1941, during a Japanese “mopping-up” campaign in the Jin-Cha-Ji border region, the 6th Squad of the 7th Company, 1st Regiment, 1st Sub-district—squad leader Ma Baoyu, deputy leader Ge Zhenlin, and soldiers Song Xueyi, Hu Delin, and Hu Fucai—drew Japanese troops toward the summit of Qipantuo on Langya Mountain, Yi County, to cover the evacuation of party and government organs and civilians. After running out of ammunition they destroyed their rifles and jumped from the cliff. Ma Baoyu, Hu Delin, and Hu Fucai died; Ge Zhenlin and Song Xueyi were caught by branches and survived with injuries. Details and enemy casualty figures vary between accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.summary: 1941年9月28日，日军早渊支队突入长沙市区，长沙一度失守。 On 28 September 1941 the Japanese Hayabuchi detachment entered Changsha, which briefly fell.
fields.description: 1941年9月27日日军第4师团一部与早渊支队渡过捞刀河、浏阳河，28日早渊支队一部自长沙东北角突入城内，当晚全部进入长沙；29日第4师团主力亦开进长沙。日军因粮弹消耗、后方被切断，10月1日开始撤退，10月8日退回新墙河北岸。日期据光明网与《长沙会战》。 On 27 September 1941 parts of the Japanese 4th Division and the Hayabuchi detachment crossed the Laodao and Liuyang rivers; on the 28th the Hayabuchi detachment entered Changsha from the northeast, and the 4th Division’s main force followed on the 29th. With supplies exhausted and its rear cut, the Japanese withdrew from 1 October and were back north of the Xinqiang by the 8th.

fields.description: 1941年9月29日凌晨，日军第3师团第29旅团攻入株洲，中国暂编第2军第8师在龙头铺、大观塘、荷塘铺一带反击，至29日10时将日军击破，日军向北撤退。株洲是第二次长沙会战日军南侵最南点。日期据株洲文明网与《长沙会战》。 In the early hours of 29 September 1941 the Japanese 3rd Division’s 29th Brigade entered Zhuzhou. The Chinese Provisional 8th Division counterattacked at Longtoupu, Daguantang and Hetangpu and by 10 a.m. had broken the Japanese, who withdrew north. Zhuzhou was the southernmost point of the Japanese advance in the second Changsha campaign.

summary.zh: 1941年11月2日，日军集中5万余人对沂蒙山区发动「铁壁合围」大扫荡。
summary.en: On 2 November 1941 more than 50,000 Japanese troops launched an "iron wall" sweep in the Yimeng Mountains.

fields.name: 日军沂蒙山「铁壁合围」 Japanese "Iron Wall" Sweep in the Yimeng Mountains
fields.summary: 1941年11月2日，日军集中5万余人对沂蒙山区发动「铁壁合围」大扫荡。 On 2 November 1941 more than 50,000 Japanese troops launched an "iron wall" sweep in the Yimeng Mountains.
fields.description: 1941年9月至10月，驻山东日军集中5万余人，在第12军司令官土桥一次指挥下，准备对沂蒙山区发动「铁壁合围」大扫荡。11月2日，八路军鲁中军区部队开始沂蒙山反「扫荡」作战。日军在根据地内烧杀抢夺，群众被害和被抓走1.4万余人，被抢走粮食160余万斤。此为多路合围，不绘单一路线。 From September to October 1941 the Japanese forces in Shandong massed more than 50,000 troops under the 12th Army for an "iron wall" sweep of the Yimeng Mountains. On 2 November the Eighth Route Army's central Shandong military district began counter-sweep operations. Japanese troops burned, killed and looted in the base area; more than 14,000 people were killed or abducted and over 800 tons of grain seized. As a multi-column encirclement, it is not drawn as a single route.

fields.description: 1941 年 11 月 4 日，日军第 731 部队飞机在常德城区投撒带有鼠疫菌的跳蚤、谷物等，随后常德爆发鼠疫，造成平民死亡。具体死亡人数各说不一，待页码级核对。本事件为细菌战惨案，不绘路线。 On 4 November 1941 aircraft of the Japanese Unit 731 spread plague-infected fleas and grain over central Changde, and a plague outbreak followed, causing civilian deaths. Accounts of the death toll differ and await page-level verification. This is a bacteriological-warfare atrocity and is not drawn as a route.

fields.description: 1941 年 11 月，八路军总部特务团在山西黎城黄崖洞与日军激战数日，保卫总部兵工厂。黄崖洞是八路军在敌后最大的兵工厂所在地，此战以少敌多，掩护了兵工厂设备和人员转移。 日期、参战兵力与战果为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In November 1941 the Eighth Route Army headquarters guard regiment fought Japanese forces for several days at Huangyadong, Licheng, Shanxi, defending the headquarters arsenal. Huangyadong housed the Eighth Route Army’s largest arsenal behind enemy lines; the outnumbered defenders covered the evacuation of equipment and personnel. Dates, force sizes, and results follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日本海军偷袭珍珠港，太平洋战争爆发，中国抗战与世界大战连为一体。
summary.en: The Japanese navy attacked Pearl Harbor, starting the Pacific War and linking China’s resistance to the global conflict.

fields.name: 珍珠港事件 Attack on Pearl Harbor
fields.place: 美国夏威夷珍珠港 Pearl Harbor, Hawaii, United States
fields.summary: 日本海军偷袭珍珠港，太平洋战争爆发，中国抗战与世界大战连为一体。 The Japanese navy attacked Pearl Harbor, starting the Pacific War and linking China’s resistance to the global conflict.
fields.description: 1941 年 12 月 7 日（夏威夷时间），日本海军袭击美国太平洋舰队基地珍珠港。美国随即对日宣战，太平洋战争爆发。中国战场成为世界反法西斯战争的重要组成部分。 本事件为国际事件，不绘制路线；日期按夏威夷时间标注，待史料校订。 On 7 December 1941 (Hawaii time), the Japanese navy attacked the US Pacific Fleet base at Pearl Harbor. The United States declared war on Japan, and the Pacific War began. The China theater became an important part of the global anti-fascist war. This is an international event with no route drawn; the date follows Hawaii time and awaits historical review.

fields.description: 1941 年 12 月 8 日，日军第 23 军第 38 师团在深圳集结并越过边境进攻香港，12 月 25 日港督杨慕琦投降。深圳自 1938 年 11 月起为日军控制的前沿。 On 8 December 1941 the 38th Division of the Japanese 23rd Army mustered at Shenzhen and crossed the border into Hong Kong; Governor Mark Young surrendered on 25 December. Shenzhen had been a Japanese-controlled outpost since November 1938.

Japan then controlled the settlement’s administration, finance and press. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 中国对日宣战 China Declares War on Japan
fields.summary: 太平洋战争爆发后，中国政府正式对日本、德国、意大利宣战。 After the Pacific War began, the Chinese government formally declared war on Japan, Germany, and Italy.
fields.description: 1941 年 12 月 9 日，中国国民政府对日本、德国、意大利正式宣战，并宣布与三国所订一切条约、协定、合同一律废止。中国抗战由此更紧密地融入世界反法西斯同盟。 本事件为政治事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述待史料校订。 On 9 December 1941, the Chinese National Government formally declared war on Japan, Germany, and Italy and annulled all treaties, agreements, and contracts with them. China’s resistance became more closely integrated into the global anti-fascist alliance. This is a political event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

summary.zh: 日军第三次进攻长沙，中国军队以“天炉战法”诱敌深入并反击，取得长沙大捷。
summary.en: Japan attacked Changsha for the third time; Chinese forces drew the Japanese in and counterattacked, winning a major victory.

fields.name: 第三次长沙会战 Third Battle of Changsha 长沙大捷 Changsha Victory 第三次长沙战役 Third Changsha Campaign
fields.summary: 日军第三次进攻长沙，中国军队以“天炉战法”诱敌深入并反击，取得长沙大捷。 Japan attacked Changsha for the third time; Chinese forces drew the Japanese in and counterattacked, winning a major victory.
fields.description: 1941 年 12 月 24 日，日军第十一军再次向长沙进攻。中国第九战区司令长官薛岳采取“天炉战法”，以一部兵力逐次抵抗、诱敌深入，主力从外围侧击、合围。日军攻入长沙外围后补给困难，被迫撤退；中国军队追击，至 1942 年 1 月中旬恢复原阵地。此役是太平洋战争爆发后中国正面战场的一次重要胜利。 本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。 On 24 December 1941, the Japanese 11th Army attacked Changsha again. Xue Yue, commander of China’s Ninth War Zone, employed the “heavenly furnace” tactic: a covering force resisted in stages and drew the Japanese inward while the main force struck the flanks and closed the ring. After reaching the outskirts of Changsha, the Japanese faced supply difficulties and were forced to retreat. Chinese forces pursued and restored the original line by mid-January 1942. It was an important victory on China’s frontal battlefield after the outbreak of the Pacific War. Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

fields.place: 湖南岳阳新墙河 Xinqiang River, Yueyang, Hunan
fields.summary: 1941年12月24日，日军第3、第6、第40师团进攻新墙河，第三次长沙会战开始。 On 24 December 1941 the Japanese 3rd, 6th and 40th Divisions attacked the Xinqiang River, opening the third Changsha campaign.
fields.description: 1941年12月24日，日军第11军以第3、第6、第40师团向新墙河发起进攻，中国第20军抗击后转移。日军随后强渡汨罗江，1942年1月1日进攻长沙，遭中国第10军等部顽强抵抗，1月4日撤退，1月15日退回新墙河北岸。日期据维基百科《第三次长沙会战》与《长沙会战》。 On 24 December 1941 the Japanese 11th Army attacked the Xinqiang River with the 3rd, 6th and 40th Divisions; the Chinese 20th Corps resisted and withdrew. The Japanese crossed the Miluo and attacked Changsha on 1 January 1942, but after stubborn resistance by the Chinese 10th Corps they withdrew on the 4th and were back north of the Xinqiang by the 15th.

fields.name: 香港沦陷 Fall of Hong Kong
fields.summary: 日军攻占香港，香港沦陷。 Japanese forces captured Hong Kong.
fields.description: 1941 年 12 月 8 日，日军第 38 师团自深圳进攻香港，经十八日战斗，12 月 25 日港督杨慕琦向日军投降，香港沦陷。香港沦陷使日军控制华南沿海，并切断中国经香港的补给线。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 8 December 1941 the Japanese 38th Division attacked Hong Kong from Shenzhen. After eighteen days of fighting, Governor Mark Young surrendered on 25 December and Hong Kong fell. The occupation gave Japan control of the South China coast and cut China’s supply route through Hong Kong. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

name.en: Fall of the Miluo River Line (December 1941)

summary.zh: 1941年12月26日，日军渡过汨罗江，向长沙推进。
summary.en: On 26 December 1941 the Japanese crossed the Miluo River and advanced on Changsha.

fields.name: 汨罗江防线失守（1941年12月） Fall of the Miluo River Line (December 1941)
fields.place: 湖南湘阴汨罗 Miluo, Xiangyin, Hunan
fields.summary: 1941年12月26日，日军渡过汨罗江，向长沙推进。 On 26 December 1941 the Japanese crossed the Miluo River and advanced on Changsha.
fields.description: 1941年12月26日，日军第3、第6、第40师团渡过汨罗江，向长沙推进。中国第9战区按“天炉战法”逐次抵抗，诱敌至长沙外围。日期据维基百科《第三次长沙会战》与《长沙会战》。 On 26 December 1941 the Japanese 3rd, 6th and 40th Divisions crossed the Miluo River and advanced on Changsha. The Chinese Ninth War Zone fought a delaying action under its “heavenly furnace” plan, drawing the Japanese toward Changsha’s outskirts.

fields.name: 日军进攻长沙（1942年1月） Japanese Attack on Changsha (January 1942)
fields.summary: 1942年1月1日，日军第3、第6、第40师团进攻长沙，遭中国第10军顽强抵抗。 On 1 January 1942 the Japanese 3rd, 6th and 40th Divisions attacked Changsha and met stubborn resistance from the Chinese 10th Corps.
fields.description: 1942年1月1日，日军第3、第6、第40师团进攻长沙，中国第10军依托城垣和岳麓山炮兵顽强抵抗，日军猛攻4日未能破城，1月4日撤退。中国军队追击，1月15日日军退回新墙河北岸。这是第三次长沙会战的转折点。日期据维基百科《第三次长沙会战》与《长沙会战》。 On 1 January 1942 the Japanese 3rd, 6th and 40th Divisions attacked Changsha. The Chinese 10th Corps, supported by artillery on Yuelu Mountain, held the city walls; after four days of assault the Japanese withdrew on 4 January. The Chinese pursued, and by 15 January the Japanese were back north of the Xinqiang. This was the turning point of the third Changsha campaign.

fields.name: 中国远征军入缅 Chinese Expeditionary Force Enters Burma
fields.summary: 中国远征军自云南入缅，与盟军协同保卫滇缅公路。 The Chinese Expeditionary Force entered Burma from Yunnan to help defend the Burma Road alongside Allied forces.
fields.description: 1942 年初，为保卫滇缅公路和支援盟军，中国远征军陆续自云南入缅，与英军协同作战。远征军在缅北、缅中地区与日军激战，后因战局不利而撤退。 本事件日期取 1942 年 2 月的示意时间点，具体入缅日期待史料校订。 In early 1942, to defend the Burma Road and support the Allies, the Chinese Expeditionary Force entered Burma from Yunnan and fought alongside British troops. It engaged Japanese forces in northern and central Burma before withdrawing under unfavorable conditions. The date is an illustrative point in February 1942; the exact entry dates await historical review.

fields.place: 海南东方八所 Basuo, Dongfang, Hainan
fields.summary: 石碌—八所铁路铺轨完成，第一列矿石车抵达八所港。 The Shilu–Basuo railway was completed and the first ore train reached Basuo port.
fields.description: 为把石碌铁矿的矿石运到八所港装船，日军修建石碌—八所铁路，全长约 52 公里。1942 年 3 月铺轨完成，3 月 23 日第一列运矿车由石碌抵达八所。据日方资料，石碌铁矿 1941—1945 年开采约 69.5 万吨、运出约 41 万吨；数字待页码级核对。 To move ore from the Shilu mine to Basuo port, Japan built the roughly 52-km Shilu–Basuo railway. Track laying was completed in March 1942, and on 23 March the first ore train ran from Shilu to Basuo. According to Japanese sources, the Shilu mine produced about 695,000 tons and shipped about 410,000 tons in 1941–1945; these figures await page-level verification.

fields.summary: 日军第 15 军占领曼德勒，缅甸战役结束。 The Japanese 15th Army took Mandalay, ending the Burma campaign.
fields.description: 1942 年 1 月日军第 15 军自泰国进攻缅甸，3 月 8 日占仰光，5 月 1 日占曼德勒，中国远征军与英军退往印度、云南，缅甸战役结束。 In January 1942 the Japanese 15th Army invaded Burma from Thailand, took Rangoon on 8 March and Mandalay on 1 May; the Chinese expeditionary force and British withdrew to India and Yunnan, ending the campaign.

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

name.en: Counter-Offensive against the May Day “Mopping-Up” in Central Hebei

place.zh: 河北冀中（河间、饶阳一带）

summary.zh: 日军 5 万余人“拉网扫荡”冀中，冀中军民艰苦反“扫荡”。
summary.en: More than 50,000 Japanese troops conducted a dragnet “mopping-up” of central Hebei; local forces and civilians fought a costly counter-campaign.

fields.name: 冀中反“五一大扫荡” Counter-Offensive against the May Day “Mopping-Up” in Central Hebei 五一大扫荡 May Day Mopping-Up
fields.place: 河北冀中（河间、饶阳一带） Central Hebei (Hejian–Raoyang area)
fields.summary: 日军 5 万余人“拉网扫荡”冀中，冀中军民艰苦反“扫荡”。 More than 50,000 Japanese troops conducted a dragnet “mopping-up” of central Hebei; local forces and civilians fought a costly counter-campaign.
fields.description: 1942 年 5 月 1 日起，日军华北方面军调集 5 万余人，对冀中抗日根据地发动“五一大扫荡”，采取“铁壁合围”“拉网清剿”战法。冀中军区部队和民兵在极端困难条件下分散游击、坚持反“扫荡”，但根据地大部被分割，部队和群众损失严重，冀中抗战进入最艰苦阶段。 兵力与损失数字各书记载不一，待页码级核对。 From 1 May 1942 the Japanese North China Area Army committed more than 50,000 troops to a “May Day mopping-up” of the central Hebei base area, using “iron-wall encirclement” and dragnet search tactics. Jizhong Military Region troops and militia dispersed into guerrilla warfare and persevered, but most of the base area was cut up and military and civilian losses were severe; the resistance in central Hebei entered its hardest period. Force and loss figures vary between accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

name.en: May Day Sweep in Central Hebei

summary.zh: 日军华北方面军对冀中根据地发动“五一大扫荡”。
summary.en: The Japanese North China Area Army launched the “May Day Sweep” against the Central Hebei base area.

fields.name: 冀中五一大扫荡 May Day Sweep in Central Hebei
fields.place: 河北冀中（深县一带） Central Hebei (around Shenxian)
fields.summary: 日军华北方面军对冀中根据地发动“五一大扫荡”。 The Japanese North China Area Army launched the “May Day Sweep” against the Central Hebei base area.
fields.description: 1942 年 5 月 1 日，日军华北方面军调集第 110 师团、第 27 师团及伪军等部，对冀中抗日根据地发动大规模“扫荡”，企图围歼八路军冀中军区部队。八路军采取分散游击、地道战等方式坚持，根据地遭受严重损失。日期与兵力为通行说法，待页码级核对。本事件为战役性“扫荡”，不绘单线。 On 1 May 1942 the Japanese North China Area Army deployed the 110th and 27th Divisions and puppet troops in a large-scale sweep of the Central Hebei anti-Japanese base area, aiming to destroy the Eighth Route Army’s Central Hebei Military District. The Eighth Route Army dispersed into guerrilla and tunnel warfare; the base area suffered heavy losses. Dates and strength follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification. As a campaign-level sweep, it is not drawn as a single route.

name.en: Japanese “Sweep” of the Qiongya Base Area

summary.zh: 日军对琼崖抗日根据地发动“扫荡”，琼崖独立总队反“扫荡”。
summary.en: Japanese forces launched a “sweep” against the Qiongya anti-Japanese base area, and the Qiongya Independent Corps countered it.

fields.name: 日军“扫荡”琼崖根据地 Japanese “Sweep” of the Qiongya Base Area
fields.summary: 日军对琼崖抗日根据地发动“扫荡”，琼崖独立总队反“扫荡”。 Japanese forces launched a “sweep” against the Qiongya anti-Japanese base area, and the Qiongya Independent Corps countered it.
fields.description: 1942 年 5 月，日军调集海口、嘉积、那大等据点兵力，对琼山、文昌、定安一带的琼崖抗日根据地发动“扫荡”，企图消灭琼崖独立总队主力。琼崖独立总队以分散游击、民众自卫等方式反“扫荡”，坚持根据地。具体兵力、战斗次数与起止日期待页码级核对。本事件为“扫荡”阶段节点，不绘单线。 In May 1942 Japanese forces drawn from Haikou, Jiaji, Nada and other garrisons launched a “sweep” against the Qiongya base area in Qiongshan, Wenchang and Ding’an, aiming to destroy the main force of the Qiongya Independent Corps. The Corps resisted through dispersed guerrilla warfare and local self-defense. Strength, number of engagements and exact dates await page-level verification. This is a phase marker and is not drawn as a single route.

summary.en: The Japanese 56th Division invaded western Yunnan from Burma and occupied Wanding.

fields.summary: 日军第 56 师团自缅甸侵入滇西，占领畹町。 The Japanese 56th Division invaded western Yunnan from Burma and occupied Wanding.
fields.description: 1942 年 5 月，日军第 56 师团自缅甸向中国云南边境推进。5 月 3 日，日军占领畹町，随后沿滇缅公路北犯龙陵、腾冲。中国远征军撤退，滇西沦陷。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In May 1942 the Japanese 56th Division advanced from Burma toward the Yunnan border. On 3 May it occupied Wanding and then advanced north along the Burma Road toward Longling and Tengchong. The Chinese Expeditionary Force withdrew and western Yunnan fell. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

fields.description: 1942年5月3日，日军第56师团由缅甸攻入畹町，随即占领遮放，沿滇缅公路北上。遮放为滇缅公路要镇，失守后日军直趋芒市、龙陵。日期据《日军滇西暴行铁证如山》与《日军在滇西设慰安所30余个》。 On 3 May 1942 the Japanese 56th Division entered Wanding from Burma and quickly took Zhefang on the Burma Road, then drove north toward Mangshi and Longling.

fields.description: 1942 年 5 月 4 日，日军第 56 师团一部占领龙陵，随后继续向惠通桥推进。中国军队炸毁惠通桥，阻止日军东渡怒江。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 4 May 1942 a detachment of the Japanese 56th Division occupied Longling and continued toward the Huitong Bridge. Chinese forces blew up the bridge to stop the Japanese from crossing the Salween. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

fields.summary: 1942年5月4日，日军第56师团占领芒市。 On 4 May 1942 the Japanese 56th Division occupied Mangshi.

Mangshi was the seat of the Luxi administration and its loss opened the road to Longling.

summary.en: On 4 May 1942 the Japanese occupied Yingjiang (Ganya).

fields.name: 盈江沦陷 Fall of Yingjiang
fields.summary: 1942年5月4日，日军占领盈江（干崖）。 On 4 May 1942 the Japanese occupied Yingjiang (Ganya).
fields.description: 1942年5月4日，日军占领盈江（干崖）。盈江为德宏北部土司地区，失守后干崖土司刀京版组织滇西边区自卫军坚持游击。日期据《滇西土司的抗战》与《日军在滇西设慰安所30余个》。 On 4 May 1942 the Japanese occupied Yingjiang (Ganya) in northern Dehong. fields.name: 保山大轰炸 Bombing of Baoshan
fields.summary: 1942年5月4日至5日，日军飞机54架轰炸保山，造成重大伤亡。 On 4–5 May 1942 fifty-four Japanese aircraft bombed Baoshan, causing heavy casualties.
fields.description: 1942年5月4日中午，日军27架飞机轰炸保山，半小时后第二批27架再次轰炸；5月5日54架飞机继续轰炸。保山城几乎被毁，死伤万余人，是滇西抗战中的重大惨案。日期据《勿忘历史：1942年5月4日，日军轰炸云南保山》与《日军滇西暴行铁证如山》。 At noon on 4 May 1942 twenty-seven Japanese aircraft bombed Baoshan, followed half an hour later by another twenty-seven; on 5 May fifty-four aircraft attacked again. The city was almost destroyed and more than 10,000 were killed or wounded, one of the worst atrocities of the western Yunnan war.

fields.summary: 日军进抵惠通桥，中国军队炸桥阻敌。 Japanese forces reached the Huitong Bridge, which Chinese troops destroyed to block their advance.
fields.description: 1942 年 5 月 5 日，日军先头部队进抵怒江惠通桥，中国守军炸毁桥梁，阻止日军东进。此后中日两军隔怒江对峙，滇西沦陷区形成。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 5 May 1942 Japanese advance troops reached the Huitong Bridge over the Salween; Chinese defenders blew up the bridge and halted the Japanese eastward advance. The two sides then faced each other across the Salween, and the occupied zone in western Yunnan took shape. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 腾冲沦陷 Fall of Tengchong
fields.summary: 1942年5月10日，日军第56师团侵入腾冲县城。 On 10 May 1942 the Japanese 56th Division entered Tengchong.
fields.description: 1942年5月10日午后，日军292人由龙陵方向进入腾冲县城，不费一枪一弹占领全城。腾冲为滇西边城，失守后怒江以西约3万平方公里国土全部沦陷。日期据《日军滇西暴行铁证如山》与方国瑜《抗日战争滇西战事篇》。 In the afternoon of 10 May 1942, 292 Japanese troops entered Tengchong from Longling and occupied the city without a shot. With the fall of this border town, some 30,000 square kilometres west of the Salween were lost.

fields.description: 1942 年 5 月 15 日日军第 13 军自杭州、萧山出动，沿浙赣路西进；南昌方面的日军同时东进，两路在横峰会合，7 月日军撤退，浙赣会战结束。杭州自 1937 年 12 月即为日军占领。 On 15 May 1942 the Japanese 13th Army moved out of Hangzhou and Xiaoshan west along the Zhejiang–Jiangxi railway while the Nanchang force moved east; the columns met at Hengfeng, and the Japanese withdrew in July, ending the campaign. summary.zh: 八路军总部在十字岭突围，副参谋长左权牺牲。
summary.en: The Eighth Route Army headquarters broke out at Shiziling; deputy chief of staff Zuo Quan was killed.

fields.name: 十字岭战斗 Battle of Shiziling
fields.summary: 八路军总部在十字岭突围，副参谋长左权牺牲。 The Eighth Route Army headquarters broke out at Shiziling; deputy chief of staff Zuo Quan was killed.
fields.description: 1942 年 5 月，日军对太行根据地进行“扫荡”。5 月 25 日，八路军总部和中共中央北方局机关在山西辽县十字岭一带遭日军合围，副参谋长左权在指挥突围时牺牲，年仅 37 岁。 日期、地点与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In May 1942 Japanese forces conducted a “mopping-up” campaign in the Taihang base area. On 25 May the Eighth Route Army headquarters and the CCP Northern Bureau were encircled near Shiziling, Liaoxian, Shanxi; deputy chief of staff Zuo Quan was killed while directing the breakout at the age of 37. Dates, location, and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.name: 北疃惨案 Beituan Massacre
fields.place: 河北定县北疃 Beituan, Dingxian, Hebei
fields.summary: 日军在冀中北疃村施放毒气，屠杀村民和地道中的军民。 Japanese forces used poison gas in Beituan village in Central Hebei, killing villagers and soldiers sheltering in tunnels.
fields.description: 1942 年 5 月 27 日，日军在“五一大扫荡”中对河北定县北疃村施放毒气，杀害躲避在地道中的村民和八路军伤病员。具体死难人数各说不一，待页码级核对。本事件为惨案，不绘路线。 On 27 May 1942, during the “May Day Sweep,” Japanese forces used poison gas in Beituan village, Dingxian, Hebei, killing villagers and Eighth Route Army wounded sheltering in tunnels. Accounts of the death toll differ and await page-level verification. As a massacre, this event is not drawn as a route.

fields.description: 5月28日，金华、兰溪同日沦陷。仅据1942年年底统计，金华全县被强奸的妇女就有1370人。日期据《浙赣会战》与《衢州抗战大事记》，待页码级核对。 Jinhua and Lanxi fell on the same day, 28 May. fields.summary: 日军攻占上饶，浙赣铁路东段被打通。 Japanese forces captured Shangrao, opening the eastern section of the Zhejiang–Jiangxi railway.
fields.description: 1942 年 6 月 14 日，日军第 22 师团等部占领上饶，第三战区长官部所在地失守。7 月 1 日，东西两路日军在横峰会合，浙赣铁路被打通。日期据浙赣会战史料，待页码级核对。 On 14 June 1942 the Japanese 22nd Division and other units occupied Shangrao, seat of the Chinese 3rd War Zone headquarters. fields.name: 第5军第200师退回滇西 200th Division Returns to Western Yunnan
fields.summary: 缅甸战败后，第5军第200师退回滇西，新编第22师退往印度。 After the Burma defeat the 200th Division returned to western Yunnan while the New 22nd Division withdrew to India.
fields.description: 1942 年 5 月缅甸战局逆转，第5军被迫撤退。第200师经缅北退回云南保山一带，新编第22师随杜聿明部退往印度。撤退途中损失惨重。 路线为示意简化，仅画第200师回滇主线；新22师退印另见盟军线。日期待史料校订。 In May 1942 the Burma front collapsed and the 5th Army was forced to retreat. The 200th Division returned to the Baoshan area of Yunnan, while the New 22nd Division withdrew to India with Du Yuming’s headquarters. Losses during the retreat were severe. Illustrative simplified route showing only the 200th Division’s return; the New 22nd Division’s withdrawal to India is covered by the Allied layer. Dates await historical review.

fields.name: 温州第二次沦陷 Second Fall of Wenzhou
fields.summary: 日军小薗江混成旅团沿金华—丽水—温州公路南犯，占领温州。 The Japanese Kogiso Mixed Brigade advanced south along the Jinhua–Lishui–Wenzhou road and occupied Wenzhou.
fields.description: 1942 年 7 月，日军驻上海的第 13 军所属小薗江混成旅团近千人，沿金华、丽水、青田、温州公路南犯，7 月 1 日占丽水、9 日占青田、11 日占温州，并一度盘踞乐清磐石和瑞安县城，8 月 15 日撤走。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In July 1942 the Japanese 13th Army’s Kogiso Mixed Brigade, about 1,000 strong and based in Shanghai, advanced south along the Jinhua–Lishui–Qingtian–Wenzhou road, occupying Lishui on 1 July, Qingtian on 9 July and Wenzhou on 11 July. It briefly held Pan’shi in Yueqing and Rui’an county town before withdrawing on 15 August. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 缅甸战局失利后，中国远征军部分部队撤往印度，后整编为中国驻印军。
summary.en: After setbacks in Burma, part of the Chinese Expeditionary Force withdrew to India and was later reorganized as the Chinese Army in India.

fields.name: 远征军撤往印度 Expeditionary Force Withdraws to India
fields.summary: 缅甸战局失利后，中国远征军部分部队撤往印度，后整编为中国驻印军。 After setbacks in Burma, part of the Chinese Expeditionary Force withdrew to India and was later reorganized as the Chinese Army in India.
fields.description: 1942 年 5 月前后，缅甸战局恶化，中国远征军部分部队经野人山等路线撤往印度，损失惨重；另一部分退回云南。撤至印度的部队后来在兰姆伽整训，整编为中国驻印军。 本事件日期为示意时间点，撤退路线与时间待史料校订。 Around May 1942, as the situation in Burma deteriorated, part of the Chinese Expeditionary Force withdrew to India through difficult routes including the Naga Hills, suffering heavy losses; another part returned to Yunnan. The troops in India were later reorganized and trained at Ramgarh as the Chinese Army in India. The date is an illustrative point; retreat routes and timing await historical review.

summary.zh: 缅甸战败后，第5军新22师经野人山退往印度雷多。
summary.en: After the Burma defeat the New 22nd Division of the 5th Army withdrew through the Naga Hills to Ledo, India.

fields.name: 新22师退往印度 New 22nd Division Withdraws to India
fields.summary: 缅甸战败后，第5军新22师经野人山退往印度雷多。 After the Burma defeat the New 22nd Division of the 5th Army withdrew through the Naga Hills to Ledo, India.
fields.description: 1942 年 5 月缅甸战局逆转后，第5军新22师随杜聿明部经野人山向印度撤退，8 月抵达印度雷多（利多）。撤退途中损失惨重，后改编为中国驻印军。 路线为示意简化，日期取通行说法，待史料校订。 After the Burma front collapsed in May 1942, the New 22nd Division of the 5th Army withdrew with Du Yuming’s headquarters through the Naga Hills toward India and reached Ledo in August. Losses during the retreat were severe; the division was later reorganized into the Chinese Army in India. Illustrative simplified route; dates follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

place.zh: 浙江衢州、金华、玉山一带

summary.zh: 日军在浙赣战役撤退时散布细菌，造成疫病流行。
summary.en: Retreating Japanese forces spread bacteria during the Zhejiang–Jiangxi campaign, causing epidemics.

fields.name: 浙赣细菌战 Bacteriological Warfare in the Zhejiang–Jiangxi Campaign
fields.place: 浙江衢州、金华、玉山一带 Quzhou, Jinhua and Yushan area, Zhejiang
fields.summary: 日军在浙赣战役撤退时散布细菌，造成疫病流行。 Retreating Japanese forces spread bacteria during the Zhejiang–Jiangxi campaign, causing epidemics.
fields.description: 1942 年 8 月，日军在浙赣战役撤退过程中，在衢州、金华、玉山一带散布鼠疫、霍乱、伤寒等细菌，造成军民感染死亡。具体死亡人数各说不一，待页码级核对。本事件为细菌战惨案，不绘路线。 In August 1942, while withdrawing from the Zhejiang–Jiangxi campaign, Japanese forces spread plague, cholera and typhoid bacteria around Quzhou, Jinhua and Yushan, causing military and civilian infections and deaths. Accounts of the death toll differ and await page-level verification. This is a bacteriological-warfare atrocity and is not drawn as a route.

summary.en: In November 1942 Japanese forces attacked Ma'anshan in Zichuan; Eighth Route Army wounded, civilians and defenders held out before the position fell.

fields.name: 马鞍山保卫战 Defence of Ma'anshan
fields.place: 山东淄川马鞍山 Ma'anshan, Zichuan, Shandong
fields.summary: 1942年11月，日军围攻淄川马鞍山，八路军伤病员与守军坚守后失守。 In November 1942 Japanese forces attacked Ma'anshan in Zichuan; Eighth Route Army wounded, civilians and defenders held out before the position fell.
fields.description: 1942年11月，日军对沂蒙山区发动「扫荡」，并出动大批兵力围攻淄川马鞍山。山上八路军伤病员、家属和守军凭险坚守，最终失守。马鞍山是扼沂蒙山区入清河区的门户，此战为日军扫荡中的山地攻防战，不绘单一路线。 In November 1942 Japanese forces swept the Yimeng Mountains and sent a large force against Ma'anshan in Zichuan. Eighth Route Army wounded, family members and defenders held the mountain position before it fell. Ma'anshan was the gateway from the Yimeng Mountains into the Qinghe area; this mountain battle during the Japanese sweep is not drawn as a single route.

summary.zh: 1943年2月10日，日军800余人由滇缅铁路附属公路进犯孟定。
summary.en: On 10 February 1943 more than 800 Japanese troops advanced on Mengding via the Burma railway road.

fields.name: 日军进犯孟定 Japanese Incursion into Mengding
fields.summary: 1943年2月10日，日军800余人由滇缅铁路附属公路进犯孟定。 On 10 February 1943 more than 800 Japanese troops advanced on Mengding via the Burma railway road.
fields.description: 1943年2月10日，日军800多人及伪军、挑夫1000多人共2000多人，由滇缅铁路附属公路进犯孟定镇，烧毁土司衙门和8万斤仓储粮，抢走黄金96两，打死3人、打伤1人。孟定为滇西南边境要镇，日军此次为短期窜扰，未长期占领。日期据人民网《临沧抗战纪事》。 On 10 February 1943 more than 800 Japanese troops with about 1,000 puppet soldiers and porters—over 2,000 men—advanced on Mengding via the Burma railway road, burning the chieftain’s office and 80,000 jin of grain, seizing 96 taels of gold and killing or wounding several civilians. It was a short raid, not a permanent occupation.

name.en: Japanese Landing on the Leizhou Peninsula

summary.zh: 日军独立混成第 23 旅团在雷州半岛东海岸登陆。
summary.en: The Japanese 23rd Independent Mixed Brigade landed on the east coast of the Leizhou Peninsula.

fields.name: 日军登陆雷州半岛 Japanese Landing on the Leizhou Peninsula
fields.place: 广东雷州通明港 Tongming Port, Leizhou, Guangdong
fields.summary: 日军独立混成第 23 旅团在雷州半岛东海岸登陆。 The Japanese 23rd Independent Mixed Brigade landed on the east coast of the Leizhou Peninsula.
fields.description: 1943 年 2 月 16 日晨，日军独立混成第 23 旅团 1600 余人，在海军舰艇和飞机掩护下，于雷州半岛东海岸通明、下岚两港登陆，随即进攻海康县城。此次作战旨在封锁中国海上交通、掠夺物资并支援太平洋战场。日期与兵力为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On the morning of 16 February 1943, more than 1,600 troops of the Japanese 23rd Independent Mixed Brigade, covered by warships and aircraft, landed at Tongming and Xialan on the east coast of the Leizhou Peninsula and advanced on Haikang county town. The operation aimed to blockade China’s maritime traffic, seize supplies and support the Pacific theater. Dates and strength follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.name: 雷州半岛沦陷 Fall of the Leizhou Peninsula
fields.summary: 日军占领海康、遂溪，雷州半岛沦陷。 Japanese forces occupied Haikang and Suixi, and the Leizhou Peninsula fell.
fields.description: 1943 年 2 月 16 日日军登陆后，当日占领海康县城，17 日占客路，18 至 19 日相继占领遂溪城月、洋青及遂溪县城。雷州半岛成为日军封锁华南沿海、掠夺物资的占领区。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 After landing on 16 February 1943, Japanese forces occupied Haikang county town the same day, Khelu on 17 February, and Chengyue, Yangqing and Suixi county town on 18–19 February. The Leizhou Peninsula became an occupied zone for blockading the South China coast and seizing supplies. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

summary.en: Japanese naval landing forces occupied Xiyang, and Guangzhouwan fell.

fields.name: 日军占领广州湾 Japanese Occupation of Guangzhouwan
fields.place: 广东广州湾西营（今湛江霞山） Xiyang, Guangzhouwan (present-day Xiashan, Zhanjiang), Guangdong
fields.summary: 日军海军陆战队占领广州湾西营，广州湾沦陷。 Japanese naval landing forces occupied Xiyang, and Guangzhouwan fell.
fields.description: 1943 年 2 月 16 日，日军一部 300 余人在广州湾西营登陆，窜占麻章、赤坎；21 日，日本海军陆战队在西营码头登陆，占领西营市区。法国广州湾租借地当局与日军签订移交协定，广州湾沦陷。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 16 February 1943 a Japanese force of more than 300 landed at Xiyang in Guangzhouwan and occupied Mazhang and Chikan; on 21 February Japanese naval landing forces came ashore at Xiyang pier and occupied the urban area. The French authorities of the Guangzhouwan leased territory signed a transfer agreement with Japan, and Guangzhouwan fell. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 榆林—北黎铁路建成 Completion of the Yulin–Beili Railway
fields.place: 海南东方北黎 Beili, Dongfang, Hainan
fields.summary: 榆林—北黎铁路基本完工，在北黎与石八线接轨。 The Yulin–Beili railway was basically completed and joined the Shilu–Basuo line at Beili.
fields.description: 在修建石八线的同时，日军为连接榆林海军基地与北黎、八所等港口，修建榆林—北黎铁路，全长约 187.9 公里。1943 年 3 月基本完工，并在北黎与石八线接轨，形成海南西部铁路骨架。具体通车日待页码级核对。 While building the Shilu–Basuo line, Japan also built the roughly 187.9-km Yulin–Beili railway to link the Yulin naval base with Beili, Basuo and other ports. It was basically completed in March 1943 and joined the Shilu–Basuo line at Beili, forming the railway framework of western Hainan. The exact opening date awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 1943年3月17日，日军6000余人分8路扫荡巢无中心区。
summary.en: On 17 March 1943 more than 6,000 Japanese and puppet troops swept the Chaoxian–Wuwei centre in eight columns.

fields.name: 日军扫荡巢无中心区 Japanese Sweep of the Chaoxian–Wuwei Centre
fields.summary: 1943年3月17日，日军6000余人分8路扫荡巢无中心区。 On 17 March 1943 more than 6,000 Japanese and puppet troops swept the Chaoxian–Wuwei centre in eight columns.
fields.description: 3月17日，日军第116师团和第115师团一部及伪军共6000余人，由南京、芜湖、铜陵等地分8路「扫荡」皖中抗日根据地巢（县）无（为）中心区。新四军第七师在地方武装配合下，经两周激战，毙伤日伪军300余人，粉碎了「扫荡」。此为多路扫荡，不绘单一路线。 On 17 March more than 6,000 troops of the Japanese 116th Division, part of the 115th Division and puppet forces swept the Chaoxian–Wuwei centre of the Central Anhui base area in eight columns from Nanjing, Wuhu and Tongling. The New Fourth Army's 7th Division, with local forces, fought for two weeks, killed or wounded more than 300 Japanese and puppet troops and broke the sweep. As a multi-column operation, it is not drawn as a single route.

fields.description: 1943 年春，第18军调防宜昌以西石牌要塞，第11师担任核心守备。5 月鄂西会战爆发，第11师在石牌与日军激战，守住三峡门户。 路线为示意简化，日期取通行说法，待史料校订。 In spring 1943 the 18th Army moved to the Shipai fortress west of Yichang, with the 11th Division holding the core positions. When the Western Hubei campaign began in May, the 11th Division fought bitterly at Shipai and held the gateway to the Three Gorges. fields.description: 1943年4月起，日伪对苏中四分区全面「清乡」，在清乡区边沿构筑竹篱笆封锁线，区内据点增至200余处；4月11日「苏北地区清乡主任公署」在南通城成立。此为过程性统治事件，日期取4月开始，不绘路线。 From April 1943 Japanese and puppet forces carried out a full clearance campaign in the Fourth Sub-district, building bamboo blockade fences along its edges and increasing strongpoints inside to more than 200; on 11 April the "North Jiangsu Clearance Administration" was established in Nantong. This is a process event dated to the start of April and is not drawn as a route.

summary.en: Japanese forces attacked western Hubei; Chinese troops stubbornly defended the Shipai fortress area and thwarted the offensive.

fields.name: 鄂西会战 Battle of West Hubei 石牌保卫战 Defense of Shipai
fields.place: 湖北宜昌石牌 Shipai, Yichang, Hubei
fields.summary: 日军进攻鄂西，中国军队在石牌要塞一带顽强阻击，挫败日军攻势。 Japanese forces attacked western Hubei; Chinese troops stubbornly defended the Shipai fortress area and thwarted the offensive.
fields.description: 1943 年 5 月，日军第十一军向鄂西地区进攻，企图夺取石牌要塞、威胁重庆。中国第六战区部队依托长江三峡地形顽强抵抗，在石牌一带与日军激战，最终迫使日军撤退。此役是抗战后期正面战场的一次重要防御胜利。 本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。 In May 1943, the Japanese 11th Army attacked western Hubei, seeking to seize the Shipai fortress and threaten Chongqing. Chinese troops of the Sixth War Zone used the terrain of the Three Gorges to resist stubbornly, fighting fierce actions around Shipai and eventually forcing the Japanese to withdraw. It was an important defensive victory on China’s frontal battlefield in the later war years. Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

fields.description: 1943 年 5 月 5 日日军第 11 军自荆州、石首一带渡江南犯，鄂西会战爆发；中国军队在石牌、渔洋关一线阻击，6 月日军退回原防。荆州自 1940 年 6 月即为日军占领。 On 5 May 1943 the Japanese 11th Army crossed the Yangtze from the Jingzhou–Shishou area, opening the western Hubei battle; the Chinese army held at Shipai and Yuyangguan, and the Japanese withdrew in June. fields.description: 1943 年 5 月 9 日至 12 日，日军在湖南南县厂窖地区屠杀平民和逃难群众，制造厂窖惨案。具体死难人数各说不一，通行说法为三万余人，待页码级核对。本事件为惨案，不绘路线。 From 9 to 12 May 1943 Japanese forces massacred civilians and refugees in the Changjiao area of Nanxian, Hunan. Accounts of the death toll differ; the conventional figure is over 30,000 and awaits page-level verification. As a massacre, this event is not drawn as a route.

summary.en: On 14 May 1943 the Japanese 3rd Division captured Gong’an.

fields.name: 公安沦陷 Fall of Gong’an
fields.summary: 1943年5月14日，日军第3师团攻占公安。 On 14 May 1943 the Japanese 3rd Division captured Gong’an.
fields.description: 1943年5月12日日军第3师团进攻公安，中国第87军第43师弃守西撤，14日日军占领公安。公安失守后，日军第3、第13师团合围松滋、枝江间中国第10集团军。日期据《鄂西会战综述》与《鄂西会战纪实》。 On 12 May 1943 the Japanese 3rd Division attacked Gong’an; the Chinese 43rd Division of the 87th Corps abandoned it and withdrew west, and the Japanese occupied the town on the 14th. The Japanese 3rd and 13th Divisions then closed on the Chinese 10th Army Group between Songzi and Zhijiang.

fields.name: 松滋沦陷 Fall of Songzi
fields.summary: 1943年5月18日，日军第3师团攻占松滋。 On 18 May 1943 the Japanese 3rd Division captured Songzi.
fields.description: 1943年5月18日拂晓，日军第3师团攻占松滋。松滋为鄂西山地入口，失守后日军西取渔洋关、长阳，威胁石牌。日期据《鄂西会战综述》与《鄂西会战纪实》。 At dawn on 18 May 1943 the Japanese 3rd Division took Songzi, the entrance to the western Hubei mountains. The Japanese then drove west toward Yuyangguan and Changyang, threatening Shipai.

fields.description: 1943年5月22日，日军野沟支队与伪第29师攻占宜都。宜都为长江南岸要地，失守后日军第39师团从云池渡江，向宜昌西南的偏岩急进。日期据《鄂西会战综述》与《鄂西会战纪实》。 On 22 May 1943 the Japanese Nogawa detachment and the puppet 29th Division took Yidu, a key point on the south bank of the Yangtze. The Japanese 39th Division then crossed at Yunchi and drove on Pianyan southwest of Yichang.

fields.summary: 1943年5月24日，日军第3师团攻占长阳。 On 24 May 1943 the Japanese 3rd Division captured Changyang.
fields.description: 1943年5月24日中午，日军第3师团攻占长阳。长阳为清江要地，失守后日军第3、第13、第39师团向石牌、清江间中国江防军猛攻。日期据《鄂西会战综述》与《鄂西会战纪实》。 At noon on 24 May 1943 the Japanese 3rd Division took Changyang on the Qing River. fields.description: 1943 年 5 月鄂西会战中，第18军第11师（师长胡琏）守石牌要塞，与日军第3、第39师团激战，守住三峡门户。石牌保卫战被称为“东方的斯大林格勒”。 日期与主官为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In the Western Hubei campaign of May 1943 the 11th Division of the 18th Army under Hu Lian held the Shipai fortress against the Japanese 3rd and 39th Divisions, guarding the gateway to the Three Gorges. fields.name: 日军进犯沧源 Japanese Incursion into Cangyuan
fields.summary: 1943年6月27日，日军第56搜索联队一部进犯沧源。 On 27 June 1943 part of the Japanese 56th Reconnaissance Regiment advanced into Cangyuan.
fields.description: 1943年6月27日至7月3日，日军第56搜索联队一个大队700多人及1000多伪军、挑夫近2000人，从缅甸户板经沧源县蛮鸠向耿马县进犯，沿途烧毁孟定街、沙坝、芒掌等6个寨子200多户和3座佛寺。日期据人民网《临沧抗战纪事》与维基百科《沧源抗日斗争》。 From 27 June to 3 July 1943 a battalion of the Japanese 56th Reconnaissance Regiment—over 700 men with more than 1,000 puppet troops and porters—advanced from Hupan in Burma through Manjiu in Cangyuan toward Gengma, burning more than 200 homes in six villages and three Buddhist temples. It was a raid, not a permanent occupation.

fields.name: 缅北反攻开始 Start of the Northern Burma Counteroffensive
fields.summary: 中国驻印军与盟军自印度利多出发，向缅北日军发起反攻。 Chinese forces in India and Allied troops advanced from Ledo to counterattack Japanese forces in northern Burma.
fields.description: 1943 年 10 月起，中国驻印军新一军等部与美军部队自印度利多出发，向缅北推进，先后进行胡康河谷、孟拱河谷等战役，为打通中印公路创造条件。 本事件日期为示意时间点，作战经过待史料校订。 Beginning in October 1943, the Chinese Army in India, including the New 1st Army, and US units advanced from Ledo into northern Burma, fighting in the Hukawng and Mogaung valleys and helping to open the Ledo Road. The date is an illustrative point; operational details await historical review.

fields.summary: 第74军由长沙方向调防常德，随后参加常德会战。 The 74th Army moved from the Changsha area to Changde and fought in the Battle of Changde.
fields.description: 1943 年秋，第74军由长沙方向调防常德，第57师守常德城，军主力在外围策应。11 月常德会战爆发，第57师苦守孤城，第74军等部在外围反攻。 路线为示意简化，日期取通行说法，待史料校订。 In autumn 1943 the 74th Army moved from the Changsha area to Changde; the 57th Division held the city while the main force operated on the outskirts. When the Battle of Changde began in November, the 57th Division held out in the isolated city and the 74th Army counterattacked from outside. Illustrative simplified route; dates follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

summary.en: The 16th Regiment of the 386th Brigade ambushed a Japanese officers’ observation group at Hanluecun, killing more than 120.

fields.name: 韩略村战斗 Battle of Hanluecun 韩略村伏击战 Hanluecun Ambush
fields.place: 山西洪洞韩略村 Hanluecun, Hongtong, Shanxi
fields.summary: 第129师386旅16团在韩略村伏击日军战地观战团，歼敌 120 余人。 The 16th Regiment of the 386th Brigade ambushed a Japanese officers’ observation group at Hanluecun, killing more than 120.
fields.description: 1943 年 10 月 24 日，八路军第129师第386旅第16团在团长王近山率领下，于山西洪洞韩略村西侧公路伏击日军华北方面军组织的战地观战团，歼灭少将旅团长以下军官 120 余人，击毁汽车 13 辆。此战打乱了日军对太岳根据地的“扫荡”部署。 歼敌数字与番号细节各书记载略有出入，待页码级核对。 On 24 October 1943 the 16th Regiment of the 386th Brigade, 129th Division, under commander Wang Jinshan, ambushed a Japanese officers’ battlefield observation group organized by the North China Area Army on the road west of Hanluecun, Hongtong, Shanxi. More than 120 officers, including a major-general brigade commander, were killed and 13 vehicles destroyed. The action disrupted Japanese “mopping-up” plans for the Taiyue base area. Casualty figures and unit details vary slightly between accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: Japanese forces attacked Changde; the Chinese garrison held out for days before breaking out, and Chinese troops counterattacked to recover the city.

fields.name: 常德会战 Battle of Changde 常德保卫战 Defense of Changde
fields.summary: 日军进攻常德，中国守军坚守多日后突围，中国军队随后反攻收复常德。 Japanese forces attacked Changde; the Chinese garrison held out for days before breaking out, and Chinese troops counterattacked to recover the city.
fields.description: 1943 年 11 月，日军第十一军向常德地区发起进攻，企图牵制中国军队并夺取洞庭湖周边粮区。中国第 74 军第 57 师坚守常德城，与日军激战多日，伤亡惨重后突围。中国军队外围部队随即反攻，12 月收复常德。此役战斗激烈，双方均有重大伤亡。 本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。 In November 1943, the Japanese 11th Army attacked the Changde area, seeking to pin down Chinese forces and seize the rice-producing region around Dongting Lake. The 57th Division of the Chinese 74th Army defended Changde in bitter fighting for many days before breaking out with heavy losses. Chinese forces on the periphery counterattacked and recovered the city in December. Both sides suffered major casualties. Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

fields.summary: 1943年11月3日，日军第68师团户田支队攻占南县。 On 3 November 1943 the Toda detachment of the Japanese 68th Division captured Nanxian.
fields.description: 1943年11月2日日军第11军分三路会攻常德，东路第68师团户田支队自华容、石首南犯，3日攻占南县，随后占三仙湖，进抵洞庭湖北岸。日期据《湖南抗日战争日志（1943年11月）》与《常德会战全过程》。 On 2 November 1943 the Japanese 11th Army attacked Changde in three columns. The Toda detachment of the 68th Division advanced south from Huarong and Shishou, took Nanxian on the 3rd and Sanxianhu soon after, reaching the north shore of Dongting Lake.

fields.name: 石门沦陷 Fall of Shimen
fields.summary: 1943年11月15日，日军第3、第13师团攻陷石门。 On 15 November 1943 the Japanese 3rd and 13th Divisions captured Shimen.
fields.description: 1943年11月13日日军第3、第13师团向石门进攻，中国第73军暂5师死守，师长彭士量在突围中殉国，15日晨石门失守。石门为常德西北屏障，失守后日军直趋慈利、桃源。日期据《湖南抗日战争日志（1943年11月）》与《常德会战全过程》。 On 13 November 1943 the Japanese 3rd and 13th Divisions attacked Shimen. The Chinese Provisional 5th Division of the 73rd Corps held on; its commander Peng Shiliang was killed during the breakout, and Shimen fell on the morning of the 15th. The town was Changde’s northwestern shield, and its loss opened the way to Cili and Taoyuan.

fields.name: 澧县沦陷 Fall of Lixian
fields.summary: 1943年11月17日，日军第116师团攻占澧县。 On 17 November 1943 the Japanese 116th Division captured Lixian.
fields.description: 1943年11月15日晚日军第116师团从澧县以北进攻，中国第44军第150师等部防守，17日澧县失守。日军随后经临澧向常德推进。日期据《湖南抗日战争日志（1943年11月）》与《常德会战全过程》。 On the evening of 15 November 1943 the Japanese 116th Division attacked north of Lixian. The Chinese 150th Division of the 44th Corps defended the town, which fell on the 17th. The Japanese then advanced via Linli toward Changde.

summary.zh: 中美英三国领导人举行开罗会议，发表《开罗宣言》，明确战后归还中国领土。
summary.en: Leaders of China, the United States, and Britain met in Cairo and issued the Cairo Declaration, affirming the return of Chinese territories after the war.

fields.name: 开罗会议 Cairo Conference
fields.summary: 中美英三国领导人举行开罗会议，发表《开罗宣言》，明确战后归还中国领土。 Leaders of China, the United States, and Britain met in Cairo and issued the Cairo Declaration, affirming the return of Chinese territories after the war.
fields.description: 1943 年 11 月 22 日至 26 日，蒋介石、罗斯福、丘吉尔在开罗举行会议，讨论对日作战与战后安排。会议发表的《开罗宣言》明确表示，日本所窃取于中国的领土，如东北、台湾、澎湖列岛等，应归还中国。 本事件为外交事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述待史料校订。 From 22 to 26 November 1943, Chiang Kai-shek, Franklin D. Roosevelt, and Winston Churchill met in Cairo to discuss the war against Japan and postwar arrangements. The Cairo Declaration stated that territories Japan had seized from China, including the Northeast, Taiwan, and the Penghu Islands, should be returned to China. This is a diplomatic event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

summary.en: On 22 November 1943 the Japanese 13th Division captured Cili.

fields.name: 慈利沦陷 Fall of Cili
fields.summary: 1943年11月22日，日军第13师团攻占慈利。 On 22 November 1943 the Japanese 13th Division captured Cili.
fields.description: 1943年11月17日日军第13师团分三路进攻慈利，中国第74军第58师在赤松山、慈利以南阵地抗击，18日慈利失守，22日日军主力进占慈利。慈利失守后，日军西路由慈利、桃源迂回常德西南。日期据《湖南抗日战争日志（1943年11月）》与《常德会战全过程》。 On 17 November 1943 the Japanese 13th Division attacked Cili in three columns. The Chinese 58th Division of the 74th Corps fought at Chisong Mountain and south of Cili; the town fell on the 18th, and the Japanese main force occupied it on the 22nd. The western column then swung through Cili and Taoyuan to cut Changde’s southwest.

summary.en: On 22 November 1943 the Japanese 3rd Division captured Taoyuan.

fields.name: 桃源沦陷 Fall of Taoyuan
fields.summary: 1943年11月22日，日军第3师团攻占桃源。 On 22 November 1943 the Japanese 3rd Division captured Taoyuan.
fields.description: 1943年11月19日日军第3师团主力由澧水南渡，直扑陬市、桃源，21日以伞兵配合攻占桃源，22日进占桃源县城并切断常德守军与第74军主力的联系。日期据《湖南抗日战争日志（1943年11月）》与《常德会战全过程》。 On 19 November 1943 the main force of the Japanese 3rd Division crossed the Li River and drove on Zoushi and Taoyuan. On the 21st, with paratroopers, it took Taoyuan and on the 22nd occupied the county town, cutting the link between Changde’s defenders and the 74th Corps.

fields.name: 常德沦陷 Fall of Changde
fields.summary: 1943年12月3日，日军攻占常德，中国第57师大部殉国。 On 3 December 1943 the Japanese captured Changde after the Chinese 57th Division was largely destroyed.
fields.description: 1943年11月24日日军环攻常德，中国第74军第57师师长余程万率部死守，激战至12月3日凌晨，守军弹尽粮绝，余程万率残部突围，常德沦陷。12月9日中国军队克复常德。日期据《湖南抗日战争日志（1943年11月）》与《常德会战全过程》。 On 24 November 1943 the Japanese encircled and assaulted Changde. The Chinese 57th Division of the 74th Corps, commanded by Yu Chengwan, held on until the early hours of 3 December, when with ammunition and food exhausted Yu broke out with the survivors and the city fell. The Chinese recaptured Changde on 9 December.
