fields.summary: 新四军在车桥歼灭日伪军，扩大苏中根据地。 The New Fourth Army destroyed Japanese and puppet forces at Cheqiao, expanding the Central Jiangsu base area.
fields.description: 1944 年 3 月 5 日，新四军第一师在江苏淮安车桥地区歼灭日伪军，扩大苏中抗日根据地。日期与战果为通行说法，待页码级核对。 本事件为战役点，不绘行军路线：车桥战役由新四军第一师在苏中发起，与军部驻地盐城不是同一条路线。 On March 5, 1944, the New Fourth Army’s 1st Division destroyed Japanese and puppet forces at Cheqiao, Huai’an, Jiangsu, expanding the Central Jiangsu anti-Japanese base area. Dates and results follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification. This is a battle point with no march route: the Battle of Cheqiao was fought by the N4A 1st Division from Central Jiangsu, not by the headquarters at Yancheng.

fields.name: 豫湘桂战役 Operation Ichi-Go 一号作战 Operation Ichi-Go
fields.summary: 日军发动豫湘桂战役，沿平汉、湘桂铁路南犯，中国正面战场遭受重大损失。 Japan launched Operation Ichi-Go south along the Beijing–Hankou and Hunan–Guangxi railways, inflicting heavy losses on China’s frontal battlefield.
fields.description: 1944 年 4 月 17 日，日军发动豫湘桂战役，先后在河南、湖南、广西等地进攻。中国军队虽顽强抵抗，但郑州、长沙、衡阳、桂林、柳州、南宁等地相继失守，正面战场遭受抗战后期最严重的挫折之一。 本事件日期与范围取通行说法，待史料校订。 On 17 April 1944, Japan launched Operation Ichi-Go, attacking across Henan, Hunan, and Guangxi. Despite stubborn Chinese resistance, Zhengzhou, Changsha, Hengyang, Guilin, Liuzhou, and Nanning fell in succession, one of the most serious setbacks for China’s frontal battlefield in the later war years. Dates and extent follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

summary.en: 1st War Zone troops resisted the Japanese in central Henan; Zhengzhou, Xuchang, and Luoyang fell in succession.

fields.name: 第1战区豫中会战 1st War Zone in Central Henan
fields.summary: 第1战区部队在豫中抗击日军，郑州、许昌、洛阳相继失守。 1st War Zone troops resisted the Japanese in central Henan; Zhengzhou, Xuchang, and Luoyang fell in succession.
fields.description: 1944 年 4 月，日军发动豫中作战。第1战区司令长官蒋鼎文、副司令长官汤恩伯所部在郑州、许昌、洛阳一线抵抗，因指挥失误与兵力分散而节节失利。第36集团军总司令李家钰在撤退中殉国。 路线为示意简化，日期取通行说法，待史料校订。 In April 1944 the Japanese launched the Central Henan operation. Troops of the 1st War Zone under Jiang Dingwen and Tang Enbo resisted along the Zhengzhou–Xuchang–Luoyang line but were defeated in detail because of command failures and dispersed forces. General Li Jiayu, commander of the 36th Group Army, was killed during the retreat. Illustrative simplified route; dates follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

summary.zh: 1944年4月18日，日军第37师团在中牟强渡新黄河，豫中会战爆发。
summary.en: On 18 April 1944 the Japanese 37th Division forced the New Yellow River at Zhongmou, opening the Central Henan campaign.

fields.name: 中牟沦陷（1944） Fall of Zhongmou (1944)
fields.summary: 1944年4月18日，日军第37师团在中牟强渡新黄河，豫中会战爆发。 On 18 April 1944 the Japanese 37th Division forced the New Yellow River at Zhongmou, opening the Central Henan campaign.
fields.description: 1944年4月17日夜至18日凌晨，日军第37师团配属独立混成第7旅团在中牟县强渡新黄河，突破暂编第15军阵地，中牟随即失守，豫中会战爆发。日军随后在郑州、新郑、尉氏、洧川等地与第28集团军激战。日期据《豫中会战经过》与《河南的抗战历程》。 On the night of 17–18 April 1944 the Japanese 37th Division with the 7th Independent Mixed Brigade crossed the New Yellow River at Zhongmou, broke the Provisional 15th Corps and took the town, opening the Central Henan campaign. The Japanese then fought the 28th Group Army at Zhengzhou, Xinzheng, Weishi and Weichuan.

summary.en: Japanese forces captured Zhengzhou during the Central Henan campaign.

fields.name: 郑州沦陷 Fall of Zhengzhou
fields.summary: 豫中会战中日军攻占郑州。 Japanese forces captured Zhengzhou during the Central Henan campaign.
fields.description: 1944 年 4 月，日军发动豫中会战，第 12 军自中牟、邙山头渡过黄河。4 月 23 日，日军占领郑州。郑州沦陷日期有 4 月 19 日、20 日、23 日诸说，此处取“至 4 月 23 日相继攻陷郑州”的记载，待页码级核对。 In April 1944 Japan launched the Central Henan campaign; the 12th Army crossed the Yellow River at Zhongmu and the Mangshan foothills. On 23 April Japanese forces occupied Zhengzhou. Accounts of the date vary among 19, 20 and 23 April; this entry follows the record that Zhengzhou was taken by 23 April and awaits page-level verification.

fields.summary: 1944年4月23日，日军占领新郑。 On 23 April 1944 the Japanese occupied Xinzheng.
fields.description: 1944年4月23日，日军占领郑州、新郑、广武、尉氏、洧川、鄢陵、密县等县，随后沿平汉铁路南犯，24日占领长葛。《豫中会战经过》则记4月21日新郑、尉氏被日军攻陷，正文并列。日期取《河南的抗战历程》与《重读抗战·河南》。 On 23 April 1944 the Japanese occupied Zhengzhou, Xinzheng, Guangwu, Weishi, Weichuan, Yanling and Mi counties, then advanced south along the Beiping–Hankou railway and took Changge on the 24th. The campaign narrative gives 21 April for Xinzheng and Weishi; that variant is noted in the text.

fields.summary: 1944年4月24日，日军占领长葛。 On 24 April 1944 the Japanese occupied Changge.
fields.description: 1944年4月23日日军占领郑州、新郑等地后沿平汉铁路南犯，24日占领长葛。长葛失守后，日军直逼许昌。日期据《河南的抗战历程》与漯河日报《重温郾城受降历史》，两源一致。 After taking Zhengzhou and Xinzheng on 23 April 1944 the Japanese advanced south along the Beiping–Hankou railway and occupied Changge on the 24th, closing on Xuchang. fields.summary: 日军攻占许昌，豫中会战扩大。 Japanese forces captured Xuchang, widening the Central Henan campaign.
fields.description: 1944 年 4 月 30 日，日军第 12 军以三个师团又两个旅进攻许昌，中国守军新编第 29 师抵抗。5 月 1 日，许昌失守。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 30 April 1944 the Japanese 12th Army attacked Xuchang with three divisions and two brigades; the Chinese New 29th Division resisted. Xuchang fell on 1 May. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

Linying fell on the 2nd, after which the Japanese attacked Yancheng and Luohe. Both cited accounts give 2 May.

fields.name: 禹县沦陷 Fall of Yu County
fields.place: 河南禹县 Yu County (Yuzhou), Henan
fields.summary: 1944年5月3日，日军第62师团攻占禹县。 On 3 May 1944 the Japanese 62nd Division captured Yu County (Yuzhou).
fields.description: 1944年5月3日，日军第62师团向禹县发动攻击，击溃守军第29军，禹县、郏县同日沦入敌手。禹县失守后，部分守军退入禹西山区，日军自5月4日起在文殊、方山、神垕、大雄山等地围剿。日期据《中华民族抗日编年（1944年5月）》与《抗日战争中的平顶山》。 On 3 May 1944 the Japanese 62nd Division attacked Yu County, routed the 29th Corps and took both Yu County and Jiaxian the same day. Part of the Chinese force withdrew into the western hills, where the Japanese hunted them from 4 May around Wenshu, Fangshan, Shenhou and Daxiongshan.

fields.description: 1944年5月1日至4日，许昌、临颍、郏县、禹县、临汝相继失守。日军战车第3师团向西迂回，席卷襄城、郏县、临汝，一部快速逼近洛阳外围龙门。日期据《豫中会战经过》与《河南的抗战历程》。 Between 1 and 4 May 1944 Xuchang, Linying, Jiaxian, Yu County and Linru fell in succession. The Japanese 3rd Tank Division swept west through Xiangcheng, Jiaxian and Linru, with part of it driving quickly toward the Longmen approaches to Luoyang.

summary.zh: 1944年5月5日，日军攻陷郾城、漯河。
summary.en: On 5 May 1944 the Japanese captured Yancheng and Luohe.

fields.name: 漯河沦陷 Fall of Luohe
fields.summary: 1944年5月5日，日军攻陷郾城、漯河。 On 5 May 1944 the Japanese captured Yancheng and Luohe.
fields.description: 1944年5月5日，日军攻破五里庙，沙河北岸中国军队阵地崩溃，南撤部队遭日军南北夹击。下午1时日军侵占郾城、突入漯河，守军顾锡九部突围，漯河陷落。漯河时为郾城县辖镇，是平汉铁路南段重镇。日期据《漯河保卫战》与漯河日报。 On 5 May 1944 the Japanese broke the Wulimiao position and the Chinese line north of the Sha River collapsed, with the withdrawing troops caught in a double envelopment. At 1 p.m. the Japanese took Yancheng and entered Luohe; Gu Xijiu’s force broke out and the town fell. Luohe was then a town under Yancheng county and a key point on the southern Beiping–Hankou railway.

summary.en: On 6 May 1944 the Japanese captured Dengfeng.

fields.name: 登封沦陷 Fall of Dengfeng
fields.summary: 1944年5月6日，日军攻占登封。 On 6 May 1944 the Japanese captured Dengfeng.
fields.description: 至1944年5月6日，日军先后攻占许昌、登封、禹县、郏县、襄城、临汝、宝丰、鲁山等地，一部直抵洛阳龙门附近。登封失守后，日军从东南方向逼近洛阳。日期据《豫中会战经过》与《河南的抗战历程》。 By 6 May 1944 the Japanese had taken Xuchang, Dengfeng, Yu County, Jiaxian, Xiangcheng, Linru, Baofeng and Lushan, with part of their force reaching the vicinity of Longmen. The fall of Dengfeng brought the Japanese toward Luoyang from the southeast.

summary.en: On 7 May 1944 the Japanese occupied Lushan.

fields.name: 鲁山沦陷 Fall of Lushan
fields.summary: 1944年5月7日，日军占领鲁山。 On 7 May 1944 the Japanese occupied Lushan.
fields.description: 1944年5月7日，日军占领鲁山，随后占领第一战区储备基地下汤。鲁山时为河南省政府驻地之一，失守后省政府迁至内乡丹水镇。日期据《抗日战争中的平顶山》与《豫中会战经过》；后者记5月6日，正文并列。 On 7 May 1944 the Japanese occupied Lushan and then the First War Zone supply base at Xiatang. Lushan was then one of the seats of the Henan provincial government, which moved to Danshui in Neixiang after its fall. The Pingdingshan history gives 7 May; the campaign narrative gives 6 May.

summary.en: On 8 May 1944 Japanese columns from north and south converged on Xiping, opening the southern Beiping–Hankou railway.

fields.name: 西平沦陷 Fall of Xiping
fields.summary: 1944年5月8日，南北两路日军夹击攻占西平，打通平汉线南段。 On 8 May 1944 Japanese columns from north and south converged on Xiping, opening the southern Beiping–Hankou railway.
fields.description: 1944年5月8日，沿平汉铁路南下的日军与自信阳北上的日军第11军宫下旅团南北夹击，攻占西平，打通河南境内平汉线。西平失守后，日军集中主力进攻洛阳。日期据《豫中会战经过》《洛阳保卫战》与《民国百年》。 On 8 May 1944 the Japanese force advancing south along the Beiping–Hankou railway and the Miyashita brigade of the 11th Army moving north from Xinyang converged on Xiping, opening the line through Henan. The Japanese then concentrated on Luoyang.

fields.name: 第15军防守洛阳 15th Army Defends Luoyang
fields.summary: 豫中会战中，第15军守洛阳，与日军第12军激战，洛阳于 5 月 25 日失守。 In the Central Henan campaign the 15th Army defended Luoyang against the Japanese 12th Army; the city fell on 25 May.
fields.description: 1944 年 5 月豫中会战中，第15军（军长武庭麟）守洛阳，依托城防工事与日军第12军等部激战十余日。5 月 25 日洛阳失守，守军突围。 日期与主官为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In the Central Henan campaign of May 1944 the 15th Army under Wu Tinglin defended Luoyang, fighting the Japanese 12th Army and other units for more than ten days from the city’s fortifications. Luoyang fell on 25 May and the defenders broke out. Dates and appointments follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.name: 巩县沦陷 Fall of Gong County
fields.place: 河南巩县 Gong County (Gongyi), Henan
fields.summary: 1944年5月9日，日军“菊兵团”攻占巩县。 On 9 May 1944 the Japanese Kiku detachment captured Gong County (Gongyi).
fields.description: 1944年5月9日，自郑州沿陇海铁路西犯的日军“菊兵团”攻占巩县，11日占领偃师，迫近洛阳城东。巩县失守后，日军完成对洛阳东西两面的合围。日期据《河南的抗战历程》与《豫中会战经过》。 On 9 May 1944 the Japanese Kiku detachment, advancing west from Zhengzhou along the Longhai railway, took Gong County and on the 11th Yanshi, closing on Luoyang from the east. The fall of Gong County completed the Japanese encirclement of Luoyang from east and west.

summary.en: The Chinese Expeditionary Force crossed the Salween and counterattacked toward Tengchong, Longling, and Songshan, recovering western Yunnan by early 1945.

fields.name: 滇西反攻 Western Yunnan Counteroffensive 滇西缅北反攻 Yunnan–Burma Counteroffensive
fields.summary: 中国远征军强渡怒江，反攻腾冲、龙陵、松山，至 1945 年初收复滇西。 The Chinese Expeditionary Force crossed the Salween and counterattacked toward Tengchong, Longling, and Songshan, recovering western Yunnan by early 1945.
fields.description: 1944 年 5 月，中国远征军强渡怒江，向腾冲、龙陵、松山等地日军发起反攻。中国军队与盟军协同，经过松山、腾冲、龙陵等激战，至 1945 年 1 月收复畹町，打通中印公路。此役是抗战后期中国军队在滇西的重要反攻，与缅北反攻相互配合。 本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。 In May 1944, the Chinese Expeditionary Force crossed the Salween and launched a counteroffensive against Japanese forces at Tengchong, Longling, Songshan, and other points. Working with Allied forces, Chinese troops fought fierce battles at Songshan, Tengchong, and Longling, recovered Wanding in January 1945, and opened the Ledo Road. The campaign was an important Chinese counteroffensive in western Yunnan in the later war years, coordinated with the northern Burma offensive. Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

fields.name: 远征军自保山强渡怒江 Expeditionary force crosses the Salween from Baoshan
fields.summary: 中国远征军自保山强渡怒江，滇西反攻开始。 The Chinese expeditionary force crossed the Salween from Baoshan, opening the western Yunnan counter-offensive.
fields.description: 1944 年 5 月 11 日中国远征军自保山地区强渡怒江，分路进攻腾冲、龙陵、松山；至 1945 年 1 月 27 日攻克畹町，与驻印军在芒友会师。保山为远征军集结与补给基地。 On 11 May 1944 the Chinese expeditionary force crossed the Salween from the Baoshan area and attacked Tengchong, Longling and Songshan; Wanding fell on 27 January 1945 and the force linked with the India-based army at Mangyou. Baoshan was the staging and supply base.

summary.en: On 12 May 1944 the Japanese 69th Division captured Mianchi.

fields.name: 渑池沦陷 Fall of Mianchi
fields.summary: 1944年5月12日，日军第69师团攻陷渑池。 On 12 May 1944 the Japanese 69th Division captured Mianchi.
fields.description: 1944年5月9日，驻晋南垣曲的日军第69师团主力强渡黄河，向渑池进攻；12日攻陷渑池、新安，直逼洛阳城西。渑池附近第36集团军西移卢氏附近，洛阳守军陷于孤军苦战。日期据《河南的抗战历程》与《豫中会战经过》；后者记9日渡河、13日各路会合。 On 9 May 1944 the main force of the Japanese 69th Division crossed the Yellow River from Yuanqu in southern Shanxi and attacked Mianchi, taking Mianchi and Xin’an on the 12th and closing on Luoyang from the west. The Chinese 36th Group Army near Mianchi withdrew toward Lushi, leaving Luoyang isolated. The campaign narrative gives 9 May for the crossing and 13 May for the junction of columns.

summary.zh: 1944年5月12日，日军第69师团攻陷新安。
summary.en: On 12 May 1944 the Japanese 69th Division captured Xin’an.

fields.name: 新安沦陷 Fall of Xin’an
fields.summary: 1944年5月12日，日军第69师团攻陷新安。 On 12 May 1944 the Japanese 69th Division captured Xin’an.
fields.description: 1944年5月12日，日军第69师团在攻陷渑池的同时攻陷新安，进抵洛阳以西。新安失守后，陇海铁路洛阳至潼关段被日军控制，第一战区主力向西转移。日期据《河南的抗战历程》与《豫中会战经过》。 On 12 May 1944 the Japanese 69th Division took Xin’an together with Mianchi and reached the approaches west of Luoyang. With Xin’an lost the Japanese controlled the Longhai railway from Luoyang toward Tongguan, and the First War Zone’s main force shifted west.

fields.place: 湖南岳阳新墙河 Xinqiang River, Yueyang, Hunan
fields.summary: 1944年5月28日，日军第68、第116师团渡过新墙河，长衡会战开始。 On 28 May 1944 the Japanese 68th and 116th Divisions crossed the Xinqiang River, opening the Changsha–Hengyang campaign.
fields.description: 1944年5月27日日军第11军分三路南犯，中路第68、第116师团于28日上午渡过新墙河，中国第20军抗击后向平江以东山区转移。日期据《长衡会战》与台湾国防部《抗日戰爭長衡會戰之研究》。 On 27 May 1944 the Japanese 11th Army advanced south in three columns; the central 68th and 116th Divisions crossed the Xinqiang on the morning of the 28th. The Chinese 20th Corps resisted and withdrew to the hills east of Pingjiang.

fields.description: 5月29日，日伪军围攻淮北灵（璧）五（河）抗日游击区，焚毁18个村庄、1003户、4200余间房屋，打死无辜村民103人，打伤210余人。此为暴行事件，不绘路线。日期与数字据《安徽沦陷大事记（三）》与人民网，待页码级核对。 On 29 May Japanese and puppet troops attacked the Lingbi–Wuhe anti-Japanese guerrilla zone in northern Anhui, burning 18 villages, 1,003 households and more than 4,200 rooms, killing 103 villagers and wounding over 210. This atrocity is not drawn as a route. The date and figures follow the third part of the Anhui occupation chronology and People's Daily and await page-level verification.

summary.en: The Chinese Expeditionary Force captured the Japanese stronghold at Songshan after bitter fighting, opening a key point on the Burma Road.

fields.name: 松山战役 Battle of Songshan 松山攻坚战 Songshan Offensive
fields.place: 云南龙陵松山 Songshan, Longling, Yunnan
fields.summary: 中国远征军围攻松山日军据点，经苦战收复松山，打通滇缅公路关键节点。 The Chinese Expeditionary Force captured the Japanese stronghold at Songshan after bitter fighting, opening a key point on the Burma Road.
fields.description: 1944 年 6 月至 9 月，中国远征军对云南龙陵松山日军据点发起进攻。日军依托坚固工事顽抗，中国军队付出重大伤亡，最终于 9 月 7 日收复松山，为滇西反攻和滇缅公路恢复通车创造条件。 本事件日期、地点与战果待史料校订。 From June to September 1944, the Chinese Expeditionary Force attacked the Japanese stronghold at Songshan in Longling, Yunnan. Japanese troops resisted from fortified positions, and Chinese forces suffered heavy casualties before recapturing Songshan on 7 September, facilitating the western Yunnan counteroffensive and the reopening of the Burma Road. Dates, location, and assessments await historical review.

fields.summary: 1944年6月5日，日军第40师团攻占沅江。 On 5 June 1944 the Japanese 40th Division captured Yuanjiang.
fields.description: 1944年5月28日日军西路第40师团自华容南犯，6月1日夜在赤山半岛以西登陆，6月5日攻占沅江，12日攻占益阳。日期据《长衡会战》与台湾国防部《抗日戰爭長衡會戰之研究》。 On 28 May 1944 the Japanese western 40th Division advanced south from Huarong, landed west of Chishan Peninsula on the night of 1 June, took Yuanjiang on the 5th and Yiyang on the 12th.

fields.name: 日军平戛守备 Japanese Defence of Pingjia
fields.place: 云南龙陵平戛 Pingjia, Longling, Yunnan
fields.summary: 1944年6月，日军在平戛构筑据点，阻止中国远征军南下。 In June 1944 the Japanese fortified Pingjia to block the Chinese Expeditionary Force’s advance south.
fields.description: 1944年6月，中国远征军第11集团军分路进攻龙陵、平戛，日军第56师团在平戛（平达）构筑据点固守。中国第2军第9师围攻平达、攻占象达，至9月进占平戛，三面合围龙陵。日期据《中国远征军滇西作战梗概》与《滇西大反攻：绝地反击 收复国土》。 In June 1944 the Chinese 11th Group Army attacked Longling and Pingjia; the Japanese 56th Division held fortified posts at Pingjia (Pingda). The Chinese 9th Division besieged Pingda, took Xiangda and entered Pingjia in September, closing in on Longling from three sides.

summary.en: In June 1944 the Japanese held a post at Xiangda, which the Chinese 2nd Army captured.

fields.place: 云南龙陵象达 Xiangda, Longling, Yunnan
fields.summary: 1944年6月，日军在象达构筑据点，被中国远征军第2军攻占。 In June 1944 the Japanese held a post at Xiangda, which the Chinese 2nd Army captured.
fields.description: 1944年6月5日起，中国远征军第11集团军第2军第9师围攻平达，并攻占象达，追击日军至油菜地。日军第56师团在象达一带构筑据点，掩护龙陵侧翼。日期据《中国远征军滇西作战梗概》与《滇西大反攻：绝地反击 收复国土》。 From 5 June 1944 the Chinese 2nd Army’s 9th Division besieged Pingda, took Xiangda and pursued the Japanese to Youcaidi. The Japanese 56th Division held posts around Xiangda to cover Longling’s flank.

summary.en: On 8 June 1944 the Japanese 58th Division captured Xiangyin.

fields.name: 湘阴沦陷 Fall of Xiangyin
fields.summary: 1944年6月8日，日军第58师团攻占湘阴。 On 8 June 1944 the Japanese 58th Division captured Xiangyin.
fields.description: 1944年6月8日日军第58师团第52旅团经汨罗镇、望城坡攻占湘阴。湘阴为长沙北面水陆要地，失守后日军从北面逼近长沙。日期据《长衡会战》与台湾国防部《抗日戰爭長衡會戰之研究》。 On 8 June 1944 the 52nd Brigade of the Japanese 58th Division advanced via Miluo and Wangchengpo to take Xiangyin, the water-and-land gateway north of Changsha. Its fall brought the Japanese to Changsha’s northern approaches.

fields.name: 益阳沦陷 Fall of Yiyang
fields.summary: 1944年6月12日，日军第40师团攻占益阳。 On 12 June 1944 the Japanese 40th Division captured Yiyang.
fields.description: 1944年6月12日日军第40师团攻占益阳，随后向宁乡进攻。中国第24集团军第73、第79军对日军实施钳形攻击，益阳一度被中国军队收复。日期据《长衡会战》与台湾国防部《抗日戰爭長衡會戰之研究》。 On 12 June 1944 the Japanese 40th Division took Yiyang and advanced on Ningxiang. The Chinese 73rd and 79th Corps of the 24th Group Army counterattacked in a pincer, and Yiyang was briefly recovered.

fields.name: 浏阳沦陷 Fall of Liuyang
fields.summary: 1944年6月14日，日军第3师团攻占浏阳。 On 14 June 1944 the Japanese 3rd Division captured Liuyang.
fields.description: 1944年6月14日23时30分，日军第3师团攻占浏阳。此前第13师团从浏阳东南迂回，第68师团从镇头攻向普迹，形成合围。浏阳失守后，日军从东南面威胁长沙、株洲。日期据《长衡会战》与《日军侵华战争》。 At 11:30 p.m. on 14 June 1944 the Japanese 3rd Division took Liuyang, after the 13th Division had swung around its southeast and the 68th Division advanced from Zhentou. Its fall threatened Changsha and Zhuzhou from the southeast.

fields.name: 第4军防守长沙 4th Army Defends Changsha
fields.summary: 长衡会战中，第4军守长沙，与日军第11军激战，长沙于 6 月 19 日失守。 In the Changsha–Hengyang campaign the 4th Army defended Changsha against the Japanese 11th Army; the city fell on 19 June.
fields.description: 1944 年 6 月，日军第11军进攻长沙。第4军（军长张德能）在长沙城郊抵抗，因指挥与部署失误，长沙于 6 月 19 日失守，第4军突围。此后日军继续南下进攻衡阳。 日期与主官为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In June 1944 the Japanese 11th Army attacked Changsha. The 4th Army under Zhang Deneng resisted around the city but, hampered by command and deployment failures, lost Changsha on 19 June and broke out. The Japanese then continued south toward Hengyang. Dates and appointments follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: On 20 June 1944 the Japanese captured Zhuzhou.

fields.name: 株洲沦陷（1944） Fall of Zhuzhou (1944)
fields.summary: 1944年6月20日，日军攻占株洲。 On 20 June 1944 the Japanese captured Zhuzhou.
fields.description: 1944年6月20日，日军在攻占长沙后沿粤汉铁路南下，先后攻占醴陵、株洲、渌口、湘潭。株洲为粤汉、湘黔铁路交点，失守后日军打开南下衡阳的通道。日期据《长衡会战》与台湾国防部《抗日戰爭長衡會戰之研究》。 On 20 June 1944, after taking Changsha, the Japanese advanced south along the Canton–Hankou railway and took Liling, Zhuzhou, Lukou and Xiangtan in succession. Zhuzhou was the junction of the Canton–Hankou and Hunan–Guizhou railways; its fall opened the way to Hengyang.

fields.name: 衡阳保卫战 Defense of Hengyang 衡阳会战 Hengyang Campaign
fields.summary: 中国第 10 军坚守衡阳 47 天，重创日军，最终衡阳失守。 The Chinese 10th Army held Hengyang for 47 days, inflicting heavy losses on Japanese forces before the city fell.
fields.description: 1944 年 6 月，日军在豫湘桂战役中进攻衡阳。中国第 10 军约一万七千人坚守衡阳，面对优势日军的围攻，苦战 47 天，伤亡惨重，弹尽援绝，衡阳于 8 月 8 日失守。此役迟滞了日军南进，是抗战后期著名的城市防御战。 本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为城防示意，待史料校订。 In June 1944, Japanese forces attacked Hengyang during Operation Ichi-Go. The Chinese 10th Army, about 17,000 strong, defended the city against a numerically superior Japanese siege for 47 days. With heavy casualties, ammunition exhausted, and no relief in sight, Hengyang fell on 8 August. The defense delayed the Japanese advance south and became one of the best-known urban defense battles of the later war years. Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a sketch of the city defense and awaits historical review.

fields.summary: 1944年8月26日，日军再次攻陷丽水县城。 On 26 August 1944 Japanese forces again captured Lishui.
fields.description: 8月26日，日军第70师团和梨冈支队3000余人进犯丽水县城，国军新编第11师63团与日军激战彻夜，团长彭孝儒及大部官兵阵亡，县城沦陷。9月16日，国军新编第11师62团攻克县城。日期据《丽水抗战》，待页码级核对。 On 26 August more than 3,000 troops of the Japanese 70th Division and the Rioka detachment attacked Lishui. The Chinese New 11th Division's 63rd Regiment fought all night; its commander Peng Xiaoru and most of his men died and the county town fell. On 16 September the 62nd Regiment retook the town. The date follows the Lishui chronicle and awaits page-level verification.

fields.summary: 日军甲支队自金华经丽水、青田进攻，占领温州并长期盘踞。 The Japanese Kō Detachment advanced from Jinhua via Lishui and Qingtian and occupied Wenzhou for a prolonged period.
fields.description: 1944 年 9 月，日军第 13 军组织甲支队（后改编为独立混成第 89 旅团）共 4 个大队，由黎冈少将指挥，自金华集结，经丽水、青田，于 9 月 9 日占领温州，随后占领乐清西乡和县城，在瓯江口以北沿海构筑工事、修建简易机场，直至 1945 年 6 月才撤出。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In September 1944 the Japanese 13th Army formed the Kō Detachment (later the 89th Independent Mixed Brigade), four battalions under Major General Kogiso, which assembled at Jinhua, advanced via Lishui and Qingtian and occupied Wenzhou on 9 September. It then took western Yueqing and the county town, built fortifications and a simple airfield along the coast north of the Ou River mouth, and did not withdraw until June 1945. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

fields.description: 1944年9月11日日军攻陷桂北黄沙河，桂柳会战揭幕。黄沙河为全州东北屏障，失守后全州门户洞开。日期据《桂柳会战惨败内幕》与维基百科《桂柳会战》。 On 11 September 1944 the Japanese took Huangshahe in northern Guangxi, opening the Guilin–Liuzhou campaign. Huangshahe was Quanzhou’s northeastern shield; its loss exposed Quanzhou.

fields.name: 全州沦陷 Fall of Quanzhou
fields.place: 广西全州 Quanzhou (Quan County), Guangxi
fields.summary: 1944年9月14日，日军第13师团占领全州。 On 14 September 1944 the Japanese 13th Division occupied Quanzhou.
fields.description: 1944年9月14日凌晨，日军第13师团占领全州（全县）。中国第93军军长陈牧农未奉命令擅自弃守，焚毁大批军用物资，后被枪决。全州为西南补给基地，失守后桂林吃紧。日期据维基百科《桂柳会战》与《桂柳会战》。 In the early hours of 14 September 1944 the Japanese 13th Division took Quanzhou (Quan County). The Chinese 93rd Corps commander Chen Munong abandoned it without orders and burned large stocks; he was later executed. Quanzhou was the southwest supply base, and its loss left Guilin exposed.

fields.summary: 1944年9月22日，日军第23军攻陷梧州。 On 22 September 1944 the Japanese 23rd Army captured Wuzhou.
fields.description: 1944年9月22日日军第23军攻陷梧州。日军由广东清远沿西江西进，梧州失守后继续向平南、桂平推进，威胁柳州右侧背。日期据维基百科《桂柳会战》与《桂柳会战》。 On 22 September 1944 the Japanese 23rd Army took Wuzhou. Advancing west along the Xi River from Qingyuan in Guangdong, the Japanese then pushed toward Pingnan and Guiping, threatening Liuzhou’s right flank.

fields.description: 1944年9月30日日军攻陷兴安。中国第93军、第79军在兴安一线抵抗后撤退；另有记10月1日失守，正文并列。兴安失守后，日军直趋灵川、桂林。日期据《桂柳会战惨败内幕》与《桂柳会战》。 On 30 September 1944 the Japanese took Xing’an after the Chinese 93rd and 79th Corps resisted and withdrew. Another account gives 1 October; that variant is noted. The Japanese then drove on Lingchuan and Guilin.

name.zh: 八路军南下支队挺进湘粤
name.en: The Southward Column Marches toward Hunan and Guangdong

summary.zh: 第359旅主力组成南下支队，从延安出发南征湘粤，进抵广东南雄后奉命北返鄂豫边。
summary.en: The main force of the 359th Brigade formed the Southward Column, marched from Yan’an toward Hunan and Guangdong, and after reaching Nanxiong, Guangdong, was ordered back to the Hubei–Henan border.

fields.name: 八路军南下支队挺进湘粤 The Southward Column Marches toward Hunan and Guangdong 359旅南下 359th Brigade Southward March 国民革命军第十八集团军独立第一游击支队 18th Group Army Independent 1st Guerrilla Detachment
fields.summary: 第359旅主力组成南下支队，从延安出发南征湘粤，进抵广东南雄后奉命北返鄂豫边。 The main force of the 359th Brigade formed the Southward Column, marched from Yan’an toward Hunan and Guangdong, and after reaching Nanxiong, Guangdong, was ordered back to the Hubei–Henan border.
fields.description: 1944 年 11 月 9 日，八路军第359旅主力等 4000 余人组成南下支队（国民革命军第十八集团军独立第一游击支队），在司令员王震、政治委员王首道率领下从延安出发，经晋绥、太岳、豫西，1945 年 1 月 27 日在湖北大悟山与新四军第五师会师；2 月渡长江，3 月进入湘鄂赣边，7 月主力继续南下，8 月 26 日进抵广东南雄西北百顺地区，拟与东江纵队会合。因国民党军重兵堵截，会师未成；日本投降后奉命北返，10 月上旬回到鄂豫边大悟山，随后恢复第359旅番号、编入中原军区。这是八路军在抗战后期的一次远程战略行动。 行军路线与日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 9 November 1944 the main force of the 359th Brigade, over 4,000 strong, formed the Southward Column (officially the 18th Group Army Independent 1st Guerrilla Detachment) under commander Wang Zhen and political commissar Wang Shoudao and set out from Yan’an. Passing through the Jin-Sui, Taiyue and western Henan areas, it joined the New Fourth Army’s 5th Division at Dawushan, Hubei, on 27 January 1945, crossed the Yangtze in February, entered the Hunan–Hubei–Jiangxi border in March, and reached the Baishun area northwest of Nanxiong, Guangdong, on 26 August 1945, intending to link up with the Dongjiang Column. Blocked by strong KMT forces, the link-up failed; after Japan’s surrender the column was ordered north and returned to Dawushan in early October, then resumed the 359th Brigade designation and joined the Central Plains Military District. It was a long-range strategic operation of the late war. Route and dates follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军在豫湘桂战役中占领南宁，打通大陆交通线的企图一度得逞。
summary.en: Japanese forces captured Nanning during Operation Ichi-Go, temporarily achieving their aim of opening a continental transport route.

fields.name: 南宁失守 Fall of Nanning
fields.summary: 日军在豫湘桂战役中占领南宁，打通大陆交通线的企图一度得逞。 Japanese forces captured Nanning during Operation Ichi-Go, temporarily achieving their aim of opening a continental transport route.
fields.description: 1944 年 11 月，日军在豫湘桂战役中继续南犯，11 月 24 日占领南宁。日军企图打通从华北到印度支那的大陆交通线，但战线过长、兵力分散，难以长期巩固。 本事件为路线分段端点，日期与地点为通行说法，待史料校订。 In November 1944, Japanese forces continued south during Operation Ichi-Go and captured Nanning on 24 November. Japan sought to open a continental transport route from North China to Indochina, but overextended lines and dispersed forces made it difficult to hold. This event marks a route segment endpoint; date and location follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

summary.zh: 1944年11月25日，日军第3师团第34联队进攻黎明关，贵州境内抗日第一枪打响。
summary.en: On 25 November 1944 the Japanese 34th Regiment attacked Liming Pass, opening the fighting in Guizhou.

fields.name: 黎明关战斗 Battle of Liming Pass
fields.place: 贵州荔波黎明关 Liming Pass, Libo, Guizhou
fields.summary: 1944年11月25日，日军第3师团第34联队进攻黎明关，贵州境内抗日第一枪打响。 On 25 November 1944 the Japanese 34th Regiment attacked Liming Pass, opening the fighting in Guizhou.
fields.description: 1944年11月25日，日军第3师团第34联队2000余人由广西思恩进攻荔波黎明关，中国第97军第196师第587团团长周国仲率部阻击，激战三天两夜，打响贵州境内抗日第一枪。日军久攻不下，从小路迂回，27日黎明关失守。日期据贵州政协《抗战时期荔波的贡献与牺牲》与《黔山抗战烽火》。 On 25 November 1944 more than 2,000 men of the Japanese 3rd Division’s 34th Regiment attacked Liming Pass from Sien in Guangxi. Colonel Zhou Guozhong’s 587th Regiment of the Chinese 97th Corps’ 196th Division held for three days and nights, opening the fighting in Guizhou. Unable to take the pass frontally, the Japanese turned its flank and occupied it on the 27th.

summary.en: On 28 November 1944 the Japanese captured Nandan.

fields.name: 南丹沦陷 Fall of Nandan
fields.summary: 1944年11月28日，日军攻陷南丹。 On 28 November 1944 the Japanese captured Nandan.
fields.description: 1944年11月28日日军攻陷南丹。日军第13师团由河池西进，突破南丹、黎明关，进入贵州，12月2日攻占独山，12月4日撤回广西。日期据《中华民族抗战编年（1944年11月）》与维基百科《桂柳会战》。 On 28 November 1944 the Japanese took Nandan. The 13th Division advanced west from Hechi, broke through Nandan and Liming Pass into Guizhou, took Dushan on 2 December and withdrew into Guangxi on the 4th.

fields.summary: 1944年11月28日，日军由越南突入中国，攻占凭祥。 On 28 November 1944 Japanese forces entered China from Vietnam and captured Pingxiang.
fields.description: 1944年11月28日日军由越南突入中国，攻占凭祥。日军南方军第21军一部由越南进攻广西，与第23军会合于绥渌。日期据维基百科《桂柳会战》与《中华民族抗战编年（1944年11月）》。 On 28 November 1944 Japanese forces crossed from Vietnam into China and took Pingxiang. Part of the Southern Army’s 21st Army advanced into Guangxi and joined the 23rd Army at Suilu.

summary.en: On 30 November 1944 the Japanese 3rd Division’s 6th Regiment captured Sandu.

fields.name: 三都沦陷 Fall of Sandu
fields.summary: 1944年11月30日，日军第3师团第6联队攻占三都县城。 On 30 November 1944 the Japanese 3rd Division’s 6th Regiment captured Sandu.
fields.description: 1944年11月30日下午，日军第3师团第6联队先头部队攻占三都县城，拆毁民房搭浮桥，焚烧上街和老十字一带。12月1日日军由三都取道丹寨北犯都匀，临走时纵火焚城。日期据《日军侵华暴行——贵州篇》与《日军入侵黔南》。 On the afternoon of 30 November 1944 the advance guard of the Japanese 3rd Division’s 6th Regiment took Sandu, tearing down houses for a pontoon bridge and burning the upper street and Old Cross area. On 1 December the Japanese left Sandu for Danzhai and Duyun, setting the town on fire as they departed.

summary.en: The 74th Army moved to western Hunan, joined the 4th Front Army, and fought in the Western Hunan campaign.

fields.name: 第74军调防湘西 74th Army Moves to Western Hunan
fields.summary: 第74军调防湘西，编入第4方面军，参加湘西会战。 The 74th Army moved to western Hunan, joined the 4th Front Army, and fought in the Western Hunan campaign.
fields.description: 1944 年底，第74军调防湘西，隶属王耀武第4方面军，担任芷江、雪峰山方向作战任务。1945 年 4 月湘西会战爆发，第74军等部依托雪峰山阵地抗击日军。 路线为示意简化，日期取通行说法，待史料校订。 In late 1944 the 74th Army moved to western Hunan under Wang Yaowu’s 4th Front Army, tasked with the Zhijiang and Xuefeng Mountains sector. When the Western Hunan campaign began in April 1945, the 74th Army and other units resisted the Japanese from positions in the Xuefeng Mountains. Illustrative simplified route; dates follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

fields.name: 独山沦陷 Fall of Dushan
fields.summary: 日军攻占贵州独山，黔南事变达到顶点。 Japanese forces captured Dushan in Guizhou, the high point of the Qiannan Incident.
fields.description: 1944 年 12 月 2 日，日军第 13 师团一部攻占贵州独山，震动重庆。12 月 4 日日军开始撤退，12 月 8 日独山光复。日期据《黔南事变》史料，待页码级核对。 On 2 December 1944 a detachment of the Japanese 13th Division captured Dushan in Guizhou, shocking Chongqing. The Japanese began withdrawing on 4 December and Dushan was recovered on 8 December. The date follows Qiannan Incident histories and awaits page-level verification.

fields.summary: 1944年12月2日，日军攻占龙州。 On 2 December 1944 the Japanese captured Longzhou.
fields.description: 1944年12月2日日军攻占龙州。日军第22师团沿桂越公路南下，连陷凭祥、龙州，12月10日与从越南突入的日军在绥渌会合，大陆交通线打通。日期据维基百科《桂柳会战》与《中华民族抗战编年（1944年11月）》。 On 2 December 1944 the Japanese took Longzhou. The 22nd Division advanced south along the Guangxi–Vietnam highway through Pingxiang to Longzhou and joined the force from Vietnam at Suilu on 10 December, completing the overland route.

fields.name: 丹寨沦陷 Fall of Danzhai
fields.summary: 1944年12月2日，日军第3师团第6联队攻占丹寨（八寨）县城。 On 2 December 1944 the Japanese 3rd Division’s 6th Regiment captured Danzhai (Bazhai).
fields.description: 1944年12月2日，日军第3师团第6联队第三大队步骑兵约千余人经三都攻占丹寨（八寨）县城，3日上午放火焚烧丹寨后继续向都匀方向进犯。日期据《日军侵华暴行——贵州篇》与《黔山抗战烽火》。 On 2 December 1944 about 1,000 infantry and cavalry of the 3rd Battalion, 6th Regiment, 3rd Division took Danzhai (Bazhai) via Sandu. On the morning of the 3rd they burned the town and pushed on toward Duyun.

fields.name: 荔波沦陷 Fall of Libo
fields.summary: 1944年12月3日，日军攻入荔波县城。 On 3 December 1944 the Japanese entered Libo.
fields.description: 1944年12月3日，日军第3师团第34联队攻入荔波县城，4日拂晓撤离。日军在荔波境内屠杀群众近2000人、打伤3000多人。日期据贵州政协《抗战时期荔波的贡献与牺牲》与《日军侵华暴行——贵州篇》。 On 3 December 1944 the Japanese 3rd Division’s 34th Regiment entered Libo and withdrew at dawn on the 4th. In Libo the Japanese killed nearly 2,000 civilians and wounded more than 3,000.

summary.en: On 3 December 1944 the Japanese advance guard reached Niuchang, 7 km east of Duyun, the deepest point of the Qiannan incident.

fields.name: 日军进抵都匀牛场 Japanese Reach Niuchang near Duyun
fields.summary: 1944年12月3日，日军前卫进抵都匀以东7公里的牛场，为黔南事变日军最远点。 On 3 December 1944 the Japanese advance guard reached Niuchang, 7 km east of Duyun, the deepest point of the Qiannan incident.
fields.description: 1944年12月3日13时，日军第3师团第6联队前卫进至都匀以东13公里的龙坪，13时50分接到就地停止、立即反转的命令，此时其前卫已进至都匀东牛场西面，距都匀县城仅7公里。这是黔南事变日军最远点。日期据《黔山抗战烽火》与《日军入侵黔南》。 At 1 p.m. on 3 December 1944 the advance guard of the Japanese 3rd Division’s 6th Regiment reached Longping, 13 km east of Duyun. At 1:50 p.m. it received orders to halt and turn back; by then it had reached Niuchang west of the town, only 7 km from Duyun. This was the deepest Japanese penetration of the Qiannan incident.

fields.description: 1945 年 1 月 27 日中国远征军攻克中缅边境的畹町，与从印度东进的驻印军在芒友会师，中印公路全线打通，滇西反攻结束。 On 27 January 1945 the Chinese expeditionary force took Wanding on the China–Burma border and linked with the India-based army advancing from India at Mangyou, opening the Ledo road and ending the western Yunnan counter-offensive.

summary.zh: 日军占领粤北重镇韶关，打通粤汉铁路南段。
summary.en: Japanese forces captured Shaoguan, the key northern Guangdong city, opening the southern section of the Canton–Hankou railway.

fields.name: 韶关沦陷 Fall of Shaoguan
fields.place: 广东韶关（曲江） Shaoguan (Qujiang), Guangdong
fields.summary: 日军占领粤北重镇韶关，打通粤汉铁路南段。 Japanese forces captured Shaoguan, the key northern Guangdong city, opening the southern section of the Canton–Hankou railway.
fields.description: 1945 年 1 月，日军第 6 方面军为打通粤汉铁路南段并破坏赣南空军基地，向粤北、赣南发动进攻。1 月 28 日，日军占领粤北重镇曲江（韶关），随后沿粤汉铁路南北展开。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In January 1945 the Japanese 6th Area Army attacked northern Guangdong and southern Jiangxi to open the southern section of the Canton–Hankou railway and destroy air bases in southern Jiangxi. On 28 January it captured Qujiang (Shaoguan), the key city of northern Guangdong, and then expanded along the railway. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 遂川机场失守 Fall of the Suichuan Airfield
fields.summary: 日军第 27 师团攻占遂川机场，随后南下进攻赣州。 The Japanese 27th Division captured the Suichuan airfield and advanced south toward Ganzhou.
fields.description: 1945 年 1 月，日军第 27 师团自湘东茶陵、攸县南下，进攻遂川。1 月 31 日，日军攻占遂川机场，随后占领遂川县城，并沿公路南犯赣州。日期有 1 月 30 日、31 日诸说，待页码级核对。 In January 1945 the Japanese 27th Division advanced south from Chaling and Youxian in eastern Hunan toward Suichuan. On 31 January it captured the Suichuan airfield, then the county town, and advanced south along the road toward Ganzhou. Accounts differ between 30 and 31 January and await page-level verification.

summary.en: Japanese forces advanced north from northern Guangdong and occupied Nanxiong.

fields.name: 南雄沦陷 Fall of Nanxiong
fields.summary: 日军自粤北北犯，占领南雄。 Japanese forces advanced north from northern Guangdong and occupied Nanxiong.
fields.description: 1945 年 2 月 1 日，日军占领始兴；2 月 3 日占领南雄。南路日军随后经南雄进入江西，进攻大余、新城，配合北路日军会攻赣州。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 1 February 1945 Japanese forces occupied Shixing and on 3 February Nanxiong. The southern column then entered Jiangxi through Nanxiong, attacked Dayu and Xincheng, and converged with the northern column on Ganzhou. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

fields.description: 1945 年 2 月 5 日，南路日军攻占大余县城，随后沿赣余公路北犯，占领黄龙、青龙、池江等地，2 月 8 日与北路日军会攻新城机场。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 5 February 1945 the southern Japanese column captured Dayu county town and advanced north along the Ganzhou–Dayu road, occupying Huanglong, Qinglong and Chijiang before joining the northern column in attacking the Xincheng airfield on 8 February. The date follows conventional accounts and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 赣州沦陷 Fall of Ganzhou
fields.summary: 日军第 27 师团进占赣州，赣南沦陷。 The Japanese 27th Division entered Ganzhou, and southern Jiangxi fell.
fields.description: 1945 年 2 月 5 日，日军第 27 师团进占赣州城，随后占领全城并继续南侵，占领南康、大余、新城等地。赣州于 7 月 12 日被中国军队收复。日期有 2 月 5 日进占、2 月 6 日全城诸说，待页码级核对。 On 5 February 1945 the Japanese 27th Division entered Ganzhou and then occupied the whole city, continuing south to take Nankang, Dayu and Xincheng. Ganzhou was recovered by Chinese forces on 12 July. Accounts differ between entry on 5 February and full occupation on 6 February and await page-level verification.

summary.en: On 6 February 1945 Nankang fell.

fields.name: 南康沦陷 Fall of Nankang
fields.summary: 1945年2月6日，南康沦陷。 On 6 February 1945 Nankang fell.
fields.description: 1945年2月，日军为打通赣南、摧毁遂川和赣州机场，向赣州、南康、大余推进。2月5日赣州、大余沦陷，2月6日南康沦陷。南康是赣州西南门户。日期据《江西抗日战争史》与《江西抗战大事记》，待页码级核对。 In February 1945 Japanese forces advanced on Ganzhou, Nankang and Dayu to open the way through southern Jiangxi and destroy the Suichuan and Ganzhou airfields. Ganzhou and Dayu fell on 5 February and Nankang on 6 February. Nankang was the southwestern gateway to Ganzhou. The date follows the Jiangxi war history and the Jiangxi war chronology and awaits page-level verification.

fields.name: 第18军调防湘西 18th Army Moves to Western Hunan
fields.summary: 第18军调防湘西沅陵、辰溪，作为第4方面军机动兵团参加湘西会战。 The 18th Army moved to Yuanling and Chenxi in western Hunan as the 4th Front Army’s mobile corps for the Western Hunan campaign.
fields.description: 1945 年春，第18军调防湘西沅陵、辰溪集结，作为第4方面军的机动兵团。4 月湘西会战爆发后，第18军随时准备增援雪峰山方向。 路线为示意简化，日期取通行说法，待史料校订。 In spring 1945 the 18th Army assembled at Yuanling and Chenxi in western Hunan as the 4th Front Army’s mobile corps. When the Western Hunan campaign began in April, it stood ready to reinforce the Xuefeng Mountains sector. fields.name: 西峡口沦陷 Fall of Xixiakou
fields.summary: 1945年3月30日，日军攻占西峡口。 On 30 March 1945 the Japanese captured Xixiakou.
fields.description: 1945年3月30日拂晓，日军第110师团、战车第3师团等部向西峡口进犯，西峡口当日沦陷。中国守军退守重阳店，至4月7日击退日军进攻，歼敌四千余人。日期据《豫西鄂北会战》与光明网《西峡口之战》。 At dawn on 30 March 1945 the Japanese 110th Division and 3rd Tank Division attacked Xixiakou, which fell the same day. The Chinese defenders withdrew to Chongyangdian and by 7 April had beaten off the Japanese attack, killing more than 4,000. Both cited accounts give 30 March.

fields.name: 南阳沦陷 Fall of Nanyang
fields.summary: 1945年4月1日，日军攻占南阳。 On 1 April 1945 the Japanese captured Nanyang.
fields.description: 1945年3月22日，日军发动豫西鄂北战役，开始进袭南阳。4月1日南阳失守。日军第110师团、战车第3师团等部随后西进，攻击西峡口、淅川。日期据《河南的抗战历程》《豫西鄂北会战》与《抗战最伟大的省——河南》。 On 22 March 1945 the Japanese launched the Western Henan–Northern Hubei campaign and attacked Nanyang, which fell on 1 April. The Japanese 110th Division and 3rd Tank Division then drove west against Xixiakou and Xichuan. The cited accounts agree on 1 April.

fields.name: 淅川沦陷 Fall of Xichuan
fields.summary: 1945年4月1日，日军攻占淅川（老城）。 On 1 April 1945 the Japanese captured Xichuan (Laocheng).
fields.description: 1945年3月30日西峡口失守后，日军第110师团继续西进，4月1日陷淅川（今老城镇），即向重阳店方向攻击。另有记载称淅川在1945年2月沦陷，为河南最后沦陷的县城，日期待考，正文并列。日期取《豫西鄂北会战》。 After Xixiakou fell on 30 March 1945 the Japanese 110th Division drove west and took Xichuan (modern Laocheng) on 1 April, then attacked toward Chongyangdian. Another account places the fall in February 1945 and calls Xichuan the last Henan county to fall; that variant remains unresolved and is noted here. The date follows the Western Henan–Northern Hubei campaign history.

fields.name: 谷城沦陷 Fall of Gucheng
fields.summary: 1945年4月7日，日军攻占谷城，占领5天后撤退。 On 7 April 1945 the Japanese captured Gucheng and withdrew five days later.
fields.description: 1945年4月7日，日军第39师团一部攻占谷城，至12日撤退，占领谷城5天。谷城为襄河以西要地，日军占谷城旨在策应老河口作战。日期据《中国抗日战争全史》与襄阳日报《日军在襄阳地区的主要罪行》。 On 7 April 1945 a detachment of the Japanese 39th Division took Gucheng and withdrew on the 12th, occupying the town for five days. Gucheng was a key point west of the Han River, and the operation was intended to support the attack on Laohekou.

summary.zh: 日军进攻湘西芷江机场，中国军队反击，取得湘西会战胜利。
summary.en: Japanese forces attacked the Zhijiang airfield in western Hunan; Chinese troops counterattacked and won the Battle of West Hunan.

fields.name: 湘西会战 Battle of West Hunan 雪峰山会战 Battle of Xuefeng Mountains
fields.summary: 日军进攻湘西芷江机场，中国军队反击，取得湘西会战胜利。 Japanese forces attacked the Zhijiang airfield in western Hunan; Chinese troops counterattacked and won the Battle of West Hunan.
fields.description: 1945 年 4 月，日军发动湘西会战，企图破坏芷江空军基地。中国军队依托雪峰山地形顽强抵抗并反击，至 6 月收复失地，日军伤亡惨重。此役是抗战后期正面战场的一次重要胜利，也是日本投降前中国军队的最后一次大规模攻势防御作战。 本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。 In April 1945, Japanese forces launched the Battle of West Hunan in an attempt to destroy the Zhijiang air base. Chinese troops used the terrain of the Xuefeng Mountains to resist stubbornly and counterattack, recovering the lost ground by June and inflicting heavy casualties on the Japanese. It was an important victory on China’s frontal battlefield in the final year of the war and one of the Chinese army’s last large-scale defensive-offensive operations before Japan’s surrender. Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

fields.name: 日军自邵阳进攻湘西 Japanese advance from Shaoyang into western Hunan
fields.summary: 日军自邵阳、东安出动，进攻芷江机场。 The Japanese moved from Shaoyang and Dong’an against the Zhijiang airfield.
fields.description: 1945 年 4 月 9 日日军第 20 军自邵阳、东安出动，进攻芷江机场，湘西会战爆发；中国军队在雪峰山一线阻击并反攻，6 月日军退回原防。邵阳自 1944 年 9 月即为日军占领。 On 9 April 1945 the Japanese 20th Army moved from Shaoyang and Dong’an against the Zhijiang airfield, opening the western Hunan battle; the Chinese army held and counter-attacked along the Xuefeng mountains, and the Japanese withdrew in June. Shaoyang had been occupied since September 1944.

fields.description: 1945年4月上旬，日军第34师团及第68师团第58旅团分由东安、全县向新宁进犯，4月12日进攻新宁，中国第74军第58师一个营坚守3日，15日日军增援，16日新宁失守。日期据《湘西会战大事记》与维基百科《湘西会战》。 In early April 1945 the Japanese 34th Division and the 58th Brigade of the 68th Division advanced on Xinning from Dong’an and Quanxian. fields.summary: 1945年4月21日，日军第116师团攻占洞口。 On 21 April 1945 the Japanese 116th Division captured Dongkou.
fields.description: 1945年4月21日，日军第116师团第133联队猛攻洞口，中国守军第74军第57师一部抵抗后撤退，洞口失守。洞口为湘黔公路要隘，失守后日军直逼雪峰山主阵地。日期据《湘西会战大事记》与维基百科《湘西会战》。 On 21 April 1945 the 133rd Regiment of the Japanese 116th Division stormed Dongkou; part of the Chinese 57th Division of the 74th Corps resisted and withdrew, and the town fell. Dongkou was a key pass on the Hunan–Guizhou highway, and its loss brought the Japanese to the main Xuefeng Mountain positions.

fields.name: 武冈保卫战 Defence of Wugang
fields.summary: 1945年4月27日，日军第68师团围攻武冈，中国守军坚守至5月7日解围。 On 27 April 1945 the Japanese 68th Division besieged Wugang; the Chinese garrison held out until relieved on 7 May.
fields.description: 1945年4月27日，日军第68师团3000余人围攻武冈，中国第74军第58师一个加强营依托糯米三合土城墙坚守，至5月7日中国第121师、第44师增援，内外夹击，日军撤退，武冈解围。日期据《湘西会战大事记》与维基百科《湘西会战》。 On 27 April 1945 more than 3,000 Japanese of the 68th Division besieged Wugang. A reinforced battalion of the Chinese 58th Division held the walls, built with glutinous-rice mortar, until the Chinese 121st and 44th Divisions arrived on 7 May and attacked from inside and outside; the Japanese withdrew and the siege was lifted.

fields.place: 湖南绥宁武阳 Wuyang, Suining, Hunan
fields.summary: 1945年4月29日，日军第68师团第58旅团攻占武阳。 On 29 April 1945 the 58th Brigade of the Japanese 68th Division captured Wuyang.
fields.description: 1945年4月26日日军第68师团第58旅团进攻武阳，中国第74军第58师第174团9连苦战4昼夜，全连殉国，29日武阳失守。5月1日中国第94军第5师克复武阳，歼敌1500余人。日期据《湘西会战大事记》与维基百科《湘西会战》。 On 26 April 1945 the 58th Brigade of the Japanese 68th Division attacked Wuyang. The 9th Company of the Chinese 174th Regiment, 58th Division, fought for four days and was wiped out; Wuyang fell on the 29th. On 1 May the Chinese 5th Division of the 94th Corps retook Wuyang, killing more than 1,500 Japanese.

fields.description: 1945 年 5 月，第4战区部队在桂北发起反攻，先后收复柳州、桂林，将日军逐出广西。此役与湘西会战、滇西反攻同为抗战末期中国军队的局部反攻。 路线为示意简化，日期取通行说法，待史料校订。 In May 1945 4th War Zone troops launched a counteroffensive in northern Guangxi, recovering Liuzhou and Guilin and driving the Japanese out of the province. Together with the Western Hunan campaign and the western Yunnan counteroffensive, it was one of the limited Chinese counteroffensives at the end of the war. fields.description: 1945 年 5 月，新6军（廖耀湘部）近三万人自云南昆明空运湖南芷江，担任湘西会战总预备队并担负芷江机场守备。此时战局已趋稳定，新6军未及全面参战。 空运航线为示意直线，非地面行军；日期取通行说法，待史料校订。 In May 1945 nearly 30,000 troops of the New 6th Army under Liao Yaoxiang were airlifted from Kunming, Yunnan, to Zhijiang, Hunan, as the general reserve for the Western Hunan campaign and to guard Zhijiang airfield. By then the situation had stabilized and the army did not enter combat in full. Shown as a schematic air bridge, not a ground march; dates follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

fields.name: 广岛原子弹爆炸 Atomic Bombing of Hiroshima
fields.summary: 美国在广岛投下原子弹，加速了日本投降的进程。 The United States dropped an atomic bomb on Hiroshima, accelerating Japan’s surrender.
fields.description: 1945 年 8 月 6 日，美国在日本广岛投下原子弹，造成大量人员伤亡。8 月 9 日，美国又在长崎投下原子弹。核打击与苏联出兵东北共同加速了日本投降。 本事件为国际事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述待史料校订。 On 6 August 1945, the United States dropped an atomic bomb on Hiroshima, causing massive casualties. On 9 August, another bomb was dropped on Nagasaki. The nuclear strikes, together with the Soviet entry into the war in the Northeast, accelerated Japan’s surrender. This is an international event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

fields.name: 苏联对日宣战与出兵东北 Soviet Declaration of War on Japan and Invasion of the Northeast
fields.place: 中国东北（哈尔滨方向） Northeast China (Harbin direction)
fields.summary: 苏联对日宣战并出兵中国东北，关东军迅速崩溃。 The Soviet Union declared war on Japan and invaded Northeast China, rapidly collapsing the Kwantung Army.
fields.description: 1945 年 8 月 8 日（莫斯科时间），苏联对日宣战；8 月 9 日，苏军从东、北、西三个方向进入中国东北和朝鲜北部，进攻日本关东军。关东军在短时间内瓦解，日本投降进程明显加快。 本事件为国际事件，不绘制路线；日期按中国通行的 8 月 9 日标注，地点取东北方向示意点，待史料校订。 The Soviet Union declared war on Japan on 8 August 1945 (Moscow time); on 9 August, Soviet forces entered Northeast China and northern Korea from the east, north, and west, attacking the Japanese Kwantung Army. The Kwantung Army collapsed quickly, significantly accelerating Japan’s surrender. This is an international event with no route drawn; the date follows the conventional Chinese usage of 9 August, and the location is an illustrative point in the Northeast pending historical review.

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

name.en: Mao Zedong Issues “The Last Battle against the Japanese”

summary.zh: 毛泽东发表声明，号召全国规模反攻。
summary.en: Mao Zedong issued a statement calling for a nationwide counter-offensive.

fields.name: 《对日寇的最后一战》发表 Mao Zedong Issues “The Last Battle against the Japanese” 对日寇的最后一战 The Last Battle against the Japanese
fields.summary: 毛泽东发表声明，号召全国规模反攻。 Mao Zedong issued a statement calling for a nationwide counter-offensive.
fields.description: 1945 年 8 月 9 日，毛泽东在延安发表《对日寇的最后一战》声明，指出对日战争已处在最后阶段，号召中国人民的一切抗日力量举行全国规模的反攻，八路军、新四军及其他人民军队应在一切可能条件下，对不愿投降的侵略者及其走狗实行广泛进攻。 声明文本以《毛泽东选集》第三卷所收版本为准。 On 9 August 1945 Mao Zedong issued the statement “The Last Battle against the Japanese” in Yan’an, declaring that the war against Japan had entered its final stage and calling on all Chinese anti-Japanese forces to launch a nationwide counter-offensive. The Eighth Route Army, New Fourth Army, and other people’s forces were to attack widely wherever the invaders and their collaborators refused to surrender. The text follows the version collected in Selected Works of Mao Zedong, vol. 3.

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

name.en: The Eighth Route Army Launches the General Counter-Offensive

summary.zh: 朱德连续发布七道反攻命令，八路军向华北日伪军全面进攻。
summary.en: Zhu De issued seven counter-offensive orders; the Eighth Route Army attacked Japanese and puppet forces across North China.

fields.name: 八路军发动大反攻 The Eighth Route Army Launches the General Counter-Offensive 八路军全面反攻 Eighth Route Army General Counter-Offensive
fields.summary: 朱德连续发布七道反攻命令，八路军向华北日伪军全面进攻。 Zhu De issued seven counter-offensive orders; the Eighth Route Army attacked Japanese and puppet forces across North China.
fields.description: 1945 年 8 月 10 日至 11 日，八路军总司令朱德以延安总部名义连续发布七道反攻命令，要求各解放区抗日武装向附近城镇、交通要道的日伪军送出通牒，限期缴械，对拒绝投降者坚决消灭；同时命令晋绥、晋察冀、山东和冀热辽部队向东北及华北各城市推进。各解放区部队随即展开全面反攻，至 9 月 2 日共解放县以上城市 150 座。 命令序号与时间以中央档案馆藏件为准，战果统计为通行说法。 From 10 to 11 August 1945 Zhu De, commander-in-chief of the Eighth Route Army, issued seven counter-offensive orders in the name of the Yan’an headquarters. Anti-Japanese forces in the liberated areas were to send ultimatums to Japanese and puppet troops in nearby towns and along transport routes, demand surrender within a set time, and destroy those who refused. Forces in the Jin-Sui, Jin-Cha-Ji, Shandong, and Ji-Re-Liao areas were ordered to advance toward cities in North China and the Northeast. The liberated areas then launched a general counter-offensive; by 2 September they had liberated 150 county-level towns and cities. Order numbers and times follow the documents held by the Central Archives; the tally of liberated cities follows conventional accounts.

summary.en: The Japanese emperor broadcast the rescript accepting the Potsdam Declaration, bringing victory in China’s war of resistance.

fields.name: 日本宣布无条件投降 Japan Announces Unconditional Surrender
fields.summary: 日本天皇广播《终战诏书》，宣布接受《波茨坦公告》，中国抗日战争取得胜利。 The Japanese emperor broadcast the rescript accepting the Potsdam Declaration, bringing victory in China’s war of resistance.
fields.description: 1945 年 8 月 15 日，日本天皇裕仁通过广播发布《终战诏书》，宣布接受中美英苏四国发表的《波茨坦公告》，实际上宣布无条件投降。中国各地举行庆祝活动，抗日战争取得胜利。 本事件为政治事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述待史料校订。 On 15 August 1945, Emperor Hirohito broadcast the Imperial Rescript on the Termination of the War, accepting the Potsdam Declaration issued by China, the United States, Britain, and the Soviet Union—in effect announcing unconditional surrender. Celebrations took place across China, marking victory in the war of resistance. This is a political event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

fields.description: 日军为掠夺田独铁矿，从上海、广州、香港、澳门、汕头、厦门等沦陷区诱骗、强征劳工，并在海南各县强抽民夫。劳工在日军和工头押制下从事高强度劳动，病死、饿死、打死、烧死、活埋者众多。战后调查与《海南铁矿志》记载死亡万余人；1945 年 8 月日军投降时，田独铁矿仅存 1713 人。具体数字待页码级核对。本事件为惨案，不绘路线。 To extract the Tiandu iron ore, Japan deceived and forcibly recruited laborers from Shanghai, Guangzhou, Hong Kong, Macao, Shantou and Xiamen and impressed villagers across Hainan. Under Japanese guards and foremen they performed heavy labor, and many died of disease, starvation, beatings, burning or burial alive. Postwar investigations and the Hainan Iron Mine Gazetteer record more than 10,000 deaths; when Japan surrendered in August 1945 only 1,713 laborers remained at Tiandu. These figures await page-level verification. As a massacre, this event is not drawn as a route.

fields.name: 日本签署投降书 Signing of the Japanese Instrument of Surrender
fields.place: 日本东京湾美国“密苏里”号战列舰 USS Missouri, Tokyo Bay, Japan
fields.summary: 日本代表在东京湾签署投降书，第二次世界大战正式结束。 Japanese representatives signed the instrument of surrender in Tokyo Bay, formally ending the Second World War.
fields.description: 1945 年 9 月 2 日，日本政府代表在东京湾美国“密苏里”号战列舰上签署投降书，中、美、英、苏等同盟国代表签字接受。至此，中国抗日战争与第二次世界大战正式结束。 本事件为政治事件，不绘制路线；日期与地点为通行说法，待史料校订。 On 2 September 1945, Japanese government representatives signed the instrument of surrender aboard the USS Missouri in Tokyo Bay, and representatives of the Allied powers, including China, the United States, Britain, and the Soviet Union, accepted it. China’s war of resistance and the Second World War formally ended. This is a political event with no route drawn; date and location follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

fields.name: 富阳宋殿洽降 Surrender Talks at Songdian, Fuyang
fields.place: 浙江富阳宋殿 Songdian, Fuyang, Zhejiang
fields.summary: 1945年9月4日，侵浙日军在富阳宋殿村洽降。 On 4 September 1945 the Japanese forces in Zhejiang attended surrender talks at Songdian in Fuyang.
fields.description: 9月4日，侵浙日军投降仪式在富阳宋殿村举行，第三战区副司令长官韩德勤代表中国政府主持接受日军投降仪式；侵杭日军最高指挥官、第133师团长野地嘉平代表日方呈交投降日军的兵力、驻地、指挥系统、官长姓名等图表。富阳人民后来把宋殿村改为受降村。受降事件，不绘路线。 On 4 September the surrender ceremony for Japanese forces in Zhejiang was held at Songdian in Fuyang. Lieutenant General Han Deqin, deputy commander of the Third War Zone, presided for China; the senior Japanese commander in Hangzhou, Lieutenant General Noji Kahei of the 133rd Division, submitted charts of Japanese strength, dispositions, command system and officers. The village was later renamed Shouxiang (Surrender) village. This surrender event is not drawn as a route.

fields.name: 中国战区受降仪式 Surrender Ceremony in the China Theater
fields.summary: 中国战区受降仪式在南京举行，何应钦代表中国接受冈村宁次投降。 The surrender ceremony for the China Theater was held in Nanjing, where He Yingqin accepted the surrender of Okamura Yasuji on behalf of China.
fields.description: 1945 年 9 月 9 日，中国战区受降仪式在南京中央军校大礼堂举行。中国陆军总司令何应钦代表中国战区最高统帅接受日本驻华派遣军总司令冈村宁次投降，在华日军向中国缴械。 政治事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述待史料校订。 On 9 September 1945 the surrender ceremony for the China Theater was held in the auditorium of the Central Military Academy in Nanjing. He Yingqin, commander-in-chief of the Chinese Army, accepted the surrender of Okamura Yasuji, commander of the Japanese forces in China, on behalf of the supreme command of the China Theater, and Japanese troops in China laid down their arms. A political event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

fields.name: 太原受降 Japanese Surrender at Taiyuan
fields.summary: 1945年9月13日，第二战区司令长官阎锡山在太原接受日军投降。 On 13 September 1945 Yan Xishan, commander of the Second War Zone, accepted the Japanese surrender at Taiyuan.
fields.description: 1945年9月13日，日军第1军司令官澄田赉四郎在太原受领中国第二战区司令长官部第一号命令，开始部署投降事宜。第二战区共接受日军第1军及第114师团、第3、第10、第14独立旅团、第5独立骑兵团等部六万余人投降，并遣返日侨四万人。受降事件不绘制进攻路线。日期据国家档案局《伟大胜利——中国受降档案》与《山西县城沦陷及光复概况》。 On 13 September 1945 Lt. Gen. Teita Raishiro, commander of the Japanese First Army, received Order No. 1 from the Chinese Second War Zone headquarters at Taiyuan and began arranging the surrender. The Second War Zone accepted over 60,000 Japanese troops of the First Army, the 114th Division and the 3rd, 10th and 14th Independent Brigades and 5th Independent Cavalry Regiment, and repatriated 40,000 Japanese civilians. No advance route is drawn for a surrender event. Dates follow the National Archives’ surrender records and the Shanxi county gazetteer compilation.

fields.name: 长沙受降 Japanese Surrender at Changsha
fields.summary: 1945年9月15日，第四方面军司令官王耀武在长沙接受日军第20军投降。 On 15 September 1945 Wang Yaowu, commander of the Chinese Fourth Front Army, accepted the surrender of the Japanese 20th Army at Changsha.
fields.description: 1945年9月15日，第四方面军司令官王耀武在长沙岳麓山湖南大学科学馆接受日军第20军司令官坂西一良中将投降。长衡岳受降区负责接受长沙、衡阳、岳阳地区日军，日军第20军、第64、第68、第116师团及独立第17、第81、第82旅团等部约7万人投降。受降事件不绘制进攻路线。日期据湖南省档案局《湖南地区日军受降报告书档案》与《人民日报海外版》受降档案。 On 15 September 1945 Wang Yaowu, commander of the Fourth Front Army, accepted the surrender of Lt. Gen. Sakanishi Ichiro, commander of the Japanese 20th Army, at the Hunan University science building on Yuelu Mountain in Changsha. The Changsha–Hengyang–Yueyang surrender zone covered some 70,000 Japanese troops of the 20th Army, the 64th, 68th and 116th Divisions and the 17th, 81st and 82nd Independent Brigades. No advance route is drawn for a surrender event.

fields.summary: 张发奎在广州接受田中久一投降。 Zhang Fakui accepted the surrender of Tanaka Hisakazu in Guangzhou.
fields.description: 1945 年 9 月 16 日上午 10 时，中国第二方面军司令官张发奎在广州中山纪念堂接受日本第 23 军司令官兼香港占领地总督田中久一投降，受降范围包括广州、雷州半岛与海南岛。日期据中国受降档案，待页码级核对。本事件为受降事件，不绘路线。 At 10:00 on 16 September 1945 Zhang Fakui, commander of the Chinese 2nd Front Army, accepted the surrender of Tanaka Hisakazu, commander of the Japanese 23rd Army and governor of occupied Hong Kong, at the Sun Yat-sen Memorial Hall in Guangzhou. The surrender covered Guangzhou, the Leizhou Peninsula and Hainan. The date follows Chinese surrender archives and awaits page-level verification. As a surrender event, it is not drawn as a route.

fields.name: 杭州日军缴械 Disarmament of Japanese Troops in Hangzhou
fields.summary: 1945年9月18日，驻杭日军全部缴械。 On 18 September 1945 all Japanese troops in Hangzhou were disarmed.
fields.description: 9月7日，陈纯白率部进入杭州市区，从伪市长吴念中处接收伪杭州市政府；9月18日，驻杭日军全部缴械。月底，杭州周围的新四军部队和各县抗日民主政府干部开始北撤，省政府各机关迁回杭州。受降事件，不绘路线。 On 7 September Chen Chunbai led troops into Hangzhou and took over the puppet municipal government from mayor Wu Nianzhong; on 18 September all Japanese troops in Hangzhou were disarmed. At the end of the month New Fourth Army units around Hangzhou and county democratic government cadres began withdrawing north, and provincial government offices returned to the city. This surrender event is not drawn as a route.

fields.name: 武汉受降 Japanese Surrender at Wuhan
fields.summary: 1945年9月18日，第六战区司令长官孙蔚如在汉口接受日军第六方面军投降。 On 18 September 1945 Sun Weiru, commander of the Chinese Sixth War Zone, accepted the surrender of the Japanese Sixth Area Army at Hankou.
fields.description: 1945年9月18日下午3时，第六战区司令长官孙蔚如在汉口中山公园受降堂接受日军第六方面军司令官冈部直三郎大将率属21万人投降。武汉受降区负责接受武汉、沙市、宜昌地区日军。受降事件不绘制进攻路线。日期据国家档案局《伟大胜利——中国受降档案》与人民网《1945，难忘的武汉之夏》。 At 3 p.m. on 18 September 1945 Sun Weiru, commander of the Chinese Sixth War Zone, accepted the surrender of Gen. Okabe Tasaburo, commander of the Japanese Sixth Area Army, and 210,000 troops at the surrender hall in Hankou’s Zhongshan Park. The Wuhan surrender zone covered Wuhan, Shashi and Yichang. No advance route is drawn for a surrender event.

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

summary.zh: 1945年9月20日，第五战区在郾城（漯河）接受日军投降。
summary.en: On 20 September 1945 the Chinese Fifth War Zone accepted the Japanese surrender at Yancheng (Luohe).

fields.name: 漯河受降 Japanese Surrender at Luohe
fields.summary: 1945年9月20日，第五战区在郾城（漯河）接受日军投降。 On 20 September 1945 the Chinese Fifth War Zone accepted the Japanese surrender at Yancheng (Luohe).
fields.description: 1945年9月20日，第五战区在郾城（漯河）山西会馆举行受降仪式，司令长官刘峙主持，日军第12军司令官鹰森孝在投降书上签字，在郾城投降日军31560人。漯河为全国16个受降区之一。受降事件不绘制进攻路线。日期据《日军郑州投降纪实》与《受降亭》。 On 20 September 1945 the Fifth War Zone held a surrender ceremony at the Shanxi Guild Hall in Yancheng (Luohe), presided over by commander Liu Zhi; Lt. Gen. Takamori of the Japanese 12th Army signed the instrument of surrender, and 31,560 Japanese troops surrendered at Yancheng. Luohe was one of the sixteen surrender zones in China. No advance route is drawn for a surrender event.

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

summary.zh: 1945年9月22日，第一战区在郑州接受日军第12军投降。
summary.en: On 22 September 1945 the Chinese First War Zone accepted the surrender of the Japanese 12th Army at Zhengzhou.

fields.name: 郑州受降 Japanese Surrender at Zhengzhou
fields.summary: 1945年9月22日，第一战区在郑州接受日军第12军投降。 On 22 September 1945 the Chinese First War Zone accepted the surrender of the Japanese 12th Army at Zhengzhou.
fields.description: 1945年9月22日，第一战区在郑州前进指挥所举行受降仪式，由战区参谋长李昆岗主持，日军第12军司令官鹰森孝向胡宗南部投降，在郑州投降日军43334人。郑州受降区原定洛阳，后因日军第12军军部驻郑州而改在郑州。受降事件不绘制进攻路线。日期据《日军郑州投降纪实》与《重读抗战·河南》。 On 22 September 1945 the First War Zone held a surrender ceremony at its Zhengzhou advance headquarters, presided over by Chief of Staff Li Kungang; Lt. Gen. Takamori of the Japanese 12th Army surrendered to Hu Zongnan’s forces, with 43,334 Japanese troops laying down arms at Zhengzhou. The surrender site had originally been Luoyang but was moved to Zhengzhou because the 12th Army headquarters was there. No advance route is drawn for a surrender event.

summary.zh: 1945年9月24日，第十战区在蚌埠举行受降仪式。
summary.en: On 24 September 1945 the Chinese Tenth War Zone held a surrender ceremony in Bengbu.

fields.name: 蚌埠受降 Japanese Surrender at Bengbu
fields.summary: 1945年9月24日，第十战区在蚌埠举行受降仪式。 On 24 September 1945 the Chinese Tenth War Zone held a surrender ceremony in Bengbu.
fields.description: 9月24日下午3时，在蚌埠国民党军第十战区前进指挥所礼堂内举行第九受降区受降仪式，由第十战区司令长官李品仙、前进指挥所主任张金等主持，日军代表第6军司令官十川次郎在投降书上签字。受降事件，不绘路线。 At 3 p.m. on 24 September the Ninth Surrender District ceremony was held in the advance command post of the Chinese Tenth War Zone in Bengbu, presided over by Tenth War Zone commander Li Pinxian and advance command post director Zhang Jin. The Japanese representative, Lieutenant General Jūkawa Jirō, commander of the 6th Army, signed the instrument of surrender. This surrender event is not drawn as a route.

name.en: Surrender of Japanese Forces in Shantou

summary.zh: 余汉谋在汕头接受田中久一代表投降。
summary.en: Yu Hanmou accepted the surrender of Tanaka Hisakazu’s representative in Shantou.

fields.name: 汕头受降 Surrender of Japanese Forces in Shantou
fields.summary: 余汉谋在汕头接受田中久一代表投降。 Yu Hanmou accepted the surrender of Tanaka Hisakazu’s representative in Shantou.
fields.description: 1945 年 9 月 28 日上午 9 时，中国第七战区司令长官余汉谋派代表徐景唐在汕头“潮汕前进指挥所”接受日军第 23 军参谋长富田直亮代表田中久一投降，受降范围包括曲江、潮汕地区。日期据中国受降档案，待页码级核对。本事件为受降事件，不绘路线。 At 09:00 on 28 September 1945 Xu Jingtang, representing Chinese 7th War Zone commander Yu Hanmou, accepted the surrender of Major General Tomita Naoaki, chief of staff of the Japanese 23rd Army and representative of Tanaka Hisakazu, at the Chaoshan advance command post in Shantou. The surrender covered Qujiang and the Chaoshan region. The date follows Chinese surrender archives and awaits page-level verification. As a surrender event, it is not drawn as a route.

summary.zh: 1945年9月28日，驻厦日军在鼓浪屿海滨饭店签署投降书。
summary.en: On 28 September 1945 the Japanese garrison in Xiamen signed the instrument of surrender at the Gulangyu seaside hotel.

fields.name: 厦门受降 Japanese Surrender at Xiamen
fields.place: 福建厦门鼓浪屿 Gulangyu, Xiamen, Fujian
fields.summary: 1945年9月28日，驻厦日军在鼓浪屿海滨饭店签署投降书。 On 28 September 1945 the Japanese garrison in Xiamen signed the instrument of surrender at the Gulangyu seaside hotel.
fields.description: 9月28日，国民党海军第二舰队司令李世甲、厦门要港司令刘德浦在鼓浪屿海滨饭店举行驻厦日军受降仪式，驻厦日军司令官原田清一海军中将在投降书上签字。受降事件，不绘路线。 On 28 September the Chinese navy's 2nd Fleet commander Li Shijia and Xiamen port commander Liu Depu held the surrender ceremony for the Japanese garrison at the Gulangyu seaside hotel; Vice Admiral Harada Seiichi, commander of the Xiamen garrison, signed the instrument of surrender. This surrender event is not drawn as a route.

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

name.en: Surrender of Japanese Forces in Hainan

summary.zh: 国民党第 46 军渡海接收海南，日军海南警备府所部投降。
summary.en: The Chinese 46th Army crossed to Hainan to receive the surrender of the Japanese Hainan Guard District.

fields.name: 海南受降 Surrender of Japanese Forces in Hainan
fields.summary: 国民党第 46 军渡海接收海南，日军海南警备府所部投降。 The Chinese 46th Army crossed to Hainan to receive the surrender of the Japanese Hainan Guard District.
fields.description: 1945 年 9 月，国民党第 46 军渡海进入海南。10 月初，叶佩高、朱晖日在海口成立前进指挥所，负责对日受降；10 月中旬起，第 188 师、新编第 19 师、第 175 师分批登陆，接收日军武器、器材与物资。日军海南警备府所部投降。精确受降仪式日期与各批接收日程待页码级核对。本事件为受降事件，不绘路线。 In September 1945 the Chinese 46th Army crossed to Hainan. In early October Ye Peigao and Zhu Huiri established an advance command post at Haikou to handle the Japanese surrender; from mid-October the 188th, New 19th and 175th Divisions landed in batches and took over Japanese weapons, equipment and supplies. The Japanese Hainan Guard District surrendered. The exact ceremony date and reception schedule await page-level verification. As a surrender event, it is not drawn as a route.

summary.zh: 1945年10月6日，天津举行日军受降仪式。
summary.en: On 6 October 1945 a Japanese surrender ceremony was held in Tianjin.

fields.name: 天津受降 Japanese Surrender at Tianjin
fields.summary: 1945年10月6日，天津举行日军受降仪式。 On 6 October 1945 a Japanese surrender ceremony was held in Tianjin.
fields.description: 10月6日，天津举行日军受降仪式，接收天津地区日军。天津是华北重要港口和日军华北方面军的重要据点。受降事件，不绘路线。日期据中国受降档案与《中国抗日战争史》，待页码级核对。 On 6 October a surrender ceremony was held in Tianjin to receive the Japanese forces in the Tianjin area. Tianjin was a major North China port and an important base of the Japanese North China Area Army. This surrender event is not drawn as a route. The date follows the Chinese surrender archives and the Chinese war history and awaits page-level verification.

summary.en: On 10 October 1945 the Japanese surrender ceremony was held at the Hall of Supreme Harmony in Beiping.

fields.name: 北平受降 Japanese Surrender at Beiping
fields.summary: 1945年10月10日，北平太和殿举行日军受降仪式。 On 10 October 1945 the Japanese surrender ceremony was held at the Hall of Supreme Harmony in Beiping.
fields.description: 10月10日，北平太和殿举行日军受降仪式，第十一战区司令长官孙连仲代表中国政府受降，日军华北方面军司令官根本博在投降书上签字。受降事件，不绘路线。日期据中国受降档案与《中国抗日战争史》，待页码级核对。 On 10 October the surrender ceremony was held at the Hall of Supreme Harmony in Beiping. Sun Lianzhong, commander of the 11th War Zone, received the surrender for China, and General Nemoto Hiroshi, commander of the Japanese North China Area Army, signed the instrument of surrender. This surrender event is not drawn as a route. The date follows the Chinese surrender archives and the Chinese war history and awaits page-level verification.

summary.zh: 中国战区台湾省受降仪式在台北举行，台湾光复。
summary.en: The Taiwan surrender ceremony of the China Theater was held in Taipei, and Taiwan returned to China.

fields.name: 台湾光复 Retrocession of Taiwan
fields.summary: 中国战区台湾省受降仪式在台北举行，台湾光复。 The Taiwan surrender ceremony of the China Theater was held in Taipei, and Taiwan returned to China.
fields.description: 1945 年 10 月 25 日，中国战区台湾省受降仪式在台北举行，日本台湾总督安藤利吉向中国代表陈仪投降，台湾及澎湖列岛回归中国。日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。本事件为受降事件，不绘路线。 On 25 October 1945 the China Theater’s Taiwan surrender ceremony was held in Taipei. Japanese governor-general Rikichi Andō surrendered to Chinese representative Chen Yi, and Taiwan and the Penghu Islands returned to China. fields.description: 1933 年 10 月 12 日，国民党以杨子恒为总指挥，调集 4 个正规团及耀县、淳化、旬邑等县民团数千人，携带大炮向照金苏区发起大规模“围剿”。刘志丹率红二十六军主力主动撤离照金，转至外线作战；习仲勋等留在照金坚持斗争，随后撤出薛家寨。10 月 18 日，敌军在叛徒引路下从后沟石缝攀上薛家寨，寨内守军与边区机关突围，薛家寨失守。陕甘边党政军随后向包家寨、南梁方向转移，11 月 3—5 日在包家寨召开联席会议，决定恢复红二十六军、创建以南梁为中心的根据地。 On 12 October 1933 the KMT, under Yang Ziheng, sent four regular regiments and several thousand militia from Yao, Chunhua and Xunyi counties with artillery against the Zhaojin base. Liu Zhidan withdrew the main force of the 26th Red Army to exterior lines, while Xi Zhongxun and others stayed behind and later left Xuejiazhai. On 18 October, guided by a traitor, enemy troops climbed the rear gorge into Xuejiazhai; the defenders and border organs broke out and the stronghold fell. The border party, government and army then moved toward Baojiazhai and Nanliang, where the 3–5 November conference decided to restore the 26th Red Army and build the Nanliang base.

atlasTitle.en: The Long March

place.zh: 甘肃合水包家寨（今蒿咀铺乡张举塬村）

summary.zh: 陕甘边特委与红军临时总指挥部联席会议，决定恢复红二十六军、以南梁为中心创建根据地。
summary.en: A joint conference of the border special committee and the provisional Red Army command decided to restore the 26th Red Army and build the base around Nanliang.

fields.name: 包家寨会议 Baojiazhai conference
fields.place: 甘肃合水包家寨（今蒿咀铺乡张举塬村） Baojiazhai, Heshui, Gansu (Zhangjuyuan village, Haozipu)
fields.summary: 陕甘边特委与红军临时总指挥部联席会议，决定恢复红二十六军、以南梁为中心创建根据地。 A joint conference of the border special committee and the provisional Red Army command decided to restore the 26th Red Army and build the base around Nanliang.
fields.description: 1933 年 11 月 3—5 日，中共陕甘边区特委、陕甘边区革命委员会和红军临时总指挥部在合水县包家寨（今蒿咀铺乡张举塬村）召开联席会议。会议总结照金失守的教训，决定撤销红军临时总指挥部，恢复红二十六军、成立第四十二师（王泰吉任师长、高岗任政委、刘志丹任参谋长），进军南梁建立根据地，并划分陕北安定、陇东南梁、关中照金三路游击区。11 月 8 日在平定川莲花寺宣布红四十二师成立，全师 500 余人。会议旧址在张举塬村东峁，坐标取蒿咀铺乡代表点。 From 3 to 5 November 1933 the Shaanxi-Gansu Border Special Committee, the border revolutionary committee and the provisional Red Army command met at Baojiazhai (Zhangjuyuan village, Haozipu township, Heshui). Reviewing the loss of Zhaojin, the conference abolished the provisional command, restored the 26th Red Army and formed its 42nd Division (Wang Taiji commander, Gao Gang political commissar, Liu Zhidan chief of staff), decided to march on Nanliang and build the base there, and divided three guerrilla zones — Anding in northern Shaanxi, Nanliang in eastern Gansu, Zhaojin in Guanzhong. On 8 November the 42nd Division was proclaimed at Lianhuasi, Pingdingchuan, some 500 strong. The meeting site is at the eastern ridge of Zhangjuyuan; the coordinate uses the Haozipu township point.

atlasTitle.en: The Long March

name.en: First counter-encirclement campaign in the Shaanxi-Gansu border area

summary.zh: 红四十二师转外线作战，经 30 余次战斗挫败国民党军对南梁的“围剿”。
summary.en: The 42nd Division fought on exterior lines and broke the KMT encirclement of Nanliang in over 30 actions.

fields.name: 陕甘边第一次反“围剿” First counter-encirclement campaign in the Shaanxi-Gansu border area
fields.place: 甘肃华池南梁 Nanliang, Huachi, Gansu
fields.summary: 红四十二师转外线作战，经 30 余次战斗挫败国民党军对南梁的“围剿”。 The 42nd Division fought on exterior lines and broke the KMT encirclement of Nanliang in over 30 actions.
fields.description: 1934 年 2 月，国民党西安绥署调集第十七路军驻陇东警备第二旅 2 个团、陕西警备骑兵旅 2 个团、第 42 师 1 个团及第 86 师一部和民团共万余人，分路合击以南梁为中心的陕甘边苏区。红四十二师以部分游击队袭扰牵制，主力转至外线：3 月经三道川、蔺家砭、李家梁战斗歼骑兵旅第二团 4 个连，4 月 11 日在西华池歼 700 余人，5 月上旬在三里塬歼 2 个连，5 月下旬北返南梁，6 月在马子川击退第 86 师 1 个营。经 30 余次战斗，毙伤国民党军及民团 3000 余人，挫败围剿，南梁根据地得到巩固并扩大。陕北方向的同期反围剿另见「陕北苏区第一次反“围剿”」。 In February 1934 the Xi’an garrison headquarters sent over 10,000 troops — two regiments of the 2nd Security Brigade in eastern Gansu, two of the Shaanxi Security Cavalry Brigade, one regiment of the 42nd Division, part of the 86th Division and militia — against the Shaanxi-Gansu border base centred on Nanliang. Leaving guerrillas to harass and pin the enemy, the 42nd Division moved to exterior lines: in March it destroyed four companies of the cavalry brigade’s 2nd Regiment at Sandaochan, Linjiabian and Lijialiang; on 11 April it annihilated over 700 men at Xihuachi; in early May two companies at Sanliyuan; in late May it returned north to Nanliang and in June drove off a battalion of the 86th Division at Mazichuan. In over 30 actions it killed or wounded more than 3,000 KMT troops and militia, breaking the campaign and consolidating and expanding the Nanliang base. The simultaneous campaign in northern Shaanxi is a separate event.

name.zh: 陕甘边区革命委员会成立
name.en: Founding of the Shaanxi-Gansu Border Revolutionary Committee

place.zh: 甘肃华池南梁小河沟四合台

fields.name: 陕甘边区革命委员会成立 Founding of the Shaanxi-Gansu Border Revolutionary Committee
fields.place: 甘肃华池南梁小河沟四合台 Sihetai, Xiaohegou, Nanliang, Huachi, Gansu
fields.summary: 陕甘边区革命委员会在南梁小河沟四合台成立，习仲勋任主席。 The Shaanxi-Gansu Border Revolutionary Committee was founded at Sihetai, Nanliang, with Xi Zhongxun as chairman.
fields.description: 1934 年 2 月 25 日，中共红四十二师党委主持在南梁小河沟四合台村召开群众大会，成立新的陕甘边区革命委员会，选举习仲勋为主席，白天章、贾生秀任副主席，蔡子伟任政治秘书长。革命委员会的成立标志陕甘苏区初具规模；同年 11 月 1—7 日，陕甘边区苏维埃政府在荔园堡成立。 On 25 February 1934 a mass meeting convened by the 42nd Division’s party committee at Sihetai, Xiaohegou, Nanliang, founded a new Shaanxi-Gansu Border Revolutionary Committee, electing Xi Zhongxun chairman with Bai Tianzhang and Jia Shengxiu as vice-chairmen and Cai Ziwei as political secretary. Its founding marked the emergence of the Shaanxi-Gansu Soviet area; the border Soviet government proper was established at Liyuanpu on 1–7 November the same year.

summary.en: The 42nd Division destroyed the headquarters and two battalions of the 5th Regiment, 2nd Security Brigade, at Xihuachi.

fields.name: 西华池战斗 Action at Xihuachi
fields.place: 甘肃合水西华池（今合水县城） Xihuachi, Heshui, Gansu (today’s Heshui county town)
fields.summary: 红四十二师在西华池歼陇东警备第二旅第五团团部及两个营。 The 42nd Division destroyed the headquarters and two battalions of the 5th Regiment, 2nd Security Brigade, at Xihuachi.
fields.description: 1934 年 4 月 11 日，红四十二师在西华池（今合水县城）地区歼灭国民党陇东警备第二旅第五团团部及 2 个营，计 700 余人，缴枪 500 余支。此战为陕甘边第一次反“围剿”外线作战的重要一仗；另有一说记为 4 月 2 日、毙俘 600 余人。 On 11 April 1934 the 42nd Division annihilated the headquarters and two battalions of the 5th Regiment, 2nd Security Brigade, at Xihuachi (today’s Heshui county town) — over 700 men — and captured more than 500 rifles. It was a key action on the exterior lines of the first counter-encirclement campaign; another account gives 2 April and 600-odd killed and captured.

place.zh: 陕西淳化三里塬（今十里塬镇三里塬村一带）
place.en: Sanliyuan, Chunhua, Shaanxi (Sanliyuan village, Shilixiang town)

summary.zh: 红四十二师在淳化三里塬遭遇战中歼陕西游击支队两个连。
summary.en: The 42nd Division destroyed two companies of the Shaanxi guerrilla detachment in an encounter at Sanliyuan, Chunhua.

fields.name: 三里塬战斗 Action at Sanliyuan
fields.place: 陕西淳化三里塬（今十里塬镇三里塬村一带） Sanliyuan, Chunhua, Shaanxi (Sanliyuan village, Shilixiang town)
fields.summary: 红四十二师在淳化三里塬遭遇战中歼陕西游击支队两个连。 The 42nd Division destroyed two companies of the Shaanxi guerrilla detachment in an encounter at Sanliyuan, Chunhua.
fields.description: 1934 年 5 月上旬，红四十二师在淳化三里塬与国民党陕西游击支队遭遇，歼其 2 个连。此后国民党军以 8 个团兵力开始新的“围剿”，红四十二师于 5 月下旬北返南梁。三里塬取今淳化县十里塬镇三里塬村一带代表点，战场具体位置待核。 In early May 1934 the 42nd Division encountered the KMT Shaanxi guerrilla detachment at Sanliyuan, Chunhua, and destroyed two of its companies. The KMT then began a new encirclement with eight regiments, and the division returned north to Nanliang in late May. Sanliyuan uses the Sanliyuan village area of Shilixiang town, Chunhua; the exact battle site awaits verification.

name.zh: 陕北苏区第一次反“围剿”
name.en: First counter-encirclement campaign in northern Shaanxi

summary.en: Northern Shaanxi guerrillas and the 42nd Division’s 3rd Regiment broke the 86th Division’s clearance of the northern Shaanxi Soviet area.

fields.name: 陕北苏区第一次反“围剿” First counter-encirclement campaign in northern Shaanxi
fields.place: 陕西安定县城（今子长市安定镇） Anding county town (Anding town, Zichang), Shaanxi
fields.summary: 陕北游击队与红四十二师第三团协同，打破第八十六师对陕北苏区的“清剿”。 Northern Shaanxi guerrillas and the 42nd Division’s 3rd Regiment broke the 86th Division’s clearance of the northern Shaanxi Soviet area.
fields.description: 1934 年 5 月起，井岳秀第八十六师及各县民团共 1.5 万余人对陕北苏区“清剿”。7 月 8 日陕北游击队总指挥部在安定杨道峁成立，谢子长任总指挥；7 月 17 日攻入安定县城，释放被捕党员和群众 200 余人。7 月下旬谢子长南下南梁与红四十二师会合，任师政委；8 月 15 日率红三团及陕北游击队第 1、2、5 支队返回安定，经景武家塌、张家圪台、河口镇、董家寺等战斗，拔除三个据点，歼敌 200 余人、俘 100 余人；谢子长在 8 月 26 日河口镇战斗中胸部负伤。历时三个多月，打破了对陕北苏区的第一次“围剿”。这与陕甘边方向 1934 年 2—6 月的反“围剿”是同一轮“围剿”的两个战场。 From May 1934 Jing Yuexiu’s 86th Division and county militia, over 15,000 strong, cleared the northern Shaanxi Soviet area. On 8 July the Northern Shaanxi Guerrilla Headquarters was formed at Yangdaomao, Anding, under Xie Zichang; on 17 July it took Anding county town and freed over 200 imprisoned party members and supporters. In late July Xie went south to Nanliang, joined the 42nd Division and became its political commissar; on 15 August he returned to Anding with the 3rd Regiment and the 1st, 2nd and 5th guerrilla detachments, and through the actions at Jingwujiajia, Zhangjiagetai, Hekou and Dongjiasi the reds destroyed three enemy posts, killing over 200 and capturing more than 100. Xie was wounded in the chest at Hekou on 26 August. In just over three months the first encirclement of northern Shaanxi was broken — the second theatre of the same round that included the February–June campaign in the Shaanxi-Gansu border area.

fields.name: 国民党军第二道封锁线（湘军、粤军） KMT Second Blockade Line (Hunan and Guangdong Armies) 第二道封锁线 Second Blockade Line 汝城—城口封锁线 Rucheng–Chengkou Blockade Line

fields.summary: 国民党军在汝城—城口间构筑第二道封锁线，红军于 11 月 5—8 日突破。 KMT forces built the second blockade line between Rucheng and Chengkou; the Red Army broke through on 5–8 November.
fields.description: 1934 年 11 月初，蒋介石令湘军何键、粤军陈济棠在湖南汝城至广东城口间构筑第二道封锁线，以碉堡群控制湘粤通道。11 月 1 日，中革军委令红一军团夺取城口、红三军团夺取汝城；红一军团第二师第六团第一营急行军 220 余里，于 11 月 2 日夜袭占城口；汝城守敌较多，红军以一部监视，主力于 11 月 5 日从汝城、城口间分三路通过，至 11 月 8 日全部突破封锁线。本坐标为汝城—城口间代表点，具体碉堡线待考。 In early November 1934, Chiang Kai-shek ordered He Jian’s Hunan troops and Chen Jitang’s Guangdong troops to build the second blockade line between Rucheng in Hunan and Chengkou in Guangdong, using blockhouses to control the Hunan–Guangdong corridor. On 1 November the CMC ordered the First Army Corps to take Chengkou and the Third Army Corps to take Rucheng. The 1st Battalion of the 6th Regiment, Second Division, marched over 220 li and seized Chengkou by night on 2 November. Rucheng was too strongly held, so the Red Army monitored it and moved the main force through the Rucheng–Chengkou gap in three columns from 5 November, completing the breakthrough by 8 November. The coordinate is a representative point between Rucheng and Chengkou; the exact blockhouse line awaits verification.

place.zh: 湖南永顺万坪镇龙家寨（十万坪）

summary.zh: 红二、六军团在永顺龙家寨十万坪伏击国民党军陈渠珍部，取得会师后第一个大胜仗。
summary.en: The Red Second and Sixth Army Groups ambushed Chen Quzhen’s Hunan forces at Shiwangping and won their first major victory after joining forces.

fields.name: 十万坪大捷 Victory at Shiwangping 龙家寨战斗 Battle of Longjiazhai
fields.place: 湖南永顺万坪镇龙家寨（十万坪） Longjiazhai (Shiwangping), Wanping, Yongshun, Hunan
fields.summary: 红二、六军团在永顺龙家寨十万坪伏击国民党军陈渠珍部，取得会师后第一个大胜仗。 The Red Second and Sixth Army Groups ambushed Chen Quzhen’s Hunan forces at Shiwangping and won their first major victory after joining forces.
fields.description: 1934 年 11 月 13 日红二、六军团主动撤离永顺县城北撤，16 日黄昏在龙家寨十万坪谷地伏击尾追的国民党军陈渠珍部龚仁杰、周燮卿两旅，战至深夜，又在把总河击溃杨其昌旅；17 日在龙家寨开庆功大会，18 日重占永顺县城。此役歼敌 1000 余人、俘 2000 余人，缴枪 2200 余支，是两军团会师后第一个大胜仗。万坪镇即旧龙家寨，镇政府驻十万坪，战场在今万坪镇上坪、碑立坪一带。 On 13 November 1934 the Second and Sixth Army Groups deliberately abandoned Yongshun and withdrew north. At dusk on 16 November they ambushed the pursuing brigades of Gong Renjie and Zhou Xieqing of Chen Quzhen’s Hunan army in the Shiwangping valley at Longjiazhai, and late that night routed Yang Qichang’s brigade at Bazonghe. A victory rally was held at Longjiazhai on 17 November and Yongshun was retaken on 18 November. The battle killed over 1,000 and captured over 2,000 enemy troops with more than 2,200 rifles, the first major victory after the two army groups joined. Wanping town is the former Longjiazhai; its government seat is at Shiwangping and the battlefield lies around today’s Shangping and Beiliping villages.

name.zh: 国民党军湘江封锁线（湘军、桂军）

summary.zh: 国民党军以湘江为第四道封锁线，湘军由全州南下、桂军由兴安与灌阳北上，企图夹击中央红军。
summary.en: Kuomintang forces used the Xiang River as a fourth blockade line, with Hunan troops driving south from Quanzhou and Guangxi troops north from Xing’an and Guanyang to trap the Central Red Army.

fields.name: 国民党军湘江封锁线（湘军、桂军） KMT Xiang River Blockade
fields.summary: 国民党军以湘江为第四道封锁线，湘军由全州南下、桂军由兴安与灌阳北上，企图夹击中央红军。 Kuomintang forces used the Xiang River as a fourth blockade line, with Hunan troops driving south from Quanzhou and Guangxi troops north from Xing’an and Guanyang to trap the Central Red Army.
fields.description: 1934 年 11 月，国民党军以第四路军（何键部）和桂军（白崇禧部）等依托湘江构筑第四道封锁线，集结重兵堵截中央红军。湘军刘建绪部由全州南下，桂军由兴安、灌阳北上，企图在湘江以东夹击红军。红军在屏山、大坪、凤凰嘴、界首等渡口和新圩、脚山铺、光华铺等阻击阵地与敌激战，最终突破封锁线，但伤亡重大。部队番号与指挥关系为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In November 1934, Kuomintang forces including the Fourth Route Army (He Jian) and Guangxi forces (Bai Chongxi) established a fourth blockade line along the Xiang River and concentrated troops to intercept the Central Red Army. Liu Jianxu’s Hunan troops drove south from Quanzhou while Guangxi troops moved north from Xing’an and Guanyang, seeking to crush the Red Army east of the river. The Red Army fought at the Pingshan, Daping, Fenghuangzui, and Jieshou ferries and at the Xinxu, Jiaoshanpu, and Guanghuapu blocking positions before breaking through at heavy cost. Unit designations and command relationships follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.
