fields.name: 围攻龙山县城 Siege of Longshan
fields.place: 湖南龙山县城（首善镇） Longshan county town (Shoushan), Hunan
fields.summary: 忠堡大捷后红二、六军团围攻龙山县城 37 天。 After the victory at Zhongbao, the Red Second and Sixth Army Groups besieged Longshan for 37 days.
fields.description: 1935 年 6 月 18 日红二、六军团主力云集龙山县城周围，23 日攻城未克，改取长围久困，围城 37 天；期间击退守军两次突围，并打击来凤方向增援。7 月 27 日撤围南下，迎击增援龙山的陶广纵队。 On 18 June 1935 the main force of the Second and Sixth Army Groups gathered around Longshan county town. An assault on 23 June failed, so the Red Army settled into a 37-day blockade, beating back two break-out attempts and striking relief forces from Laifeng. The siege was lifted on 27 July to meet Tao Guang’s column advancing to relieve Longshan.

place.zh: 四川懋功（今小金）县城天主教堂
place.en: Catholic church, Maogong (Xiaojin) county town, Sichuan

summary.zh: 红军总政治部在懋功县城天主教堂召开会师联欢庆祝会，两军会合后总兵力达十余万人。
summary.en: The Red Army’s General Political Department held a link-up celebration at the Catholic church in Maogong; the combined forces numbered over 100,000.

fields.name: 懋功会师联欢会 Maogong Link-up Celebration 懋功会师庆祝大会 Maogong Victory Rally 天主教堂干部大会 Cadre Meeting at the Catholic Church
fields.place: 四川懋功（今小金）县城天主教堂 Catholic church, Maogong (Xiaojin) county town, Sichuan
fields.summary: 红军总政治部在懋功县城天主教堂召开会师联欢庆祝会，两军会合后总兵力达十余万人。 The Red Army’s General Political Department held a link-up celebration at the Catholic church in Maogong; the combined forces numbered over 100,000.
fields.description: 1935 年 6 月 18 日，中共中央率中央机关离开达维到达懋功（今小金），受到担负接应任务的红三十军政治委员李先念所率第八十八师部队欢迎。6 月 21 日，红军总政治部在懋功县城天主教堂召开会师联欢庆祝会（另有记载称在县城天主教堂召开干部大会，并在城隍庙举行庆祝会师的联欢会），红一、红四方面军部队代表参加，演唱陆定一编写的《两大主力会合歌》。两军会合后总兵力达十余万人，是长征途中规模最大的一次会师。会师后中央电请张国焘立即赶来懋功「以便商决一切」，为 6 月 26 日的两河口会议作了准备。本坐标为懋功县城代表点，天主教堂与城隍庙的具体会址待落位。 On 18 June 1935 the Central Committee left Dawei with its organs and reached Maogong (present-day Xiaojin), where it was welcomed by the 88th Division troops under Li Xiannian, political commissar of the 30th Army, who had been sent to meet it. On 21 June the Red Army’s General Political Department held a link-up celebration at the Catholic church in Maogong county town (other accounts say a cadre meeting was held at the Catholic church and a celebration at the City God temple), with representatives of the First and Fourth Front Armies and the singing of Lu Dingyi’s “Song of the Meeting of the Two Main Forces.” The combined forces came to more than 100,000 men, the largest link-up of the Long March. Afterwards the Centre telegraphed Zhang Guotao to come at once to Maogong “to settle everything together,” preparing the way for the Lianghekou meeting of 26 June. The coordinate is a representative point at Maogong county town; the exact sites of the church and temple remain to be fixed.

fields.summary: 张国焘由茂县赶到两河口，中央领导冒雨在镇外会场举行欢迎大会，朱德致欢迎词。 Zhang Guotao reached Lianghekou from Mao county and the Central Committee leaders welcomed him in the rain at a rally ground outside the town, with Zhu De giving the address.
fields.description: 1935 年 6 月 20 日，中共中央致电张国焘，要他立即赶到懋功两河口商谈会师后的行动问题。6 月 25 日，尚在茂县的张国焘带警卫部队经威州、理番赶到两河口。毛泽东、张闻天、周恩来、朱德、博古、刘伯承等中央领导和红一方面军指战员冒雨在镇外会场欢迎，会前由工兵把一片荒坡开辟成会场、用沙土铺平地面；朱德致欢迎词，张国焘代表红四方面军讲话。欢迎大会的地址另有记为「两河口镇抚边村外」者，与会人员步行三里迎接一说亦见于记述。这次会面把两个方面军的领导人聚到一处，次日即召开两河口会议。本坐标为两河口镇代表点。 On 20 June 1935 the Central Committee telegraphed Zhang Guotao to come at once to Lianghekou in Maogong to discuss action after the link-up. On 25 June Zhang, still at Mao county, came with his guard unit by way of Weizhou and Lifan. Mao Zedong, Zhang Wentian, Zhou Enlai, Zhu De, Bo Gu, Liu Bocheng, and other leaders and First Front Army troops welcomed him in the rain at a rally ground outside the town, which engineers had cut out of a waste slope and levelled with sand; Zhu De gave the address of welcome and Zhang Guotao spoke for the Fourth Front Army. Some accounts place the rally “outside Fubian village, Lianghekou,” and some say the leaders walked three li to meet him. The meeting brought the leaders of the two front armies together, and the Lianghekou conference opened the next day. The coordinate is a representative point at Lianghekou.

atlasTitle.en: The Long March

summary.zh: 中央政治局在两河口决定集中主力北上，创造川陕甘根据地。
summary.en: The Politburo met at Lianghekou and decided to concentrate the main force northward to create the Sichuan–Shaanxi–Gansu base area.

fields.name: 两河口会议 Lianghekou Meeting 两河口政治局扩大会议 Lianghekou Enlarged Politburo Meeting 懋功两河口会议 Lianghekou Meeting at Maogong
fields.place: 四川小金两河口镇 Lianghekou, Xiaojin, Sichuan
fields.summary: 中央政治局在两河口决定集中主力北上，创造川陕甘根据地。 The Politburo met at Lianghekou and decided to concentrate the main force northward to create the Sichuan–Shaanxi–Gansu base area.
fields.description: 1935 年 6 月 26 日，中央政治局在懋功以北两河口召开扩大会议，通过《关于一、四方面军会合后战略方针的决定》，决定集中主力向北进攻，在运动战中消灭敌人，首先取得甘肃南部，创造川陕甘苏区根据地。张国焘在会上表示同意，会后以“组织问题”为由拖延北上。本坐标为两河口镇代表点，会议会址待进一步落位。 On 26 June 1935 the Politburo held an enlarged meeting at Lianghekou north of Maogong and adopted the “Decision on the Strategic Policy after the Meeting of the First and Fourth Front Armies”. It decided to concentrate the main force for a northward attack, destroy the enemy in mobile warfare, first take southern Gansu, and create the Sichuan–Shaanxi–Gansu Soviet base. Zhang Guotao agreed at the meeting but afterwards delayed the northward move on the pretext of “organizational questions”. The coordinate is a representative point at Lianghekou; the meeting site awaits further placement.

fields.summary: 中央红军翻越梦笔山，继续北上卓克基、两河口方向。 The Central Red Army crossed Mengbi Mountain and continued north toward Zhuokeji and Lianghekou.
fields.description: 1935 年 6 月 26 日两河口会议后，中央红军于 6 月 27 日由两河口北上，翻越梦笔山垭口（海拔约 4080—4114 米），进入马尔康卓克基一带。梦笔山是小金与马尔康的界山，红四方面军部队此后亦曾翻越。本坐标为梦笔山垭口代表点。 After the Lianghekou meeting of 26 June 1935, the Central Red Army moved north from Lianghekou on 27 June and crossed the Mengbi Mountain pass (about 4,080–4,114 m) into the Zhuokeji area of Maerkang. Mengbi Mountain lies on the Xiaojin–Maerkang border; Fourth Front Army units also crossed it later. The coordinate is a representative point at the Mengbi pass.

atlasTitle.en: The Long March

name.zh: 攻占卓克基与进驻官寨
name.en: Seizure of Zhuokeji and Occupation of the Chieftain’s Fortress

place.zh: 四川马尔康卓克基镇西索村（卓克基土司官寨）
place.en: Xisuo village, Zhuokeji, Maerkang, Sichuan (Zhuokeji chieftain’s fortress)

summary.zh: 红六团攻占卓克基土司官寨，中央机关与主力同日进驻，官寨成为北上总后方。
summary.en: The 6th Regiment took the Zhuokeji chieftain’s fortress, where the Central Committee organs and main force arrived the same day; the fortress became the rear base for the march north.

fields.name: 攻占卓克基与进驻官寨 Seizure of Zhuokeji and Occupation of the Chieftain’s Fortress 卓克基战斗 Fighting at Zhuokeji 卓克基土司官寨 Zhuokeji Chieftain’s Fortress
fields.place: 四川马尔康卓克基镇西索村（卓克基土司官寨） Xisuo village, Zhuokeji, Maerkang, Sichuan (Zhuokeji chieftain’s fortress)
fields.summary: 红六团攻占卓克基土司官寨，中央机关与主力同日进驻，官寨成为北上总后方。 The 6th Regiment took the Zhuokeji chieftain’s fortress, where the Central Committee organs and main force arrived the same day; the fortress became the rear base for the march north.
fields.description: 1935 年 6 月 26 日至 28 日两河口会议期间，红一方面军先头部队自两河口出发，翻越梦笔山进入马尔康境内。6 月 29 日，先头红六团攻占卓克基。卓克基土司索观瀛受国民党政府宣传蛊惑，派兵据守官寨，在深谷中开枪阻击，红军一名向导牺牲；相持至夜晚大雨倾盆，红军先头部队为联络后续部队向天空发射三颗彩色信号弹，夜空通明，土司兵从未见过，以为红军施法术、放「神火」，仓皇弃寨而逃，连土司大印都未及带走。同日，中共中央、中央军委与中央红军主力、红四方面军第三十军第八十八师主力翻越梦笔山到达卓克基地区。红军进驻官寨后严守纪律、不扰百姓，并派人寻找土司宣讲民族政策。毛泽东、朱德、周恩来等在官寨住宿数日，毛泽东翻阅土司书房的《三国演义》《古文观止》，称「古有郿坞，今有官寨，土司的这个城堡应该是我们在长征途中见到的最有特色的建筑了」。此后卓克基成为红军北上的后勤基地，《松潘战役计划》《夏洮战役计划》都把卓克基列为总后方，马尔康一带先后建立 13 个乡级苏维埃组织。1952 年索观瀛到北京参加「五一」观礼，毛泽东邀他同桌就餐，说「红军当年是借路北上，住进官寨，你用不着躲进山林里」。本坐标为官寨所在西索村代表点。 During the Lianghekou conference of 26–28 June 1935 the advance guard of the First Front Army moved up from Lianghekou, crossed Mount Mengbi, and entered Maerkang. On 29 June the 6th Regiment took Zhuokeji. The Zhuokeji chieftain Suo Guanying, stirred up by Nationalist propaganda, had his men hold the fortress and open fire in the ravine, killing a Red Army guide; the stand lasted into the night, when heavy rain fell and the advance guard, to signal the following troops, fired three coloured flares. The night sky lit up, and the chieftain’s soldiers, who had never seen such a thing, took it for magic or “divine fire” and abandoned the fortress in panic, leaving even the chieftain’s seal behind. That same day the Central Committee, the Military Commission, the First Front Army main force, and the main force of the Fourth Front Army’s 88th Division crossed Mount Mengbi and reached the Zhuokeji area. The Red Army kept strict discipline in the fortress, did not disturb the villagers, and sent men to find the chieftain and explain its nationality policy. Mao Zedong, Zhu De, and Zhou Enlai stayed several days; Mao read Romance of the Three Kingdoms and Guwen Guanzhi from the chieftain’s library and remarked: “In old times there was Meiwu; today there is the fortress. This castle of the chieftain’s must be the most distinctive building we have seen on the Long March.” Zhuokeji then became the Red Army’s rear base for the march north, named as general rear depot in both the Songpan and Xiatao campaign plans, and thirteen township-level soviets were set up around Maerkang. In 1952 Suo Guanying came to Beijing for the May Day parade and Mao invited him to his table, saying: “The Red Army was only borrowing the road north and stayed in your fortress; there was no need to hide in the hills.” The coordinate is a representative point at Xisuo village, site of the fortress.

fields.name: 连克六城 Capture of six county seats
fields.place: 陕西保安（今志丹） Bao'an (now Zhidan), Shaanxi
fields.summary: 反“围剿”中连克六座县城，陕甘边与陕北苏区连成一片。 Six county seats were taken, linking the Shaanxi-Gansu border and northern Shaanxi base areas.
fields.description: 1935 年 2 月至 6 月，红二十六军、红二十七军在第二次反“围剿”中先后攻克安定、延长、延川、安塞、保安、靖边等县城，使陕甘边与陕北苏区连成一片。县城名单为通行说法，待页码级核对。 From February to June 1935, the 26th and 27th Red Armies took Anding, Yanchang, Yanchuan, Ansai, Bao’an and Jingbian county seats during the second counter-encirclement campaign, linking the Shaanxi-Gansu border and northern Shaanxi base areas. fields.description: 1935 年 7 月 2 日，红一方面军第一军团和红四方面军第三十军各一部组成先头部队，翻越雅克夏雪山（长板山、马塘梁子，垭口海拔约 4443—4460 米），到达黑水马河坝；7 月 9 日，红一方面军主力及红四方面军一部翻越此山进入黑水，随后进抵芦花。本坐标为雅克夏山垭口代表点。 On 2 July 1935 an advance detachment formed from the First Army Corps of the First Front Army and part of the 30th Army of the Fourth Front Army crossed Yakexia Snow Mountain (Changban Mountain, Matang Liangzi; pass about 4,443–4,460 m) and reached Maheba in Heishui. On 9 July the main force of the First Front Army and part of the Fourth Front Army crossed into Heishui and advanced to Luhua. The coordinate is a representative point at the Yakexia pass.

summary.zh: 中央政治局常委在卓克基官寨开会，通过《告康藏西番民众书》，确定民族平等与民族革命纲领。
summary.en: The Politburo Standing Committee met in the Zhuokeji fortress and adopted the “Proclamation to the Tibetan People of Kham and Tibet,” setting out equality and national revolution policy.

fields.name: 卓克基会议 Zhuokeji Meeting 卓克基政治局常委会议 Zhuokeji Politburo Standing Committee Meeting 卓克基土司议政厅会议 Meeting in the Chieftain’s Council Hall
fields.place: 四川马尔康卓克基土司官寨二楼土司议政厅 Chieftain’s council hall, second floor, Zhuokeji fortress, Maerkang, Sichuan
fields.summary: 中央政治局常委在卓克基官寨开会，通过《告康藏西番民众书》，确定民族平等与民族革命纲领。 The Politburo Standing Committee met in the Zhuokeji fortress and adopted the “Proclamation to the Tibetan People of Kham and Tibet,” setting out equality and national revolution policy.
fields.description: 1935 年 7 月 3 日，中共中央政治局常务委员会在卓克基土司官寨二楼「土司议政厅」召开会议，即卓克基会议。会议专门讨论民族地区的有关问题，通过《中国共产党中央委员会告康藏西番民众书——进行西藏民族革命运动的斗争纲领》，指出中国共产党的民族政策是解放被压迫的各民族、建立自由选举的革命政府，号召藏族民众反对帝国主义及国民党军阀。《告康藏西番民众书》的广泛张贴与配套宣传，逐步打消了当地部分土司和民众的疑虑，是红军在川西北民族地区立足的关键一步。中央机关与中央领导人在官寨驻留约一周，7 月中旬经梭磨、马塘向黑水前进。本坐标为官寨代表点，会议房间即官寨二楼议政厅。 On 3 July 1935 the Politburo Standing Committee of the Central Committee met in the chieftain’s council hall on the second floor of the Zhuokeji fortress — the Zhuokeji meeting. It dealt specifically with questions in the nationality areas and adopted the “Proclamation of the Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party to the Tibetan People of Kham and Tibet: A Programme of Struggle for the National Revolutionary Movement in Tibet,” stating that the Party’s nationality policy was to liberate the oppressed nationalities and establish freely elected revolutionary governments, and calling on Tibetans to oppose imperialism and the Nationalist warlords. The wide posting of the proclamation and the accompanying publicity gradually dispelled the misgivings of some local chieftains and common people, a key step in the Red Army’s establishing itself in the nationality areas of northwestern Sichuan. The Central Committee organs and leaders stayed about a week, moving on in mid-July by way of Suomo and Matang toward Heishui. The coordinate is a representative point at the fortress; the meeting room is the council hall on its second floor.

fields.description: 1935 年 7 月 3 日，先头部队进抵昌德宿营休整；7 月 6 日翻越昌德山（仓德山、拖罗冈山，垭口海拔约 4164—4283 米），抵达下打古。昌德山位于黑水县境内，红四方面军部队此后亦曾翻越。本坐标为昌德山垭口代表点。 On 3 July 1935 the advance detachment reached Changde and camped there to rest; on 6 July it crossed Changde Mountain (Cangde, Tuoluogang; pass about 4,164–4,283 m) and reached Xiadagu. fields.summary: 中央红军翻越达古山，向毛儿盖前进。 The Central Red Army crossed Dagu Mountain and advanced toward Maoergai.
fields.description: 1935 年 7 月 7 日，红军由打古一带出发，翻越达古山（打古山、拖罗岗，垭口海拔约 4484—4752 米）向毛儿盖前进。达古山位于黑水县境内，是中央红军长征中翻越的海拔最高的雪山之一。本坐标为达古山垭口代表点。 On 7 July 1935 the Red Army set out from the Dagu area and crossed Dagu Mountain (Dagu, Tuoluogang; pass about 4,484–4,752 m) toward Maoergai. Dagu Mountain lies in Heishui county and was one of the highest snow mountains crossed by the Central Red Army during the Long March. The coordinate is a representative point at the Dagu pass.

summary.zh: 红一军团主力配属红三十军围攻毛儿盖，胡宗南部李日基营据寺顽抗七日后夜遁，红军占领毛儿盖，打开北上通道。
summary.en: The First Army Corps with the 30th Army besieged Maoergai; Li Riji’s battalion held the temple for a week and then slipped away at night, and the Red Army took Maoergai, opening the road north.

fields.name: 毛儿盖战斗 Fight for Maoergai 攻占毛儿盖 Capture of Maoergai 李日基营被歼 Destruction of Li Riji’s Battalion
fields.place: 四川松潘毛儿盖镇 Maoergai, Songpan, Sichuan
fields.summary: 红一军团主力配属红三十军围攻毛儿盖，胡宗南部李日基营据寺顽抗七日后夜遁，红军占领毛儿盖，打开北上通道。 The First Army Corps with the 30th Army besieged Maoergai; Li Riji’s battalion held the temple for a week and then slipped away at night, and the Red Army took Maoergai, opening the road north.
fields.description: 1935 年 7 月初，蒋介石调十多个团赶赴松潘防堵红军，胡宗南命令第一师补充旅第二团加强营营长李日基带队抢占毛儿盖。红军攻松潘未克后，以红一军团主力配属红三十军转攻毛儿盖。7 月 9 日，红军向李日基部发起五次攻击均未奏效；战至 7 月 15 日，李日基接到胡宗南准许撤退的命令，借夜暗率全营六百余人由寺庙东北方向突围，直奔松潘，红军追击俘敌一百余人；7 月 16 日下午，红一军团将李日基残部包围于腊子山以西二十五公里处，士兵纷纷举枪投降，李日基从山上滚下逃脱。另有记载称先头部队 7 月 10 日到达毛儿盖、守敌一个营被缴械、俘敌三百余、缴获轻重机枪三十六挺与电台一部；《中国共产党历史》则记 7 月 16 日先头部队抵达松潘附近的毛儿盖。各说不一，事件起止取 7 月 9 日至 16 日。毛儿盖此后成为中共中央与右路军的集结地，红军在此驻留四十余天。本坐标为毛儿盖镇代表点。 In early July 1935 Chiang Kai-shek sent more than ten regiments to hold Songpan, and Hu Zongnan ordered Li Riji, commander of the reinforced battalion of the 1st Division’s replacement brigade, to seize Maoergai first. After the attack on Songpan failed, the main force of the First Army Corps, with the 30th Army under it, turned on Maoergai. On 9 July the Red Army launched five assaults on Li’s battalion without success; by 15 July Li had Hu Zongnan’s permission to withdraw and slipped out of the temple to the northeast at night with over 600 men, making for Songpan, while the Red Army pursued and took more than 100 prisoners; on the afternoon of 16 July the First Army Corps surrounded the remnant 25 km west of Lazishan, where the soldiers surrendered and Li escaped by rolling down the hillside. Other accounts say the advance force reached Maoergai on 10 July, disarmed a battalion, took over 300 prisoners and captured 36 machine guns and a radio set, while Party History of the CCP records the advance force reaching Maoergai near Songpan on 16 July. The accounts differ, and the event is dated 9–16 July. Maoergai then became the assembly area of the Central Committee and the Right Route Army, where the Red Army stayed for over forty days. The coordinate is a representative point at Maoergai town.

name.zh: 中共中央进驻黑水芦花寨
name.en: The Central Committee at Luhua, Heishui

summary.zh: 中央机关与中央领导经长板山进入黑水，7 月 10 日进驻芦花寨，在此休整筹粮并为芦花会议作准备。
summary.en: Having crossed Mount Changban into Heishui, the Central Committee organs and leaders reached Luhua on 10 July, resting and collecting grain there before the Luhua meeting.

fields.name: 中共中央进驻黑水芦花寨 The Central Committee at Luhua, Heishui 芦花休整与筹粮 Rest and Grain Collection at Luhua 中央机关到黑水 Central Organs Reach Heishui
fields.place: 四川黑水芦花镇 Luhua, Heishui, Sichuan
fields.summary: 中央机关与中央领导经长板山进入黑水，7 月 10 日进驻芦花寨，在此休整筹粮并为芦花会议作准备。 Having crossed Mount Changban into Heishui, the Central Committee organs and leaders reached Luhua on 10 July, resting and collecting grain there before the Luhua meeting.
fields.description: 1935 年 7 月 2 日，红一方面军第一军团和红四方面军第三十军各一部组成的先头部队翻越长板山（雅克夏山）进入黑水；7 月 9 日，红一方面军主力翻越同一座雪山进入黑水境内，随后进抵芦花。7 月 10 日，中共中央主要领导人到达黑水县芦花寨。黑水县境内有大黑水、小黑水与毛儿盖河三大水系，县以河名，县城即芦花镇；红军在此休整一周余，一边筹粮、一边等待张国焘北上，7 月 18 日起在芦花召开政治局常委扩大会议（芦花会议），7 月 21—22 日继续开政治局扩大会议解决组织与前敌指挥问题。7 月下旬，中央机关离开芦花，经昌德、打古翻越昌德山、达古山向毛儿盖前进。本坐标为芦花镇代表点，中央机关驻地与芦花会议会址待进一步落位。 On 2 July 1935 an advance force made up of units of the First Army Corps and the Fourth Front Army’s 30th Army crossed Mount Changban (Yakexia) into Heishui; on 9 July the main force of the First Front Army crossed the same snow mountain into Heishui and went on to Luhua. On 10 July the principal leaders of the Central Committee reached Luhua village in Heishui county. The county takes its name from its three river systems — the Greater and Lesser Heishui and the Maoergai river — and its county town is Luhua; the Red Army rested there for more than a week, collecting grain and waiting for Zhang Guotao to come north, and from 18 July held the enlarged meeting of the Politburo Standing Committee known as the Luhua meeting, continuing on 21–22 July with an enlarged Politburo meeting on organisation and the forward command. In late July the Central Committee organs left Luhua and moved toward Maoergai by way of Changde and Dagu and over the Changde and Dagu passes. The coordinate is a representative point at Luhua town; the exact sites of the Central Committee’s quarters and of the meeting remain to be fixed.

atlasTitle.en: The Long March

name.en: Grain Collection at Maoergai and the “Wheat-Cutting Certificates”

place.zh: 四川松潘毛儿盖镇克藏村一带

summary.zh: 红军在毛儿盖以木板借据向藏民购粮，割一坵青稞即留一块“割麦证”，成为长征群众纪律的物证。
summary.en: At Maoergai the Red Army bought grain from Tibetans with wooden receipts, leaving a “wheat-cutting certificate” in every field it reaped — physical proof of Long March discipline.

fields.name: 毛儿盖筹粮与“割麦证” Grain Collection at Maoergai and the “Wheat-Cutting Certificates” 木质借据 Wooden Loan Receipts 割麦牌 Wheat-Cutting Boards
fields.place: 四川松潘毛儿盖镇克藏村一带 Kezang village, Maoergai, Songpan, Sichuan
fields.summary: 红军在毛儿盖以木板借据向藏民购粮，割一坵青稞即留一块“割麦证”，成为长征群众纪律的物证。 At Maoergai the Red Army bought grain from Tibetans with wooden receipts, leaving a “wheat-cutting certificate” in every field it reaped — physical proof of Long March discipline.
fields.description: 1935 年 7 月，红一方面军先头部队从黑水翻越打古山到达松潘以西的毛儿盖克藏村。这里属藏区，时值青稞将熟，但村庄空无一人：红军到达前，当地藏民听信国民党的污名化宣传，认为红军是青面獠牙的恶魔，纷纷躲进深山。7 月高原青稞尚未成熟，红军在毛儿盖驻留四十余天等待收割，随后自己动手割麦、搓粒、炒熟，再运到河边水磨坊磨成面粉。为不损群众利益，红军总政治部规定：每个部队收了哪块地，必须在田头立一块“割麦牌”，写明收割数量，群众归来后可持牌向任何红军部队或苏维埃政府兑取与青稞价值相等的银子、茶叶等物。现存国家一级文物的一块木板顶部横书“割麦证”，下方竖排小楷写：“老庚：我们在这坵田内割了青稞一仟斤，我们自己吃了，这块木牌可作我们购买你们这些青稞的证据。请你们归来以后，拿住这块木牌，向任何红军部队或苏维埃政府，都可兑取与我们吃你们青稞价值相等的银子、茶叶与你们所需要的东西，在你们还未曾兑得这些东西前需要好好保存这块木牌子。前敌总政治部 麦田第××号。”2011 年克藏村藏族女村民仁青卓玛家翻修房屋，从旧木板中发现此牌，经识字的木匠与离休干部尼麦上报，得以保存，现藏四川松潘县红军长征纪念馆；毛儿盖一带先后发现三块木质借据，另两块一捐一藏。因当地藏民大多不识汉文，不少借条被当柴烧掉或改作壁板、粮仓盖。本坐标为克藏村一带示意点，精确位置待实测。 In July 1935 the advance force of the First Front Army crossed Mount Dagu from Heishui and reached Kezang village at Maoergai, west of Songpan. This was Tibetan country, the barley was nearly ripe, and the village was empty: before the Red Army arrived the people had been told it was a horned monster and had fled into the mountains. The barley was not yet ripe in July, and the Red Army waited at Maoergai for over forty days, then reaped it themselves, rubbed out the grain, parched it, and carried it to water mills by the river to grind into flour. To avoid harming the people, the General Political Department laid down that every unit which reaped a field must plant a “wheat-cutting board” at its edge stating how much had been taken, so that when the owners returned they could exchange it with any Red Army unit or soviet government for silver, tea, or whatever they needed to the value of the barley. A board now listed as a Grade One national cultural relic reads, across the top, “Wheat-Cutting Certificate,” and below in vertical columns: “Old friend: we cut 1,000 jin of barley in this field and ate it ourselves; this board serves as our evidence of purchase. When you return, take this board to any Red Army unit or soviet government and you may exchange it for silver, tea, or whatever you need to the value of the barley we ate; until then please keep this board safe. Forward General Political Department, Field No. XX.” In 2011, when the Tibetan villager Renqing Zhuoma’s family was renovating their house in Kezang, the board came to light among old timbers; a literate carpenter and the retired cadre Nyimai reported it and it was preserved. It is now in the Songpan Red Army Long March Memorial Hall, and three such receipts have been found around Maoergai, one donated and one wrapped in a khata and kept. Because few Tibetans there read Chinese, many receipts were burned as firewood or reused as wall boards and granary lids. The coordinate is a schematic point for the Kezang area; the exact site remains to be surveyed.

summary.zh: 中央政治局在芦花开会，解决统一指挥与四方面军工作问题。
summary.en: The Politburo met at Luhua to settle unified command and the work of the Fourth Front Army.

fields.name: 芦花会议 Luhua Meeting 黑水芦花会议 Luhua Meeting at Heishui 芦花政治局会议 Luhua Politburo Meeting
fields.place: 四川黑水芦花镇 Luhua, Heishui, Sichuan
fields.summary: 中央政治局在芦花开会，解决统一指挥与四方面军工作问题。 The Politburo met at Luhua to settle unified command and the work of the Fourth Front Army.
fields.description: 1935 年 7 月 18 日，中央政治局常委会议在芦花召开，同意周恩来辞去红军总政委，任命张国焘为红军总政委、军委总负责者；7 月 21—22 日政治局扩大会议听取张国焘、徐向前、陈昌浩关于红四方面军的报告，肯定其成绩，批评退出鄂豫皖、放弃通南巴等错误，并决定组织前敌总指挥部，徐向前任总指挥、陈昌浩任政委、叶剑英任参谋长。本坐标为芦花镇代表点，会址待进一步落位。 On 18 July 1935 the Politburo Standing Committee met at Luhua and agreed that Zhou Enlai should resign as political commissar of the Red Army, appointing Zhang Guotao as political commissar and head of the Military Commission. On 21–22 July an enlarged Politburo meeting heard reports from Zhang Guotao, Xu Xiangqian, and Chen Changhao on the Fourth Front Army, affirmed its achievements, criticized errors including the withdrawal from the Hubei–Henan–Anhui base and the abandonment of Tongnanba, and decided to form the Front Command with Xu Xiangqian as commander, Chen Changhao as political commissar, and Ye Jianying as chief of staff. The coordinate is a representative point at Luhua; the meeting site awaits further placement.

name.zh: 松潘战役计划流产与《夏洮战役计划》
name.en: Abandonment of the Songpan Campaign and the Xiatao Plan

place.zh: 四川松潘毛儿盖（中央与红军总部所在地）
place.en: Maoergai, Songpan, Sichuan (seat of the Central Committee and Red Army headquarters)

summary.zh: 胡宗南主力集结松潘、张国焘延宕部队行动，中革军委 8 月 1 日放弃松潘战役，3 日改定《夏洮战役计划》，红军转向阿坝、夏河流域。
summary.en: With Hu Zongnan’s main force concentrated at Songpan and Zhang Guotao stalling, the Military Commission abandoned the Songpan campaign on 1 August and adopted the Xiatao plan on 3 August, turning toward Ngawa and the Xia river.

fields.name: 松潘战役计划流产与《夏洮战役计划》 Abandonment of the Songpan Campaign and the Xiatao Plan 松潘战役受挫 Songpan Campaign Frustrated 夏洮战役计划 Xiatao Campaign Plan
fields.place: 四川松潘毛儿盖（中央与红军总部所在地） Maoergai, Songpan, Sichuan (seat of the Central Committee and Red Army headquarters)
fields.summary: 胡宗南主力集结松潘、张国焘延宕部队行动，中革军委 8 月 1 日放弃松潘战役，3 日改定《夏洮战役计划》，红军转向阿坝、夏河流域。 With Hu Zongnan’s main force concentrated at Songpan and Zhang Guotao stalling, the Military Commission abandoned the Songpan campaign on 1 August and adopted the Xiatao plan on 3 August, turning toward Ngawa and the Xia river.
fields.description: 1935 年 6 月 29 日，周恩来根据中央政治局决定制定《松潘战役计划》，准备乘胡宗南部初到松潘地区、兵力尚未集中、碉堡尚未构筑完成的时机，消灭胡宗南部、控制松潘，打开北出甘南的通道。但张国焘以“组织问题”未解决为由延宕部队行动，在发布命令时把“进攻”松潘改为“佯攻”，使胡宗南部得以从容集中兵力于松潘，敌其他各部也进抵这一地区，懋功一带又被敌军占领，红军陷入腹背受敌的境地。8 月 1 日，中革军委不得不放弃松潘战役计划；红军总司令部重新调整部署，决定从 8 月 1 日起改以攻占阿坝以北夏河流域为战役目的。8 月 3 日，红军总部制定《夏（河）洮（河）战役计划》，指出松潘战役已失时机，“现特改为攻占阿坝，迅速北进夏河流域”，“以期于洮河流域消灭遭遇之蒋敌主力，形成在甘南广大地域发展之局势”，并把红一、红四方面军混编为左、右两路军。8 月 4—6 日，中央政治局在毛儿盖以南的沙窝开会，讨论的正是松潘战役未能实施所造成的局势。计划由红军总部制定，具体签发地与会议地点待考，本坐标取毛儿盖地区。 On 29 June 1935 Zhou Enlai, acting on the Politburo’s decision, drew up the Songpan campaign plan, intending to destroy Hu Zongnan’s forces and seize Songpan while they were newly arrived, un-concentrated, and without completed fortifications, thus opening the road north to southern Gansu. But Zhang Guotao stalled the troops on the pretext that the “organisational question” was unresolved and, when issuing orders, changed “attack” Songpan into a “feint,” so that Hu Zongnan could concentrate at Songpan at leisure while other Nationalist units came up and Maogong was taken, leaving the Red Army between two fires. On 1 August the Military Commission had to abandon the Songpan campaign; the Red Army headquarters readjusted, deciding that from 1 August the objective would be to take the Xia river valley north of Ngawa. On 3 August headquarters drew up the Xia (river)–Tao (river) campaign plan, noting that the Songpan campaign had lost its moment and that “it is now changed to taking Ngawa and pressing quickly north into the Xia river valley,” in order “to destroy the main force of the Chiang army encountered in the Tao river valley and create a situation for expansion over the broad area of southern Gansu,” and mixing the First and Fourth Front Armies into a Left and a Right Route Army. From 4 to 6 August the Politburo met at Shawo south of Maoergai precisely to discuss the situation created by the failure to carry out the Songpan campaign. The plan was drawn up by the Red Army headquarters; the exact place of issue and of the meetings remains to be established, and the coordinate here is a representative point for the Maoergai area.

atlasTitle.en: The Long March

summary.zh: 红二、六军团在宣恩板栗园、利福田歼灭国民党军第 85 师师部及两个团。
summary.en: The Red Second and Sixth Army Groups destroyed the headquarters and two regiments of the KMT 85th Division at Banliyuan–Lifutian in Xuan’en.

fields.name: 板栗园大捷 Victory at Banliyuan
fields.place: 湖北宣恩板栗园 Banliyuan, Xuan’en, Hubei
fields.summary: 红二、六军团在宣恩板栗园、利福田歼灭国民党军第 85 师师部及两个团。 The Red Second and Sixth Army Groups destroyed the headquarters and two regiments of the KMT 85th Division at Banliyuan–Lifutian in Xuan’en.
fields.description: 1935 年 8 月 2 日红二、六军团自龙山兴隆街北进沙道沟佯动，诱使鄂军第 85 师由小关继续向李家河南进；3 日晨红军从高罗、李家河之间揳入敌纵深，11 时抢先赶到板栗园东侧利福田谷地设伏，12 时许敌进入伏击圈，战至 23 时全歼其师部、两个团又 1 个营，击毙师长谢彬，俘敌千余人。 On 2 August 1935 the Second and Sixth Army Groups moved from Xinglongjie in Longshan north to Shadaogou as a feint, drawing the Hubei 85th Division on towards Lijiahe. At dawn on 3 August the Red Army thrust into the enemy depth between Gaoluo and Lijiahe, reached the Lifutian valley east of Banliyuan at 11 a.m. and lay in ambush; the enemy entered the trap around noon and was destroyed by 11 p.m., including the divisional headquarters, two regiments and a battalion. Its commander Xie Bin was killed and about 1,000 men were captured.

place.zh: 四川松潘毛儿盖沙窝（俄灯寨）

summary.zh: 中央政治局在沙窝开会，重申北上方针，首次以中央文件使用“长征”一词。
summary.en: The Politburo met at Shawo, reaffirmed the northward policy, and first used the term “Long March” in a central document.

fields.name: 沙窝会议 Shawo Meeting 毛儿盖沙窝会议 Shawo Meeting at Maoergai 沙窝政治局扩大会议 Shawo Enlarged Politburo Meeting
fields.place: 四川松潘毛儿盖沙窝（俄灯寨） Shawo (Edengzhai), Maoergai, Songpan, Sichuan
fields.summary: 中央政治局在沙窝开会，重申北上方针，首次以中央文件使用“长征”一词。 The Politburo met at Shawo, reaffirmed the northward policy, and first used the term “Long March” in a central document.
fields.description: 1935 年 8 月 4—6 日，中央政治局在毛儿盖附近沙窝（俄灯寨）召开扩大会议，讨论红一、四方面军会合后的形势与任务及组织问题；通过《关于一、四方面军会合后的政治形势与任务的决议》，重申两河口会议北上方针，强调党对红军的绝对领导和两军团结，增补陈昌浩、周纯全为政治局委员。决议中“红军一万八千里长征”是中央文件首次正式使用“长征”一词。本坐标为俄灯寨代表点。 From 4 to 6 August 1935 the Politburo held an enlarged meeting at Shawo (Edengzhai) near Maoergai to discuss the situation and tasks after the meeting of the First and Fourth Front Armies, as well as organizational questions. It adopted the “Resolution on the Political Situation and Tasks after the Meeting of the First and Fourth Front Armies”, reaffirmed the northward policy of the Lianghekou meeting, stressed absolute Party leadership over the Red Army and unity between the two armies, and added Chen Changhao and Zhou Chunquan to the Politburo. The phrase “the Red Army’s 18,000-li Long March” in the resolution was the first formal use of “Long March” in a central document. The coordinate is a representative point at Edengzhai.

fields.name: 芭蕉坨战斗 Battle of Bajiaotuo
fields.place: 湖南龙山芭蕉坨（洗洛—湾塘—小河一带，酉水东岸） Bajiaotuo (Xiluo–Wantang–Xiaohe, east bank of the Youshui), Longshan, Hunan
fields.summary: 红二、六军团在龙山湾塘一带击溃陶广纵队十个团。 The Red Second and Sixth Army Groups routed ten regiments of Tao Guang’s column near Wantang in Longshan.
fields.description: 1935 年 8 月 3 日板栗园大捷后，红二、六军团主力回到龙山三元、石羔、桶车、兴隆街、茨岩塘一带休整。7 日获悉陶广纵队十个团将由招头寨经芭蕉坨、凉风洞、欧溪坪、花鹿溪开赴龙山县城，傍晚两万红军轻装趁夜在芭蕉坨—花鹿溪一线设伏；8 日上午陶广改道可立坡，欲从湾塘一带渡酉水与来凤徐源泉部会合，红军分四路向鸡公嘴、干溪坝、红石坎、高寨、鸭子塘出击，战至当晚击溃该纵队十个团，毙、俘各 300 余人。战场沿今洗洛—湾塘—小河公路、酉水东岸展开，长约十公里，坐标为战场带代表点。 After the victory at Banliyuan on 3 August 1935 the main force of the Second and Sixth Army Groups rested in the Longshan base area around Sanyuan, Shigao, Tongche, Xinglongjie and Ciyantang. On 7 August it learned that ten regiments of Tao Guang’s column would march from Zhaotouzhai via Bajiaotuo, Liangfengdong, Ouxiping and Hualuxi towards Longshan county town, and that evening 20,000 troops moved out to ambush the Bajiaotuo–Hualuxi line. On the morning of 8 August Tao Guang switched to the Kelipo road, intending to cross the Youshui near Wantang and join Xu Yuanquan at Laifeng; the Red Army attacked in four columns towards Jigongzui, Ganxiba, Hongshikan, Gaozhai and Yazitang and by nightfall routed the ten regiments, killing and capturing about 300 each. The battlefield runs for about 10 km along today’s Xiluo–Wantang–Xiaohe road on the east bank of the Youshui; the point is representative of that zone.

fields.name: 右路军先头部队从毛儿盖出发过草地 The Right Route Army’s Advance Guard Sets Out Across the Grasslands 红四团先行过草地 The 4th Regiment Leads Across the Grassland 一过草地出发 Start of the First Grassland Crossing
fields.place: 四川松潘毛儿盖以北草地入口 Northern edge of Maoergai, Songpan, Sichuan, where the grasslands begin
fields.summary: 红四团与红四方面军第二九四团组成的右路军先头部队自毛儿盖出发，8 月 26 日到达班佑，为主力走出北上的路线。 The Right Route Army’s advance guard, the 4th Regiment with the Fourth Front Army’s 294th Regiment, left Maoergai on 21 August and reached Banyou on 26 August, opening the route north for the main force.
fields.description: 1935 年 8 月 17 日清早，红四团正在开干部会，团长黄开湘接到毛泽东打来的电话：“党中央、中革军委决定红四团为先锋团，你们要在茫茫的草地上为全军走出条北上的路线来。”8 月 21 日，由红一方面军第四团和红四方面军第二九四团组成的右路军先头部队从毛儿盖出发，向班佑开进，在草地中摸索前进六天，8 月 26 日到达班佑。随后右路军第三十军于 8 月 29 日发起包座战斗，至 31 日全歼堵击的胡宗南部第四十九师，打开进军甘南的门户。主力部队穿过草地用了七天七夜，8 月底右路军全部到达班佑、巴西、阿西地区。草地行军是长征中减员最严重的一段，聂荣臻后来回忆，一军团掉队、落伍与牺牲的在四百以上。本坐标为毛儿盖以北草地入口示意点，出发地与行军路线待进一步落位。 Early on 17 August 1935, while the 4th Regiment was holding a cadre meeting, its commander Huang Kaixiang took a telephone call from Mao Zedong: “The Central Committee and the Military Commission have decided that the 4th Regiment shall be the vanguard; you must find a route north for the whole army across those vast grasslands.” On 21 August the Right Route Army’s advance guard — the First Front Army’s 4th Regiment and the Fourth Front Army’s 294th Regiment — set out from Maoergai for Banyou, feeling its way across the grassland for six days and reaching Banyou on 26 August. The 30th Army of the Right Route Army then attacked at Baozuo on 29 August, and by 31 August had wiped out the blocking 49th Division of Hu Zongnan’s army, opening the gate to southern Gansu. The main force took seven days and nights to cross the grassland, and by the end of August the whole Right Route Army had reached Banyou, Baxi, and Axi. The grassland march cost more lives than any other stage of the Long March; Nie Rongzhen later recalled that the First Army Corps alone had over 400 missing, straggling, or dead. The coordinate is a schematic point at the northern edge of Maoergai where the grassland begins; the exact starting point and route remain to be fixed.

fields.name: 左路军占领阿坝 Left column takes Aba
fields.place: 四川阿坝（麦桑） Aba (Mai Sang), Sichuan
fields.summary: 左路军先头纵队经大藏寺、查理寺占领阿坝。 The left column’s advance force took Aba via Dazangsi and Chalisi.
fields.description: 1935 年 8 月 15 日左路军先头纵队自卓克基、马尔康出发，经大藏寺、卡尔古、龙尔甲，8 月 19 日占查理寺，8 月 21 日占阿坝。阿坝为麦桑土官杨俊扎西驻地，杨弃城逃往果洛。此后左路军以阿坝为后方，8 月 28 日先头进入草地，8 月 31 日抵噶曲河（白河）畔，因河水暴涨，9 月 3 日折返阿坝。 On 15 August 1935 the left column’s advance force left Zhuokeji and Barkam via Dazangsi, Kargu and Longerjia, taking Chalisi on 19 August and Aba on 21 August. Aba was the seat of the Maisang headman Yang Junzhaxi, who abandoned it for Golok. Aba then became the left column’s rear base; its advance guard entered the grasslands on 28 August, reached the Ghaqu (Bai) river on 31 August and, with the river in flood, turned back on 3 September.

fields.description: 1935 年 8 月底，刚走出草地的右路军发起包座战役。8 月 29 日夜红 30 军 89 师 264 团攻击大戒寺守敌，歼两个连；30 日夜援敌胡宗南部第 49 师先头进至大戒寺以南，红军且战且退诱其深入；31 日 15 时红 30 军主力从包座河两岸山林出击，将敌分割为三块，战至当夜歼其大部，师长伍诚仁重伤。与此同时红 4 军第 10 师攻击求吉寺，师长王友钧中弹牺牲，残敌被围至 9 月中旬红军南下方撤。此役毙伤敌 4000 余人、俘 800 余人，缴枪 1500 余支，是红一、红四方面军会师后第一个重大胜利，打开了北上甘南的门户。 At the end of August 1935 the right column, just out of the grasslands, fought the battle of Baozuo. On the night of 29 August the 264th Regiment of the 30th Corps’ 89th Division attacked the Dajiesi garrison and destroyed two companies; on the night of 30 August the advance guard of the KMT 49th Division reached south of Dajiesi and the Red Army traded ground to draw it in; at 15:00 on 31 August the main force of the 30th Corps struck from the woods on both banks of the Baozuo river, cut the enemy into three and by nightfall had destroyed most of the division, severely wounding its commander Wu Chengren. Meanwhile the 4th Corps’ 10th Division attacked Qiujisi, losing divisional commander Wang Youjun, and kept the remnant besieged until the southward move in mid-September. The battle killed and wounded over 4,000 and captured over 800 with more than 1,500 rifles, the first major victory after the Maogong link-up, opening the road into southern Gansu.

fields.summary: 中央在巴西召开紧急会议，决定率红一、红三军连夜北上。 The central leadership held an emergency meeting at Baxi and decided to lead the First and Third Army Corps north that night.
fields.description: 1935 年 9 月 9 日，张国焘电令右路军南下，叶剑英获取密电后报告毛泽东。毛泽东、张闻天、博古等赶到红三军团驻地巴西，连夜召开政治局紧急会议，决定率红一、红三军和军委纵队一部立即北上，脱离险境，并发布《为执行北上方针告同志书》。9 月 10 日凌晨，中央率部离开巴西，向俄界前进。本坐标为巴西镇班佑寺代表点，阿西牙弄紧急会议会址待分别落位。 On 9 September 1935 Zhang Guotao telegraphed the right column to move south. Ye Jianying obtained the telegram and reported it to Mao Zedong. Mao, Zhang Wentian, and Bo Gu rushed to the Third Army Corps headquarters at Baxi and held an emergency Politburo meeting that night. They decided to lead the First and Third Army Corps and part of the CMC column north immediately to escape the danger, and issued the “Letter to Comrades on Carrying Out the Northward Policy”. In the early hours of 10 September the central leadership left Baxi for Ejie. The coordinate is a representative point at Banyou Temple, Baxi; the Axi Yanong emergency meeting site awaits separate placement.

fields.summary: 中央政治局在俄界通过《关于张国焘同志的错误的决定》，整编陕甘支队。 The Politburo met at Ejie, adopted the “Decision on Comrade Zhang Guotao’s Errors”, and reorganized the Shaanxi–Gansu Detachment.
fields.description: 1935 年 9 月 12 日，中央政治局在甘肃迭部俄界（今高吉村）召开扩大会议，听取毛泽东关于与四方面军领导者争论及今后战略方针的报告，通过《关于张国焘同志的错误的决定》，决定将红一、红三军和军委纵队整编为中国工农红军陕甘支队，彭德怀任司令员、毛泽东任政委，并成立由毛泽东、周恩来、王稼祥、彭德怀、林彪组成的五人团。本坐标为高吉村代表点，会址待进一步落位。 On 12 September 1935 the Politburo held an enlarged meeting at Ejie (now Gaoji Village) in Diebu, Gansu. It heard Mao Zedong’s report on the dispute with the Fourth Front Army leadership and future strategy, adopted the “Decision on Comrade Zhang Guotao’s Errors”, and decided to reorganize the First and Third Army Corps and the CMC column into the Chinese Workers’ and Peasants’ Red Army Shaanxi–Gansu Detachment, with Peng Dehuai as commander and Mao Zedong as political commissar. It also formed a five-man group of Mao Zedong, Zhou Enlai, Wang Jiaxiang, Peng Dehuai, and Lin Biao. The coordinate is a representative point at Gaoji Village; the meeting site awaits further placement.

fields.description: 1935 年 9 月，国民党新编第 14 师鲁大昌部据守腊子口天险，企图阻止红军北上。红军经过激战夺取腊子口，打开进入甘南的通道。部队番号与指挥关系为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In September 1935, the KMT New 14th Division under Lu Dachang held the natural stronghold at Lazikou to block the Red Army’s northward advance. fields.description: 1935 年 9 月 27 日，中共中央在甘肃通渭榜罗镇召开会议，决定把红军长征的落脚点放在陕北，以陕北作为领导中国革命的大本营。 On 27 September 1935, the CCP Central Committee met at Bangluo in Tongwei, Gansu, and decided to make northern Shaanxi the destination of the Long March and the base for leading the Chinese revolution.

atlasTitle.en: The Long March

summary.zh: 陕甘支队在青石嘴突袭东北军骑兵运输队，缴获战马百余匹。
summary.en: The Shaanxi–Gansu Detachment raided an Northeast Army cavalry supply column at Qingshizui, capturing over 100 horses.

fields.name: 青石嘴战斗 Battle of Qingshizui 青石嘴突袭 Qingshizui Raid 六盘山首战 First Battle after Liupan Mountain
fields.place: 宁夏固原青石嘴 Qingshizui, Guyuan, Ningxia
fields.summary: 陕甘支队在青石嘴突袭东北军骑兵运输队，缴获战马百余匹。 The Shaanxi–Gansu Detachment raided an Northeast Army cavalry supply column at Qingshizui, capturing over 100 horses.
fields.description: 1935 年 10 月 7 日，陕甘支队翻越六盘山后，前卫在青石嘴附近抓获敌军便衣侦察员，得知东北军骑兵第七师第十九团两个连正在青石嘴休整。毛泽东决定突袭，以第四大队正面攻击、第一和第五大队两翼迂回、第十三大队后卫掩护，经约半小时战斗，歼敌 200 余人，缴获战马 100 余匹及大批弹药。红军以此组建第一支骑兵侦察连。本坐标为青石嘴村代表点，具体战场待考。 On 7 October 1935, after crossing the Liupan Mountains, the Shaanxi–Gansu Detachment’s advance guard captured enemy plainclothes scouts near Qingshizui and learned that two companies of the 19th Regiment, 7th Cavalry Division, Northeast Army, were resting there. Mao Zedong ordered a surprise attack: the 4th Battalion attacked frontally, the 1st and 5th Battalions swept the flanks, and the 13th Battalion covered the rear. In about half an hour the Red Army killed or wounded more than 200 enemy soldiers and captured over 100 horses and large quantities of ammunition. The captured horses were used to form the Red Army’s first cavalry reconnaissance company. The coordinate is a representative point at Qingshizui village; the exact battlefield awaits verification.

atlasTitle.en: The Long March

summary.zh: 红四方面军南下，攻占绥靖、崇化、丹巴、懋功。
summary.en: The Fourth Front Army moved south and took Suijing, Chonghua, Danba, and Maogong.

fields.name: 绥崇丹懋战役 Suichong Danmao Campaign 绥丹崇懋战役 Suidan Chongmao Campaign 红四方面军南下第一阶段 First Stage of the Fourth Front Army’s Southward Move
fields.place: 四川丹巴县城 Danba county town, Sichuan
fields.summary: 红四方面军南下，攻占绥靖、崇化、丹巴、懋功。 The Fourth Front Army moved south and took Suijing, Chonghua, Danba, and Maogong.
fields.description: 1935 年 10 月 8 日至 20 日，红四方面军执行《绥丹崇懋战役计划》，王树声率右纵队沿大金川南下夺取绥靖、丹巴，徐向前、陈昌浩率左纵队沿抚边河南下夺取懋功、达维。经 12 天战斗，击溃川军 6 个旅，占领绥靖、崇化、丹巴、懋功等地，为南下天全、芦山打开通道。本坐标为丹巴县城代表点，绥靖、崇化、懋功待分别落位。 From 8 to 20 October 1935, the Fourth Front Army carried out the “Suidan Chongmao Campaign Plan”. Wang Shusheng led the right column south along the Dajin River to take Suijing and Danba, while Xu Xiangqian and Chen Changhao led the left column south along the Fubian River to take Maogong and Dawei. In twelve days of fighting they routed six Sichuan brigades and occupied Suijing, Chonghua, Danba, and Maogong, opening the way south to Tianquan and Lushan. The coordinate is a representative point at Danba county town; Suijing, Chonghua, and Maogong await separate placement.

atlasTitle.en: The Long March

name.en: The Central Red Army reaches Wuqi

summary.zh: 中央红军进入陕北苏区，历时一年的长征结束。
summary.en: The Central Red Army entered the northern Shaanxi Soviet area, ending the year-long Long March.

fields.name: 中央红军到达吴起镇 The Central Red Army reaches Wuqi
fields.summary: 中央红军进入陕北苏区，历时一年的长征结束。 The Central Red Army entered the northern Shaanxi Soviet area, ending the year-long Long March.
fields.description: 1935 年 10 月 19 日，中共中央率陕甘支队到达陕北吴起镇，进入西北苏区；10 月 21 日在吴起镇以西头道川、二道川、三道川设伏击溃尾追的东北军骑兵 2000 余人（「切尾巴」战斗）；10 月 22 日中央政治局在吴起镇召开扩大会议，宣告中央红军长征结束。与红十五军团的正式会师在 11 月 6 日甘泉象鼻子湾，另见「象鼻子湾会师」。 On 19 October 1935 the Central Committee and the Shaanxi-Gansu Detachment reached Wuqi, entering the Northwest Soviet area; on 21 October they ambushed and routed some 2,000 pursuing Northeast Army cavalry west of Wuqi (the “cutting the tail” action); on 22 October the Politburo meeting at Wuqi declared the Long March over. The formal meeting with the 15th Corps took place at Xiangbizibay, Ganquan, on 6 November — see that event.

atlasTitle.en: The Long March

summary.zh: 中央红军在吴起镇击退尾追骑兵，结束长征最后一战。
summary.en: The Central Red Army defeated the pursuing cavalry at Wuqi, the last battle of the Long March.

fields.name: 切尾巴战役 “Cutting the Tail” Battle 吴起镇战役 Battle of Wuqi Town 长征最后一战 Last Battle of the Long March
fields.place: 陕西吴起镇 Wuqi Town, Shaanxi
fields.summary: 中央红军在吴起镇击退尾追骑兵，结束长征最后一战。 The Central Red Army defeated the pursuing cavalry at Wuqi, the last battle of the Long March.
fields.description: 1935 年 10 月 19 日，中央红军到达吴起镇，国民党军骑兵追至苏区门口。20 日，红军在头道川、平台山、二道川、三道川设伏；21 日发起“切尾巴”战役，分块切割、相机包围，歼灭东北军白凤翔第六师一个骑兵团、郭希鹏第三师两个骑兵团，击溃马鸿宾部第三十五师马培清骑兵团，毙伤 600 余人，俘 1000 余人，缴获战马、驮马 1600 余匹。此役是中央红军结束长征的最后一战。本坐标为吴起镇代表点。 On 19 October 1935 the Central Red Army reached Wuqi, with KMT cavalry pursuing to the gate of the Soviet area. On 20 October the Red Army set ambushes at Toudao Creek, Pingtai Mountain, Erdao Creek, and Sandao Creek; on 21 October it launched the “Cutting the Tail” battle, cutting the enemy into blocks and encircling them. It destroyed one cavalry regiment of Bai Fengxiang’s 6th Division and two cavalry regiments of Guo Xipeng’s 3rd Division, routed Ma Peiqing’s cavalry regiment of Ma Hongbin’s 35th Division, killed or wounded more than 600, captured more than 1,000, and took over 1,600 horses and pack animals. The battle was the last of the Central Red Army’s Long March. The coordinate is a representative point at Wuqi.

atlasTitle.en: The Long March

summary.zh: 红四方面军南下攻占宝兴、天全、芦山、名山，百丈关受挫。
summary.en: The Fourth Front Army moved south and took Baoxing, Tianquan, Lushan, and Mingshan, but was checked at Baizhang Pass.

fields.name: 天芦名雅邛大战役 Tian-Lu-Ming-Ya-Qiong-Da Campaign 天全芦山名山雅安邛崃大邑战役 Tianquan–Lushan–Mingshan–Ya’an–Qionglai–Dayi Campaign 红四方面军南下第二阶段 Second Stage of the Fourth Front Army’s Southward Move
fields.place: 四川芦山县城 Lushan county town, Sichuan
fields.summary: 红四方面军南下攻占宝兴、天全、芦山、名山，百丈关受挫。 The Fourth Front Army moved south and took Baoxing, Tianquan, Lushan, and Mingshan, but was checked at Baizhang Pass.
fields.description: 1935 年 10 月 24 日至 11 月 25 日，红四方面军分左、中、右纵队从懋功、丹巴等地南下，攻占宝兴、天全、芦山、名山等地，歼敌 1 万余人，击落飞机 1 架。11 月中旬进攻百丈关，遭川军 80 余团反扑，激战 7 昼夜，伤亡近万人，被迫撤至天全、芦山、宝兴休整。此役是红四方面军南下由进攻转入防御的转折点。本坐标为芦山县城代表点。 From 24 October to 25 November 1935, the Fourth Front Army moved south in left, center, and right columns from Maogong and Danba, taking Baoxing, Tianquan, Lushan, and Mingshan, destroying more than 10,000 enemy troops, and downing one aircraft. In mid-November it attacked Baizhang Pass but was counterattacked by more than 80 Sichuan regiments; after seven days and nights of fighting it suffered nearly 10,000 casualties and withdrew to Tianquan, Lushan, and Baoxing. The campaign marked the Fourth Front Army’s shift from offensive to defensive in the south. The coordinate is a representative point at Lushan county town.
fields.entities: 红四方面军 Red Fourth Front Army

summary.zh: 中共中央政治局常委扩大会议在下寺湾召开，成立西北革命军事委员会，恢复红一方面军番号。
summary.en: A Politburo standing committee meeting at Xiabeisiwan created the Northwest Revolutionary Military Commission and restored the First Front Army designation.

fields.name: 下寺湾会议 Xiabeisiwan meeting
fields.place: 陕西甘泉下寺湾 Xiabeisiwan, Ganquan, Shaanxi
fields.summary: 中共中央政治局常委扩大会议在下寺湾召开，成立西北革命军事委员会，恢复红一方面军番号。 A Politburo standing committee meeting at Xiabeisiwan created the Northwest Revolutionary Military Commission and restored the First Front Army designation.
fields.description: 1935 年 11 月 3 日，中共中央政治局常委扩大会议在甘泉下寺湾召开，听取郭洪涛、聂洪钧关于陕北苏区和红军情况的汇报，决定成立中国工农红军西北革命军事委员会（毛泽东任主席，周恩来、彭德怀任副主席），恢复红一方面军番号，红十五军团编入红一方面军序列；同时决定中央领导分两路行动：一路赴瓦窑堡主持后方并处理陕北错误肃反，一路由毛泽东、周恩来、彭德怀率领南下迎击国民党军对陕甘苏区的第三次“围剿”。 On 3 November 1935 an enlarged meeting of the Politburo standing committee at Xiabeisiwan, Ganquan, heard Guo Hongtao and Nie Hongjun on the northern Shaanxi base and red forces. It created the Northwest Revolutionary Military Commission (Mao Zedong chairman; Zhou Enlai and Peng Dehuai vice-chairmen) and restored the First Front Army designation, incorporating the 15th Corps. The leadership divided: one group went to Wayaobao to run the rear and address the erroneous purge, the other under Mao, Zhou and Peng moved south against the third KMT encirclement.

atlasTitle.en: The Long March

place.zh: 陕西甘泉道镇象鼻子湾

summary.zh: 红一军团与红十五军团在象鼻子湾会师，毛泽东发表“雪地讲话”，宣告长征胜利结束。
summary.en: The 1st and 15th Corps met at Xiangbizibay, where Mao Zedong’s “snow speech” declared the Long March ended in victory.

fields.name: 象鼻子湾会师 Meeting at Xiangbizibay
fields.place: 陕西甘泉道镇象鼻子湾 Xiangbizibay, Daozhen, Ganquan, Shaanxi
fields.summary: 红一军团与红十五军团在象鼻子湾会师，毛泽东发表“雪地讲话”，宣告长征胜利结束。 The 1st and 15th Corps met at Xiangbizibay, where Mao Zedong’s “snow speech” declared the Long March ended in victory.
fields.description: 1935 年 11 月 6 日，中央红军与徐海东、刘志丹、程子华率领的红十五军团在甘泉道镇象鼻子湾村会师。毛泽东在漫天大雪中向军委直属纵队等 300 余人发表讲话，总结长征：「长征是宣言书，长征是宣传队，长征是播种机」「长征以我们的胜利、敌人的失败而结束」。会师后，中央红军与红十五军团合编为红一方面军，彭德怀任司令员、毛泽东任政治委员，下辖红一军团与红十五军团。 On 6 November 1935 the Central Red Army and the 15th Corps under Xu Haidong, Liu Zhidan and Cheng Zihua met at Xiangbizibay, Daozhen, Ganquan. In heavy snow Mao Zedong addressed some 300 men of the CMC direct column, summing up the Long March: “The Long March is a manifesto, a propaganda force, a seeding machine”; it ended “with our victory and the enemy’s defeat”. The two forces were then combined as the First Front Army under Peng Dehuai (commander) and Mao Zedong (political commissar), with the 1st and 15th Corps.

atlasTitle.en: The Long March

summary.zh: 红四方面军在百丈关与川军决战 7 昼夜，伤亡近万，南下受挫。
summary.en: The Fourth Front Army fought a seven-day decisive battle with Sichuan troops at Baizhang Pass, suffered nearly 10,000 casualties, and was checked.

fields.name: 百丈关战役 Battle of Baizhang Pass 百丈决战 Baizhang Decisive Battle 百丈关战斗 Baizhang Pass Battle
fields.place: 四川名山百丈镇 Baizhang, Mingshan, Sichuan
fields.summary: 红四方面军在百丈关与川军决战 7 昼夜，伤亡近万，南下受挫。 The Fourth Front Army fought a seven-day decisive battle with Sichuan troops at Baizhang Pass, suffered nearly 10,000 casualties, and was checked.
fields.description: 1935 年 11 月 13 日至 21 日，红四方面军以 15 个团向名山、邛崃间百丈关进攻，16 日占领百丈镇。川军刘湘调集 80 余团，在飞机大炮掩护下从北、东、南三面反扑。红军在百丈周围十余里弧形阵地浴血苦战 7 昼夜，毙伤川军 1.5 万余人，自身伤亡近万人，被迫撤出百丈，转入防御。本坐标为百丈镇代表点。 From 13 to 21 November 1935, the Fourth Front Army attacked Baizhang Pass between Mingshan and Qionglai with fifteen regiments and took Baizhang town on 16 November. Liu Xiang concentrated more than eighty Sichuan regiments and counterattacked from north, east, and south under air and artillery cover. The Red Army fought for seven days and nights in an arc-shaped position around Baizhang, killing or wounding more than 15,000 Sichuan troops while suffering nearly 10,000 casualties, and was forced to withdraw and go on the defensive. The coordinate is a representative point at Baizhang town.

name.zh: 湘军等追堵红二、六军团
name.en: Hunan Army and Other Forces Pursue the Red Second and Sixth Army Groups

summary.zh: 国民党军以湘军李觉纵队、中央军郭汝栋与郝梦龄等纵队分路追击红二、六军团。
summary.en: Kuomintang forces, including Li Jue’s Hunan column and the Central Army columns of Guo Rudong and Hao Mengling, pursued the Red Second and Sixth Army Groups along separate routes.

fields.name: 湘军等追堵红二、六军团 Hunan Army and Other Forces Pursue the Red Second and Sixth Army Groups
fields.summary: 国民党军以湘军李觉纵队、中央军郭汝栋与郝梦龄等纵队分路追击红二、六军团。 Kuomintang forces, including Li Jue’s Hunan column and the Central Army columns of Guo Rudong and Hao Mengling, pursued the Red Second and Sixth Army Groups along separate routes.
fields.description: 1935 年 11 月至 1936 年 10 月，国民党军以湘军李觉纵队、中央军郭汝栋与郝梦龄等纵队分路追击红二、六军团，企图将其围歼于湘鄂川黔地区；红军突围西进，最终与红四方面军会师。部队番号与指挥关系为通行说法，待页码级核对。 From November 1935 to October 1936, Kuomintang forces including Li Jue’s Hunan column and the Central Army columns of Guo Rudong and Hao Mengling pursued the Red Second and Sixth Army Groups, seeking to destroy them in the Hunan-Hubei-Sichuan-Guizhou region; the Red Army broke out westward and eventually joined the Red Fourth Front Army. Unit designations and command relationships follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.name: 桑植出发长征 Setting out from Sangzhi
fields.place: 湖南桑植刘家坪（干田坝） Liujiaping (Gantianba), Sangzhi, Hunan
fields.summary: 红二、六军团在桑植刘家坪、瑞塔铺誓师，开始长征。 The Red Second and Sixth Army Groups held their departure rally at Liujiaping and Ruitapu in Sangzhi and began the Long March.
fields.description: 1935 年 11 月 4 日湘鄂川黔省委与军委分会在桑植刘家坪召开联席会议，决定战略转移；19 日红二、六军团分别在刘家坪干田坝和瑞塔铺枫树塔举行突围誓师大会，当晚主力 1.7 万余人出发长征，红十八师留守茨岩塘掩护。 On 4 November 1935 the Hunan-Hubei-Sichuan-Guizhou provincial committee and the Military Commission branch met at Liujiaping in Sangzhi and decided on a strategic transfer. On 19 November the Second and Sixth Army Groups held break-out rallies at Gantianba in Liujiaping and at Fengshuta in Ruitapu; that evening more than 17,000 troops set out, while the 18th Division stayed behind at Ciyantang to cover them.
fields.entities: 红六军团 Red Sixth Army Group 红二方面军 Red Second Front Army

atlasTitle.en: The Long March

summary.zh: 直罗镇战役为党中央把革命大本营放在西北举行奠基礼。
summary.en: The Battle of Zhiluozhen lays the foundation for establishing the Party Central Committee’s base in the northwest.

fields.name: 直罗镇战役 Battle of Zhiluozhen 直罗镇战斗 Battle of Zhiluo
fields.place: 陕西富县直罗镇 Zhiluozhen, Fu County, Shaanxi
fields.summary: 直罗镇战役为党中央把革命大本营放在西北举行奠基礼。 The Battle of Zhiluozhen lays the foundation for establishing the Party Central Committee’s base in the northwest.
fields.description: 1935 年 11 月 20 日国民党军第 109 师沿葫芦河川进入直罗镇，红一方面军当夜将其包围；21 日拂晓红一军团由北向南、红十五军团由南向北猛攻，上午攻入镇内，师长牛元峰率残部退守寨子山；23 日晚残敌突围，牛元峰被击毙；24 日在张家湾歼东北军第 106 师一个团。此役歼敌一个师又一个团，毙伤 1000 余人、俘 5300 余人，为党中央把革命大本营放在西北举行「奠基礼」。原坐标误置富县县城，相差约 35km。 On 20 November 1935 the KMT 109th Division marched into Zhiluozhen along the Hulu river and was encircled that night by the First Front Army. At dawn on 21 November the 1st Army Corps attacked from north to south and the 15th Army Corps from south to north, breaking into the town by late morning and driving divisional commander Niu Yuanfeng onto Zhaizishan. The remnant broke out on the night of 23 November and Niu was killed; on 24 November a regiment of the Northeast Army’s 106th Division was destroyed at Zhangjiawan. The battle destroyed a division and a regiment, killing and wounding over 1,000 and capturing over 5,300, the “foundation-laying ceremony” for the Party centre’s base in the northwest. The former coordinate was Fu county town, about 35 km away.
fields.entities: 中央红军（红一方面军） Central Red Army 东北军 Northeast Army (KMT) 红十五军团 Red 15th Army Corps

atlasTitle.en: The Long March

summary.zh: 中共中央政治局扩大会议确定抗日民族统一战线方针，并决定东征。
summary.en: An enlarged CCP Politburo meeting adopted the anti-Japanese national united front and decided on the Eastern Expedition.

fields.name: 瓦窑堡会议 Wayaobao Meeting
fields.place: 陕西子长瓦窑堡 Wayaobao, Zichang, Shaanxi
fields.summary: 中共中央政治局扩大会议确定抗日民族统一战线方针，并决定东征。 An enlarged CCP Politburo meeting adopted the anti-Japanese national united front and decided on the Eastern Expedition.
fields.description: 1935 年 12 月 17—25 日，中共中央政治局在陕北瓦窑堡召开扩大会议，通过《关于目前政治形势与党的任务决议》，确定建立抗日民族统一战线；12 月 23 日通过《关于军事战略问题的决议》，决定渡黄河东征，以巩固和扩大陕甘苏区并直接对日作战。 From 17 to 25 December 1935 the CCP Politburo held an enlarged meeting at Wayaobao in northern Shaanxi, adopting a resolution on the current political situation and the Party’s tasks that established the anti-Japanese national united front; on 23 December it adopted a resolution on military strategy deciding to cross the Yellow River eastward to consolidate and expand the Shaanxi-Gansu base and fight Japan directly.

atlasTitle.en: The Long March

place.zh: 湖南芷江便水（上坪一带）

summary.zh: 红二、红六军团在芷江便水伏击湘军第十六师，掩护西进。
summary.en: The Second and Sixth Army Corps ambushed the Hunan 16th Division at Bianshui near Zhijiang, covering their westward move.

fields.name: 便水战役 Battle of Bianshui 便水战斗 Bianshui Battle 芷江便水之战 Bianshui Battle near Zhijiang
fields.place: 湖南芷江便水（上坪一带） Bianshui, Zhijiang, Hunan (Shangping area)
fields.summary: 红二、红六军团在芷江便水伏击湘军第十六师，掩护西进。 The Second and Sixth Army Corps ambushed the Hunan 16th Division at Bianshui near Zhijiang, covering their westward move.
fields.description: 1936 年 1 月 5 日至 6 日，红二、红六军团在芷江、晃县间便水地区伏击尾追的湘军李觉纵队第十六师。因敌军提前侦察、伏击意图暴露，战斗转为阵地拉锯战；红军毙伤俘敌近千人，自身亦有较大伤亡，红四师参谋长金承忠、十一团团长覃耀楚牺牲。6 日黄昏撤出战斗，向黔东转移。本坐标为便水/上坪代表点。 From 5 to 6 January 1936, the Second and Sixth Army Corps ambushed the pursuing 16th Division of Li Jue’s Hunan column at Bianshui between Zhijiang and Huangxian. Enemy reconnaissance exposed the ambush, and the battle became a positional struggle. The Red Army killed, wounded, or captured nearly 1,000 enemy troops but also suffered heavy casualties; Jin Chengzhong, chief of staff of the Fourth Division, and Qin Yaochu, commander of the 11th Regiment, were killed. The Red Army withdrew at dusk on 6 January and moved toward eastern Guizhou. The coordinate is a representative point at Bianshui/Shangping.
fields.entities: 红二方面军 Red Second Front Army 红六军团 Red Sixth Army Group

atlasTitle.en: The Long March

place.zh: 贵州黔西鸭池河古渡口

summary.zh: 红二、红六军团从鸭池河渡口渡过乌江上游，进占黔西。
summary.en: The Second and Sixth Army Corps crossed the upper Wu River at Yachihe and entered western Guizhou.

fields.name: 鸭池河渡口 Yachihe Ferry 鸭池河渡口 Yachi River Crossing 红军强渡鸭池河 Forcing the Yachi River
fields.place: 贵州黔西鸭池河古渡口 Yachihe old ferry, Qianxi, Guizhou
fields.summary: 红二、红六军团从鸭池河渡口渡过乌江上游，进占黔西。 The Second and Sixth Army Corps crossed the upper Wu River at Yachihe and entered western Guizhou.
fields.description: 1936 年 2 月 2 日，红二、红六军团先头部队奔袭鸭池河渡口，控制南岸，缴获木船 4 只，在船工帮助下连夜架设浮桥，1.8 万余人用 3 天渡过鸭池河，进占黔西、大定、毕节，打开黔西北大门。本坐标为鸭池河古渡口代表点。 On 2 February 1936, the advance guard of the Second and Sixth Army Corps rushed the Yachihe ferry, secured the south bank, captured four wooden boats, and with local boatmen built a pontoon bridge overnight. More than 18,000 troops crossed the Yachi River over three days and entered Qianxi, Dading, and Bijie, opening the door to northwestern Guizhou. The coordinate is a representative point at the old Yachihe ferry.

name.en: The Fourth Front Army’s Second Move North

summary.zh: 红四方面军撤离天全、芦山、宝兴，经丹巴、道孚、炉霍、甘孜二次北上。
summary.en: The Fourth Front Army withdrew from Tianquan, Lushan, and Baoxing and moved north again via Danba, Daofu, Luhuo, and Ganzi.

fields.name: 红四方面军二次北上 The Fourth Front Army’s Second Move North 红四方面军再次北上 The Fourth Front Army Moves North Again 康道炉战役 Kang-Dao-Lu Campaign
fields.place: 四川甘孜县城 Ganzi county town, Sichuan
fields.summary: 红四方面军撤离天全、芦山、宝兴，经丹巴、道孚、炉霍、甘孜二次北上。 The Fourth Front Army withdrew from Tianquan, Lushan, and Baoxing and moved north again via Danba, Daofu, Luhuo, and Ganzi.
fields.description: 1936 年 2 月中旬，红四方面军撤离天全、芦山、宝兴地区，再次翻越夹金山，经达维、懋功、丹巴向西转移；3 月 1 日先头部队攻占道孚，15 日占炉霍，随后占领甘孜。7 月初与红二、六军团在甘孜会师，随后共同北上。本坐标为甘孜县城代表点，具体行军路线待细化。 In mid-February 1936 the Fourth Front Army withdrew from Tianquan, Lushan, and Baoxing, crossed the Jiajin Mountains again, and moved west via Dawei, Maogong, and Danba. On 1 March its advance guard took Daofu, on 15 March Luhuo, and then Ganzi. In early July it met the Second and Sixth Army Corps at Ganzi and moved north together. The coordinate is a representative point at Ganzi county town; the exact route awaits refinement.

atlasTitle.en: The Long March

place.zh: 贵州大方将军山、七家田一带
place.en: Jiangjunshan and Qijiatian area, Dafang, Guizhou

summary.zh: 红十七师在将军山、七家田伏击万耀煌纵队敢死队，歼其六个连。
summary.en: The 17th Division ambushed Wan Yaohuang’s dare-to-die detachment at Jiangjunshan and Qijiatian, destroying six companies.

fields.name: 将军山战役 Battle of Jiangjunshan 将军山伏击战 Jiangjunshan Ambush 七家田战斗 Qijiatian Battle
fields.place: 贵州大方将军山、七家田一带 Jiangjunshan and Qijiatian area, Dafang, Guizhou
fields.summary: 红十七师在将军山、七家田伏击万耀煌纵队敢死队，歼其六个连。 The 17th Division ambushed Wan Yaohuang’s dare-to-die detachment at Jiangjunshan and Qijiatian, destroying six companies.
fields.description: 1936 年 2 月 19 日上午，红六军团第十七师进至大定以西的将军山、七家田一带，发现万耀煌纵队一支六个连的敢死队沿清毕公路前进，萧克当即命令第五十五团、第五十一团从公路东侧攻击，第四十九团从西侧插入，红二军团第四师第十一团一个营及第五师一部也参加战斗。经约一个半小时激战，将该敢死队击溃，毙敌 100 余人、俘敌 300 余人，缴步枪 300 余支、轻机枪 9 挺。战后红十七师占领将军山构筑工事，阻击敌军至 2 月 26 日，掩护毕节方面休整。本坐标为将军山、七家田一带代表点。 On the morning of 19 February 1936 the 17th Division of the Sixth Army Group reached Jiangjunshan and Qijiatian west of Dading and spotted a six-company dare-to-die detachment of Wan Yaohuang’s column moving along the Qingbi highway. Xiao Ke ordered the 55th and 51st Regiments to attack from the east side of the road and the 49th Regiment to cut in from the west; one battalion of the 11th Regiment, 4th Division, Second Army Group and part of the 5th Division also took part. After about ninety minutes the detachment was routed: more than 100 enemy killed, over 300 captured, and more than 300 rifles and nine light machine guns taken. The 17th Division then occupied Jiangjunshan and built positions, holding off the enemy until 26 February to cover the rest and consolidation at Bijie. The coordinate is a representative point in the Jiangjunshan–Qijiatian area.

fields.description: 1936 年 2 月 20 日，红一方面军以中国人民红军抗日先锋军名义东渡黄河，红十五军团作为红一方面军一部参加东征，进入山西石楼、中阳一带。日期与部队关系为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On February 20, 1936, the First Front Army crossed the Yellow River eastward as the Chinese People’s Red Army Anti-Japanese Vanguard. fields.name: 关上村战斗 Battle of Guanshangcun
fields.place: 山西中阳关上村 Guanshangcun, Zhongyang, Shanxi
fields.summary: 红十五军团在关上村歼灭晋绥军一部。 The Red 15th Army Corps destroyed a Shanxi-Suiyuan Army unit at Guanshangcun.
fields.description: 1936 年 2 月 25—27 日，红一军团在中阳城南 25 里的关上村、郭家庄地域，以口袋阵围歼晋绥军独立第 2 旅先头第 4 团，随后追击击溃其旅部及第 3 团，俘 400 余人，缴山炮 3 门。关上村战斗是红军东渡后第一个大胜仗，打通了南下晋西南的通道。此处原误系于红十五军团名下，实为红一军团战果。 On 25–27 February 1936 the 1st Army Corps trapped and destroyed the advance 4th Regiment of the Shanxi-Suiyuan Independent 2nd Brigade at Guanshang and Guojiazhuang, 25 li south of Zhongyang, then pursued and routed the brigade headquarters and 3rd Regiment, capturing over 400 men and three mountain guns. It was the first major victory after the crossing and opened the road south into south-western Shanxi. The event was previously misattributed to the 15th Army Corps.

atlasTitle.en: The Long March

summary.zh: 红二、六军团在乌蒙山区与国民党军回旋作战。
summary.en: The Red Second and Sixth Army Groups maneuvered against KMT forces in the Wumeng Mountains.

fields.name: 乌蒙山回旋战 Wumeng Mountains maneuvering battle
fields.summary: 红二、六军团在乌蒙山区与国民党军回旋作战。 The Red Second and Sixth Army Groups maneuvered against KMT forces in the Wumeng Mountains.
fields.description: 1936 年 2 月 27 日，红二、六军团撤离毕节，进入黔滇交界的乌蒙山区，面对国民党军五个纵队十余万人的四面合围，辗转回旋一个月、行程千余里。3 月 2 日野马川会议决定以赫章为中心与敌周旋；3 月 8 日由奎香折返，在以则河伏击樊崧甫纵队先头；3 月 9 日、10 日突破分水岭、广德关防线；3 月 12 日在哲庄坝（得章坝）伏击万耀煌第十三师；3 月 16 日第三次进入奎香，19 日从敌两个纵队接合部跳出包围圈；3 月 22 日进至宣威来宾铺，23 日在虎头山与滇军孙渡纵队激战；3 月 28 日、29 日进占盘县、亦资孔，回旋战结束。毛泽东后来评价「二、六军团在乌蒙山打转转……硬是转出来了嘛」。本坐标为赫章代表点，各次战斗另有独立点位。 On 27 February 1936 the Second and Sixth Army Groups left Bijie and entered the Wumeng Mountains on the Guizhou–Yunnan border, where five KMT columns and more than 100,000 men closed in from all sides; for a month they maneuvered over a thousand li. On 2 March the Yemachuan meeting decided to wear the enemy down around Hezhang; on 8 March the army doubled back from Kuixiang and ambushed the advance guard of Fan Songfu’s column at Yizehe; on 9–10 March it broke the Fenshuiling and Guangdeguan lines; on 12 March it ambushed Wan Yaohuang’s 13th Division at Zhezhuangba (Dezhangba); on 16 March it entered Kuixiang a third time and on 19 March slipped out through the seam between two enemy columns; on 22 March it reached Laibinpu in Xuanwei and on 23 March fought Sun Du’s Yunnan troops at Hutoushan; on 28–29 March it took Panxian and Yizikong, ending the campaign. Mao Zedong later remarked that “the Second and Sixth Army Groups went round and round in the Wumeng Mountains… and simply walked out of it.” The coordinate is a representative point at Hezhang; the individual battles have their own points.

place.zh: 四川丹巴、道孚交界党岭山夏羌涅阿垭口
place.en: Xiaqiangniea Pass, Dangling Mountain, on the Danba–Daofu border, Sichuan

summary.zh: 红四方面军先遣军翻越党岭山夏羌涅阿垭口，进占道孚。
summary.en: The Fourth Front Army’s advance guard crossed the Xiaqiangniea Pass of Dangling Mountain and took Daofu.

fields.name: 翻越党岭山 Crossing Dangling Mountain 党岭雪山 Dangling Snow Mountain 夏羌涅阿垭口 Xiaqiangniea Pass
fields.place: 四川丹巴、道孚交界党岭山夏羌涅阿垭口 Xiaqiangniea Pass, Dangling Mountain, on the Danba–Daofu border, Sichuan
fields.summary: 红四方面军先遣军翻越党岭山夏羌涅阿垭口，进占道孚。 The Fourth Front Army’s advance guard crossed the Xiaqiangniea Pass of Dangling Mountain and took Daofu.
fields.description: 1936 年 2 月下旬，红四方面军按《康（定）道（孚）炉（霍）战役计划》分三路向康北进军。刘伯承、程世才率先遣军（以红三十军一部组成），由丹巴边耳进入党岭，2 月 27 日至 28 日翻越夏羌涅阿垭口（海拔约 4810 米），2 月 28 日进至道孚境内，3 月 1 日占领道孚县城；方面军总部 3 月 15 日翻越同垭口抵道孚。党岭主峰海拔约 5470 米，是红军长征翻越的海拔最高、牺牲最大的雪山之一。本坐标为夏羌涅阿垭口代表点。 In late February 1936 the Fourth Front Army advanced into northern Kham under the Kangding–Daofu–Luhuo campaign plan. Liu Bocheng and Cheng Shicai led an advance guard built around a portion of the 30th Army from Danba into Dangling; on 27–28 February it crossed the Xiaqiangniea Pass (about 4,810 m), reached Daofu county on 28 February, and took Daofu town on 1 March. The army headquarters crossed the same pass and reached Daofu on 15 March. Dangling’s main peak is about 5,470 m, making it one of the highest and costliest snow mountains crossed on the Long March. The coordinate is a representative point at the Xiaqiangniea Pass.

atlasTitle.en: The Long March

summary.zh: 红二、六军团在野马川开会，决定以赫章为中心在乌蒙山区回旋作战。
summary.en: The Second and Sixth Army Groups met at Yemachuan and decided to maneuver in the Wumeng Mountains around Hezhang.

fields.name: 野马川会议 Yemachuan Meeting 赫章野马川会议 Yemachuan Meeting in Hezhang
fields.place: 贵州赫章野马川镇 Yemachuan, Hezhang, Guizhou
fields.summary: 红二、六军团在野马川开会，决定以赫章为中心在乌蒙山区回旋作战。 The Second and Sixth Army Groups met at Yemachuan and decided to maneuver in the Wumeng Mountains around Hezhang.
fields.description: 1936 年 3 月 2 日，贺龙、任弼时、关向应、萧克、王震等在贵州赫章野马川召开军团领导人会议。会议分析敌我兵力对比与乌蒙山区地理、气候条件，决定以地处乌蒙山腹地的赫章为中心，在贵州赫章、威宁与云南彝良、镇雄、昭通一带迂回作战，以虚实结合、声东击西甩开追兵，再寻机向滇东转移。会议原定「继续西进、寻机南行」，3 月 4 日部队进至妈姑、回水塘时发现南进道路已被切断，遂改向西北，于 6 日进至彝良奎香。野马川会议是乌蒙山回旋战的开端。本坐标为野马川镇代表点。 On 2 March 1936 He Long, Ren Bishi, Guan Xiangying, Xiao Ke, Wang Zhen, and other army group leaders met at Yemachuan in Hezhang, Guizhou. They weighed the balance of forces and the terrain and climate of the Wumeng Mountains, and decided to make Hezhang the centre of a maneuvering campaign across Hezhang and Weining in Guizhou and Yiliang, Zhenxiong, and Zhaotong in Yunnan, using feints to throw off the pursuit before turning east into Yunnan. The meeting originally planned to continue west and then look for a way south; on 4 March, at Magu and Huishuitang, the southern road was found cut and the army turned northwest, reaching Kuixiang in Yiliang on 6 March. The Yemachuan meeting opened the Wumeng Mountains maneuvering campaign. The coordinate is a representative point at Yemachuan.

fields.place: 贵州赫章河镇乡以则村（以则河） Yize village, Hezhen township, Hezhang, Guizhou (Yizehe)
fields.summary: 红二、六军团由奎香折返 50 里，在以则河伏击樊崧甫纵队先头。 The Second and Sixth Army Groups doubled back 25 km from Kuixiang and ambushed the advance guard of Fan Songfu’s column at Yizehe.
fields.description: 1936 年 3 月 6 日至 7 日，红二、六军团进至云南彝良奎香一带，摆出北渡金沙江的姿态，诱使国民党军万耀煌、樊崧甫、郝梦龄三个纵队掉头西北。樊崧甫第二十八师步步紧逼，红军于 3 月 7 日夜由奎香折返约 50 里，在威宁以北、今赫章河镇乡以则村一带山地设伏。8 日拂晓，敌第二十八师先头部队进入伏击圈，红四师、红十六师、红十七师一齐开火，歼其先头两个连，毙伤俘敌数百人（另有「重创 600 余人」说），迫使该敌不敢轻进。战斗后红军迅速返回奎香，并于 3 月 9 日、10 日突破分水岭、广德关两道防线。本坐标为以则村代表点。 On 6–7 March 1936 the Second and Sixth Army Groups reached the Kuixiang area of Yiliang, Yunnan, posing as if about to cross the Jinsha River northward, which drew the columns of Wan Yaohuang, Fan Songfu, and Hao Mengling back to the northwest. Fan Songfu’s 28th Division pressed close; on the night of 7 March the Red Army doubled back about 25 km from Kuixiang and set an ambush in the hills north of Weining, around present-day Yize village in Hezhen township, Hezhang. At dawn on 8 March the division’s advance guard entered the trap and the 4th, 16th, and 17th Divisions opened fire together, destroying two leading companies and killing, wounding, or capturing several hundred (some accounts say over 600), which checked the enemy’s pursuit. The Red Army then returned swiftly to Kuixiang and on 9–10 March broke through the Fenshuiling and Guangdeguan defence lines. The coordinate is a representative point at Yize village.

summary.en: The Second and Sixth Army Groups ambushed Wan Yaohuang’s 13th Division at Zhezhuangba (Dezhangba), destroying two regiments.

fields.name: 哲庄坝伏击战 Zhezhuangba Ambush 得章坝伏击战 Dezhangba Ambush 哲庄坝战斗 Zhezhuangba Battle
fields.place: 贵州赫章哲庄镇（得章坝，镇雄以南） Zhezhuang (Dezhangba), Hezhang, Guizhou, south of Zhenxiong
fields.summary: 红二、六军团在哲庄坝（得章坝）伏击万耀煌第十三师，歼其两个团。 The Second and Sixth Army Groups ambushed Wan Yaohuang’s 13th Division at Zhezhuangba (Dezhangba), destroying two regiments.
fields.description: 1936 年 3 月 11 日，红二军团第四师进抵镇雄城外以萨沟，获悉万耀煌纵队第十三师经哲庄坝（又称得章坝，今赫章县哲庄镇）向镇雄前进。12 日凌晨，红军分三路进入伏击阵地：一路由巴基山梁子至三锅庄、雨子场，一路由古基至哲庄、黄家营盘，一路由大屋基梁子至桃园垭口。9 时许，敌第十三师进入伏击圈，红军自西侧制高点拦腰截断，与敌短兵相接、反复肉搏十余次，万耀煌换装混杂于溃兵中逃脱。此役歼敌两个团、俘敌 200 余人，缴获轻重机枪 30 余挺（另有「歼敌 300 余人」「击溃第十三师」等口径）。红六师第十八团政委余秋里在战斗中负重伤，失去左臂。伏击战后红军被五个纵队围困于镇雄、赫章间狭小地域，3 月 16 日第三次进入奎香，19 日跳出包围圈。本坐标为哲庄镇代表点。 On 11 March 1936 the Second Army Corps’ 4th Division reached Yisagou outside Zhenxiong and learned that Wan Yaohuang’s 13th Division was moving toward Zhenxiong via Zhezhuangba (also called Dezhangba, present-day Zhezhuang in Hezhang). Before dawn on 12 March the Red Army moved into ambush positions in three routes: from Baji ridge to Sanguozhuang and Yuzichang, from Guji to Zhezhuang and Huangjiayingpan, and from Dawuji ridge to Taoyuan pass. At about 9 a.m. the 13th Division entered the trap; the Red Army cut it in two from the heights to the west and fought hand to hand more than ten times, while Wan Yaohuang changed clothes and escaped among the routed troops. Two regiments were destroyed, over 200 captured, and more than 30 light and heavy machine guns taken (other accounts give over 300 casualties or describe the 13th Division as routed). Yu Qiuli, commissar of the 18th Regiment of the 6th Division, was gravely wounded and lost his left arm. After the ambush five enemy columns confined the Red Army in a narrow area between Zhenxiong and Hezhang; it entered Kuixiang a third time on 16 March and broke out on 19 March. The coordinate is a representative point at Zhezhuang.

fields.name: 来宾铺战斗 Laibinpu Battle 虎头山战斗 Hutoushan Battle 宣威来宾铺战斗 Laibinpu Battle at Xuanwei
fields.place: 云南宣威来宾铺（今来宾街道）、虎头山一带 Laibinpu (present-day Laibin) and Hutoushan, Xuanwei, Yunnan
fields.summary: 红二、六军团在来宾铺虎头山与滇军孙渡纵队激战，歼敌 400 余人。 The Second and Sixth Army Groups fought Sun Du’s Yunnan troops at Hutoushan near Laibinpu, killing or wounding over 400.
fields.description: 1936 年 3 月 22 日，红二、六军团到达云南宣威东北的来宾铺、徐屯地区。3 月 23 日，红军在来宾铺城北虎头山一带与滇军孙渡纵队激战竟日，歼敌 400 余人（另有歼敌近千人的记载，待核），自身亦有较大伤亡。战后红军沿乌蒙山东麓继续南下，3 月 28 日、29 日先后进占盘县、亦资孔地区，乌蒙山回旋战结束；3 月 30 日在盘县「九间楼」召开盘县会议，决定北渡金沙江。来宾铺战斗后，红二、六军团放弃了在滇东创建根据地的计划。本坐标为来宾街道代表点。 On 22 March 1936 the Second and Sixth Army Groups reached Laibinpu and Xutun northeast of Xuanwei, Yunnan. On 23 March they fought Sun Du’s Yunnan column all day around Hutoushan north of Laibinpu, killing or wounding more than 400 (some accounts give nearly a thousand, pending verification) and suffering considerable casualties themselves. The army then moved south along the eastern foot of the Wumeng Mountains, occupying Panxian and Yizikong on 28–29 March and ending the Wumeng Mountains campaign; on 30 March the Panxian meeting at the “Nine-Room Tower” decided to cross the Jinsha River northward. After Laibinpu the Second and Sixth Army Groups abandoned the plan to build a base in eastern Yunnan. The coordinate is a representative point at Laibin.

summary.zh: 红二、红六军团在盘县九间楼开会，决定北渡金沙江与红四方面军会合。
summary.en: The Second and Sixth Army Corps met at Jiujianlou in Panxian and decided to cross the Jinsha River north to join the Fourth Front Army.

fields.name: 盘县会议 Panxian Meeting 盘县九间楼会议 Panxian Jiujianlou Meeting 盘县紧急会议 Panxian Emergency Meeting
fields.place: 贵州盘州九间楼 Jiujianlou, Panzhou, Guizhou
fields.summary: 红二、红六军团在盘县九间楼开会，决定北渡金沙江与红四方面军会合。 The Second and Sixth Army Corps met at Jiujianlou in Panxian and decided to cross the Jinsha River north to join the Fourth Front Army.
fields.description: 1936 年 3 月 30 日夜，红二、红六军团在盘县九间楼召开会议，传达红军总部电示，分析全国形势，决定放弃在南北盘江建立根据地，立即北渡金沙江，与红四方面军会合、共同北上抗日。4 月 1 日撤离盘县。本坐标为九间楼代表点。 On the night of 30 March 1936, the Second and Sixth Army Corps met at Jiujianlou in Panxian. They relayed the Red Army headquarters’ instructions, analyzed the national situation, and decided to abandon plans for a base between the north and south Pan rivers. Instead they would cross the Jinsha River north to join the Fourth Front Army and move north together to resist Japan. They left Panxian on 1 April. The coordinate is a representative point at Jiujianlou.

atlasTitle.en: The Long March

place.zh: 四川道孚麻孜乡西南亚洛阔山垭口
place.en: Yalokuo Mountain pass southwest of Mazi township, Daofu, Sichuan

summary.zh: 红四军第十师由道孚麻孜乡翻越亚洛阔山，开始四天奔袭瞻化。
summary.en: The 10th Division of the 4th Army crossed Yalokuo Mountain from Mazi, Daofu, beginning the four-day rush on Zhanhua.

fields.name: 翻越亚洛阔山 Crossing Yalokuo Mountain 亚洛阔垭口 Yalokuo Pass
fields.place: 四川道孚麻孜乡西南亚洛阔山垭口 Yalokuo Mountain pass southwest of Mazi township, Daofu, Sichuan
fields.summary: 红四军第十师由道孚麻孜乡翻越亚洛阔山，开始四天奔袭瞻化。 The 10th Division of the 4th Army crossed Yalokuo Mountain from Mazi, Daofu, beginning the four-day rush on Zhanhua.
fields.description: 1936 年 3 月 27 日，红四方面军第四军奉命以第十师、第十一师由道孚奔袭瞻化（今新龙），限速夺取县城。4 月 1 日，第十师经麻孜乡（陈伯钧日记记为「麻子沟」）翻越亚洛阔山垭口（图测海拔约 4510 米）西进，当日行约六十里至热里科喇嘛寺宿营。部分资料将这一段四座垭口记为决益涅阿、伊则涅阿、伊涅阿、俄里涅阿，名称与对应关系尚待考证。本坐标为亚洛阔山垭口代表点。 On 27 March 1936 the 4th Army of the Fourth Front Army was ordered to rush Zhanhua (present-day Xinlong) with its 10th and 11th Divisions from Daofu and take the county town at speed. On 1 April the 10th Division crossed the Yalokuo Mountain pass (mapped at about 4,510 m) from Mazi township (recorded as “Mazigou” in Chen Bojun’s diary) and marched some sixty li west to camp at Relike Lamasery. Some sources record the four passes of this stretch as Jueyi Niea, Yize Niea, Yi Niea, and Eli Niea; the names and their correspondence still require verification. The coordinate is a representative point at the Yalokuo pass.
fields.entities: 红四方面军 Red Fourth Front Army

summary.en: The 10th Division crossed Shayong Mountain past Yalokuo Monastery and moved toward the Jiasikong River.

fields.name: 翻越沙拥山 Crossing Shayong Mountain 沙拥垭口 Shayong Pass
fields.place: 四川道孚麻孜乡与甲斯孔乡沙拥村之间沙拥山垭口 Shayong Mountain pass between Mazi and Jiasikong townships, Daofu, Sichuan
fields.summary: 红四军第十师经亚洛阔旧寺翻越沙拥山，向甲斯孔河前进。 The 10th Division crossed Shayong Mountain past Yalokuo Monastery and moved toward the Jiasikong River.
fields.description: 1936 年 4 月 2 日，红四军第十师由热里科喇嘛寺继续西进，经亚洛阔旧寺翻越沙拥山垭口（图测海拔约 4700 米）前往甲斯孔河畔，当日行约五十里至甲子孔。陈伯钧日记称「今日的山与党岭不相上下」，可见积雪与海拔之高。本坐标为沙拥山垭口代表点。 On 2 April 1936 the 10th Division moved west from Relike Lamasery, passed Yalokuo Monastery, and crossed the Shayong Mountain pass (mapped at about 4,700 m) toward the Jiasikong River, marching about fifty li to Jiazikong. Chen Bojun’s diary notes that “today’s mountain was comparable to Dangling,” indicating deep snow and high elevation. The coordinate is a representative point at the Shayong pass.

place.zh: 四川道孚麻孜乡与新龙拉日马乡交界伊涅阿山垭口
place.en: Yijiea Mountain pass on the Daofu–Xinlong border, Sichuan

summary.en: The 10th Division crossed Yijiea Mountain into the Larima area.

fields.name: 翻越伊涅阿山 Crossing Yijiea Mountain 伊涅阿垭口 Yijiea Pass 丹巴达吉 Danba Daji
fields.place: 四川道孚麻孜乡与新龙拉日马乡交界伊涅阿山垭口 Yijiea Mountain pass on the Daofu–Xinlong border, Sichuan
fields.summary: 红四军第十师翻越伊涅阿山，进入拉日马一带。 The 10th Division crossed Yijiea Mountain into the Larima area.
fields.description: 1936 年 4 月 3 日，红四军第十师由甲子孔继续西进，经沙拥村翻越伊涅阿山垭口（图测海拔约 4616 米），当日行约四十里至腊科。伊涅阿山是道孚与新龙的界山，藏语意为「向阳的山垭」，当地又称「丹巴达吉」。本坐标为伊涅阿山垭口代表点。 On 3 April 1936 the 10th Division continued west from Jiazikong, passed Shayong village, and crossed the Yijiea Mountain pass (mapped at about 4,616 m), marching about forty li to Lako. Yijiea Mountain forms the border between Daofu and Xinlong; its Tibetan name means “sunny pass,” and it is also called “Danba Daji” locally. The coordinate is a representative point at the Yijiea pass.

atlasTitle.en: The Long March

place.zh: 四川新龙甲拉乡东南扎巴加山垭口
place.en: Zhabajia Mountain pass southeast of Jiala township, Xinlong, Sichuan

summary.zh: 红四军第十师翻越扎巴加山，直抵瞻化县城。
summary.en: The 10th Division crossed Zhabajia Mountain and reached Zhanhua county town.

fields.name: 翻越扎巴加山 Crossing Zhabajia Mountain 扎巴加垭口 Zhabajia Pass 梁阿卡山 Liangaka Mountain
fields.place: 四川新龙甲拉乡东南扎巴加山垭口 Zhabajia Mountain pass southeast of Jiala township, Xinlong, Sichuan
fields.summary: 红四军第十师翻越扎巴加山，直抵瞻化县城。 The 10th Division crossed Zhabajia Mountain and reached Zhanhua county town.
fields.description: 1936 年 4 月 4 日，红四军第十师由腊科出发，行约五十里进沟，再翻越扎巴加山垭口（实测海拔约 4590 米）行约九十里，当晚抵达瞻化（今新龙）县城并投入战斗，夜十时攻破县城。扎巴加山藏语意为「带回声的山」，当地又称「梁阿卡山」。至此，红四军四天连续翻越四座海拔 4000 米以上雪山，完成高原长途奔袭。本坐标为扎巴加山垭口代表点。 On 4 April 1936 the 10th Division left Lako, marched about fifty li up the valley, crossed the Zhabajia Mountain pass (surveyed at about 4,590 m), and covered another ninety li to reach Zhanhua (present-day Xinlong) county town that evening, attacking at once and breaking into the town at 10 p.m. The Tibetan name of Zhabajia means “mountain that returns an echo,” and it is also called “Liangaka.” The 4th Army thus crossed four passes above 4,000 m in four consecutive days, completing a long-distance highland raid. The coordinate is a representative point at the Zhabajia pass.

atlasTitle.en: The Long March

summary.zh: 红四军第十师夜袭瞻化县城，打开北上通道。
summary.en: The 10th Division stormed Zhanhua county town at night, opening the northward route.

fields.name: 夺取瞻化 Capture of Zhanhua 攻占瞻化县城 Taking Zhanhua County Town 飞夺雅砻江铁索桥 Seizing the Yalong River Chain Bridge
fields.place: 四川新龙（瞻化）县城 Zhanhua (present-day Xinlong) county town, Sichuan
fields.summary: 红四军第十师夜袭瞻化县城，打开北上通道。 The 10th Division stormed Zhanhua county town at night, opening the northward route.
fields.description: 1936 年 4 月 4 日，红四军第十师经四天连续翻越四座雪山抵达瞻化（今新龙）县城，几乎未作停顿即投入战斗，当晚十时攻破县城，并夺取雅砻江铁索桥。此役打开了红四方面军北上甘孜的通道，被视为高原山地长途奔袭的典型战例。战斗中红军亦有一定伤亡，具体数字待核。本坐标为瞻化县城代表点。 On 4 April 1936 the 10th Division of the 4th Army reached Zhanhua (present-day Xinlong) county town after crossing four snow mountains in four days. It attacked almost without pause, broke into the town at 10 p.m., and seized the chain bridge over the Yalong River. The action opened the Fourth Front Army’s route north to Garzê and is regarded as a classic long-distance highland raid. The Red Army also suffered casualties; the exact number requires verification. The coordinate is a representative point at Zhanhua county town.

place.zh: 云南禄劝普渡河铁索桥
place.en: Pudu River chain bridge, Luquan, Yunnan

summary.zh: 红二军团抢占普渡河渡口，与滇军激战，渡河受阻。
summary.en: The Second Army Corps seized the Pudu River crossing and fought the Yunnan army, but the crossing was blocked.

fields.name: 普渡河战斗 Battle of the Pudu River 普渡河渡口战斗 Pudu River Crossing Battle 普渡河铁索桥战斗 Pudu River Chain Bridge Battle
fields.place: 云南禄劝普渡河铁索桥 Pudu River chain bridge, Luquan, Yunnan
fields.summary: 红二军团抢占普渡河渡口，与滇军激战，渡河受阻。 The Second Army Corps seized the Pudu River crossing and fought the Yunnan army, but the crossing was blocked.
fields.description: 1936 年 4 月 8 日，红二军团第四师先头部队抢占禄劝普渡河渡口，与滇军孙渡纵队激战；红四师大部从铁索桥下涉水过河，红六军团前卫第十七师在普渡河与滇军遭遇，渡河受阻。红军被迫调整部署，转至六甲阻击。本坐标为普渡河铁索桥代表点。 On 8 April 1936, the advance guard of the Fourth Division, Second Army Corps, seized the Pudu River crossing in Luquan and fought Sun Du’s Yunnan column. Most of the Fourth Division forded the river below the chain bridge, while the Seventeenth Division, vanguard of the Sixth Army Corps, met the Yunnan troops at the Pudu River and was blocked. The Red Army adjusted its deployment and turned to block the enemy at Liujia. The coordinate is a representative point at the Pudu River chain bridge.

fields.place: 云南寻甸六甲贾白山 Liujia, Jiabaishan, Xundian, Yunnan
fields.summary: 红六师在六甲阻击滇军，掩护主力西进。 The Sixth Division blocked the Yunnan army at Liujia, covering the main force’s westward move.
fields.description: 1936 年 4 月 9 日，红二军团第六师在寻甸六甲石蜡坨垭口阻击尾追的滇军第七旅，红十六、十七、十八团抢占垭口南北山冈，激战至傍晚，红五师增援从侧后夹击，滇军溃退。红军以伤亡 200 余人代价歼敌近千人，粉碎滇军将红军消灭于普渡河以东、功山以南的计划。本坐标为六甲/贾白山代表点。 On 9 April 1936, the Sixth Division of the Second Army Corps blocked the pursuing 7th Brigade of the Yunnan army at the Shilatuo pass in Liujia, Xundian. The 16th, 17th, and 18th Regiments seized the high ground north and south of the pass and fought until evening, when the Fifth Division arrived and attacked the enemy flank and rear, routing the Yunnan troops. The Red Army suffered more than 200 casualties and killed or wounded nearly 1,000 enemy soldiers, foiling the plan to destroy the Red Army east of the Pudu River and south of Gongshan. The coordinate is a representative point at Liujia/Jiabaishan.

place.en: Yaha Snow Mountain between Shangjiang and Xiaozhongdian, Shangri-La, Yunnan
