fields.name: 翻越雅哈雪山 Crossing Yaha Snow Mountain 中甸雪山 Zhongdian Snow Mountain
fields.place: 云南香格里拉上江、小中甸之间雅哈雪山 Yaha Snow Mountain between Shangjiang and Xiaozhongdian, Shangri-La, Yunnan
fields.summary: 红二、红六军团渡金沙江后翻越雅哈雪山，进入中甸藏区。 After crossing the Jinsha River, the Second and Sixth Army Groups crossed Yaha Snow Mountain into the Zhongdian Tibetan area.
fields.description: 1936 年 4 月 25 日至 28 日，红二、红六军团在石鼓至巨甸一线渡过金沙江，随后沿玉龙雪山西麓北上。4 月 28 日，红二军团第四师前卫第十二团经上江、立马河翻越雅哈雪山，在干岩房遭中甸头人汪学鼎民团阻击，红军有伤亡；红军未直接还击，以密集火力压制、驱散民团。4 月 30 日先头部队进入中甸县城，红二军团直属队及第五、第六师于 5 月 1 日、3 日先后到达。雅哈雪山海拔诸说不一，有 5300 米、3924 米与约 4000 米等说法，本数据不取单一数值。本坐标为雅哈雪山垭口代表点。 From 25 to 28 April 1936 the Second and Sixth Army Groups crossed the Jinsha River between Shigu and Judian and moved north along the western foot of Yulong Snow Mountain. On 28 April the 12th Regiment, forward unit of the 4th Division, Second Army Group, crossed Yaha Snow Mountain via Shangjiang and Limahé. At Ganyanfang it was ambushed by the militia of the Zhongdian headman Wang Xueding and suffered casualties; the Red Army did not return fire directly and dispersed the militia with heavy fire over their heads. The advance guard entered Zhongdian town on 30 April; the Second Army Group headquarters and the 5th and 6th Divisions arrived on 1 and 3 May. Published elevations for Yaha vary widely (5,300 m, 3,924 m, and about 4,000 m), so this entry does not adopt a single figure. The coordinate is a representative point at the Yaha pass.

name.en: Crossing the Greater and Lesser Snow Mountains

place.zh: 云南香格里拉与四川乡城交界大、小雪山垭口
place.en: Greater and Lesser Snow Mountain passes on the Yunnan–Sichuan border, Shangri-La / Xiangcheng

summary.en: The Sixth Army Group crossed the Greater and Lesser Snow Mountains from Zhongdian into Xiangcheng, Sichuan.

fields.name: 翻越大、小雪山 Crossing the Greater and Lesser Snow Mountains 大雪山（咱浪雪山） Greater Snow Mountain (Zanlang) 小雪山（甲子雪山） Lesser Snow Mountain (Jiazi)
fields.place: 云南香格里拉与四川乡城交界大、小雪山垭口 Greater and Lesser Snow Mountain passes on the Yunnan–Sichuan border, Shangri-La / Xiangcheng
fields.summary: 红六军团由中甸翻越大、小雪山，进入四川乡城。 The Sixth Army Group crossed the Greater and Lesser Snow Mountains from Zhongdian into Xiangcheng, Sichuan.
fields.description: 1936 年 5 月 5 日，红二、红六军团由中甸分两路北进：红二军团经得荣、巴安（今巴塘）、白玉，红六军团经定乡（今乡城）、稻城、理化（今理塘）、瞻化（今新龙）至甘孜。5 月 9 日，红六军团由中甸出发，翻越大雪山（咱浪雪山，垭口海拔约 4333 米）与小雪山（甲子雪山，垭口海拔约 4185 米）进入乡城境内；5 月 14 日到达定乡，受到桑披寺僧众接待并休整一周。两山垭口同在一道山脊，常被视作一座雪山。本坐标为两垭口之间的代表点。 On 5 May 1936 the Second and Sixth Army Groups left Zhongdian on two routes: the Second Army Group via Derong, Batang, and Baiyü; the Sixth via Xiangcheng, Daocheng, Litang, and Xinlong to Garzê. On 9 May the Sixth Army Group crossed the Greater Snow Mountain (Zanlang, pass about 4,333 m) and the Lesser Snow Mountain (Jiazi, pass about 4,185 m) into Xiangcheng county, reaching Xiangcheng town on 14 May, where it was received by the Sangpi Monastery and rested for a week. The two passes lie on the same ridge and are often treated as one snow mountain. The coordinate is a representative point between the two passes.

summary.en: The Second Army Group crossed the Yuericipu Pass via Bozi and entered Zhongzan in Batang.

fields.place: 四川巴塘中咱乡月日茨普垭口 Yuericipu Pass, Zhongzan township, Batang, Sichuan
fields.summary: 红二军团经波茨翻越月日茨普，进入巴塘中咱。 The Second Army Group crossed the Yuericipu Pass via Bozi and entered Zhongzan in Batang.
fields.description: 1936 年 5 月 15 日，从得荣北进的红二军团经巴塘县波茨翻越月日茨普垭口（图测海拔约 4579 米），进入中咱乡境。「月日茨普」藏语意为「亮水头」，因草场之水源于冰川、源头晶莹耀眼而得名。5 月 20 日，红二军团先头第四师在巴塘南部茨巫乡与仁波喇嘛寺武装僧兵接火，红军围而不打、晓以大义，随后经中咱向巴安（今巴塘）前进。本坐标为月日茨普垭口代表点。 On 15 May 1936 the Second Army Group, moving north from Derong, crossed the Yuericipu Pass (mapped at about 4,579 m) via Bozi in Batang county and entered Zhongzan township. The Tibetan name means “bright water head,” after the glacier-fed streams there. On 20 May the advance 4th Division clashed with armed monks of Renbo Monastery at Ciwu in southern Batang; the Red Army surrounded them without attacking and persuaded them to stand down, then advanced via Zhongzan toward Batang. The coordinate is a representative point at the Yuericipu pass.

place.zh: 四川乡城、稻城交界沙鲁里山垭口
place.en: Shaluli Mountain pass on the Xiangcheng–Daocheng border, Sichuan

summary.zh: 红六军团由乡城翻越沙鲁里山，进入稻城桑堆。
summary.en: The Sixth Army Group crossed the Shaluli Mountains from Xiangcheng into Sangdui, Daocheng.

fields.name: 翻越沙鲁里山 Crossing the Shaluli Mountains 无名山 Nameless Mountain 乡城、稻城界山 Xiangcheng–Daocheng border mountain
fields.place: 四川乡城、稻城交界沙鲁里山垭口 Shaluli Mountain pass on the Xiangcheng–Daocheng border, Sichuan
fields.summary: 红六军团由乡城翻越沙鲁里山，进入稻城桑堆。 The Sixth Army Group crossed the Shaluli Mountains from Xiangcheng into Sangdui, Daocheng.
fields.description: 1936 年 5 月 20 日，红六军团由乡城出发，翻越乡城与稻城交界、当地称「无名山」的沙鲁里山垭口（图测海拔约 4730 米），进入稻城县桑堆乡，5 月 22 日进驻稻城县城。此后经理化（今理塘）北上，6 月 3 日在甲洼与红四方面军第三十二军会师。本坐标为沙鲁里山垭口代表点。 On 20 May 1936 the Sixth Army Group left Xiangcheng and crossed the Shaluli Mountain pass on the Xiangcheng–Daocheng border, locally called the “Nameless Mountain” (mapped at about 4,730 m), entering Sangdui township in Daocheng county and reaching Daocheng town on 22 May. It then moved north via Litang and met the 32nd Army of the Fourth Front Army at Jiawa on 3 June. The coordinate is a representative point at the Shaluli pass.

place.zh: 四川巴塘亚日贡、巴塘县城之间藏巴拉山垭口
place.en: Zangbala Mountain pass between Yarigong and Batang town, Sichuan

summary.zh: 红二军团翻越藏巴拉山，进至巴塘县城附近。

fields.name: 翻越藏巴拉山 Crossing Zangbala Mountain 藏巴拉雪山 Zangbala Snow Mountain
fields.place: 四川巴塘亚日贡、巴塘县城之间藏巴拉山垭口 Zangbala Mountain pass between Yarigong and Batang town, Sichuan
fields.summary: 红二军团翻越藏巴拉山，进至巴塘县城附近。 The Second Army Group crossed Zangbala Mountain and approached Batang town.
fields.description: 1936 年 6 月 5 日，经亚日贡向巴塘北进的红二军团翻越藏巴拉山垭口（图测海拔约 4900 米），进至巴塘县城附近。红二军团随后佯攻巴塘、主力绕城北进，6 月 14 日撤离巴塘向白玉进发，6 月 30 日到达甘孜绒巴岔，与红四方面军会合。藏巴拉山是红二军团（后编为红二方面军）长征中翻越的海拔最高的雪山之一。本坐标为藏巴拉山垭口代表点。 On 5 June 1936 the Second Army Group, moving north via Yarigong toward Batang, crossed the Zangbala Mountain pass (mapped at about 4,900 m) and approached Batang town. It then feinted against Batang while the main force bypassed the town to the north, withdrew toward Baiyü on 14 June, and reached Rongbacha in Garzê on 30 June to join the Fourth Front Army. Zangbala is among the highest snow mountains crossed by the Second Army Group (later the Second Front Army) on the Long March. The coordinate is a representative point at the Zangbala pass.
fields.entities: 红二方面军 Red Second Front Army

summary.en: Part of the Second Army Group crossed the Ere Pass from Batang toward Baiyü.

fields.name: 翻越恶热拉山 Crossing Ere Pass 恶热拉垭口 Ere Pass
fields.place: 四川白玉盖玉乡恶热拉山垭口 Ere Mountain pass, Gaiyü township, Baiyü, Sichuan
fields.summary: 红二军团一部由巴塘北进，翻越恶热拉山进至白玉。 Part of the Second Army Group crossed the Ere Pass from Batang toward Baiyü.
fields.description: 1936 年 6 月 14 日，红二军团撤离巴塘向白玉进发。6 月 18 日，部队兵分两路：一路经恶热拉山垭口（图测海拔约 4636 米）北进。「恶热拉」藏语意为「头巾山」。两路于白玉县城会合，6 月 19 日进驻白玉，休整五天。本坐标为恶热拉山垭口代表点。 On 14 June 1936 the Second Army Group left Batang for Baiyü. On 18 June it split into two columns: one crossed the Ere Mountain pass (mapped at about 4,636 m). The Tibetan name means “headscarf mountain.” The two columns reunited at Baiyü county town and entered it on 19 June, resting for five days. The coordinate is a representative point at the Ere pass.

fields.description: 1936 年 6 月 18 日，由巴塘北进的红二军团兵分两路，另一路经麦拉山垭口（图测海拔约 4340 米）北进。「麦拉」藏语意为「黑痣山」，垭口位于绒玉乡与盖玉乡交界。两路于白玉县城会合，6 月 19 日进驻白玉。本坐标为麦拉山垭口代表点。 On 18 June 1936 the Second Army Group, moving north from Batang, split into two columns; the other crossed the Maila Mountain pass (mapped at about 4,340 m). The Tibetan name means “black mole mountain,” and the pass lies on the border between Rongyü and Gaiyü townships. The two columns reunited at Baiyü county town and entered it on 19 June. The coordinate is a representative point at the Maila pass.

summary.en: The Second Army Group crossed Sheng’oula Mountain and reached Rongbacha in Garzê to join the Fourth Front Army.

fields.place: 四川白玉赠科乡生欧拉山垭口 Sheng’oula Mountain pass, Zengkê township, Baiyü, Sichuan
fields.summary: 红二军团翻越生欧拉山，进至甘孜绒巴岔与红四方面军会合。 The Second Army Group crossed Sheng’oula Mountain and reached Rongbacha in Garzê to join the Fourth Front Army.
fields.description: 1936 年 6 月 25 日，红二军团由白玉经嘎拖寺、河坡、赠科向甘孜挺进；6 月 30 日翻越白玉与甘孜界山生欧拉山垭口（图测海拔约 4767 米），进至甘孜绒巴岔，与红四方面军第三十军第八十八师及当地群众会合。「生欧拉」藏语意为「哭泣的山」。7 月 1 日，红二、红六军团齐集甘孜甘海子，与红四方面军会师。本坐标为生欧拉山垭口代表点。 On 25 June 1936 the Second Army Group moved from Baiyü toward Garzê via Gathok Monastery, Hepo, and Zengkê. On 30 June it crossed the Sheng’oula Mountain pass (mapped at about 4,767 m) on the Baiyü–Garzê border and reached Rongbacha in Garzê, joining the 88th Division of the Fourth Front Army’s 30th Army and local people. The Tibetan name means “weeping mountain.” On 1 July the Second and Sixth Army Groups assembled at Ganhaizi near Garzê and met the Fourth Front Army. The coordinate is a representative point at the Sheng’oula pass.

fields.place: 甘肃岷县（战役中心） Minxian, Gansu (campaign centre)
fields.summary: 红四方面军发起岷洮西固战役，攻占临潭、漳县、渭源、通渭等地。 The Fourth Front Army launched the Min–Tao–Xigu campaign, taking Lintan, Zhangxian, Weiyuan, Tongwei, and surrounding areas.
fields.description: 1936 年 8 月 5 日，中共中央西北局在求吉寺会议后发布《岷洮西固战役计划》，红四方面军分两纵队由包座北上，先机夺取岷州（今岷县）、洮州（今临潭）、西固（今舟曲）地区。战役至 9 月 7 日结束，历时 34 天，先后攻占漳县、临潭、渭源、通渭四座县城及岷县、陇西、临洮、武山、宕昌等县广大农村，共歼敌 7000 余人。岷县县城久攻未克，红军改取围而不打，主力绕城北上。此役打开了红二、四方面军北上的通道。本坐标为岷县代表点；西固方向为战役分支，未单独建模。 On 5 August 1936, after the Qiuji Monastery meeting, the Northwest Bureau issued the Min–Tao–Xigu campaign plan. The Fourth Front Army moved north from Bazuo in two columns to seize Minzhou (present-day Minxian), Taozhou (Lintan), and Xigu (Zhouqu). The campaign ended on 7 September after 34 days, taking Zhangxian, Lintan, Weiyuan, and Tongwei county towns and large rural areas of Minxian, Longxi, Lintao, Wushan, and Dangchang, with more than 7,000 enemy troops killed or wounded. Minxian town was not taken; the Red Army switched to containing it and moved its main force around it to the north. The campaign opened the route north for the Second and Fourth Front Armies. The coordinate is a representative point at Minxian; the Xigu branch is not modelled separately.

atlasTitle.en: The Long March

summary.zh: 红三十军第八十八师夜袭腊子口，打开北上甘南门户。
summary.en: The 88th Division of the 30th Army took Lazikou by night attack, opening the gate to southern Gansu.

fields.name: 夜袭腊子口 Night Attack at Lazikou 1936 年腊子口战斗 1936 Lazikou Battle
fields.place: 甘肃迭部腊子口 Lazikou, Diebu, Gansu
fields.summary: 红三十军第八十八师夜袭腊子口，打开北上甘南门户。 The 88th Division of the 30th Army took Lazikou by night attack, opening the gate to southern Gansu.
fields.description: 1936 年 8 月 8 日夜，红四方面军第三十军第八十八师进攻腊子口，以两个营正面佯攻、一个营侧后迂回，加上一年前陕甘支队攻克腊子口的声威，迅速击垮国民党鲁大昌部守军一个营。8 月 9 日红军突破腊子口进入岷县境内，北上门户打开。此次战斗与 1935 年 9 月中央红军攻克腊子口是两次不同行动。本坐标为腊子口代表点。 On the night of 8 August 1936 the 88th Division of the Fourth Front Army’s 30th Army attacked Lazikou, feinting frontally with two battalions and sending one battalion around the flank. Together with the prestige of the Shaanxi–Gansu Detachment’s capture of Lazikou a year earlier, the attack quickly broke a battalion of Lu Dachang’s defenders. On 9 August the Red Army passed Lazikou into Minxian county, opening the northern gate. This action is distinct from the Central Red Army’s capture of Lazikou in September 1935. The coordinate is a representative point at Lazikou.

place.zh: 甘肃岷县县城南二郎山
place.en: Erlangshan south of Minxian county town, Gansu

summary.zh: 红三十军猛攻岷县二郎山，激战六昼夜后改强攻为围困。
summary.en: The 30th Army assaulted Erlangshan at Minxian for six days and nights before switching to containment.

fields.name: 二郎山战斗 Battle of Erlangshan 岷县二郎山战斗 Erlangshan Battle at Minxian 二郎山战役 Erlangshan Campaign
fields.place: 甘肃岷县县城南二郎山 Erlangshan south of Minxian county town, Gansu
fields.summary: 红三十军猛攻岷县二郎山，激战六昼夜后改强攻为围困。 The 30th Army assaulted Erlangshan at Minxian for six days and nights before switching to containment.
fields.description: 1936 年 8 月 10 日晚 11 时，红四方面军第三十军向岷县县城屏障二郎山发起猛攻，徐向前、陈昌浩、程世才、李先念等指挥，红军四次突破敌第三号碉堡，并在张家坪与敌特务团巷战。战斗反复拉锯，前沿阵地七次易手；鲁大昌急调两营增援。激战六昼夜，红军毙伤敌 1500 余人（另有 2000 余人说），缴轻重机枪 11 挺、迫击炮 5 门，自身伤亡 1000 余人。因城垣坚固、缺乏攻坚武器且部队刚出草地，红军改强攻为佯攻，以少数兵力围困县城，主力休整并做群众工作。本坐标为二郎山代表点。 At 11 p.m. on 10 August 1936 the Fourth Front Army’s 30th Army assaulted Erlangshan, the natural shield of Minxian town, under Xu Xiangqian, Chen Changhao, Cheng Shicai, and Li Xiannian. The Red Army broke into the enemy’s No. 3 blockhouse four times and fought street actions against the special service regiment at Zhangjiaping. The front line changed hands seven times, and Lu Dachang rushed two battalions as reinforcements. After six days and nights the Red Army had killed or wounded more than 1,500 enemy troops (some accounts say over 2,000), captured 11 light and heavy machine guns and five mortars, and suffered over 1,000 casualties. With strong walls, little siege equipment, and troops exhausted from the grasslands, the Red Army switched from assault to feint, containing the town with a small force while the main force rested and worked among the people. The coordinate is a representative point at Erlangshan.

summary.zh: 红四军第十师与妇女独立团攻占临潭旧城，随后阻击马彪旅。
summary.en: The 10th Division and the Women’s Independent Regiment took Lintan old town, then blocked Ma Biao’s brigade.

fields.name: 临潭旧城战斗 Battle of Lintan Old Town 洮州旧城战斗 Taozhou Old Town Battle
fields.place: 甘肃临潭旧城（今城关镇） Lintan old town (present-day Chengguan), Gansu
fields.summary: 红四军第十师与妇女独立团攻占临潭旧城，随后阻击马彪旅。 The 10th Division and the Women’s Independent Regiment took Lintan old town, then blocked Ma Biao’s brigade.
fields.description: 1936 年 8 月 20 日拂晓前，红四军第十师和妇女独立团沿山梁大道逼近洮州旧城；8 月 22 日发起攻击，攻占瓦窑坪、双峰堆，次日夺取对坡山、大坡山顶、大湾山梁制高点，击溃「铲共义勇团」，占领旧城，全歼守敌一个营，缴枪 300 余支，俘敌数十名。8 月 23 日，马步芳部马彪旅猛攻旧城，红军在旧城郊口、八龙河一带阻击。随后红军撤至新城方向。本坐标为临潭旧城代表点。 Before dawn on 20 August 1936 the 10th Division of the 4th Army and the Women’s Independent Regiment advanced on Taozhou old town along the ridge road. On 22 August they attacked, taking Wayaoping and Shuangfengdui, and the next day seized the heights at Duiposhan, Daposhan, and Dawan ridge, routed the “Communist Suppression Volunteers,” and occupied the old town. A garrison battalion was destroyed, over 300 rifles and several dozen prisoners taken. On 23 August Ma Biao’s brigade of Ma Bufang’s forces attacked; the Red Army blocked it at the town outskirts and along the Balong River, then withdrew toward Xincheng. The coordinate is a representative point at Lintan old town.

summary.zh: 红二方面军十天奔袭七百余里，攻占成县、徽县、两当、康县。
summary.en: In ten days the Second Front Army marched over 700 li and took Chengxian, Huixian, Liangdang, and Kangxian.

fields.name: 成徽两康战役 Cheng–Hui–Liang–Kang Campaign 成徽两当康县战役 Chengxian–Huixian–Liangdang–Kangxian Campaign 陇南战役 Longnan Campaign
fields.place: 甘肃成县（战役中心） Chengxian, Gansu (campaign centre)
fields.summary: 红二方面军十天奔袭七百余里，攻占成县、徽县、两当、康县。 In ten days the Second Front Army marched over 700 li and took Chengxian, Huixian, Liangdang, and Kangxian.
fields.description: 1936 年 9 月 11 日至 20 日，红二方面军按《成徽两康战役计划》分左、中、右三路纵队由哈达铺地区东出陇南，十天行程七百余里。左纵队红六军 9 月 18 日攻占徽县、两当（两当由地下工作者配合智取，俘保安队和警察 97 人，缴枪 200 余支）；中纵队红二军第四师、红三十二军 9 月 18 日拂晓攻占成县，守敌一个营被歼，缴枪 300 余支；右纵队红二军第六师 9 月 19 日占领康县。战役共攻占四座县城及西和、礼县、武都、略阳、凤县部分地区，为创建陇南临时根据地和三大主力会师创造了条件。本坐标为成县代表点。 From 11 to 20 September 1936 the Second Front Army executed the Cheng–Hui–Liang–Kang plan, moving east from the Hadapu area in three columns and covering over 700 li in ten days. The left column (Sixth Army) took Huixian and Liangdang on 18 September; Liangdang was taken by stealth with underground contacts, capturing 97 security men and police and over 200 rifles. The centre column (4th Division of the Second Army and the 32nd Army) took Chengxian at dawn on 18 September, destroying a garrison battalion and capturing over 300 rifles. The right column (6th Division) took Kangxian on 19 September. The campaign seized four county towns and parts of Xihe, Lixian, Wudu, Lueyang, and Fengxian, creating conditions for the Longnan base area and the three armies’ rendezvous. The coordinate is a representative point at Chengxian.

summary.zh: 中共中央西北局在岷州开会，否定西进主张，通过《静会战役纲领》。
summary.en: The Northwest Bureau met at Minzhou, rejected the westward plan, and adopted the Jingning–Huining campaign outline.

fields.name: 岷州会议 Minzhou Meeting 中共中央西北局岷州会议 Northwest Bureau Minzhou Meeting 三十里铺会议 Sanshilipu Meeting
fields.place: 甘肃岷县三十里铺 Sanshilipu, Minxian, Gansu
fields.summary: 中共中央西北局在岷州开会，否定西进主张，通过《静会战役纲领》。 The Northwest Bureau met at Minzhou, rejected the westward plan, and adopted the Jingning–Huining campaign outline.
fields.description: 1936 年 9 月 16 日至 18 日，中共中央西北局在岷县三十里铺召开会议。张国焘坚持红四方面军由临潭西进青海、占领甘西；朱德、陈昌浩等主张执行中央指示，北上静宁、会宁地区与红一方面军会合。会议最终否定西进主张，通过《静会战役纲领》，9 月 18 日由朱德、张国焘、陈昌浩联名电告党中央。岷州会议是三大主力会师前的关键一步。本坐标为三十里铺会址代表点。 From 16 to 18 September 1936 the Northwest Bureau of the CPC Central Committee met at Sanshilipu in Minxian. Zhang Guotao insisted that the Fourth Front Army move west from Lintan into Qinghai; Zhu De and Chen Changhao argued for obeying the Central Committee and moving north to the Jingning–Huining area to join the First Front Army. The meeting rejected the westward plan and adopted the Jingning–Huining campaign outline, which Zhu De, Zhang Guotao, and Chen Changhao reported to the Central Committee on 18 September. The Minzhou meeting was a key step toward the three armies’ rendezvous. The coordinate is a representative point at the Sanshilipu site.

name.zh: 红二军第六师占领康县

summary.zh: 成徽两康战役中，红二军第六师由右路占领康县。
summary.en: During the Cheng–Hui–Liang–Kang campaign the 6th Division of the Second Army took Kangxian on the right column.

fields.name: 红二军第六师占领康县 6th Division Takes Kangxian 攻占康县 Capture of Kangxian
fields.place: 甘肃康县县城 Kangxian county town, Gansu
fields.summary: 成徽两康战役中，红二军第六师由右路占领康县。 During the Cheng–Hui–Liang–Kang campaign the 6th Division of the Second Army took Kangxian on the right column.
fields.description: 1936 年 9 月 11 日至 20 日，红二方面军按《成徽两康战役计划》分左、中、右三路纵队由哈达铺地区东出陇南。右纵队红二军第六师 9 月 19 日占领康县，与左纵队攻占的徽县、两当和中纵队攻占的成县连成一片，为创建陇南临时根据地创造了条件。本坐标为康县县城代表点。 From 11 to 20 September 1936 the Second Front Army moved east from the Hadapu area in three columns under the Cheng–Hui–Liang–Kang plan. The right column, the 6th Division of the Second Army, took Kangxian on 19 September, linking with Huixian and Liangdang taken by the left column and Chengxian taken by the centre column, creating conditions for the Longnan base area. The coordinate is a representative point at Kangxian county town.

place.zh: 甘肃成县抛沙镇五龙山、新堡山
place.en: Wulongshan and Xinbaoshan, Paosha, Chengxian, Gansu

summary.zh: 红二方面军在五龙山阻击王均部，毙伤数百、俘敌 300 余。
summary.en: The Second Front Army blocked Wang Jun’s forces at Wulongshan, killing or wounding several hundred and capturing over 300.

fields.name: 五龙山阻击战 Wulongshan Blocking Battle 成县五龙山战斗 Wulongshan Battle at Chengxian 抛沙阻击战 Paosha Blocking Battle
fields.place: 甘肃成县抛沙镇五龙山、新堡山 Wulongshan and Xinbaoshan, Paosha, Chengxian, Gansu
fields.summary: 红二方面军在五龙山阻击王均部，毙伤数百、俘敌 300 余。 The Second Front Army blocked Wang Jun’s forces at Wulongshan, killing or wounding several hundred and capturing over 300.
fields.description: 1936 年 9 月 25 日，国民党王均部第三十五旅及补充团由武都向成县反扑。9 月 27 日至 29 日，红二方面军以红三十二军和红二军第四师、第六师在成县抛沙五龙山、新堡山设伏阻击。红军第十二团政委杨秀山率一营迂回敌侧后，与正面守军夹击；战斗毙伤敌数百人、俘敌 300 余人，第十八团政委周成宏（一作周盛宏）牺牲，杨秀山负伤。阻击战完成钳制敌军、掩护主力集结的任务，红军随后移师徽县红川。本坐标为五龙山代表点。 On 25 September 1936 the 35th Brigade and a replacement regiment of Wang Jun’s force counterattacked Chengxian from Wudu. From 27 to 29 September the Second Front Army’s 32nd Army and the 4th and 6th Divisions of the Second Army ambushed and blocked them at Wulongshan and Xinbaoshan in Paosha. Yang Xiushan, political commissar of the 12th Regiment, led a battalion around the enemy flank to attack in conjunction with the front-line defenders. Several hundred enemy troops were killed or wounded and over 300 captured; Zhou Chenghong (also recorded as Zhou Shenghong), political commissar of the 18th Regiment, was killed, and Yang Xiushan was wounded. The blocking action pinned the enemy and covered the main force’s concentration; the Red Army then moved to Hongchuan in Huixian. The coordinate is a representative point at Wulongshan.

atlasTitle.en: The Long March

place.zh: 甘肃临潭新城镇（洮州卫城）

summary.zh: 中共中央西北局在洮州重申北上，张国焘被迫同意会师。
summary.en: The Northwest Bureau reaffirmed the northward move at Taozhou; Zhang Guotao was forced to agree to the rendezvous.

fields.name: 洮州会议 Taozhou Meeting 中共中央西北局洮州会议 Northwest Bureau Taozhou Meeting 临潭新城会议 Lintan Xincheng Meeting
fields.place: 甘肃临潭新城镇（洮州卫城） Xincheng (Taozhou), Lintan, Gansu
fields.summary: 中共中央西北局在洮州重申北上，张国焘被迫同意会师。 The Northwest Bureau reaffirmed the northward move at Taozhou; Zhang Guotao was forced to agree to the rendezvous.
fields.description: 1936 年 9 月 27 日，中共中央西北局在临潭新城（今新城镇）召开会议，重新研究红四方面军行动方针。朱德再次争取张国焘，徐向前、陈昌浩等表示拥护北上；张国焘被迫同意放弃西进。会议重申岷州会议决定，当日 20 时朱德、张国焘、徐向前、陈昌浩联名电告党中央和红二方面军，表示「决不再改变」。9 月 28 日红四方面军分六路北上，30 日撤离临潭，10 月 9 日在会宁与红一方面军会师。本坐标为临潭新城会址代表点。 On 27 September 1936 the Northwest Bureau met at Xincheng in Lintan to reconsider the Fourth Front Army’s course. Zhu De again pressed Zhang Guotao; Xu Xiangqian and Chen Changhao supported moving north, and Zhang Guotao was forced to abandon the westward plan. The meeting reaffirmed the Minzhou decision, and at 20:00 that day Zhu De, Zhang Guotao, Xu Xiangqian, and Chen Changhao telegraphed the Central Committee and the Second Front Army that the decision would “never be changed again.” On 28 September the Fourth Front Army moved north in six columns, left Lintan on 30 September, and met the First Front Army at Huining on 9 October. The coordinate is a representative point at the Xincheng site.

place.zh: 甘肃通渭县城（战役终点代表点）
place.en: Tongwei county town, Gansu (representative end point)

summary.zh: 红四方面军执行《通庄静会战役计划》分五个纵队北上，10 月 5 日占领通渭。
summary.en: The Fourth Front Army carried out the Tong–Zhuang–Jing–Hui plan in five columns and took Tongwei on 5 October.

fields.name: 通庄静会战役 Tong–Zhuang–Jing–Hui Campaign 通渭庄浪静宁会宁战役 Tongwei–Zhuanglang–Jingning–Huining Campaign 静会战役 Jing–Hui Campaign
fields.place: 甘肃通渭县城（战役终点代表点） Tongwei county town, Gansu (representative end point)
fields.summary: 红四方面军执行《通庄静会战役计划》分五个纵队北上，10 月 5 日占领通渭。 The Fourth Front Army carried out the Tong–Zhuang–Jing–Hui plan in five columns and took Tongwei on 5 October.
fields.description: 1936 年 9 月 27 日洮州会议否决张国焘西进主张后，9 月 28 日红四方面军发布《通庄静会战役计划》，决定在西兰通道以北阻击胡宗南部，与红一方面军会师后进军宁夏。9 月 29 日总部下达北进命令，30 日起各部分五个纵队由岷州、漳县等地向通渭、庄浪、会宁、静宁地区前进，10 月 5 日占领通渭县城。此役是三大主力会师的直接前奏：红四方面军由此进至会宁一带，红一方面军则以红十五军团骑兵团于 10 月 2 日袭占会宁城接应。战役期间张国焘仍在 9 月 20 日前后下令部队折回西进，经中央连电说服与朱德、徐向前、陈昌浩等抵制，部队才重新北上，故各部队实际出发日期先后不一。本坐标为通渭县城代表点；五个纵队的逐路路线尚未分线建模。 After the Taozhou meeting on 27 September 1936 rejected Zhang Guotao’s westward plan, the Fourth Front Army issued the Tong–Zhuang–Jing–Hui campaign plan on 28 September: block Hu Zongnan north of the Xi’an–Lanzhou road, then join the First Front Army and move on Ningxia. Headquarters ordered the northward advance on 29 September; from 30 September the army moved in five columns from Minzhou, Zhangxian, and elsewhere toward Tongwei, Zhuanglang, Huining, and Jingning, taking Tongwei county town on 5 October. The campaign was the immediate prelude to the three main forces’ link-up: the Fourth Front Army thereby reached the Huining area, while the First Front Army’s 15th Army Corps cavalry regiment seized Huining town on 2 October to receive it. Around 20 September Zhang Guotao had again ordered a turn back west; only after repeated telegrams from the Centre and resistance from Zhu De, Xu Xiangqian, Chen Changhao and others did the units resume the northward move, so starting dates varied. The coordinate is a representative point at Tongwei county town; the five columns’ separate routes are not yet modelled.

atlasTitle.en: The Long March

place.zh: 甘肃会宁县城（今会师镇）

summary.zh: 红十五军团骑兵团奔袭会宁，两小时内全歼守敌，打开会师接应阵地。
summary.en: The 15th Army Corps cavalry regiment raided Huining and destroyed the garrison within two hours, opening the link-up staging ground.

fields.name: 攻克会宁城 Capture of Huining Town 会宁攻城战斗 Huining Assault 红十五军团骑兵团奔袭会宁 15th Army Corps Cavalry Raid on Huining
fields.place: 甘肃会宁县城（今会师镇） Huining county town (present-day Huishi), Gansu
fields.summary: 红十五军团骑兵团奔袭会宁，两小时内全歼守敌，打开会师接应阵地。 The 15th Army Corps cavalry regiment raided Huining and destroyed the garrison within two hours, opening the link-up staging ground.
fields.description: 1936 年 9 月 30 日，红一方面军第十五军团直属骑兵团（团长韦杰、政委夏云飞）由宁夏同心县出发奔袭会宁县城，10 月 2 日凌晨 5 时许到达城北，趁守敌国民党军两个连及地方警兵未备发起猛攻，不到两小时全歼守敌，占领会宁县城，缴获一批武器弹药。从受领任务到攻克县城历时两天、行程 150 余公里（另有 300 余里、32 小时说），仅数人轻伤。此后红十五军团继续向会宁东南前进，控制会宁至静宁沿线要点；红一军团第一师、第二师占领界石铺等地，控制西兰公路 50 余公里地段。会宁城的夺取为 10 月 9 日三大主力会师提供了接应阵地。本坐标为会宁县城代表点。 On 30 September 1936 the cavalry regiment directly under the First Front Army’s 15th Army Corps (commander Wei Jie, commissar Xia Yunfei) set out from Tongxin in Ningxia to raid Huining town. At about 5 a.m. on 2 October it reached the north of the town and attacked while two KMT companies and local police were still unprepared; within two hours the garrison was destroyed and the town taken, with a large quantity of weapons and ammunition captured. The operation took two days and covered more than 150 km from receipt of orders (some accounts say over 300 li in 32 hours), with only a few lightly wounded. The 15th Army Corps then pushed southeast and controlled the Huining–Jingning line, while the 1st and 2nd Divisions of the 1st Army Corps occupied Jieshipu and other points, controlling over 50 km of the Xi’an–Lanzhou highway. The capture provided the staging ground for the three main forces’ link-up on 9 October. The coordinate is a representative point at Huining county town.

atlasTitle.en: The Long March

summary.zh: 红六军第十六师夜袭娘娘坝，师长张辉负伤后牺牲。
summary.en: The 16th Division of the Sixth Army raided Niangniangba; division commander Zhang Hui was wounded and died.

fields.name: 娘娘坝战斗 Battle of Niangniangba 天水娘娘坝夜袭 Night Raid at Niangniangba, Tianshui
fields.place: 甘肃天水娘娘坝 Niangniangba, Tianshui, Gansu
fields.summary: 红六军第十六师夜袭娘娘坝，师长张辉负伤后牺牲。 The 16th Division of the Sixth Army raided Niangniangba; division commander Zhang Hui was wounded and died.
fields.description: 1936 年 10 月 4 日，红二方面军分两路北撤，红六军由两当先行动身。10 月 5 日，红六军第十六师进至天水李子园，师长张辉率一个连夜袭娘娘坝，击溃守敌一个营，掩护全军渡过渭河封锁线。张辉在战斗中负重伤，撤至李子园普华寺后牺牲，年仅 25 岁。本坐标为娘娘坝代表点。 On 4 October 1936 the Second Front Army withdrew north in two columns, the Sixth Army leading from Liangdang. On 5 October the 16th Division reached Ziyuan in Tianshui; division commander Zhang Hui led a company in a night raid on Niangniangba, routed a garrison battalion, and covered the army’s crossing of the Wei River blockade line. Zhang Hui was badly wounded and died at Puhua Monastery in Ziyuan; he was 25. The coordinate is a representative point at Niangniangba.

atlasTitle.en: The Long March

place.zh: 甘肃礼县罗家堡龙池湾一带
place.en: Luojiabao and Longchiwan area, Lixian, Gansu

summary.zh: 红六军在罗家堡龙池湾遭两路敌军夹击，第十六师政委晏福生负重伤。
summary.en: The Sixth Army was caught between two enemy columns at Luojiabao–Longchiwan; 16th Division commissar Yan Fusheng was gravely wounded.

fields.name: 罗家堡战斗 Battle of Luojiabao 龙池湾战斗 Longchiwan Battle
fields.place: 甘肃礼县罗家堡龙池湾一带 Luojiabao and Longchiwan area, Lixian, Gansu
fields.summary: 红六军在罗家堡龙池湾遭两路敌军夹击，第十六师政委晏福生负重伤。 The Sixth Army was caught between two enemy columns at Luojiabao–Longchiwan; 16th Division commissar Yan Fusheng was gravely wounded.
fields.description: 1936 年 10 月 7 日，红六军冒雨由天水向礼县前进，途经罗家堡龙池湾一带时突遭两路敌军夹击。红军边打边走，第十六师政委晏福生在战斗中身负重伤，后与部队失散，历尽艰险返回部队并失去右臂。红六军主力突围后继续北上，10 月 8 日与左纵队在礼县固城会合。本坐标为罗家堡、龙池湾一带代表点。 On 7 October 1936 the Sixth Army marched in rain from Tianshui toward Lixian and was suddenly caught between two enemy columns near Luojiabao and Longchiwan. Fighting as it moved, the army suffered heavy casualties; Yan Fusheng, political commissar of the 16th Division, was gravely wounded, became separated from the unit, and eventually rejoined it after losing his right arm. The main force broke through and continued north, joining the left column at Gucheng in Lixian on 8 October. The coordinate is a representative point in the Luojiabao–Longchiwan area.

atlasTitle.en: The Long March

place.zh: 甘肃会宁青江驿、静宁界石铺一带

summary.zh: 红四方面军第四军先头部队与红一方面军在青江驿、界石铺会合，揭开三军会师序幕。
summary.en: Advance units of the Fourth Front Army’s 4th Army met the First Front Army at Qingjiangyi and Jieshipu, opening the three-army link-up.

fields.name: 青江驿、界石铺会师 Link-up at Qingjiangyi and Jieshipu 先头部队会师 Advance Guard Link-up 界石铺会师 Jieshipu Link-up
fields.place: 甘肃会宁青江驿、静宁界石铺一带 Qingjiangyi (Huining) and Jieshipu (Jingning), Gansu
fields.summary: 红四方面军第四军先头部队与红一方面军在青江驿、界石铺会合，揭开三军会师序幕。 Advance units of the Fourth Front Army’s 4th Army met the First Front Army at Qingjiangyi and Jieshipu, opening the three-army link-up.
fields.description: 1936 年 10 月 7 日，红四方面军第四军先头部队两个团抵达会宁县城，与红一方面军第十五军团第七十三师会合。10 月 8 日，第四军第十师在会宁青江驿、静宁界石铺等地与红一军团第一师会师。这两次会合早于 10 月 9 日主力入城，被称作三大主力会师的序幕；两军指战员虽连日行军，仍相互握手拥抱。会师后红四方面军总部与第四军、第三十一军于 10 月 9 日进入会宁县城。本坐标为界石铺代表点，青江驿在其西约 20 公里。 On 7 October 1936 two advance regiments of the Fourth Front Army’s 4th Army reached Huining county town and joined the First Front Army’s 15th Army Corps 73rd Division. On 8 October the 4th Army’s 10th Division met the 1st Army Corps’ 1st Division at Qingjiangyi in Huining and Jieshipu in Jingning. These meetings preceded the main forces’ entry on 9 October and are regarded as the opening of the three-army link-up; despite days of marching, the men embraced one another. The Fourth Front Army headquarters, the 4th Army and the 31st Army then entered Huining town on 9 October. The coordinate is a representative point at Jieshipu; Qingjiangyi lies about 20 km to its west.

atlasTitle.en: The Long March

summary.zh: 红一、红四方面军在会宁会师，10 月 10 日举行庆祝联欢大会；红二方面军随后在将台堡与红一方面军会师。
summary.en: The First and Fourth Front Armies met at Huining and held a celebration on 10 October; the Second Front Army later met the First at Jiangtaibao.

fields.name: 会宁会师 Huining link-up 三大主力会师 Meeting of the Three Main Forces
fields.summary: 红一、红四方面军在会宁会师，10 月 10 日举行庆祝联欢大会；红二方面军随后在将台堡与红一方面军会师。 The First and Fourth Front Armies met at Huining and held a celebration on 10 October; the Second Front Army later met the First at Jiangtaibao.
fields.description: 1936 年 10 月 9 日，朱德、张国焘、徐向前、陈昌浩率红军总部和第四军、第三十一军抵达甘肃会宁县城，与红一方面军会合，会宁会师实现。10 月 10 日黄昏，庆祝会师联欢大会在会宁县城文庙大成殿前举行，朱德宣读中共中央《为庆祝一、二、四方面军大会合通电》，通电宣告「我们即刻就要进入一个新阶段了，这就是抗日民族革命战争的阶段」。此前 10 月 7 日第四军先头部队已在会宁与红十五军团第七十三师会合，10 月 8 日第四军第十师在青江驿、界石铺与红一军团第一师会师。10 月 22 日，红二方面军与红一方面军在宁夏西吉将台堡会师，三大主力会师完成，长征胜利结束。本坐标为会宁县城代表点。 On 9 October 1936 Zhu De, Zhang Guotao, Xu Xiangqian, and Chen Changhao led the Red Army headquarters, the 4th Army, and the 31st Army into Huining county town in Gansu and joined the First Front Army, completing the Huining link-up. At dusk on 10 October a celebration was held before the Dacheng Hall of the Confucian temple in Huining, where Zhu De read the Central Committee’s “Message of Congratulation on the Great Union of the First, Second, and Fourth Front Armies,” which declared that “we are about to enter a new stage — the stage of the national revolutionary war against Japan.” Earlier, on 7 October, advance units of the 4th Army had met the 15th Army Corps’ 73rd Division at Huining, and on 8 October the 4th Army’s 10th Division met the 1st Army Corps’ 1st Division at Qingjiangyi and Jieshipu. On 22 October the Second Front Army met the First at Jiangtaibao in Xiji, Ningxia, completing the union of the three main forces and ending the Long March. The coordinate is a representative point at Huining county town.

atlasTitle.en: The Long March

place.zh: 甘肃甘谷磐安镇一带渭河渡口
place.en: Wei River crossings around Pan’an, Gangu, Gansu

summary.zh: 红二方面军在磐安、礼辛一带强渡渭河，摆脱追敌后北上通渭。
summary.en: The Second Front Army forced the Wei River around Pan’an and Lixin, escaped its pursuers, and moved north to Tongwei.

fields.name: 强渡渭河 Forcing the Wei River 红二方面军北渡渭河 Second Front Army Crossing the Wei River
fields.place: 甘肃甘谷磐安镇一带渭河渡口 Wei River crossings around Pan’an, Gangu, Gansu
fields.summary: 红二方面军在磐安、礼辛一带强渡渭河，摆脱追敌后北上通渭。 The Second Front Army forced the Wei River around Pan’an and Lixin, escaped its pursuers, and moved north to Tongwei.
fields.description: 1936 年 10 月 9 日至 11 日，红二方面军左、右纵队在甘谷磐安镇、礼辛镇一带就近选择渡口强渡渭河。时值深秋雨季，上游暴雨致河水暴涨，部分行至河心的指战员被洪水卷走；红军昼夜兼程，于 10 月 11 日在礼辛镇陈家庄一带集结完毕，随后经通渭榜罗镇北上，10 月 22 日到达将台堡与红一方面军会师。贺龙后来总结称「过渭河，狼狈极了」。本坐标为磐安镇渡口代表点。 From 9 to 11 October 1936 the Second Front Army’s left and right columns forced the Wei River at the nearest crossings around Pan’an and Lixin in Gangu. It was the autumn rainy season; upstream storms raised the river and swept away some men caught midstream. Marching day and night, the army assembled at Chenjiazhuang near Lixin on 11 October, then moved north via Bangluo in Tongwei and reached Jiangtaibao on 22 October to meet the First Front Army. He Long later summed up the crossing as “utterly wretched.” The coordinate is a representative point at the Pan’an crossing.

fields.summary: 红五军在华家岭大墩梁阻击敌军，罗南辉与 880 余名指战员牺牲。 The Fifth Army blocked the enemy at Dadunliang, Huajialing; Luo Nanhui and over 880 officers and men were killed.
fields.description: 1936 年 10 月，红一、二、四方面军在会宁、静宁地区会师后，国民党王均部、毛炳文部紧追。红五军副军长罗南辉奉命率部在通渭、会宁交界的华家岭大墩梁阻击，他此前已负伤，仍躺在担架上指挥。10 月 22 日至 23 日，红五军在大墩梁与敌军 9 个团激战，敌机 7 架轮番轰炸，红军多次反冲锋未能打退敌军，罗南辉和 880 余名指战员牺牲，完成了掩护主力转移的任务。本坐标为大墩梁代表点。 In October 1936, after the First, Second, and Fourth Front Armies met at Huining and Jingning, Wang Jun’s and Mao Bingwen’s forces pressed close. Luo Nanhui, deputy commander of the Fifth Army, was ordered to block them at Dadunliang in Huajialing on the Tongwei–Huining border; already wounded, he commanded from a stretcher. On 22–23 October the Fifth Army fought nine enemy regiments at Dadunliang while seven aircraft bombed in relays. Repeated counterattacks failed to drive the enemy back; Luo Nanhui and over 880 officers and men were killed, but the main force was covered in its withdrawal. The coordinate is a representative point at Dadunliang.

fields.description: 万历二十一年（1593）正月明军平壤大捷后南下，四月日军因粮尽与议和撤出汉城，五月明军与朝鲜军进驻。此后双方在和谈与战事之间反复，至万历二十六年（1598）露梁海战方告结束。 After the Ming victory at Pyongyang in the first month of 1593 the army moved south; in the fourth month the Japanese withdrew from Hanseong for lack of grain and to negotiate, and in the fifth month Ming and Korean troops entered. fields.description: 1645 年 4 月，清军攻破扬州，史可法殉国，随后清军在城中进行大规模屠杀，史称扬州十日。具体死亡人数为通行说法，本文只记事件性质。日期与经过待页码级核对。 In April 1645 Qing forces breached Yangzhou and Shi Kefa died; the city was then subjected to a large-scale massacre, known as the Ten Days of Yangzhou. Casualty figures follow conventional accounts; this entry records only the nature of the event. Dates and details await page-level verification.

fields.name: 隆武政权建立 The Longwu regime
fields.summary: 唐王朱聿键在福州称帝，建立隆武政权。 Prince Tang proclaimed himself emperor in Fuzhou, founding the Longwu regime.
fields.description: 1645 年 8 月，唐王朱聿键在福州称帝，改元隆武，继续抗清，倚重郑芝龙、黄道周等人。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In August 1645 Prince Tang proclaimed himself emperor in Fuzhou with the era name Longwu and continued resistance to the Qing, relying on figures such as Zheng Zhilong and Huang Daozhou. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: The coastal evacuation and sea ban

summary.zh: 清廷下令东南沿海迁界禁海。
summary.en: The Qing ordered coastal evacuation and a maritime ban.

fields.name: 迁界禁海 The coastal evacuation and sea ban
fields.summary: 清廷下令东南沿海迁界禁海。 The Qing ordered coastal evacuation and a maritime ban.
fields.description: 1661 年，清廷为切断郑氏补给，下令东南沿海迁界禁海，居民内迁，沿海经济受到重创。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 本事件为政治决策/政治运动，不绘制行军路线。 In 1661 the Qing court ordered coastal evacuation and a maritime ban to cut off Zheng Chenggong’s supplies. Residents were moved inland and the coastal economy suffered heavily. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification. This is a political decision/movement; no march route is drawn.

fields.name: 永历帝被俘 The capture of the Yongli Emperor
fields.summary: 吴三桂在昆明缢杀永历帝，南明终结。 Wu Sangui executed the Yongli Emperor in Kunming, ending the Southern Ming.

name.en: The Revolt of the Three Feudatories

summary.zh: 吴三桂在云南起兵，三藩之乱爆发。
summary.en: Wu Sangui rose in Yunnan, beginning the Revolt of the Three Feudatories.

fields.name: 三藩之乱 The Revolt of the Three Feudatories
fields.summary: 吴三桂在云南起兵，三藩之乱爆发。 Wu Sangui rose in Yunnan, beginning the Revolt of the Three Feudatories.
fields.description: 1673 年，平西王吴三桂在云南起兵反清，耿精忠、尚之信等响应，三藩之乱爆发，至 1681 年才被平定。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1673 Wu Sangui, Prince of Pingxi, rose against the Qing in Yunnan; Geng Jingzhong and Shang Zhixin soon joined, beginning the Revolt of the Three Feudatories, which was suppressed only in 1681. fields.description: 康熙二十二年（1683）设黑龙江将军驻瑷珲，屯兵备边；二十四年（1685）五月清军自瑷珲出师，六月彭春、郎坦率军围攻雅克萨，俄军守将托尔布津降，清军毁城而还，俄军旋复据之。 In 1683 the Heilongjiang command was established at Aihun to garrison the frontier; in the fifth month of 1685 the Qing army marched out, in the sixth month Peng Chun and Langtan besieged Albazin, its commander Tolbuzin surrendered, the Qing demolished the fort and withdrew, and the Russians soon reoccupied it.

fields.description: 1722 年，康熙帝去世，皇四子胤禛即位，次年改元雍正；其即位过程与遗诏真伪长期存在争议。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1722 the Kangxi Emperor died and his fourth son Yinzhen ascended the throne, adopting the Yongzheng era name the following year. The succession and the authenticity of the edict have long been debated. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Ming–Qing

summary.zh: 雍正帝在西南推行改土归流。
summary.en: The Yongzheng Emperor replaced native chieftains with appointed officials in the southwest.

fields.name: 改土归流 The replacement of native chieftains
fields.summary: 雍正帝在西南推行改土归流。 The Yongzheng Emperor replaced native chieftains with appointed officials in the southwest.
fields.description: 1726 年起，雍正帝在西南推行改土归流，废除土司，改设流官，加强对云南、贵州、广西等地的直接治理。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 From 1726 the Yongzheng Emperor promoted the replacement of native chieftains with appointed officials in the southwest, abolishing hereditary tusi and strengthening direct governance in Yunnan, Guizhou, and Guangxi. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.description: 1729 年，雍正帝因西北用兵设立军机处，后成为清朝最高决策机构，强化了皇权与政务效率。日期与制度为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1729, during the northwestern campaigns, the Yongzheng Emperor established the Grand Council, which became the Qing’s highest decision-making body and strengthened imperial control. fields.summary: 乾隆两次用兵金川，至 1776 年平定。 The Qianlong Emperor campaigned twice in Jinchuan, pacifying it by 1776.
fields.description: 1747 年起，乾隆帝两次对大小金川用兵，至 1776 年最终平定，是乾隆“十全武功”中耗时最长、耗费最大的一役。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 From 1747 the Qianlong Emperor launched two campaigns against the Jinchuan chiefdoms, finally pacifying them in 1776. It was the longest and most costly of the “Ten Great Campaigns.” Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: The Complete Library of the Four Treasuries

summary.zh: 清廷开馆编纂《四库全书》。

fields.name: 四库全书 The Complete Library of the Four Treasuries
fields.summary: 清廷开馆编纂《四库全书》。 The Qing court began compiling the Complete Library of the Four Treasuries.
fields.description: 1773 年，清廷开馆编纂《四库全书》，汇集历代典籍，同时大量禁毁“违碍”书籍，成为清代文化控制与文献整理的双重象征。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1773 the Qing court began compiling the Complete Library of the Four Treasuries, gathering texts from across history while also banning and destroying many works deemed objectionable—a dual symbol of literary compilation and cultural control. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Ming–Qing

summary.zh: 福康安连克擦木、济咙，西藏全境收复。
summary.en: Fukanggan took Chamu and Gyirong, completing the recovery of Tibet.

fields.name: 清军攻克济咙 Qing army takes Gyirong
fields.place: 西藏济咙（今吉隆） Gyirong (Jilong), Tibet
fields.summary: 福康安连克擦木、济咙，西藏全境收复。 Fukanggan took Chamu and Gyirong, completing the recovery of Tibet.
fields.description: 乾隆五十七年（1792）五月六日福康安、海兰察冒雨分五路攻擦木山隘，初七日克之；初八日败济咙援军，初十日克济咙，斩六百余、俘二百余，西藏全境收复。随后清军越喜马拉雅山入廓尔喀境，八月廓尔喀请降。 On 6 May 1792 Fukanggan and Hailanca attacked the Chamu pass in five columns during rain and took it on the 7th; on the 8th they beat the relief force from Gyirong and on the 10th took Gyirong, killing over 600 and capturing over 200, completing the recovery of Tibet. The army then crossed the Himalaya into Nepal and in the eighth month received Gorkha’s surrender.

place.zh: 西藏吉隆热索桥（中尼界桥）

summary.zh: 清军入廓尔喀境，在热索桥突破廓军河防。
summary.en: The Qing army entered Gorkha territory and broke the river defence at the Rasuwagadhi bridge.

fields.name: 热索桥之战 Battle of the Rasuwagadhi bridge
fields.place: 西藏吉隆热索桥（中尼界桥） Rasuwagadhi bridge, Gyirong, Tibet
fields.summary: 清军入廓尔喀境，在热索桥突破廓军河防。 The Qing army entered Gorkha territory and broke the river defence at the Rasuwagadhi bridge.
fields.description: 乾隆五十七年（1792）五月十四日清军过藏廓边界摆吗奈撒，十五日在热索桥与廓军激战：正面佯攻北岸碉楼，另遣土兵越山绕至上游伐木为筏渡河，袭南岸碉房，主力乘势搭桥夺取三座石碉。此后清军历协布鲁、东觉、噶勒拉、堆补木诸战，七月底逼近廓尔喀都城阳布，八月受降。 On 14 May 1792 the Qing army crossed the Tibet–Gorkha boundary at Paimainaisa; on the 15th it fought at the Rasuwagadhi bridge, feinting against the north-bank blockhouse while tribal troops crossed upstream on rafts to storm the south-bank posts, the main body then bridging the river and taking three stone blockhouses. The army went on to fight at Chukla, Dongjue, Ghalela and Dunbumu, closing on the Gorkha capital in late July and receiving its surrender in the eighth month.

name.en: The Qing campaign against the Gurkhas

summary.zh: 福康安率军入藏，击退廓尔喀。
summary.en: Fu Kang’an led Qing forces into Tibet and repelled the Gurkhas.

fields.name: 平定廓尔喀 The Qing campaign against the Gurkhas
fields.summary: 福康安率军入藏，击退廓尔喀。 Fu Kang’an led Qing forces into Tibet and repelled the Gurkhas.
fields.description: 1792 年，廓尔喀入侵西藏，福康安率清军入藏反击，收复失地并逼近廓尔喀，随后订立《钦定藏内善后章程》。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1792 the Gurkhas invaded Tibet. Fu Kang’an led Qing forces into Tibet, recovered the lost territory, and advanced toward Nepal, leading to the Qing regulations for Tibet. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 天理教攻入紫禁城，失败。
summary.en: The Eight Trigrams sect attacked the Forbidden City but was defeated.

fields.name: 天理教起义 The Eight Trigrams uprising
fields.summary: 天理教攻入紫禁城，失败。 The Eight Trigrams sect attacked the Forbidden City but was defeated.
fields.description: 1813 年，天理教（八卦教）在林清等率领下攻入紫禁城，与清军激战失败，史称癸酉之变。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1813 the Eight Trigrams sect, led by Lin Qing and others, attacked the Forbidden City. After fierce fighting the uprising failed, an event known as the Guiyou incident. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Ming–Qing

name.en: The destruction of opium at Humen

summary.zh: 林则徐在虎门销毁鸦片。
summary.en: Lin Zexu destroyed confiscated opium at Humen.

fields.name: 虎门销烟 The destruction of opium at Humen
fields.summary: 林则徐在虎门销毁鸦片。 Lin Zexu destroyed confiscated opium at Humen.
fields.description: 1839 年 6 月，钦差大臣林则徐在广东虎门海滩当众销毁收缴的鸦片，成为鸦片战争的直接导火索之一。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In June 1839 Imperial Commissioner Lin Zexu publicly destroyed confiscated opium at Humen, an event that helped trigger the First Opium War. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Ming–Qing

summary.zh: 英国舰队封锁珠江口，鸦片战争爆发。
summary.en: The British fleet blockaded the Pearl River estuary, beginning the First Opium War.

fields.name: 鸦片战争 The First Opium War
fields.summary: 英国舰队封锁珠江口，鸦片战争爆发。 The British fleet blockaded the Pearl River estuary, beginning the First Opium War.
fields.description: 1840 年，英国以禁烟为借口派舰队封锁珠江口，进攻虎门，鸦片战争爆发，清朝战败后签订《南京条约》。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1840 Britain used the opium crackdown as a pretext to blockade the Pearl River estuary and attack Humen, beginning the First Opium War. After defeat the Qing signed the Treaty of Nanjing. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Ming–Qing

summary.zh: 洪秀全在金田起义，建太平天国。
summary.en: Hong Xiuquan rose at Jintian and founded the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom.

fields.name: 太平天国 The Taiping Rebellion
fields.summary: 洪秀全在金田起义，建太平天国。 Hong Xiuquan rose at Jintian and founded the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom.
fields.description: 1851 年，洪秀全在广西金田起义，建号太平天国，随后攻占南京，成为清朝规模最大的内部战争。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1851 Hong Xiuquan rose at Jintian in Guangxi and founded the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom. The movement later captured Nanjing and became the largest internal war of the Qing period. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Ming–Qing

summary.zh: 总理衙门设立，洋务运动兴起。
summary.en: The Zongli Yamen was established, launching the Self-Strengthening Movement.

fields.name: 洋务运动 The Self-Strengthening Movement
fields.summary: 总理衙门设立，洋务运动兴起。 The Zongli Yamen was established, launching the Self-Strengthening Movement.
fields.description: 1861 年，清廷设立总理各国事务衙门，随后创办近代军工、民用企业与新式学堂，史称洋务运动，试图“师夷长技以自强”。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1861 the Qing established the Zongli Yamen (Foreign Office), followed by modern arsenals, enterprises, and schools. The Self-Strengthening Movement sought to adopt Western technology while preserving Qing rule. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Ming–Qing

summary.zh: 清廷设立京师同文馆，培养外语与洋务人才。
summary.en: The Qing founded the Tongwen Guan in Beijing to train foreign-language and technical talent.

fields.name: 京师同文馆 The Beijing Tongwen Guan
fields.summary: 清廷设立京师同文馆，培养外语与洋务人才。 The Qing founded the Tongwen Guan in Beijing to train foreign-language and technical talent.
fields.description: 1862 年，清廷设立京师同文馆，最初培养外语翻译人才，后增设算学、格致等课程，是洋务教育的重要起点。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1862 the Qing established the Tongwen Guan in Beijing, initially to train translators and later adding mathematics and science, a key starting point for modern education in the Self-Strengthening Movement. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Ming–Qing

summary.zh: 李鸿章奏设上海广方言馆，培养外语人才。
summary.en: Li Hongzhang founded the Shanghai Foreign Language School to train interpreters.

fields.name: 上海广方言馆 The Shanghai Foreign Language School
fields.summary: 李鸿章奏设上海广方言馆，培养外语人才。 Li Hongzhang founded the Shanghai Foreign Language School to train interpreters.
fields.description: 1863 年，李鸿章在上海奏设广方言馆，招收学生研习外语与西学，后并入江南制造总局翻译馆，是洋务教育的重要机构。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1863 Li Hongzhang founded the Shanghai Foreign Language School to teach foreign languages and Western learning. It later merged with the Jiangnan Arsenal’s translation department and became an important institution of Self-Strengthening education. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: Li Hongzhang founded the Jiangnan Arsenal in Shanghai.

fields.summary: 李鸿章创办江南制造总局。 Li Hongzhang founded the Jiangnan Arsenal in Shanghai.
fields.description: 1865 年，李鸿章在上海创办江南制造总局，制造枪炮、弹药与轮船，是洋务运动最重要的军工企业之一。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1865 Li Hongzhang founded the Jiangnan Arsenal in Shanghai to produce firearms, ammunition, and ships. It became one of the most important military enterprises of the Self-Strengthening Movement. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: Zuo Zongtang founded the Fuzhou Navy Yard.

fields.description: 1866 年，左宗棠在福州马尾创办福州船政局，附设船政学堂，培养海军与造船人才，是洋务运动的重要海军基地。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1866 Zuo Zongtang founded the Fuzhou Navy Yard at Mawei, with a naval school attached. It trained naval officers and shipbuilders and became a key base of the Self-Strengthening Movement. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 福州船政学堂开学，培养海军与造船人才。
summary.en: The Fuzhou Naval School opened to train naval officers and shipbuilders.

fields.name: 福州船政学堂 The Fuzhou Naval School
fields.summary: 福州船政学堂开学，培养海军与造船人才。 The Fuzhou Naval School opened to train naval officers and shipbuilders.
fields.description: 1867 年，福州船政学堂（求是堂艺局）在马尾开学，分前学堂与后学堂，分别培养造船与驾驶人才，被誉为中国近代海军的摇篮。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1867 the Fuzhou Naval School opened at Mawei with separate departments for shipbuilding and navigation, earning a reputation as the cradle of China’s modern navy. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 清廷派遣首批幼童赴美留学。
summary.en: The Qing sent the first group of young students to study in the United States.

fields.name: 留美幼童 The Chinese Educational Mission
fields.summary: 清廷派遣首批幼童赴美留学。 The Qing sent the first group of young students to study in the United States.
fields.description: 1872 年，在容闳推动下，清廷派遣首批幼童赴美留学，至 1875 年共派出四批，后因保守派反对于 1881 年撤回。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1872, promoted by Yung Wing, the Qing sent the first group of young students to the United States; four batches followed by 1875, but the mission was recalled in 1881 amid conservative opposition. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 李鸿章创办轮船招商局。

fields.name: 轮船招商局 The China Merchants’ Steam Navigation Company
fields.summary: 李鸿章创办轮船招商局。 Li Hongzhang founded the China Merchants’ Steam Navigation Company.
fields.description: 1872 年，李鸿章在上海创办轮船招商局，经营江海航运，与外国轮船公司竞争，是洋务运动“官督商办”的代表企业。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1872 Li Hongzhang founded the China Merchants’ Steam Navigation Company in Shanghai to operate river and coastal shipping in competition with foreign firms, a representative “official supervision and merchant management” enterprise. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Ming–Qing

name.en: The western army marches through the pass

summary.zh: 左宗棠自兰州移驻肃州，刘锦棠率军出关收复新疆。
summary.en: Zuo Zongtang moved to Suzhou and Liu Jintang led the army through the pass to recover Xinjiang.

fields.name: 西征军出关 The western army marches through the pass
fields.summary: 左宗棠自兰州移驻肃州，刘锦棠率军出关收复新疆。 Zuo Zongtang moved to Suzhou and Liu Jintang led the army through the pass to recover Xinjiang.
fields.description: 光绪元年（1875）五月清廷命左宗棠为钦差大臣督办新疆军务；二年（1876）四月左宗棠自兰州移驻肃州，刘锦棠率军出关，先克古牧地、乌鲁木齐，三年（1877）克达坂城、吐鲁番，阿古柏败死，四年（1878）正月除伊犁外新疆收复。 In the fifth month of 1875 the court made Zuo Zongtang imperial commissioner for Xinjiang; in the fourth month of 1876 he moved from Lanzhou to Suzhou and Liu Jintang led the army through the pass, taking Gucheng and Ürümqi, then Dabancheng and Turpan in 1877 as Yaqub Beg fell, so that by the first month of 1878 Xinjiang except Ili was recovered.

atlasTitle.en: Ming–Qing

summary.zh: 左宗棠率军收复新疆，除伊犁外全境平定。
summary.en: Zuo Zongtang recovered Xinjiang, pacifying the region except for Ili.

fields.name: 左宗棠收复新疆 Zuo Zongtang recovers Xinjiang
fields.place: 新疆乌鲁木齐 Urumqi, Xinjiang
fields.summary: 左宗棠率军收复新疆，除伊犁外全境平定。 Zuo Zongtang recovered Xinjiang, pacifying the region except for Ili.
fields.description: 1876—1878 年，左宗棠率清军西征，先后收复北疆与南疆，除沙俄占据的伊犁外，新疆重归清朝控制。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 From 1876 to 1878 Zuo Zongtang led Qing forces westward, recovering northern and southern Xinjiang. Except for Ili, held by Russia, the region returned to Qing control. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 李鸿章创办开平矿务局，开采煤矿。
summary.en: Li Hongzhang founded the Kaiping Mines to exploit coal deposits.

fields.name: 开平矿务局 The Kaiping Mines
fields.summary: 李鸿章创办开平矿务局，开采煤矿。 Li Hongzhang founded the Kaiping Mines to exploit coal deposits.
fields.description: 1878 年，李鸿章创办开平矿务局，采用机器开采煤矿，为轮船、军工与铁路提供燃料，是洋务民用企业的重要代表。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1878 Li Hongzhang founded the Kaiping Mines, using modern machinery to extract coal for steamships, arsenals, and railways, a major civilian enterprise of the Self-Strengthening Movement. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.name: 天津水师学堂 The Tianjin Naval Academy
fields.summary: 李鸿章创办天津水师学堂。 Li Hongzhang founded the Tianjin Naval Academy.
fields.description: 1880 年，李鸿章在天津创办水师学堂，由严复任总教习，培养北洋海军军官，是继福州船政学堂之后又一座海军学校。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1880 Li Hongzhang founded the Tianjin Naval Academy, with Yan Fu as chief instructor, to train officers for the Beiyang Navy. It was the second major naval school after Fuzhou. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 法国舰队袭击马尾，福建水师覆没。
summary.en: The French fleet attacked Mawei and destroyed the Fujian fleet.

fields.name: 中法战争 The Sino-French War
fields.summary: 法国舰队袭击马尾，福建水师覆没。 The French fleet attacked Mawei and destroyed the Fujian fleet.
fields.description: 1884 年，中法战争爆发，法国舰队在马尾袭击福建水师，福建水师几乎全军覆没；清军随后在镇南关等地取得胜利，最终签订《中法新约》。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1884 the Sino-French War broke out. The French fleet attacked the Fujian fleet at Mawei, almost annihilating it; Qing forces later won at Zhennanguan, and the war ended with the Treaty of Tianjin. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Ming–Qing

summary.zh: 清廷将台湾升格为省，刘铭传任巡抚。
summary.en: The Qing elevated Taiwan to a province, with Liu Mingchuan as governor.

fields.name: 台湾建省 Taiwan becomes a province
fields.summary: 清廷将台湾升格为省，刘铭传任巡抚。 The Qing elevated Taiwan to a province, with Liu Mingchuan as governor.
fields.description: 1885 年，清廷在中法战争后决定加强台湾防务，将台湾升格为省，以刘铭传为首任巡抚，推动铁路、电报与新政建设。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1885, after the Sino-French War, the Qing strengthened Taiwan’s defenses and elevated it to a province, appointing Liu Mingchuan as first governor; he promoted railways, telegraphs, and modern reforms. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 清廷颁布《北洋海军章程》，北洋海军正式成军。
summary.en: The Qing promulgated the Beiyang Navy regulations, formally establishing the fleet.

fields.summary: 清廷颁布《北洋海军章程》，北洋海军正式成军。 The Qing promulgated the Beiyang Navy regulations, formally establishing the fleet.
fields.description: 1888 年，清廷颁布《北洋海军章程》，北洋海军正式成军，拥有定远、镇远等铁甲舰，一度号称亚洲第一，但此后军费与训练渐弛。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1888 the Qing promulgated the Beiyang Navy regulations, formally establishing the fleet with the ironclads Dingyuan and Zhenyuan. Briefly rated the strongest in Asia, it later suffered from declining funding and training. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: Zhang Zhidong founded the Hanyang Ironworks.

fields.name: 汉阳铁厂 The Hanyang Ironworks
fields.summary: 张之洞创办汉阳铁厂。 Zhang Zhidong founded the Hanyang Ironworks.
fields.description: 1890 年，张之洞在汉阳创办铁厂，1894 年投产，是当时亚洲最大的钢铁企业之一，后与汉阳兵工厂、湖北织布局构成湖北洋务工业体系。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1890 Zhang Zhidong founded the Hanyang Ironworks, which began production in 1894 and became one of Asia’s largest steel enterprises, anchoring Hubei’s Self-Strengthening industrial complex. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 丰岛海战爆发，清军败于日本。
summary.en: The Battle of Pungdo began the First Sino-Japanese War, and the Qing were defeated.

fields.name: 甲午战争 The First Sino-Japanese War
fields.summary: 丰岛海战爆发，清军败于日本。 The Battle of Pungdo began the First Sino-Japanese War, and the Qing were defeated.
fields.description: 1894 年，日本海军在丰岛海面袭击清军运兵船，甲午战争爆发；清军在海陆战场接连失利，最终签订《马关条约》。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1894 the Japanese navy attacked Qing transports near Pungdo, beginning the First Sino-Japanese War. After defeats on land and sea, the Qing signed the Treaty of Shimonoseki. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: The Japanese fleet attacked Chinese transports near Fengdao.

fields.summary: 日本舰队在丰岛附近袭击清军运兵船。 The Japanese fleet attacked Chinese transports near Fengdao.

Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军进攻成欢，清军败退牙山。
summary.en: Japanese forces attacked Seonghwan and drove the Qing army back to Asan.

fields.name: 成欢之战 The Battle of Seonghwan
fields.summary: 日军进攻成欢，清军败退牙山。 Japanese forces attacked Seonghwan and drove the Qing army back to Asan.
fields.description: 1894 年 7 月 29 日，日军进攻驻守朝鲜成欢的清军，清军战败后向牙山方向退却，聂士成等率部突围，甲午陆战由此展开。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 29 July 1894 Japanese forces attacked the Qing garrison at Seonghwan. After defeat the Qing troops withdrew toward Asan, with Nie Shicheng’s units breaking out, opening the land war of 1894–95. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Ming–Qing

summary.zh: 清军与日军在平壤激战，清军败退。
summary.en: Qing and Japanese forces fought at Pyongyang, and the Qing army retreated.

fields.name: 平壤战役 The Battle of Pyongyang
fields.summary: 清军与日军在平壤激战，清军败退。 Qing and Japanese forces fought at Pyongyang, and the Qing army retreated.
fields.description: 1894 年 9 月，清军集结平壤与日军决战，激战一日后败退，退回鸭绿江以北，朝鲜战局急转直下。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In September 1894 Qing forces concentrated at Pyongyang for a decisive battle. After a day of fighting they were defeated and withdrew north of the Yalu, and the war in Korea turned sharply against China. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: The Battle of the Yellow Sea

summary.zh: 北洋水师与日本联合舰队在黄海激战。
summary.en: The Beiyang Fleet and the Japanese Combined Fleet fought in the Yellow Sea.

fields.name: 黄海海战 The Battle of the Yellow Sea
fields.summary: 北洋水师与日本联合舰队在黄海激战。 The Beiyang Fleet and the Japanese Combined Fleet fought in the Yellow Sea.
fields.description: 1894 年 9 月 17 日，北洋水师护送运兵船返航时在黄海大东沟附近与日本联合舰队遭遇，激战数小时，北洋水师损失多艘军舰，失去黄海制海权。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 17 September 1894 the Beiyang Fleet, escorting transports home, encountered the Japanese Combined Fleet near the Yalu estuary. After hours of fighting the Chinese fleet lost several ships and command of the Yellow Sea. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军突破鸭绿江防线，攻占九连城。

atlasTitle.en: Ming–Qing

summary.zh: 日军突破鸭绿江，攻占旅顺。
summary.en: Japanese forces crossed the Yalu and captured Lüshun.

fields.name: 辽东战役 The Liaodong campaign
fields.summary: 日军突破鸭绿江，攻占旅顺。 Japanese forces crossed the Yalu and captured Lüshun.
fields.description: 1894 年 10 月起，日军突破鸭绿江防线，接连攻占安东、金州与旅顺，并在旅顺制造大屠杀，北洋海防体系崩溃。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 From October 1894 Japanese forces broke through the Yalu defenses and captured Andong, Jinzhou, and Lüshun, carrying out a massacre at Lüshun and collapsing the Beiyang coastal defense system. summary.zh: 李鸿章与日本签订《马关条约》。
summary.en: Li Hongzhang signed the Treaty of Shimonoseki with Japan.

fields.name: 马关条约 The Treaty of Shimonoseki
fields.summary: 李鸿章与日本签订《马关条约》。 Li Hongzhang signed the Treaty of Shimonoseki with Japan.
fields.description: 1895 年 4 月，李鸿章在日本马关与日方签订《马关条约》，割让台湾、澎湖与辽东半岛，赔款二亿两，允许日本在华设厂，震动朝野。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In April 1895 Li Hongzhang signed the Treaty of Shimonoseki at Shimonoseki, ceding Taiwan, the Penghu Islands, and the Liaodong Peninsula, imposing a 200-million-tael indemnity, and permitting Japanese factories in China, shocking the Qing court and public. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: The establishment of the Taiwan Governor-General’s Office

fields.description: 1895 年 5 月，日本在台北设立台湾总督府，桦山资纪任首任总督，开始对台湾的殖民统治，与台湾民主国的抵抗同时展开。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In May 1895 Japan established the Taiwan Governor-General’s Office in Taipei, with Kabayama Sukenori as first governor-general, beginning colonial rule even as the Republic of Formosa resisted. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: Japanese forces landed in Taiwan, beginning the Yiwei War of resistance.

fields.name: 乙未战争 The Yiwei War
fields.summary: 日军登陆台湾，台湾军民展开乙未战争。 Japanese forces landed in Taiwan, beginning the Yiwei War of resistance.

Taiwanese and Qing forces fought through Taipei, Hsinchu, Miaoli, Changhua, and Tainan until the fall of Tainan in October. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.summary: 日军攻占台南，乙未战争结束。 Japanese forces captured Tainan, ending the Yiwei War.
fields.description: 1895 年 10 月，日军进攻台南，刘永福内渡，台湾民主国灭亡，乙未战争结束，台湾进入日本殖民统治时期。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In October 1895 Japanese forces took Tainan. Liu Yongfu fled to the mainland, the Republic of Formosa collapsed, and the Yiwei War ended, beginning the period of Japanese colonial rule in Taiwan. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Ming–Qing

summary.zh: 清廷以赎金换回辽东半岛。
summary.en: The Qing redeemed the Liaodong Peninsula with an indemnity.

fields.name: 辽南条约 The Treaty of Liaonan
fields.summary: 清廷以赎金换回辽东半岛。 The Qing redeemed the Liaodong Peninsula with an indemnity.
fields.description: 1895 年 11 月，中日签订《辽南条约》，清廷以三千万两白银赎回辽东半岛，日军撤出旅顺、大连，三国干涉还辽至此落地。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In November 1895 China and Japan signed the Treaty of Liaonan. The Qing paid a 30-million-tael indemnity to redeem the Liaodong Peninsula, and Japanese forces withdrew from Lüshun and Dalian, concluding the Triple Intervention settlement. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Ming–Qing

summary.zh: 清军接收旅顺，处理善后与海防重建。
summary.en: Qing forces recovered Lüshun and began postwar reconstruction.

fields.name: 旅顺善后 The recovery of Lüshun
fields.summary: 清军接收旅顺，处理善后与海防重建。 Qing forces recovered Lüshun and began postwar reconstruction.
fields.description: 1895 年 12 月，清军接收旅顺，处理日军撤离后的善后事宜，重建海防与地方秩序，但北洋海防已难以恢复旧观。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In December 1895 Qing forces recovered Lüshun and handled postwar matters after the Japanese withdrawal, rebuilding coastal defense and local order, though the Beiyang defense system never regained its former strength. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: Jian Dashi rose against the Japanese in the Taipei area.

fields.description: 1895 年底，简大狮在台北一带起事抗日，袭击日军据点，后转战台湾北部，最终失败并内渡。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 At the end of 1895 Jian Dashi rose against Japanese rule in the Taipei area, attacking Japanese posts and later moving across northern Taiwan before his ultimate defeat and return to the mainland. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 台北芝山岩的日本教师遭袭击，日方展开报复。
summary.en: Japanese teachers at Zhishanyan were attacked, prompting reprisals.

fields.name: 芝山岩事件 The Zhishanyan incident
fields.summary: 台北芝山岩的日本教师遭袭击，日方展开报复。 Japanese teachers at Zhishanyan were attacked, prompting reprisals.
fields.description: 1896 年 1 月，台北士林芝山岩的日本小学教师遭抗日民众袭击，多人死亡，日方随后展开报复性扫荡。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In January 1896 Japanese schoolteachers at Zhishanyan in Shilin, Taipei, were attacked by anti-Japanese locals, and several were killed. Japanese forces responded with reprisal sweeps. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军在云林进行报复性扫荡。
summary.en: Japanese forces carried out reprisal sweeps in Yunlin.

fields.summary: 日军在云林进行报复性扫荡。 Japanese forces carried out reprisal sweeps in Yunlin.
fields.description: 1896 年 6 月，日军在云林一带进行报复性扫荡，造成大量平民死亡，史称云林事件（云林大屠杀）。具体死亡人数仍有争议，本文只记事件性质。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In June 1896 Japanese forces carried out reprisal sweeps in the Yunlin area, causing heavy civilian deaths, an event known as the Yunlin incident (or Yunlin massacre). Casualty figures remain disputed; this entry records only the nature of the event. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.description: 1896 年，柯铁虎等人在云林古坑铁国山建立抗日据点，坚持游击战，多次击退日军围剿，成为台湾中部抗日的重要力量。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1896 Ke Tiehu and other fighters established a resistance base at Tieguoshan in Gukeng, Yunlin, waging guerrilla warfare and repelling repeated Japanese sweeps, becoming a major force in central Taiwan. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: Germany leased Jiaozhou Bay, setting off a scramble for concessions.

fields.name: 列强租借港湾 The scramble for concessions
fields.summary: 德国租借胶州湾，列强掀起瓜分狂潮。 Germany leased Jiaozhou Bay, setting off a scramble for concessions.
fields.description: 1898 年，德国强迫清廷租借胶州湾，俄、英、法、日等国随后纷纷租借港湾、划分势力范围，中国面临被瓜分的危机。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1898 Germany forced the Qing to lease Jiaozhou Bay. Russia, Britain, France, and Japan soon leased ports and carved out spheres of influence, confronting China with the threat of partition. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

He later negotiated with the Japanese and was defeated in 1902. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: The Boxer Uprising and the Eight-Nation Alliance

summary.zh: 义和团进入北京，八国联军侵华。
summary.en: The Boxers entered Beijing and the Eight-Nation Alliance intervened.

fields.name: 义和团与八国联军 The Boxer Uprising and the Eight-Nation Alliance
fields.summary: 义和团进入北京，八国联军侵华。 The Boxers entered Beijing and the Eight-Nation Alliance intervened.
fields.description: 1900 年，义和团运动高涨并进入北京，清廷对列强宣战；八国联军攻占北京，慈禧太后西逃，次年签订《辛丑条约》。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1900 the Boxer movement spread to Beijing and the Qing court declared war on the powers. The Eight-Nation Alliance captured Beijing, the court fled west, and the Boxer Protocol was signed in 1901. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: The Mutual Protection of Southeast China

summary.zh: 东南督抚与列强达成互保协议。
summary.en: Southeast governors and foreign powers agreed to mutual protection.

fields.name: 东南互保 The Mutual Protection of Southeast China
fields.summary: 东南督抚与列强达成互保协议。 Southeast governors and foreign powers agreed to mutual protection.
fields.description: 1900 年义和团运动期间，刘坤一、张之洞等东南督抚与列强驻沪领事达成“东南互保”协议，避免战火波及东南各省，显示清廷中央权威的衰落。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 During the Boxer crisis of 1900, governors Liu Kunyi and Zhang Zhidong reached a “mutual protection” agreement with foreign consuls in Shanghai, keeping the war out of southeastern provinces and revealing the decline of central authority. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 清廷推行新政，废科举、练新军。
summary.en: The Qing launched the New Policies, abolishing the civil service exams and creating a modern army.

fields.name: 清末新政 The Late Qing reforms
fields.summary: 清廷推行新政，废科举、练新军。 The Qing launched the New Policies, abolishing the civil service exams and creating a modern army.
fields.description: 1901 年起，清廷推行新政，包括改革官制、废科举、练新军、兴学堂等，试图挽救统治危机，但未能阻止革命。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 From 1901 the Qing implemented the New Policies, reforming the bureaucracy, abolishing the civil service examinations, creating a modern army, and founding schools. The reforms failed to prevent revolution. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Ming–Qing

name.en: The abolition of the imperial examinations

summary.zh: 清廷诏废科举，千年科举制终结。
summary.en: The Qing abolished the imperial examinations after a millennium.

fields.name: 废科举 The abolition of the imperial examinations
fields.summary: 清廷诏废科举，千年科举制终结。 The Qing abolished the imperial examinations after a millennium.
fields.description: 1905 年 9 月，清廷诏令自 1906 年起停止科举，延续千年的科举制度终结，新式学堂成为主要上升通道。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In September 1905 the Qing court ordered the imperial examinations stopped from 1906, ending a system that had lasted a millennium and making modern schools the main path to advancement. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.name: 上海城厢内外总工程局 The Shanghai General Works Bureau
fields.summary: 上海绅商成立城厢内外总工程局。 Shanghai elites founded the General Works Bureau.
fields.description: 1905 年 10 月，上海地方绅商成立城厢内外总工程局，办理市政、警务与公益，是清末地方自治的重要实践。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In October 1905 Shanghai elites founded the General Works Bureau for the city’s inner and outer districts, handling municipal administration, policing, and public welfare—an important experiment in late Qing local self-government. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: The Qing sent five ministers abroad to study constitutional government.

fields.summary: 清廷派五大臣出洋考察宪政。 The Qing sent five ministers abroad to study constitutional government.
fields.description: 1905 年 12 月，清廷派载泽、端方等五大臣出洋考察宪政，为预备立宪做准备，回国后推动了 1906 年的预备立宪诏。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In December 1905 the Qing sent ministers including Zaitze and Duanfang abroad to study constitutional government, preparing for the 1906 announcement of preparations for a constitution. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: The Qing court announced preparations for constitutional government.

fields.name: 预备立宪 The preparation for constitutional government
fields.summary: 清廷宣布预备立宪。 The Qing court announced preparations for constitutional government.
fields.description: 1906 年，清廷在五大臣出洋考察后宣布“预备仿行宪政”，推行官制改革，但进展缓慢，未能挽回人心。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1906, after the five ministers’ overseas investigations, the Qing court announced preparations for constitutional government and reformed the bureaucracy, but progress was slow and failed to restore public confidence. fields.name: 钦定宪法大纲 The Principles of the Constitution
fields.summary: 清廷颁布《钦定宪法大纲》。 The Qing court issued the Principles of the Constitution.
fields.description: 1908 年，清廷颁布《钦定宪法大纲》，规定君上大权，并以九年为预备立宪期限，被立宪派批评为“假立宪”。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1908 the Qing court issued the Principles of the Constitution, preserving broad imperial powers and setting a nine-year preparatory period. Constitutionalists criticized it as “fake constitutionalism.” Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.description: 1909 年 1 月，清廷颁布《城镇乡地方自治章程》，推行地方自治，设立议事会与董事会，为立宪派参与地方政治提供制度空间。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In January 1909 the Qing promulgated regulations on local self-government in towns and villages, establishing councils and boards and giving constitutionalists an institutional foothold in local politics. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

atlasTitle.en: Ming–Qing

name.en: The petition movement for a parliament

summary.zh: 各省代表赴京请愿，要求速开国会。
summary.en: Provincial delegates petitioned Beijing for an early national parliament.

fields.name: 国会请愿运动 The petition movement for a parliament
fields.summary: 各省代表赴京请愿，要求速开国会。 Provincial delegates petitioned Beijing for an early national parliament.
fields.description: 1910 年，各省咨议局与商会、教育会等团体发起三次国会请愿运动，要求缩短预备立宪期限、速开国会，清廷仅小幅让步，立宪派日益失望。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1910 provincial assemblies, chambers of commerce, and educational associations launched three petition campaigns demanding that the Qing shorten the preparatory period and convene a parliament. The court made only minor concessions, and constitutionalists grew increasingly disillusioned. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: The election of the Advisory Council

summary.zh: 资政院议员选举后开院，立宪派进入中央议事机构。
summary.en: After elections, the Advisory Council opened, bringing constitutionalists into a central deliberative body.

fields.name: 资政院选举 The election of the Advisory Council
fields.summary: 资政院议员选举后开院，立宪派进入中央议事机构。 After elections, the Advisory Council opened, bringing constitutionalists into a central deliberative body.
fields.description: 1909 年各省选举资政院议员，1910 年 10 月资政院开院，成为清末立宪派参与中央政治的重要平台，但权限有限，未能满足速开国会的要求。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1909 the provinces elected members of the Advisory Council, which opened in October 1910 as a central deliberative body for constitutionalists. Its powers were limited, however, and it failed to satisfy demands for a parliament. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.name: 资政院弹劾军机大臣 The Advisory Council impeaches the Grand Council
fields.summary: 资政院弹劾军机大臣，要求责任内阁。 The Advisory Council impeached the Grand Council and demanded a responsible cabinet.
fields.description: 1910 年 12 月，资政院第一次常年会弹劾军机大臣，要求设立责任内阁，与清廷发生正面冲突，显示资政院与皇权的张力。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In December 1910 the Advisory Council’s first annual session impeached the Grand Council and demanded a responsible cabinet, clashing directly with the court and revealing the tension between the council and imperial authority. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 四川保路运动爆发，成为辛亥革命导火索。
summary.en: The Sichuan Railway Protection Movement erupted, helping trigger the 1911 Revolution.

fields.name: 保路运动 The Railway Protection Movement
fields.summary: 四川保路运动爆发，成为辛亥革命导火索。 The Sichuan Railway Protection Movement erupted, helping trigger the 1911 Revolution.
fields.description: 1911 年，清廷宣布铁路国有，激起四川保路运动，清廷调湖北新军入川镇压，削弱了武汉防务，为武昌起义创造了条件。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 本事件为政治决策/政治运动，不绘制行军路线。 In 1911 the Qing move to nationalize railways sparked the Sichuan Railway Protection Movement. Troops were drawn from Hubei to suppress it, weakening Wuhan’s defenses and creating conditions for the Wuchang Uprising. summary.en: The Song army was ambushed by Western Xia forces at Haoshuichuan and suffered heavy losses.

fields.name: 好水川之战 Battle of Haoshuichuan
fields.place: 宁夏隆德北好水川（今甜水河一带） Haoshuichuan north of Longde, Ningxia
fields.summary: 宋军在好水川被西夏军伏击，损失惨重。 The Song army was ambushed by Western Xia forces at Haoshuichuan and suffered heavy losses.
fields.description: 庆历元年（1041）二月，元昊率十万众自天都山、折姜南下，沿瓦亭川抵好水川设伏，另遣偏师至怀远城诱敌。韩琦命任福率一万八千人自镇戎军经怀远城、得胜寨趋羊牧隆城，出夏军之后；任福在张家堡被诱，脱离辎重追击，二月十四日在好水川中伏，宋军大败，任福、桑怿、武英、王珪等战死，士卒阵亡一万余人。旧数据作 1040 年，实为庆历元年（1041）二月。 In the second month of 1041 Li Yuanhao marched south from Tiandu shan and Zhejiang along the Wating river and laid an ambush at Haoshuichuan, sending a detachment to lure the Song army at Huaiyuan. Han Qi ordered Ren Fu with 18,000 men from Zhenrongjun via Huaiyuan and Desheng towards Yangmulong to fall on the enemy’s rear; lured at Zhangjiabao, Ren Fu abandoned his baggage and was ambushed at Haoshuichuan on 14 February. The Song army was routed and Ren Fu, Sang Yi, Wu Ying and Wang Gui were killed with over 10,000 men. The old data dated the battle 1040; it was actually the second month of 1041.

atlasTitle.en: Song–Yuan

summary.zh: 韩琦闻元昊谋寇渭州，急趋镇戎军调兵万八千人付任福。
summary.en: Han Qi hurried to Zhenrongjun and gave Ren Fu 18,000 men against Li Yuanhao.

fields.name: 韩琦赴镇戎军调兵 Han Qi mobilises at Zhenrongjun
fields.place: 宁夏固原（宋镇戎军） Guyuan, Ningxia (Song Zhenrongjun)
fields.summary: 韩琦闻元昊谋寇渭州，急趋镇戎军调兵万八千人付任福。 Han Qi hurried to Zhenrongjun and gave Ren Fu 18,000 men against Li Yuanhao.
fields.description: 庆历元年（1041）二月，韩琦巡边至高平，闻元昊阅兵折姜、谋寇渭州，急趋镇戎军，尽出守兵并募敢勇共一万八千人，命环庆路副都部署任福统率，令自镇戎军经怀远城、得胜寨至羊牧隆城出夏军之后，并再三戒其持重。任福轻进，遂有好水川之败。 In the second month of 1041 Han Qi, on the frontier at Gaoping, learned that Li Yuanhao was massing at Zhejiang for an attack on Weizhou. He hurried to Zhenrongjun, turned out the garrison and raised 18,000 men under Ren Fu, ordering him to march via Huaiyuan and Desheng to Yangmulong and strike the enemy’s rear, warning him repeatedly to be cautious. Ren Fu advanced rashly and was destroyed at Haoshuichuan.

fields.description: 1044 年，宋夏经过长期战争后议和，西夏向宋称臣，宋每年赐银、绢、茶，史称庆历和议。日期与条款为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1044, after years of war, Song and Western Xia negotiated peace. fields.summary: 宋军围攻灵州，西夏决黄河水灌宋营，宋军溃退。 Song forces besieged Lingzhou; Western Xia diverted the Yellow River and routed them.
fields.description: 1081 年，北宋五路伐夏，刘昌祚部进围灵州，西夏决黄河水灌宋军营地，宋军补给断绝，大败而退。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1081, the Northern Song launched a five-route campaign against Western Xia. Liu Changzuo besieged Lingzhou, but Western Xia diverted the Yellow River into the Song camps, cutting supplies and forcing a retreat. name.en: Gao Shengtai usurps the Dali throne

summary.zh: 权臣高升泰废段正明，建立大中国，后还政段氏。
summary.en: The minister Gao Shengtai deposed Duan Zhengming and briefly founded the state of Dazhong.

fields.name: 高升泰代立 Gao Shengtai usurps the Dali throne
fields.summary: 权臣高升泰废段正明，建立大中国，后还政段氏。 The minister Gao Shengtai deposed Duan Zhengming and briefly founded the state of Dazhong.
fields.description: 1094 年大理权臣高升泰废段正明自立，国号大中国；1096 年高升泰死，其子高泰明遵遗命还政段氏，迎段正淳立，大理国进入后理国时期。此后高氏世为相国，分治善阐等府，形成国都羊苴咩城与东京善阐并重的格局。 In 1094 the Dali minister Gao Shengtai deposed Duan Zhengming and proclaimed the Great China; on his death in 1096 his son Gao Taiming restored the Duan house and enthroned Duan Zhengchun, beginning the Later Dali period. The Gao family then held the chancellorship hereditarily and governed Shanchan and other fu, giving the realm two centres, the capital Yangjumie and the eastern capital Shanchan.

atlasTitle.en: Song–Yuan

summary.zh: 方腊在睦州起义，攻占江南多州。
summary.en: Fang La rose at Muzhou and captured several prefectures in Jiangnan.

fields.name: 方腊起义 The Fang La rebellion
fields.summary: 方腊在睦州起义，攻占江南多州。 Fang La rose at Muzhou and captured several prefectures in Jiangnan.
fields.description: 宣和二年（1120）十月初九，方腊在睦州青溪县帮源洞起事，以诛朱勔为名，数日聚众数万。十一月二十二日在青溪息坑全歼两浙路常驻官军五千人，十二月克睦州、歙州，二十九日攻入杭州。宋廷以童贯为江淮荆浙宣抚使，率十五万禁军及西北蕃汉兵南下，宣和三年（1121）二月围杭州、三月复睦州与青溪、四月破帮源洞，方腊被擒，八月伏诛。 On 9 October 1120 Fang La rose at Bangyuan cave in Qingxi, Muzhou, in the name of punishing Zhu Mian, gathering tens of thousands within days. On 22 November he destroyed the 5,000-strong standing army of Liangzhe at Xikeng, took Muzhou and Shezhou in the twelfth month and entered Hangzhou on the 29th. The court sent Tong Guan south with 150,000 men; Hangzhou was besieged in the second month of 1121, Muzhou and Qingxi recovered in the third and Bangyuan cave broken in the fourth, Fang La being captured and executed in the eighth month.

summary.zh: 方腊军攻入杭州，杀两浙路制置使陈建、廉访使赵约。
summary.en: Fang La’s army entered Hangzhou, killing the Liangzhe commissioner Chen Jian and the inspector Zhao Yue.

fields.name: 方腊攻占杭州 Fang La takes Hangzhou
fields.summary: 方腊军攻入杭州，杀两浙路制置使陈建、廉访使赵约。 Fang La’s army entered Hangzhou, killing the Liangzhe commissioner Chen Jian and the inspector Zhao Yue.
fields.description: 宣和二年（1120）十二月，方腊军自睦州、歙州东进，攻克富阳、新城，二十九日进逼杭州。知州赵霆弃城走，义军入城，杀两浙路制置使陈建、廉访使赵约，纵火六日。杭州既失，东南震动，宋廷急命童贯率十五万军南下。 In the twelfth month of 1120 Fang La’s army moved east from Muzhou and Shezhou, took Fuyang and Xincheng and closed on Hangzhou on the 29th. Governor Zhao Ting fled, the rebels entered and killed the Liangzhe commissioner Chen Jian and inspector Zhao Yue, burning the city for six days. With Hangzhou lost the south-east was shaken and the court sent Tong Guan south with 150,000 men.

summary.zh: 宋军合围帮源洞，方腊被擒，起义失败。
summary.en: The Song army closed on Bangyuan cave, captured Fang La and ended the revolt.

fields.name: 帮源洞之战 Battle of Bangyuan cave
fields.place: 浙江淳安（青溪）帮源洞 Bangyuan cave, Chun’an (Qingxi), Zhejiang
fields.summary: 宋军合围帮源洞，方腊被擒，起义失败。 The Song army closed on Bangyuan cave, captured Fang La and ended the revolt.
fields.description: 宣和三年（1121）四月，王禀自睦州、刘镇自歙州合围青溪帮源洞。二十四日官军自洞后突入、纵火为号，前后夹击，义军战死七万余人；二十六日方腊及其妻、子、丞相方肥等五十二人被俘，七月解往汴京，八月伏诛。 In the fourth month of 1121 Wang Bing from Muzhou and Liu Zhen from Shezhou closed on Bangyuan cave in Qingxi. On the 24th the Song troops broke in from the rear and lit fires as a signal, attacking from both sides; over 70,000 rebels died. On the 26th Fang La, his family and chancellor Fang Fei — 52 people — were captured, sent to Kaifeng in the seventh month and executed in the eighth.

fields.description: 1215 年，蒙古军攻占金中都，金宣宗此前已迁都汴京，金朝在华北的统治受到重创。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1215, the Mongols captured Jin’s central capital.
